```js
// test/clashpanel/support/fakeScheduler.mjs
// Deterministic Scheduler (core/scheduler.js contract). No wall-clock time: virtual time only moves in `advance`.
// `yield()` is microtask-only and counted; `yieldHook(n)` runs at every yield (a test can bump a generation or throw at
// a chosen yield point); `holdYields()` makes yields wait until `release()`.
/** One real macrotask turn: every already-queued microtask (promise continuation) has run when it resolves. */
export const flush = () => new Promise((resolve) => { setImmediate(resolve); });

export function createFakeScheduler({ start = 0 } = {}) {
  let time = start;
  let nextId = 1;
  let order = 0;
  let yields = 0;
  let held = null;
  const timers = new Map();
  const delays = [];
  const scheduler = {
    yieldHook: null,
    delays,
    now: () => time,
    setTimeout(fn, ms) {
      if (typeof fn !== 'function') throw new TypeError('fake scheduler: setTimeout needs a function');
      const id = nextId;
      nextId += 1;
      const delay = Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0);
      delays.push(delay);
      order += 1;
      timers.set(id, { at: time + delay, order, fn });
      return id;
    },
    clearTimeout(id) { timers.delete(id); },
    async yield() {
      yields += 1;
      if (scheduler.yieldHook !== null) await scheduler.yieldHook(yields);
      if (held !== null) await held.promise;
    },
    holdYields() {
      let release;
      const promise = new Promise((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
      held = { promise };
      return { release() { held = null; release(); } };
    },
    /** Fire every timer due within `ms` of virtual time (including timers scheduled by fired timers), oldest first. */
    async advance(ms) {
      if (!(ms >= 0)) throw new RangeError('fake scheduler: advance needs ms >= 0');
      const target = time + ms;
      for (;;) {
        let nextKey = null;
        let next = null;
        for (const [key, t] of timers) {
          if (t.at <= target && (next === null || t.at < next.at || (t.at === next.at && t.order < next.order))) { next = t; nextKey = key; }
        }
        if (next === null) break;
        timers.delete(nextKey);
        time = Math.max(time, next.at);
        next.fn();
        await flush();
      }
      time = target;
      await flush();
    },
    pendingTimers: () => timers.size,
    get yieldCount() { return yields; },
  };
  return scheduler;
}
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/support/fakeCatalog.mjs
// Host ModelCatalog double (spec 5.2). Mutators change state only; call `fire()` to notify (so a test controls the order
// of a Viewer event, a catalog change and a readiness change). Display names and model->key mappings OUTLIVE removal,
// exactly like the real host contract (rows for unloaded models still show a name).
export function createFakeCatalog({ models = [], basis = { state: 'verified', basisKey: 'fake-basis' }, omitMeasurementBasis = false } = {}) {
  const entries = [];
  const names = new Map();
  const keyByModel = new WeakMap();
  const listeners = new Set();
  const calls = { list: 0, displayNameFor: [], keyOfModel: 0, measurementBasis: [] };
  let basisSource = basis;

  const normalize = (e) => {
    const modelKey = e.modelKey ?? null;
    const displayName = e.displayName ?? (modelKey ?? 'Unnamed model');
    return { modelKey, displayName, model: e.model ?? { fakeModel: modelKey ?? displayName }, loaded: e.loaded ?? true };
  };
  const catalog = {
    calls,
    list() { calls.list += 1; return entries.map((e) => ({ ...e })); },
    displayNameFor(key) { calls.displayNameFor.push(key); return names.get(key) ?? null; },
    keyOfModel(model) { calls.keyOfModel += 1; return keyByModel.get(model) ?? null; },
    onChange(cb) {
      if (typeof cb !== 'function') throw new TypeError('catalog.onChange: callback must be a function');
      listeners.add(cb);
      return () => { listeners.delete(cb); };
    },
    listenerCount: () => listeners.size,
    /** Add (or replace, same modelKey = a reload with a new Model object) a model; returns its Model object. */
    addModel(entry) {
      const e = normalize(entry);
      const at = e.modelKey === null ? -1 : entries.findIndex((x) => x.modelKey === e.modelKey);
      if (at >= 0) entries[at] = e; else entries.push(e);
      if (e.modelKey !== null) { names.set(e.modelKey, e.displayName); keyByModel.set(e.model, e.modelKey); }
      return e.model;
    },
    removeModel(key) {
      const at = entries.findIndex((x) => x.modelKey === key);
      if (at >= 0) entries.splice(at, 1);
    },
    setLoaded(key, loaded) {
      const e = entries.find((x) => x.modelKey === key);
      if (!e) throw new Error(`fake catalog: no model ${key}`);
      e.loaded = Boolean(loaded);
    },
    modelOf: (key) => entries.find((x) => x.modelKey === key)?.model ?? null,
    setBasis(verdictOrFn) { basisSource = verdictOrFn; },
    fire() { for (const cb of [...listeners]) cb(); },
  };
  if (!omitMeasurementBasis) {
    catalog.measurementBasis = (keys) => {
      calls.measurementBasis.push([...keys]);
      return typeof basisSource === 'function' ? basisSource([...keys]) : basisSource;
    };
  }
  for (const m of models) catalog.addModel(m);
  return catalog;
}
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/support/fakeEngine.mjs
// EnginePort double with the REAL RunHandle semantics (spec 7.1, catalog 1): sync startRun, frozen-shape members,
// state/unit/persistence events only, persistence may arrive after terminal, `done`/`persisted` never reject,
// `resultSet` may be null. Reading ANY forbidden member (register/unregister/keyOf/notifyPlacementChanged/
// invalidateModelPlacement/dispose/...) throws AND is recorded in `forbiddenAccess` (AC-P20).
import {
  DerivationAbortedError, ReadAbortedError, ResultNotResidentError, ResultSetRetainedError, UnsavedResultSetError,
} from '../../../clashtest/index.js';

export const FORBIDDEN_ENGINE_MEMBERS = Object.freeze([
  'invalidateModelPlacement', 'dispose', 'retryPersist', 'rerun', 'getResultSet', 'discardRun', 'saveTest',
  'getPairStatus', 'getElementStatus',
]);
export const FORBIDDEN_REGISTRY_MEMBERS = Object.freeze(['register', 'unregister', 'keyOf', 'notifyPlacementChanged']);

export function createDeferred() {
  let resolve;
  let reject;
  const promise = new Promise((res, rej) => { resolve = res; reject = rej; });
  return { promise, resolve, reject };
}
/** A shared, ordered call journal: pass the same array to createFakeEngine and createFakeBridge to assert ordering. */
export const createJournal = () => [];

const persistedFrom = (p) => {
  if (p.state === 'saved') return { state: 'saved' };
  if (p.state === 'failed') return { state: 'failed', error: p.error ?? new Error('persist failed') };
  if (p.state === 'skipped') return { state: 'skipped', reason: p.reason ?? 'no-store' };
  return null; // 'pending': settled later by finishPersisted
};

export function createFakeHandle({ runId, journal = null, autoFinishOnCancel = false, onFinish = null, onPersisted = null } = {}) {
  let snapshot = Object.freeze({
    runId, status: 'queued', phase: 'queued', seq: 0, unitsTotal: 0, unitsEvaluated: 0, unitsFailedOrSkipped: 0,
    pairSpaceTotal: 0, pairSpaceEvaluated: 0, pairSpaceProcessed: 0, fractionEvaluated: 0, fractionProcessed: null,
    resultsFound: 0, caveatCount: 0, caveatUnclassified: 0, currentUnitId: null, elapsedMs: 0,
  });
  let seq = 0;
  let terminal = false;
  const listeners = new Set();
  const done = createDeferred();
  const persisted = createDeferred();
  const cancelCalls = [];
  const deliver = (event) => { for (const l of [...listeners]) { try { l(event); } catch { /* the real handle swallows listener errors */ } } };
  const step = (fields) => {
    seq += 1;
    snapshot = Object.freeze({ ...snapshot, seq, status: fields.status ?? snapshot.status, phase: fields.phase ?? snapshot.phase });
    return seq;
  };
  const handle = {
    runId,
    getSnapshot: () => snapshot,
    subscribe(fn) {
      if (typeof fn !== 'function') throw new TypeError('subscribe: listener must be a function');
      listeners.add(fn);
      return () => { listeners.delete(fn); };
    },
    cancel(reason) {
      cancelCalls.push(reason);
      if (journal) journal.push('handle.cancel');
      if (!terminal && (snapshot.status === 'running' || snapshot.status === 'planning')) handle.emitState({ status: 'cancelling', phase: snapshot.phase });
      if (autoFinishOnCancel && !terminal) handle.finish({ status: 'cancelled' });
      return done.promise;
    },
    done: done.promise,
    persisted: persisted.promise,
    // ---- test controls (not part of the real handle) ----
    cancelCalls,
    listenerCount: () => listeners.size,
    setSnapshot(partial) { snapshot = Object.freeze({ ...snapshot, ...partial }); return snapshot; },
    emitState(fields = {}) {
      const s = step(fields);
      const event = {
        type: 'state', seq: s, status: snapshot.status, phase: snapshot.phase,
        ...(fields.terminal ? { terminal: true } : {}), ...(fields.persistence ? { persistence: fields.persistence } : {}),
        ...(fields.cause !== undefined ? { cause: fields.cause } : {}),
      };
      deliver(event);
      return event;
    },
    emitUnit(fields = {}) {
      const s = step(fields);
      const event = { type: 'unit', seq: s, status: snapshot.status, phase: snapshot.phase };
      deliver(event);
      return event;
    },
    emitPersistence(fields = {}) {
      seq += 1;
      const event = { type: 'persistence', state: 'saved', timedOut: false, attempt: 1, ...fields, seq };
      deliver(event);
      return event;
    },
    /** Terminal transition: terminal state event, then `done` resolves once. `resultSet` defaults to null (seal failed). */
    finish({ status = 'completed', resultSet = null, persistence = { state: 'saved', timedOut: false, attempt: 1 } } = {}) {
      if (terminal) return done.promise;
      terminal = true;
      handle.emitState({ status, phase: 'terminal', terminal: true, persistence });
      if (onFinish) onFinish(runId, { status, resultSet, persistence });
      done.resolve({ runId, status, resultSet, persistence });
      const p = persistedFrom(persistence);
      if (p !== null) persisted.resolve(p);
      return done.promise;
    },
    /** Settle `persisted` (independent of `done`): for a `pending` run that later saves or fails. */
    finishPersisted(outcome) {
      handle.emitPersistence({ state: outcome.state, ...(outcome.error ? { error: outcome.error } : {}), ...(outcome.reason ? { reason: outcome.reason } : {}) });
      if (onPersisted) onPersisted(runId, outcome);
      persisted.resolve(outcome);
    },
  };
  return handle;
}

function createAsyncSpy({ abortError, defaultResult, onStart, onSettle }) {
  const spy = { calls: [], mode: 'auto', result: defaultResult, scripted: [] };
  spy.fn = (...args) => {
    const last = args[args.length - 1];
    const signal = last !== null && typeof last === 'object' && !Array.isArray(last) ? (last.signal ?? null) : null;
    const d = createDeferred();
    const call = { args, signal, settled: false, promise: d.promise };
    const settle = (kind, value) => {
      if (call.settled) return;
      call.settled = true;
      if (signal) signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
      if (onSettle) onSettle(call);
      if (kind === 'resolve') d.resolve(value); else d.reject(value);
    };
    const onAbort = () => settle('reject', abortError());
    call.resolve = (v) => settle('resolve', v);
    call.reject = (e) => settle('reject', e);
    spy.calls.push(call);
    if (onStart) onStart(call);
    if (signal) {
      if (signal.aborted) { settle('reject', abortError()); return d.promise; }
      signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    }
    if (spy.scripted.length > 0) { const err = spy.scripted.shift(); queueMicrotask(() => settle('reject', err)); return d.promise; }
    if (spy.mode === 'auto') {
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        try { settle('resolve', typeof spy.result === 'function' ? spy.result(...args) : spy.result); } catch (e) { settle('reject', e); }
      });
    }
    return d.promise;
  };
  spy.hold = () => { spy.mode = 'manual'; return spy; };
  spy.auto = () => { spy.mode = 'auto'; return spy; };
  spy.setResult = (v) => { spy.result = v; return spy; };
  spy.rejectNext = (err, times = 1) => { for (let i = 0; i < times; i += 1) spy.scripted.push(err); return spy; };
  spy.pending = () => spy.calls.filter((c) => !c.settled);
  return spy;
}

const DEFAULT_SUMMARY = { totalResults: 0, resultsCaveated: 0, unitOutcomes: [], planningGaps: [], gapWeight: 0 };

/**
 * @param {{ bindings?: Array<{modelKey:string, model?:object, modelVersion?:string, bindingGeneration?:number, placementGeneration?:number}>,
 *           journal?: string[]|null, runIdPrefix?: string, strict?: boolean }} [options]
 *   strict (default true): releaseResultSet enforces the real residency contract (ResultSetRetainedError while leased,
 *   UnsavedResultSetError for a non-saved set unless {acknowledgeUnsaved:true}); non-resident ids are a no-op.
 */
export function createFakeEngine({ bindings = [], journal = null, runIdPrefix = 'run-', strict = true } = {}) {
  const bindingMap = new Map();
  const calls = { validateTest: [], startRun: [], retainResultSet: [], releaseResultSet: [], getPersistenceState: [], bindingFor: [] };
  const order = [];
  const handles = [];
  const leases = [];
  const resident = new Set();
  const persistenceStates = new Map();
  const forbiddenAccess = [];
  const startRunErrors = [];
  const retainErrors = [];
  const releaseErrors = [];
  const stats = { inFlight: 0, maxInFlight: 0, total: 0 };
  let validateSource = { issues: [], issuesTruncated: false };
  let startRunOverride = null;

  const note = (name) => { order.push(name); if (journal) journal.push(`engine.${name}`); };
  const bindingOf = (b) => {
    const model = b.model ?? { fakeModel: b.modelKey };
    return Object.freeze({
      modelKey: b.modelKey, model, modelVersion: b.modelVersion ?? 'v1', lease: Object.freeze({ model, epoch: 1 }),
      bindingGeneration: b.bindingGeneration ?? 1, placementGeneration: b.placementGeneration ?? 0,
    });
  };
  for (const b of bindings) bindingMap.set(b.modelKey, bindingOf(b));

  const trackDerivation = {
    onStart: (call) => { note(call.kind); stats.inFlight += 1; stats.total += 1; stats.maxInFlight = Math.max(stats.maxInFlight, stats.inFlight); },
    onSettle: () => { stats.inFlight -= 1; },
  };
  const derivationSpy = (kind, defaultResult) => {
    const spy = createAsyncSpy({
      abortError: () => new DerivationAbortedError(), defaultResult,
      onStart: (call) => { call.kind = kind; trackDerivation.onStart(call); }, onSettle: trackDerivation.onSettle,
    });
    return spy;
  };
  const readSpy = (kind, defaultResult) => createAsyncSpy({
    abortError: () => new ReadAbortedError(), defaultResult, onStart: () => note(kind),
  });
  const spies = {
    getFreshness: readSpy('getFreshness', { state: 'current', reasons: [] }),
    assessNoClashClaim: readSpy('assessNoClashClaim', { allowed: false, unqualified: false, qualifiers: [], exclusions: [], proofMethod: 'fake' }),
    summarize: derivationSpy('summarize', DEFAULT_SUMMARY),
    groupBy: derivationSpy('groupBy', { facets: [], unavailable: [], total: 0, memberships: 0, groups: [] }),
    filter: derivationSpy('filter', { matches: [], count: 0, total: 0, unavailable: [] }),
  };

  const makeResident = (runId, persistence = { state: 'saved', timedOut: false, attempt: 1 }) => {
    resident.add(runId);
    persistenceStates.set(runId, persistence);
  };
  const registry = {
    bindingFor(key) { note('bindingFor'); calls.bindingFor.push(key); return bindingMap.get(key) ?? null; },
  };
  const engine = {
    // ---- the EnginePort surface ----
    validateTest(def) {
      note('validateTest');
      calls.validateTest.push(def);
      return typeof validateSource === 'function' ? validateSource(def) : validateSource;
    },
    startRun(def, opts) {
      note('startRun');
      calls.startRun.push({ def, opts });
      if (startRunErrors.length > 0) throw startRunErrors.shift();
      if (startRunOverride) return startRunOverride(def, opts);
      const handle = createFakeHandle({
        runId: `${runIdPrefix}${handles.length + 1}`, journal,
        onFinish: (runId, { resultSet, persistence }) => { if (resultSet !== null) makeResident(runId, persistence); },
        onPersisted: (runId, outcome) => {
          persistenceStates.set(runId, outcome.state === 'saved' ? { state: 'saved', timedOut: false, attempt: 1 } : { state: outcome.state, timedOut: false, attempt: 1, ...(outcome.error ? { error: outcome.error } : {}), ...(outcome.reason ? { reason: outcome.reason } : {}) });
        },
      });
      handle.definition = def;
      handles.push(handle);
      return handle;
    },
    retainResultSet(runId) {
      note('retainResultSet');
      calls.retainResultSet.push(runId);
      if (retainErrors.length > 0) throw retainErrors.shift();
      if (!resident.has(runId)) throw new ResultNotResidentError({ runId });
      const state = persistenceStates.get(runId);
      if (!state || state.state !== 'saved') throw new UnsavedResultSetError({ runId });
      const record = { runId, released: false, releaseCalls: 0 };
      leases.push(record);
      return Object.freeze({
        release() {
          record.releaseCalls += 1;
          if (journal) journal.push('lease.release');
          record.released = true;
        },
      });
    },
    releaseResultSet(runId, opts) {
      note('releaseResultSet');
      calls.releaseResultSet.push({ runId, opts });
      if (releaseErrors.length > 0) throw releaseErrors.shift();
      if (!resident.has(runId)) return undefined;
      if (strict) {
        if (leases.some((l) => l.runId === runId && !l.released)) throw new ResultSetRetainedError({ runId });
        const state = persistenceStates.get(runId);
        if ((!state || state.state !== 'saved') && opts?.acknowledgeUnsaved !== true) throw new UnsavedResultSetError({ runId });
      }
      resident.delete(runId);
      return undefined;
    },
    getPersistenceState(runId) { note('getPersistenceState'); calls.getPersistenceState.push(runId); return persistenceStates.get(runId) ?? null; },
    getFreshness: spies.getFreshness.fn,
    assessNoClashClaim: spies.assessNoClashClaim.fn,
    derivations: { summarize: spies.summarize.fn, groupBy: spies.groupBy.fn, filter: spies.filter.fn },
    registry,
    // ---- test controls ----
    calls, order, handles, leases, forbiddenAccess, spies,
    get lastHandle() { return handles[handles.length - 1] ?? null; },
    derivationStats: () => ({ ...stats }),
    residentRunIds: () => [...resident],
    makeResident,
    setBinding(b) { bindingMap.set(b.modelKey, bindingOf(b)); },
    removeBinding(key) { bindingMap.delete(key); },
    setValidate(resultOrFn) { validateSource = resultOrFn; },
    setStartRun(fn) { startRunOverride = fn; },
    failNextStartRun(err, times = 1) { for (let i = 0; i < times; i += 1) startRunErrors.push(err); },
    failNextRetain(err) { retainErrors.push(err); },
    failNextRelease(err) { releaseErrors.push(err); },
    setPersistenceState(runId, state) { persistenceStates.set(runId, state); },
  };
  const forbid = (target, name, label) => Object.defineProperty(target, name, {
    enumerable: true,
    get() { forbiddenAccess.push(label); throw new Error(`AC-P20: ${label} must never be touched by the Panel`); },
  });
  for (const name of FORBIDDEN_ENGINE_MEMBERS) forbid(engine, name, `engine.${name}`);
  for (const name of FORBIDDEN_REGISTRY_MEMBERS) forbid(registry, name, `registry.${name}`);
  return engine;
}
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/support/fakeBridge.mjs
// ViewerBridge PORT double (catalog 3): what the controller may call. Records every call; `auto` (default) resolves each
// call with a sensible outcome, `holdAll()` switches to manual so a test resolves each call itself (interleavings).
import { createDeferred } from './fakeEngine.mjs';

const presentDefault = (req, prerequisite) => ({
  superseded: false, fitted: Boolean(req?.options?.focus), isolated: Boolean(req?.options?.isolate) && prerequisite.available,
  marked: Boolean(req?.options?.marker), notes: [],
});

export function createFakeBridge({ auto = true, journal = null, prerequisite = { available: true, reason: null }, selection = [] } = {}) {
  const calls = { present: [], clear: [], dispose: [], afterDispose: [], checkIsolationPrerequisite: 0, readAggregateSelection: 0 };
  const leftListeners = new Set();
  const failures = { present: [], clear: [], dispose: [] };
  const listenerErrors = [];
  let mode = auto ? 'auto' : 'manual';
  let disposed = false;
  let prereq = prerequisite;
  let sel = selection;
  let presentOutcome = null;
  let clearOutcome = { isolation: 'none', markersRemoved: 0, notes: [] };
  const note = (name) => { if (journal) journal.push(`bridge.${name}`); };

  function enqueue(kind, record, defaultOutcome) {
    const d = createDeferred();
    const call = { ...record, settled: false, promise: d.promise };
    call.resolve = (outcome = defaultOutcome) => { if (call.settled) return; call.settled = true; d.resolve(outcome); };
    call.reject = (error) => { if (call.settled) return; call.settled = true; d.reject(error); };
    calls[kind].push(call);
    if (failures[kind].length > 0) { const error = failures[kind].shift(); queueMicrotask(() => call.reject(error)); } else if (mode === 'auto') queueMicrotask(() => call.resolve());
    return d.promise;
  }

  const bridge = {
    calls, listenerErrors,
    present(req) {
      note('present');
      if (disposed) { calls.afterDispose.push({ kind: 'present', req }); return Promise.resolve({ disposed: true, superseded: false, fitted: false, isolated: false, marked: false, notes: [] }); }
      const dflt = typeof presentOutcome === 'function' ? presentOutcome(req) : (presentOutcome ?? presentDefault(req, prereq));
      return enqueue('present', { req }, dflt);
    },
    clear() {
      note('clear');
      if (disposed) { calls.afterDispose.push({ kind: 'clear' }); return Promise.resolve({ disposed: true, isolation: 'none', markersRemoved: 0, notes: [] }); }
      return enqueue('clear', {}, clearOutcome);
    },
    dispose() {
      note('dispose');
      if (disposed) { calls.afterDispose.push({ kind: 'dispose' }); return Promise.resolve(); }
      disposed = true;
      leftListeners.clear();
      return enqueue('dispose', {}, undefined);
    },
    checkIsolationPrerequisite() { calls.checkIsolationPrerequisite += 1; return { ...prereq }; },
    readAggregateSelection() { calls.readAggregateSelection += 1; return sel.map((e) => ({ model: e.model, dbIds: [...e.dbIds] })); },
    onModelLeft(cb) {
      if (typeof cb !== 'function') throw new TypeError('bridge.onModelLeft: callback must be a function');
      leftListeners.add(cb);
      return () => { leftListeners.delete(cb); };
    },
    // ---- test controls ----
    get disposed() { return disposed; },
    holdAll() { mode = 'manual'; return bridge; },
    autoAll() { mode = 'auto'; return bridge; },
    pending: (kind) => calls[kind].filter((c) => !c.settled),
    setPrerequisite(v) { prereq = v; },
    setSelection(list) { sel = list; },
    setPresentOutcome(valueOrFn) { presentOutcome = valueOrFn; },
    setClearOutcome(v) { clearOutcome = v; },
    failNext(kind, error) { failures[kind].push(error); },
    modelLeftListenerCount: () => leftListeners.size,
    emitModelLeft(payload) {
      for (const cb of [...leftListeners]) { try { cb(payload); } catch (e) { listenerErrors.push(e); } }
    },
  };
  return bridge;
}
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/support/fakeThree.mjs
// r71-subset THREE double: exactly the classes the Panel's viewer layer may use. Vector3 deliberately has NO setScalar
// (absent in r71). Geometries/materials count their dispose() calls so a test can prove shared resources are disposed
// once, only after their meshes are gone, and per-object geometry is disposed at removal.
export function createFakeThree() {
  const created = { geometry: [], material: [], mesh: [], line: [] };

  class Vector3 {
    constructor(x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) { this.x = x; this.y = y; this.z = z; }
    set(x, y, z) { this.x = x; this.y = y; this.z = z; return this; }
    copy(v) { return this.set(v.x, v.y, v.z); }
    clone() { return new Vector3(this.x, this.y, this.z); }
    add(v) { return this.set(this.x + v.x, this.y + v.y, this.z + v.z); }
    sub(v) { return this.set(this.x - v.x, this.y - v.y, this.z - v.z); }
    multiplyScalar(s) { return this.set(this.x * s, this.y * s, this.z * s); }
    length() { return Math.hypot(this.x, this.y, this.z); }
    distanceTo(v) { return Math.hypot(this.x - v.x, this.y - v.y, this.z - v.z); }
    equals(v) { return this.x === v.x && this.y === v.y && this.z === v.z; }
    toArray() { return [this.x, this.y, this.z]; }
  }
  class Color {
    constructor(hex = 0xffffff) { this.hex = hex; }
    set(hex) { this.hex = hex; return this; }
  }
  class Box3 {
    constructor(min = new Vector3(Infinity, Infinity, Infinity), max = new Vector3(-Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity)) { this.min = min; this.max = max; }
    set(min, max) { this.min = min; this.max = max; return this; }
    setFromPoints(points) {
      this.min = new Vector3(Infinity, Infinity, Infinity);
      this.max = new Vector3(-Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity);
      for (const p of points) {
        this.min.set(Math.min(this.min.x, p.x), Math.min(this.min.y, p.y), Math.min(this.min.z, p.z));
        this.max.set(Math.max(this.max.x, p.x), Math.max(this.max.y, p.y), Math.max(this.max.z, p.z));
      }
      return this;
    }
    isEmpty() { return this.max.x < this.min.x || this.max.y < this.min.y || this.max.z < this.min.z; }
    getCenter(target = new Vector3()) { return target.set((this.min.x + this.max.x) / 2, (this.min.y + this.max.y) / 2, (this.min.z + this.max.z) / 2); }
    getSize(target = new Vector3()) { return target.set(this.max.x - this.min.x, this.max.y - this.min.y, this.max.z - this.min.z); }
  }
  class BufferGeometry {
    constructor() { this.points = []; this.disposeCount = 0; created.geometry.push(this); }
    setFromPoints(points) {
      if (!Array.isArray(points) || !points.every((p) => p instanceof Vector3)) throw new TypeError('BufferGeometry.setFromPoints: expected an array of Vector3');
      this.points = points.map((p) => p.clone());
      return this;
    }
    dispose() { this.disposeCount += 1; }
  }
  class SphereGeometry extends BufferGeometry {
    constructor(radius = 50, widthSegments = 8, heightSegments = 6) { super(); this.parameters = { radius, widthSegments, heightSegments }; }
  }
  class Material {
    constructor(parameters = {}) { this.parameters = { ...parameters }; this.disposeCount = 0; created.material.push(this); }
    dispose() { this.disposeCount += 1; }
  }
  class MeshBasicMaterial extends Material {}
  class LineBasicMaterial extends Material {}
  class Object3D {
    constructor() { this.position = new Vector3(); this.scale = new Vector3(1, 1, 1); this.name = ''; this.userData = {}; this.visible = true; }
  }
  class Mesh extends Object3D {
    constructor(geometry, material) {
      super();
      if (!(geometry instanceof BufferGeometry)) throw new TypeError('Mesh: geometry must be a BufferGeometry');
      if (!(material instanceof Material)) throw new TypeError('Mesh: material must be a Material');
      this.geometry = geometry; this.material = material; this.isMesh = true; created.mesh.push(this);
    }
  }
  class Line extends Object3D {
    constructor(geometry, material) {
      super();
      if (!(geometry instanceof BufferGeometry)) throw new TypeError('Line: geometry must be a BufferGeometry');
      if (!(material instanceof Material)) throw new TypeError('Line: material must be a Material');
      this.geometry = geometry; this.material = material; this.isLine = true; created.line.push(this);
    }
  }
  const THREE = { REVISION: '71', Vector3, Color, Box3, BufferGeometry, SphereGeometry, MeshBasicMaterial, LineBasicMaterial, Object3D, Mesh, Line };
  const stats = {
    created,
    liveGeometries: () => created.geometry.filter((g) => g.disposeCount === 0),
    liveMaterials: () => created.material.filter((m) => m.disposeCount === 0),
    overDisposed: () => [...created.geometry, ...created.material].filter((x) => x.disposeCount > 1),
  };
  return { THREE, stats };
}
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/support/fakeViewer.mjs
// Viewer3D-shaped double (catalog 1, "Viewer"): public overlay API with MESH FIRST / SCENE NAME SECOND (throws on a
// non-string scene name, like the repo's fake), full-replace aggregate isolation with the verified semantics, both
// fitToView forms, event listeners, and injectable failures (`failNext`, optionally AFTER the state change, for the
// ambiguous-throw matrix of AC-P16). Every theming method, `impl`, selection mutators and per-model visibility
// methods THROW and are recorded: the Panel must never call them (AC-P19; theming message is exactly 'theming forbidden').
export const FAKE_EVENTS = Object.freeze({
  BEFORE_MODEL_UNLOAD: 'fake:before-model-unload', MODEL_REMOVED: 'fake:model-removed', MODEL_ADDED: 'fake:model-added',
});
export const THEMING_METHODS = Object.freeze(['setThemingColor', 'clearThemingColors', 'getThemingColor', 'updateThemingColors']);
export const FORBIDDEN_VIEWER_METHODS = Object.freeze([
  'select', 'setSelection', 'setAggregateSelection', 'clearSelection', 'isolate', 'hide', 'show', 'showAll', 'hideModel', 'setAllVisibility',
]);

export function createFakeModel({ id = 1, name = `Model ${id}`, names = {}, boxes = {}, hasObjectTree = true } = {}) {
  const model = { id, displayName: name, nodeNameCalls: [], deprecatedInstanceTreeCalls: 0, boundsCalls: [], boundsMode: 'ok' };
  const tree = {
    getNodeName(dbId) { model.nodeNameCalls.push(dbId); return Object.hasOwn(names, dbId) ? names[dbId] : null; },
    getNodeBox(dbId, out) { const b = boxes[dbId]; if (b) for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += 1) out[i] = b[i]; },
  };
  model.getObjectTree = () => (hasObjectTree ? tree : null);
  model.getInstanceTree = () => { model.deprecatedInstanceTreeCalls += 1; return hasObjectTree ? tree : null; };
  /** World-space bounds as the (evidence-gated) ViewerApi would return them: a fresh [minx,miny,minz,maxx,maxy,maxz] or null. */
  model.worldBounds = (dbId) => {
    model.boundsCalls.push(dbId);
    if (model.boundsMode === 'throw') throw new Error('bounds unavailable');
    if (model.boundsMode === 'null' || !boxes[dbId]) return null;
    return [...boxes[dbId]];
  };
  model.setBoundsMode = (m) => { model.boundsMode = m; };
  return model;
}

export function createFakeViewer({ models = [], isolation = [], hiddenNodes = [], selection = [] } = {}) {
  const state = { models: [...models], isolation: [], hiddenNodes: [...hiddenNodes], selection: [...selection], scenes: new Map(), foreignTheming: [] };
  const calls = { getAllModels: 0, getAggregateIsolation: 0, getAggregateHiddenNodes: 0, getAggregateSelection: 0, setAggregateIsolation: [], fitToView: [], overlay: [] };
  const listeners = new Map();
  const listenerLog = [];
  const injections = new Map();
  const forbiddenCalls = [];
  const themingCalls = [];
  const copyIso = (list) => list.map((e) => ({ model: e.model, ids: [...e.ids] }));
  const guarded = (name, effect) => {
    const injection = injections.get(name)?.shift();
    if (injection && !injection.afterEffect) throw injection.error;
    const result = effect();
    if (injection && injection.afterEffect) throw injection.error;
    return result;
  };
  const sceneName = (op, name) => {
    if (typeof name !== 'string') throw new TypeError(`overlays.${op}: scene name must be a string (mesh FIRST, scene name SECOND)`);
    return name;
  };
  const isMesh = (op, mesh) => {
    if (mesh === null || typeof mesh !== 'object') throw new TypeError(`overlays.${op}: mesh must be an object`);
    return mesh;
  };

  const overlays = {
    hasScene(name) { calls.overlay.push({ op: 'hasScene', args: [name] }); return state.scenes.has(sceneName('hasScene', name)); },
    addScene(name) {
      calls.overlay.push({ op: 'addScene', args: [name] });
      sceneName('addScene', name);
      return guarded('addScene', () => { if (state.scenes.has(name)) return false; state.scenes.set(name, new Set()); return true; });
    },
    addMesh(mesh, name) {
      calls.overlay.push({ op: 'addMesh', args: [mesh, name] });
      isMesh('addMesh', mesh); sceneName('addMesh', name);
      return guarded('addMesh', () => { const s = state.scenes.get(name); if (!s) return false; s.add(mesh); return true; });
    },
    removeMesh(mesh, name) {
      calls.overlay.push({ op: 'removeMesh', args: [mesh, name] });
      isMesh('removeMesh', mesh); sceneName('removeMesh', name);
      return guarded('removeMesh', () => { const s = state.scenes.get(name); return s ? s.delete(mesh) : false; });
    },
    removeScene(name) {
      calls.overlay.push({ op: 'removeScene', args: [name] });
      sceneName('removeScene', name);
      return guarded('removeScene', () => state.scenes.delete(name));
    },
  };

  const viewer = {
    calls, forbiddenCalls, themingCalls, listenerLog, aggregateFit: true, overlays,
    getAllModels() { calls.getAllModels += 1; return [...state.models]; },
    getAggregateIsolation() { calls.getAggregateIsolation += 1; return guarded('getAggregateIsolation', () => copyIso(state.isolation)); },
    getAggregateHiddenNodes() { calls.getAggregateHiddenNodes += 1; return guarded('getAggregateHiddenNodes', () => [...state.hiddenNodes]); },
    setAggregateIsolation(list) {
      if (!Array.isArray(list) || !list.every((e) => e && typeof e === 'object' && e.model && Array.isArray(e.ids))) {
        throw new TypeError('setAggregateIsolation: expected [{ model, ids: number[] }]');
      }
      calls.setAggregateIsolation.push(copyIso(list));
      return guarded('setAggregateIsolation', () => {
        if (list.length === 0) { state.isolation = []; state.hiddenNodes = []; return; }      // show-all-of-everything, also clears hidden state
        const loaded = new Set(state.models);
        state.isolation = copyIso(list.filter((e) => loaded.has(e.model) && e.ids.length > 0)); // unloaded ignored; {model, ids:[]} = show the whole model
      });
    },
    fitToView(first, second, third) {
      const aggregate = Array.isArray(first) && first.length > 0 && first[0] !== null && typeof first[0] === 'object' && 'model' in first[0];
      calls.fitToView.push({ form: aggregate ? 'aggregate' : 'ids', args: [first, second, third] });
      if (aggregate) {
        if (viewer.aggregateFit === false) throw new TypeError('fitToView: aggregate form is not supported by this viewer');
        if (!first.every((e) => Array.isArray(e.selection))) throw new TypeError('fitToView: aggregate entries need a `selection` array');
      } else if (!Array.isArray(first)) throw new TypeError('fitToView: expected an array of dbIds');
      guarded('fitToView', () => undefined);
    },
    getAggregateSelection() { calls.getAggregateSelection += 1; return guarded('getAggregateSelection', () => state.selection.map((e) => ({ model: e.model, selection: [...e.selection] }))); },
    addEventListener(name, fn) {
      listenerLog.push({ op: 'add', name });
      if (!listeners.has(name)) listeners.set(name, new Set());
      listeners.get(name).add(fn);
    },
    removeEventListener(name, fn) { listenerLog.push({ op: 'remove', name }); listeners.get(name)?.delete(fn); },
    // ---- test controls ----
    listenerCount: (name) => (name === undefined ? [...listeners.values()].reduce((n, s) => n + s.size, 0) : (listeners.get(name)?.size ?? 0)),
    dispatch(name, payload = {}) { for (const fn of [...(listeners.get(name) ?? [])]) fn({ type: name, ...payload }); },
    addModel(model) { state.models.push(model); },
    removeModel(model) { state.models = state.models.filter((m) => m !== model); state.isolation = state.isolation.filter((e) => e.model !== model); },
    setIsolationState(list) { state.isolation = copyIso(list); },
    setHiddenNodes(list) { state.hiddenNodes = [...list]; },
    setSelectionState(list) { state.selection = list.map((e) => ({ model: e.model, selection: [...e.selection] })); },
    overlayScenes: () => [...state.scenes.keys()],
    overlayMeshes: (name) => [...(state.scenes.get(name) ?? [])],
    seedForeignTheming(entries) { state.foreignTheming = entries.map((e) => ({ ...e })); },
    themingState: () => state.foreignTheming.map((e) => ({ ...e })),
    /** Queue an injected failure: `afterEffect:true` throws AFTER the Viewer state already changed (an ambiguous throw). */
    failNext(name, { error = new Error(`injected ${name} failure`), afterEffect = false, times = 1 } = {}) {
      if (!injections.has(name)) injections.set(name, []);
      for (let i = 0; i < times; i += 1) injections.get(name).push({ error, afterEffect });
    },
    injectionsRemaining: () => [...injections.values()].reduce((n, q) => n + q.length, 0),
  };
  for (const name of THEMING_METHODS) {
    viewer[name] = (...args) => { themingCalls.push({ name, args }); forbiddenCalls.push(name); throw new Error('theming forbidden'); };
  }
  for (const name of FORBIDDEN_VIEWER_METHODS) {
    viewer[name] = (...args) => { forbiddenCalls.push(name); throw new Error(`forbidden viewer call: ${name}(${args.length} args)`); };
  }
  Object.defineProperty(viewer, 'impl', { enumerable: true, get() { forbiddenCalls.push('impl'); throw new Error('forbidden: viewer.impl'); } });
  state.isolation = copyIso(isolation);
  return viewer;
}

/** A hand-written double of the ViewerApi facade (catalog 5) over a fake viewer, so bridge tasks do not depend on viewerApi.js. */
export function createFakeViewerApi(viewer = createFakeViewer()) {
  return {
    viewer,
    getAllModels: () => viewer.getAllModels(),
    getAggregateIsolation: () => viewer.getAggregateIsolation(),
    getAggregateHiddenNodes: () => viewer.getAggregateHiddenNodes(),
    setAggregateIsolation: (list) => viewer.setAggregateIsolation(list),
    fitToView: (ids, model, immediate) => viewer.fitToView(ids, model, immediate),
    fitToViewAggregate: (list, immediate) => viewer.fitToView(list, immediate),
    hasAggregateFit: () => viewer.aggregateFit !== false,
    getAggregateSelection: () => viewer.getAggregateSelection(),
    overlays: {
      hasScene: (name) => viewer.overlays.hasScene(name),
      addScene: (name) => viewer.overlays.addScene(name),
      addMesh: (mesh, name) => viewer.overlays.addMesh(mesh, name),
      removeMesh: (mesh, name) => viewer.overlays.removeMesh(mesh, name),
      removeScene: (name) => viewer.overlays.removeScene(name),
    },
    getElementWorldBounds: (model, dbId) => (typeof model?.worldBounds === 'function' ? model.worldBounds(dbId) : null),
    addEventListener: (name, fn) => viewer.addEventListener(name, fn),
    removeEventListener: (name, fn) => viewer.removeEventListener(name, fn),
  };
}
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/support/resultFixtures.mjs
// Hand-built SEALED result sets for controller/filter/list tests. They follow the REAL shapes (catalog 1, verified from
// clashtest/results/*): deep-frozen plain data; `resultId` a JSON string (opaque to the Panel); `pair` in canonical order
// (modelKey code-unit order, then dbId); `evaluatedAs`; `flags` present only when true; provenance and ledger rows built
// from the real clashtest fixture helpers so their shapes cannot drift. They need NOT pass validateResultSet (only a fake
// engine reads them); a real-engine contract test (Task 20) uses real sealed sets instead.
import { RUN_OPTION_DEFAULTS } from '../../../clashtest/index.js';
import {
  baseProvenance, emptyDiagnostics, ledgerWith, provenanceModel, unit,
} from '../../clashtest/support/resultSetFixtures.mjs';

export const MODEL_A = 'urn:test:model-a';
export const MODEL_B = 'urn:test:model-b';
export const MODEL_C = 'urn:test:model-c';
export const DIGEST = `sha256:${'a'.repeat(64)}`;

export function deepFreeze(value) {
  if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Object.isFrozen(value)) {
    Object.freeze(value);
    for (const key of Object.keys(value)) deepFreeze(value[key]);
  }
  return value;
}

const cmp = (a, b) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);
const refCmp = (x, y) => cmp(x.modelKey, y.modelKey) || (x.dbId - y.dbId);
const pairCmp = (x, y) => refCmp(x.pair.first, y.pair.first) || refCmp(x.pair.second, y.pair.second);
const ref = (r) => ({ modelKey: r.modelKey, dbId: r.dbId });

export const resultIdOf = (testId, digest, first, second) => JSON.stringify([testId, digest, first.modelKey, first.dbId, second.modelKey, second.dbId]);
/** The real `element` facet group id (clashtest/derive): JSON of ['element', {}, {dbId, modelKey}] with sorted keys. */
export const groupIdOf = (r) => JSON.stringify(['element', {}, { dbId: r.dbId, modelKey: r.modelKey }]);

/** A hard (volume-overlap) positive. `witness: null` yields the real `witnessUnavailable` flag. */
export function hardResult(a, b, { testId = 'T-1', digest = DIGEST, witness = { kind: 'vertex', point: [0, 0, 0] }, unitId = 'u1', flags = {} } = {}) {
  const [first, second] = refCmp(a, b) <= 0 ? [ref(a), ref(b)] : [ref(b), ref(a)];
  return {
    resultId: resultIdOf(testId, digest, first, second), pair: { first, second }, mode: 'volume-overlap',
    evaluatedAs: { source: ref(first), target: ref(second) }, evidence: { witness },
    flags: { ...(witness === null ? { witnessUnavailable: true } : {}), ...flags }, unitId,
  };
}

/** A soft (clearance) result with a real `distance` and closest points. */
export function softResult(a, b, { distance = 0.05, clearance = 0.25, testId = 'T-1', digest = DIGEST, unitId = 'u1', closestPoints, flags = {} } = {}) {
  const [first, second] = refCmp(a, b) <= 0 ? [ref(a), ref(b)] : [ref(b), ref(a)];
  return {
    resultId: resultIdOf(testId, digest, first, second), pair: { first, second }, mode: 'clearance',
    evaluatedAs: { source: ref(first), target: ref(second) },
    evidence: { distance, clearance, closestPoints: closestPoints ?? { first: [0, 0, 0], second: [distance, 0, 0] } }, flags, unitId,
  };
}

/** `n` distinct hard results between MODEL_A dbIds 1..n and MODEL_B dbIds 100001..100000+n, in canonical order. */
export function manyResults(n, { modelA = MODEL_A, modelB = MODEL_B, testId = 'T-1' } = {}) {
  const out = new Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 1) out[i] = hardResult({ modelKey: modelA, dbId: i + 1 }, { modelKey: modelB, dbId: 100001 + i }, { testId });
  return out.sort(pairCmp);
}

const leafUnit = (id, outcome, over = {}) => ({
  ...unit(id, outcome, over), kind: 'leaf', parentUnitId: null, sourceModelKey: MODEL_A, sourceRootDbIds: [10],
  targets: [{ modelKey: MODEL_B, scope: 'model' }],
});

/**
 * @param {object} [o]
 * @param {object[]} [o.results]        ClashResult records (sorted canonically here)
 * @param {'volume-overlap'|'clearance'} [o.mode]
 * @param {number|null} [o.clearance]   definition clearance for a soft set
 * @param {object|null} [o.definition]  undefined = derived; null = a pre-plan seal (definition and testRef.revision null)
 * @param {object} [o.outcome]          overrides on {status:'completed', coverage:'full', integrity:'clean', freshness:'current', ...}
 * @param {object} [o.ledger]           overrides on the real ledger defaults (planningGaps, units, hierarchyInternal, ...)
 * @param {Array<{modelKey:string, modelVersion?:string, bindingGeneration?:number, placementGeneration?:number}>|null} [o.provenanceModels]
 *        default [MODEL_A, MODEL_B] with modelVersion 'v1', bindingGeneration 0. `[]` models an empty (pre-plan) seal.
 * @param {number} [o.maxResultsPerRun] recorded in provenance.runOptions (spec 13 result-cap wording)
 */
export function makeSealedSet({
  results = [], mode = 'volume-overlap', clearance = null, runId = 'run-1', testId = 'T-1', revision = 1, name = 'Clash test 1',
  definition, outcome = {}, ledger = {}, provenanceModels = null, provenance = {}, diagnostics = {}, maxResultsPerRun,
} = {}) {
  const models = (provenanceModels ?? [{ modelKey: MODEL_A }, { modelKey: MODEL_B }]).map(({ modelKey, ...over }) => provenanceModel(modelKey, over));
  const def = definition === undefined ? {
    schemaVersion: 1, testId, revision, name,
    selectionA: { entries: [{ kind: 'model', modelKey: MODEL_A }] }, selectionB: { entries: [{ kind: 'model', modelKey: MODEL_B }] },
    mode, ...(mode === 'clearance' ? { clearance: clearance ?? 0.25 } : {}),
  } : definition;
  const runOptions = { ...RUN_OPTION_DEFAULTS, ...(maxResultsPerRun === undefined ? {} : { maxResultsPerRun }) };
  return deepFreeze({
    schemaVersion: 1, runId,
    testRef: { testId, revision: def === null ? null : revision, semanticDigest: def === null ? null : DIGEST },
    definition: def, derivedFromRunId: null,
    outcome: {
      status: 'completed', coverage: 'full', integrity: 'clean', freshness: 'current', environmentSensitive: false,
      environmentSensitiveCauses: [], reasons: [], ...outcome,
    },
    provenance: baseProvenance({ models, runOptions, ...provenance }),
    ledger: ledgerWith({ pairSpaceTotal: Math.max(results.length, 1), units: [leafUnit('u1', 'evaluated')], ...ledger }),
    results: [...results].sort(pairCmp),
    diagnostics: { ...emptyDiagnostics(), ...diagnostics }, statistics: {},
    digests: { digestVersion: 1, pairSetDigest: DIGEST, ledgerDigest: DIGEST }, sealed: true,
  });
}

/** n hard positives (MODEL_A 100+i vs MODEL_B 200+i); `unlocated` = indexes whose witness is unavailable. */
export function hardSet(n = 3, { unlocated = [], ...over } = {}) {
  const results = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 1) {
    results.push(hardResult({ modelKey: MODEL_A, dbId: 100 + i }, { modelKey: MODEL_B, dbId: 200 + i }, {
      witness: unlocated.includes(i) ? null : { kind: 'vertex', point: [i, i + 1, i + 2] },
    }));
  }
  return makeSealedSet({ results, ...over });
}

/** One soft result per distance (MODEL_A 100+i vs MODEL_B 200+i) with the real clearance evidence. */
export function softSet(distances = [0.01, 0.05, 0.2], { clearance = 0.25, ...over } = {}) {
  const results = distances.map((distance, i) => softResult({ modelKey: MODEL_A, dbId: 100 + i }, { modelKey: MODEL_B, dbId: 200 + i }, { distance, clearance }));
  return makeSealedSet({ results, mode: 'clearance', clearance, ...over });
}

/** completed / full / clean / current with zero results: the one shape from which a no-clash claim can be allowed. */
export const emptyCompletedClean = (over = {}) => makeSealedSet({ results: [], ...over });

/** completed but partial: a second unit failed (capacity), like the real 'positives' fixture. */
export function partialSet(n = 2, over = {}) {
  const base = hardSet(n);
  return makeSealedSet({
    results: [...base.results], outcome: { coverage: 'partial' },
    ledger: { units: [leafUnit('u1', 'evaluated'), leafUnit('u2', 'failed', { cause: 'capacity-exceeded', capacityKind: 'bucket-capacity', scopeProof: 'not-checked', pairSpaceWeight: 5 })] },
    ...over,
  });
}

/** A failed seal, e.g. failedSet({ reasons: ['result-cap'], maxResultsPerRun: 5 }) or a planning failure with no results. */
export function failedSet({ reasons = ['internal-error'], resultCount = 0, planningGaps = [], ...over } = {}) {
  const base = hardSet(resultCount);
  return makeSealedSet({
    results: [...base.results], outcome: { status: 'failed', coverage: 'partial', reasons }, ledger: { planningGaps }, ...over,
  });
}

/** The real `derivations.groupBy(set, ['element'])` response for a set (multi-valued: each result lists under both elements). */
export function elementGroupsFor(set) {
  const groups = new Map();
  for (const r of set.results) {
    for (const side of [r.pair.first, r.pair.second]) {
      const id = groupIdOf(side);
      if (!groups.has(id)) groups.set(id, { groupId: id, path: [id], facetId: 'element', params: {}, value: ref(side), count: 0, members: [] });
      const g = groups.get(id);
      g.members.push(r.resultId);
      g.count += 1;
    }
  }
  return {
    facets: [{ facetId: 'element', params: {}, multiValued: true }], unavailable: [], total: set.results.length,
    memberships: set.results.length * 2, groups: [...groups.values()].sort((x, y) => refCmp(x.value, y.value)),
  };
}

/** The real `derivations.filter(set, [{facet:'caveated', op:'eq', value:true}])` response for the given caveated ids. */
export function caveatedFilterFor(set, caveatedIds = []) {
  const wanted = new Set(caveatedIds);
  const matches = set.results.filter((r) => wanted.has(r.resultId)).map((r) => r.resultId);
  return { matches, count: matches.length, total: set.results.length, unavailable: [] };
}

/** The real `derivations.summarize(set)` response for a hand-built set (only what the Panel reads is exact; see support test). */
export function summaryFor(set) {
  const outcomes = new Map();
  let gapWeight = 0;
  for (const u of set.ledger.units) {
    if (u.outcome === 'split') continue;
    const key = `${u.outcome}\u0000${u.cause}`;
    outcomes.set(key, { outcome: u.outcome, cause: u.cause, count: (outcomes.get(key)?.count ?? 0) + 1 });
    if (u.outcome !== 'evaluated') gapWeight += u.pairSpaceWeight;
  }
  return {
    runId: set.runId, status: set.outcome.status, environmentSensitive: set.outcome.environmentSensitive,
    axes: { coverage: set.outcome.coverage, integrity: set.outcome.integrity, freshness: set.outcome.freshness, freshnessAtSeal: true },
    totalResults: set.results.length, unitOutcomes: [...outcomes.values()], planningGaps: [...set.ledger.planningGaps], gapWeight,
  };
}
```

### Task 4: Draft model, definition mapping, and the draft-identity/revision lifecycle

**Tier:** [A] format-agnostic headless

**Files:**
- Create: `clashpanel/core/draft.js`
- Modify: `test/clashpanel/scaffold.test.mjs` (`EXPECTED_MODULES` gains `core/draft.js`)
- Test: `test/clashpanel/core/draft.test.mjs`

**Scope note:** everything here is a pure function over plain data; the controller (Task 16) owns time, ids (`mintId`) and the decision to adopt the draft returned by `prepareRun` (it adopts it **only after `startRun` returns a handle**, so a failed admission leaves the draft untouched and a retry recomputes the same revision). The mapping invents nothing: the produced definition has exactly the closed Core keys `schemaVersion, testId, revision, name, selectionA, selectionB, mode, clearance?` (never `description`, never a run option), Hard mode has no clearance, Soft has **no default** clearance (OD-9). **Deviation from the catalog (stricter, justified):** the catalog says clearance is "parsed with `Number()`"; bare `Number()` accepts `'0x10'`, `'0b1'`, `'1_0'` and the empty string (`0`), which would silently turn a typo into a valid clearance, so the text must first match a plain decimal/exponent grammar (`'1e-3'` and `'.5'` stay valid; `'0x10'`, `'Infinity'`, `'1,5'` are rejected as "not a number"). Definition bounds the Panel mirrors are Core **schema** constants (name 1-256 code units, spec 6.1), not option limits; `validateTest` (Task 5) stays authoritative for everything else.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nothing at runtime. Tests use `validateTest(def) -> { issues: [{path, code, message}], issuesTruncated }` from `clashtest/index.js` (`clashtest/definition/validate.js`) only to prove definitions are valid (AC-P1).
- Produces (`clashpanel/core/draft.js`):
  - `createDraft({ testId: string, testNumber = 1 }): Draft` (deep-frozen) with `Draft = { testId, revision: number, name: string, mode: 'hard'|'soft', clearance: string, selfClash: boolean, setA: Side, setB: Side, lastRun: null|{ definitionKey: string, revision: number }, testCounter: number }`, `Side = { modelKeys: string[] /* sorted, unique */, elements: Record<string, number[]> /* sorted, unique, non-empty */ }`.
  - `draftReduce(draft, action): Draft` with `action` one of `{type:'name', value:string}`, `{type:'mode', value:'hard'|'soft'}`, `{type:'clearance', value:string}`, `{type:'selfClash', value:boolean}`, `{type:'toggleModel', side:'A'|'B', modelKey:string}`, `{type:'setElements', side:'A'|'B', elements: Record<string, number[]>}` (replaces the side's element map), `{type:'newTest', testId:string}`. An invalid or no-op action returns the SAME draft object (identity), so callers can skip notifications.
  - `selectionEntriesOf(side): Entry[]` (helper, reused by Task 5): one entry per model key, `{kind:'model', modelKey}` wins over `{kind:'elements', modelKey, dbIds}`, sorted by `modelKey`.
  - `buildDefinition(draft): { definition: object|null, problems: [{ control: 'name'|'mode'|'clearance'|'setA'|'setB', code: string, text: string }] }` (sync; `definition` deep-frozen or `null` when any problem exists). Problem codes: `name-required`, `name-too-long`, `clearance-required`, `clearance-invalid`, `clearance-not-positive`, `selection-empty`.
  - `definitionKey(definition): string` (canonical over ALL fields including `name`, excluding `revision`).
  - `prepareRun(draft): { draft: Draft, definition: object|null, problems }`.

**Depends on:** Task 1 (scaffold). No runtime dependency on other modules.

```js
// test/clashpanel/core/draft.test.mjs
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {
  buildDefinition, createDraft, definitionKey, draftReduce, prepareRun, selectionEntriesOf,
} from '../../../clashpanel/core/draft.js';
import { validateTest } from '../../../clashtest/index.js';

const reduce = (draft, ...actions) => actions.reduce(draftReduce, draft);
const fresh = () => createDraft({ testId: 'T-1' });
const withSets = (d, a = ['mA'], b = ['mB']) => reduce(d,
  ...a.map((modelKey) => ({ type: 'toggleModel', side: 'A', modelKey })), ...b.map((modelKey) => ({ type: 'toggleModel', side: 'B', modelKey })));
const ready = () => withSets(fresh());
const issuesOf = (definition) => validateTest(definition).issues;
const DEFINITION_KEYS = ['schemaVersion', 'testId', 'revision', 'name', 'selectionA', 'selectionB', 'mode', 'clearance'];

// ---- createDraft / reducer ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
test('createDraft: defaults per catalog (name "Clash test N", Hard, NO default clearance, empty sets, revision 1) and deep-frozen', () => {
  const d = fresh();
  assert.deepEqual(d, {
    testId: 'T-1', revision: 1, name: 'Clash test 1', mode: 'hard', clearance: '', selfClash: false,
    setA: { modelKeys: [], elements: {} }, setB: { modelKeys: [], elements: {} }, lastRun: null, testCounter: 1,
  });
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(d) && Object.isFrozen(d.setA) && Object.isFrozen(d.setA.modelKeys) && Object.isFrozen(d.setB.elements));
  assert.equal(createDraft({ testId: 'T-9', testNumber: 4 }).name, 'Clash test 4');
  assert.equal(createDraft({ testId: 'T-9', testNumber: 4 }).testCounter, 4);
  assert.throws(() => createDraft({ testId: '' }), TypeError);
  assert.throws(() => createDraft({}), TypeError);
});

test('reducer: name/mode/clearance/selfClash set the field; invalid or no-op actions return the SAME draft object', () => {
  const d = fresh();
  assert.equal(draftReduce(d, { type: 'name', value: 'Walls vs ducts' }).name, 'Walls vs ducts');
  assert.equal(draftReduce(d, { type: 'mode', value: 'soft' }).mode, 'soft');
  assert.equal(draftReduce(d, { type: 'clearance', value: '0.05' }).clearance, '0.05');
  assert.equal(draftReduce(d, { type: 'selfClash', value: true }).selfClash, true);
  for (const bad of [
    { type: 'name', value: 5 }, { type: 'mode', value: 'containment' }, { type: 'mode', value: 'clearance' }, { type: 'clearance', value: 0.5 },
    { type: 'selfClash', value: 'yes' }, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'C', modelKey: 'x' }, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'A', modelKey: '' },
    { type: 'setElements', side: 'A', elements: null }, { type: 'newTest' }, { type: 'unknown' }, null, undefined, 'name',
  ]) assert.equal(draftReduce(d, bad), d, JSON.stringify(bad));
  assert.equal(draftReduce(d, { type: 'name', value: d.name }), d);
  assert.equal(draftReduce(d, { type: 'mode', value: 'hard' }), d);
});

test('reducer: toggleModel adds sorted, toggles off, is per side, and never mutates the input', () => {
  const d = fresh();
  const a = reduce(d, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'A', modelKey: 'mB' }, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'A', modelKey: 'mA' });
  assert.deepEqual(a.setA.modelKeys, ['mA', 'mB']);
  assert.deepEqual(a.setB.modelKeys, []);
  assert.deepEqual(d.setA.modelKeys, []);
  const off = draftReduce(a, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'A', modelKey: 'mA' });
  assert.deepEqual(off.setA.modelKeys, ['mB']);
  assert.notEqual(off, a);
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(off) && Object.isFrozen(off.setA.modelKeys));
});

test('reducer: setElements replaces the side map and normalizes ids (integers >= 0, unique, sorted, -0 -> 0, empty lists dropped)', () => {
  const d = draftReduce(fresh(), {
    type: 'setElements', side: 'B',
    elements: { m2: [5, 3, 3, -1, 2.5, NaN, '7', null, -0, 9007199254740993], m1: [], m3: 'nope', m4: [0] },
  });
  assert.deepEqual(d.setB.elements, { m2: [0, 3, 5], m4: [0] });
  assert.ok(Object.is(d.setB.elements.m2[0], 0));
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(d.setB.elements), ['m2', 'm4']);
  const replaced = draftReduce(d, { type: 'setElements', side: 'B', elements: { m9: [1] } });
  assert.deepEqual(replaced.setB.elements, { m9: [1] });
  assert.equal(draftReduce(replaced, { type: 'setElements', side: 'B', elements: { m9: [1, 1] } }), replaced);
  assert.deepEqual(d.setA.elements, {});
});

test('reducer: a hostile model key such as "__proto__" is stored as data and never corrupts the prototype', () => {
  const d = draftReduce(fresh(), { type: 'setElements', side: 'A', elements: JSON.parse('{"__proto__": [4, 2]}') });
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(d.setA.elements), ['__proto__']);
  assert.equal(Object.getPrototypeOf(d.setA.elements), Object.prototype);
  assert.deepEqual(selectionEntriesOf(d.setA), [{ kind: 'elements', modelKey: '__proto__', dbIds: [2, 4] }]);
  assert.equal({}.polluted, undefined);
});

test('reducer: an edit to one field reuses the already-frozen sides (a name edit never recopies a large element selection)', () => {
  const big = Array.from({ length: 5000 }, (_, i) => i);
  const d = reduce(fresh(), { type: 'setElements', side: 'A', elements: { mA: big } }, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'B', modelKey: 'mB' });
  const n = draftReduce(d, { type: 'name', value: 'renamed' });
  assert.equal(n.setA, d.setA);
  assert.equal(n.setB, d.setB);
  assert.equal(draftReduce(d, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'B', modelKey: 'mC' }).setA, d.setA);
});

// ---- buildDefinition ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
test('buildDefinition: Hard maps to volume-overlap with EXACTLY the closed Core keys in order (no clearance, no description, no options)', () => {
  const { definition, problems } = buildDefinition(reduce(ready(), { type: 'name', value: '  Walls vs ducts  ' }));
  assert.deepEqual(problems, []);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(definition), ['schemaVersion', 'testId', 'revision', 'name', 'selectionA', 'selectionB', 'mode']);
  assert.deepEqual(definition, {
    schemaVersion: 1, testId: 'T-1', revision: 1, name: 'Walls vs ducts',
    selectionA: { entries: [{ kind: 'model', modelKey: 'mA' }] }, selectionB: { entries: [{ kind: 'model', modelKey: 'mB' }] }, mode: 'volume-overlap',
  });
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(definition) && Object.isFrozen(definition.selectionA.entries[0]));
});

test('buildDefinition: Hard ignores whatever is in the clearance field (even invalid text) and never emits a clearance key', () => {
  for (const text of ['', 'abc', '-3', '0.5']) {
    const { definition, problems } = buildDefinition(reduce(ready(), { type: 'clearance', value: text }));
    assert.deepEqual(problems, [], text);
    assert.equal('clearance' in definition, false, text);
  }
});

test('buildDefinition: Soft maps to clearance mode and parses the clearance as a positive finite decimal (no default)', () => {
  const soft = (text) => reduce(ready(), { type: 'mode', value: 'soft' }, { type: 'clearance', value: text });
  for (const [text, value] of [['0.05', 0.05], [' 0.25 ', 0.25], ['1e-3', 0.001], ['.5', 0.5], ['5.', 5], ['+2', 2], ['12', 12], ['1E2', 100]]) {
    const { definition, problems } = buildDefinition(soft(text));
    assert.deepEqual(problems, [], text);
    assert.equal(definition.mode, 'clearance');
    assert.equal(definition.clearance, value, text);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(definition), DEFINITION_KEYS);
  }
  const expected = {
    '': 'clearance-required', ' ': 'clearance-required', '0': 'clearance-not-positive', '-1': 'clearance-not-positive',
    '-0': 'clearance-not-positive', '0.0': 'clearance-not-positive', abc: 'clearance-invalid', Infinity: 'clearance-invalid',
    '-Infinity': 'clearance-invalid', NaN: 'clearance-invalid', '1e999': 'clearance-invalid', '0x10': 'clearance-invalid',
    '0b1': 'clearance-invalid', '1,5': 'clearance-invalid', '1_0': 'clearance-invalid', '1 2': 'clearance-invalid', '.': 'clearance-invalid',
  };
  for (const [text, code] of Object.entries(expected)) {
    const { definition, problems } = buildDefinition(soft(text));
    assert.equal(definition, null, JSON.stringify(text));
    assert.deepEqual(problems.map((p) => [p.control, p.code]), [['clearance', code]], JSON.stringify(text));
    assert.ok(problems[0].text.length > 0);
  }
});

test('buildDefinition: a model entry wins over element entries for the same model; entries are merged and sorted by modelKey', () => {
  const d = reduce(fresh(),
    { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'A', modelKey: 'mB' },
    { type: 'setElements', side: 'A', elements: { mB: [4, 3], mA: [9, 1, 9], mC: [2] } },
    { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'B', modelKey: 'mD' });
  assert.deepEqual(buildDefinition(d).definition.selectionA.entries, [
    { kind: 'elements', modelKey: 'mA', dbIds: [1, 9] }, { kind: 'model', modelKey: 'mB' }, { kind: 'elements', modelKey: 'mC', dbIds: [2] },
  ]);
  const untoggled = draftReduce(d, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'A', modelKey: 'mB' });
  assert.deepEqual(selectionEntriesOf(untoggled.setA).find((e) => e.modelKey === 'mB'), { kind: 'elements', modelKey: 'mB', dbIds: [3, 4] });
});

test('buildDefinition: self-clash makes selectionB deep-equal to selectionA (separate object), ignores Set B entirely, and validates only Set A', () => {
  const d = reduce(withSets(fresh(), ['mA', 'mB'], ['mZ']), { type: 'selfClash', value: true });
  const { definition } = buildDefinition(d);
  assert.deepEqual(definition.selectionB, definition.selectionA);
  assert.notEqual(definition.selectionB, definition.selectionA);
  assert.deepEqual(definition.selectionB.entries.map((e) => e.modelKey), ['mA', 'mB']);
  const emptyA = reduce(fresh(), { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'B', modelKey: 'mB' }, { type: 'selfClash', value: true });
  assert.deepEqual(buildDefinition(emptyA).problems.map((p) => p.control), ['setA']);
  const off = draftReduce(d, { type: 'selfClash', value: false });
  assert.deepEqual(buildDefinition(off).definition.selectionB.entries, [{ kind: 'model', modelKey: 'mZ' }]);
});

test('buildDefinition: name is trimmed and 1-256 code units; problems come in control order name, clearance, setA, setB and block the definition', () => {
  const named = (name) => buildDefinition(reduce(ready(), { type: 'name', value: name }));
  assert.equal(named('x'.repeat(256)).definition.name.length, 256);
  assert.deepEqual(named('x'.repeat(257)).problems.map((p) => [p.control, p.code]), [['name', 'name-too-long']]);
  assert.deepEqual(named('   ').problems.map((p) => [p.control, p.code]), [['name', 'name-required']]);
  assert.equal(named('  ' + 'y'.repeat(256) + '  ').definition.name.length, 256);
  const all = buildDefinition(reduce(fresh(), { type: 'name', value: '' }, { type: 'mode', value: 'soft' }));
  assert.equal(all.definition, null);
  assert.deepEqual(all.problems.map((p) => [p.control, p.code]), [
    ['name', 'name-required'], ['clearance', 'clearance-required'], ['setA', 'selection-empty'], ['setB', 'selection-empty'],
  ]);
  for (const p of all.problems) assert.equal(typeof p.text, 'string');
});

test('name length is counted in UTF-16 code units exactly like Core (a surrogate pair is 2), and the real validateTest agrees at the boundary', () => {
  const named = (name) => buildDefinition(reduce(ready(), { type: 'name', value: name }));
  const ok = named('\u{1F600}'.repeat(128));
  assert.equal(ok.definition.name.length, 256);
  assert.deepEqual(issuesOf(ok.definition), []);
  assert.deepEqual(named('\u{1F600}'.repeat(129)).problems.map((p) => p.code), ['name-too-long']);
  assert.ok(issuesOf({ ...ok.definition, name: '\u{1F600}'.repeat(129) }).some((i) => i.path === '/name' && i.code === 'string-too-long'));
});

test('AC-P1: every definition the mapping produces is accepted by the REAL validateTest with no issues and no extra keys', () => {
  const drafts = [];
  for (const mode of ['hard', 'soft']) {
    for (const selfClash of [false, true]) {
      for (const shape of ['models', 'elements', 'mixed']) {
        let d = reduce(fresh(), { type: 'mode', value: mode }, { type: 'clearance', value: '0.05' }, { type: 'selfClash', value: selfClash });
        if (shape === 'models') d = withSets(d, ['mA', 'mB'], ['mC']);
        if (shape === 'elements') d = reduce(d, { type: 'setElements', side: 'A', elements: { mA: [3, 1] } }, { type: 'setElements', side: 'B', elements: { mB: [7] } });
        if (shape === 'mixed') d = reduce(d, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'A', modelKey: 'mA' }, { type: 'setElements', side: 'A', elements: { mA: [1], mZ: [0, 8] } }, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'B', modelKey: 'mB' });
        drafts.push(d);
      }
    }
  }
  assert.equal(drafts.length, 12);
  for (const d of drafts) {
    const { definition, problems } = buildDefinition(d);
    assert.deepEqual(problems, []);
    assert.deepEqual(issuesOf(definition), [], JSON.stringify(definition));
    assert.ok(Object.keys(definition).every((k) => DEFINITION_KEYS.includes(k)));
    assert.equal(definition.mode === 'clearance', 'clearance' in definition);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(issuesOf(prepareRun(drafts[0]).definition), []);
});

test('definitionKey: canonical over all fields including name, EXCLUDING revision; insensitive to entry and dbId order', () => {
  const base = buildDefinition(ready()).definition;
  const key = definitionKey(base);
  assert.equal(definitionKey({ ...base, revision: 99 }), key);
  assert.notEqual(definitionKey({ ...base, name: 'other' }), key);
  assert.notEqual(definitionKey({ ...base, testId: 'T-2' }), key);
  assert.notEqual(definitionKey({ ...base, mode: 'clearance', clearance: 0.1 }), key);
  const soft = { ...base, mode: 'clearance', clearance: 0.1 };
  assert.notEqual(definitionKey({ ...soft, clearance: 0.2 }), definitionKey(soft));
  const a = { ...base, selectionA: { entries: [{ kind: 'elements', modelKey: 'mB', dbIds: [3, 1] }, { kind: 'model', modelKey: 'mA' }] } };
  const b = { ...base, selectionA: { entries: [{ kind: 'model', modelKey: 'mA' }, { kind: 'elements', modelKey: 'mB', dbIds: [1, 3] }] } };
  assert.equal(definitionKey(a), definitionKey(b));
  assert.equal(definitionKey({ ...b, description: 'd' }) === definitionKey(b), false);
  assert.equal(typeof key, 'string');
});

test('lifecycle: first run keeps revision 1 and records lastRun; re-running an unchanged definition REUSES the revision', () => {
  const r1 = prepareRun(ready());
  assert.equal(r1.definition.revision, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(r1.draft.lastRun, { definitionKey: definitionKey(r1.definition), revision: 1 });
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(r1.draft));
  const r2 = prepareRun(r1.draft);
  assert.equal(r2.definition.revision, 1);
  assert.equal(r2.draft.revision, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(r2.definition, r1.definition);
});

test('lifecycle: any change to the normalized definition (including the NAME) bumps the revision once', () => {
  const r1 = prepareRun(ready());
  const renamed = prepareRun(draftReduce(r1.draft, { type: 'name', value: 'Another name' }));
  assert.equal(renamed.definition.revision, 2);
  const widened = prepareRun(draftReduce(r1.draft, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'B', modelKey: 'mC' }));
  assert.equal(widened.definition.revision, 2);
  const soft = prepareRun(reduce(r1.draft, { type: 'mode', value: 'soft' }, { type: 'clearance', value: '0.1' }));
  assert.equal(soft.definition.revision, 2);
  assert.equal(prepareRun(renamed.draft).definition.revision, 2);
});

test('lifecycle: edit-and-revert BUMPS again (monotone, never reused) yet yields the same definitionKey as the first run', () => {
  const r1 = prepareRun(ready());
  const r2 = prepareRun(draftReduce(r1.draft, { type: 'name', value: 'Changed' }));
  const r3 = prepareRun(draftReduce(r2.draft, { type: 'name', value: 'Clash test 1' }));
  assert.deepEqual([r1.definition.revision, r2.definition.revision, r3.definition.revision], [1, 2, 3]);
  assert.equal(definitionKey(r3.definition), definitionKey(r1.definition));
  assert.equal(r3.draft.revision, 3);
});

test('lifecycle: editing and reverting BEFORE running does not bump (only the previous RUN is compared)', () => {
  const r1 = prepareRun(ready());
  const edited = reduce(r1.draft, { type: 'name', value: 'temp' }, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'A', modelKey: 'mQ' }, { type: 'name', value: 'Clash test 1' }, { type: 'toggleModel', side: 'A', modelKey: 'mQ' });
  assert.equal(prepareRun(edited).definition.revision, 1);
});

test('lifecycle: prepareRun is pure; an invalid draft returns the same draft with problems; a not-adopted result recomputes the same revision', () => {
  const r1 = prepareRun(ready());
  const changed = draftReduce(r1.draft, { type: 'name', value: 'Changed' });
  const a = prepareRun(changed);
  const b = prepareRun(changed);
  assert.deepEqual(a, b);
  assert.equal(changed.revision, 1);
  assert.equal(changed.lastRun.revision, 1);
  const invalid = prepareRun(reduce(r1.draft, { type: 'name', value: '' }));
  assert.equal(invalid.definition, null);
  assert.deepEqual(invalid.problems.map((p) => p.code), ['name-required']);
  assert.deepEqual(invalid.draft.lastRun, r1.draft.lastRun);
  assert.equal(invalid.draft.revision, 1);
});

test('lifecycle: New test mints the new testId, increments the counter, resets to defaults with revision 1 and no lastRun', () => {
  const r2 = prepareRun(draftReduce(prepareRun(ready()).draft, { type: 'name', value: 'Changed' }));
  assert.equal(r2.draft.revision, 2);
  const n = draftReduce(r2.draft, { type: 'newTest', testId: 'T-2' });
  assert.equal(n.testId, 'T-2');
  assert.equal(n.testCounter, 2);
  assert.equal(n.name, 'Clash test 2');
  assert.deepEqual([n.revision, n.lastRun, n.mode, n.clearance, n.selfClash], [1, null, 'hard', '', false]);
  assert.deepEqual([n.setA, n.setB], [{ modelKeys: [], elements: {} }, { modelKeys: [], elements: {} }]);
  const again = draftReduce(n, { type: 'newTest', testId: 'T-3' });
  assert.deepEqual([again.testId, again.testCounter, again.name], ['T-3', 3, 'Clash test 3']);
  assert.notEqual(prepareRun(withSets(n)).definition.testId, r2.definition.testId);
  assert.equal(prepareRun(withSets(n)).definition.revision, 1);
});
```
