```js
// clashpanel/core/labels.js
// Spec §8.2/§10.1/§12.4. Model names come from the host ModelCatalog (they survive unload); element names come
// from the LIVE model's object tree (`getObjectTree()?.getNodeName(dbId)`, never the deprecated instance tree).
// Every name is untrusted external text: it is returned as a raw string and the UI inserts it with textContent
// only (AC-P13). Display labels use a bounded LRU (LABEL_CACHE_MAX, a presentation constant, not a limit); the
// text-filter search index is a separate, per-result-set map built lazily in LIST_CHUNK_SIZE slices by warm().
import { LABEL_CACHE_MAX, LIST_CHUNK_SIZE } from './constants.js';

/** `Model <first 8 chars of modelKey>` — used when the host has no display name for a key. */
export function fallbackModelName(modelKey) {
  const key = String(modelKey ?? '');
  return `Model ${key.length > 8 ? key.slice(0, 8) : key}`;
}

/** The host display name for `modelKey`, or the fallback (also for an empty/blank name). Never throws. */
export function modelDisplayName(catalog, modelKey) {
  let name = null;
  try { name = catalog.displayNameFor(modelKey); } catch { name = null; }
  return typeof name === 'string' && name.trim().length > 0 ? name : fallbackModelName(modelKey);
}

/** Short stable suffix for disambiguation: the whole key when short, else its last 4 characters. */
const keySuffix = (modelKey) => (modelKey.length <= 6 ? modelKey : modelKey.slice(-4));

/**
 * Display names for a set of model keys, made distinguishable: a name shared by two or more keys gets
 * ` · …<suffix>` (the full key if two suffixes still collide); unique names are unchanged. Deterministic.
 */
export function disambiguatedNames(catalog, modelKeys) {
  const base = new Map(modelKeys.map((key) => [key, modelDisplayName(catalog, key)]));
  const byName = new Map();
  for (const [key, name] of base) byName.set(name, [...(byName.get(name) ?? []), key]);
  const out = new Map();
  for (const [name, keys] of byName) {
    if (keys.length === 1) { out.set(keys[0], name); continue; }
    const suffixes = keys.map(keySuffix);
    const clash = new Set(suffixes).size !== suffixes.length;
    keys.forEach((key, i) => out.set(key, `${name} · …${clash ? key : suffixes[i]}`));
  }
  return out;
}

/** Reads one node name from a live model; null when the tree is absent, the call throws or the name is empty. */
export function readNodeName(model, dbId) {
  try {
    const tree = typeof model?.getObjectTree === 'function' ? model.getObjectTree() : null;
    if (!tree || typeof tree.getNodeName !== 'function') return null;
    const name = tree.getNodeName(dbId);
    return typeof name === 'string' && name.length > 0 ? name : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function createLabelResolver({ catalog, resolveLiveModel, scheduler, knownModelKeys = () => [] }) {
  // LRU keys use a per-Model-object id, so a reloaded model (a new object) never reuses an old model's names.
  const modelIds = new WeakMap();
  let nextModelId = 1;
  const idOf = (model) => {
    let id = modelIds.get(model);
    if (id === undefined) { id = nextModelId; nextModelId += 1; modelIds.set(model, id); }
    return id;
  };
  const lru = new Map();                 // `${modelId}:${dbId}` -> name
  let searchIndex = new Map();           // modelKey -> Map<dbId, lowercased name>
  let warmSeq = 0;
  let names = null;                      // Map<modelKey, disambiguated name>, rebuilt lazily after invalidateNames()

  const liveModel = (modelKey) => {
    try {
      const model = resolveLiveModel(modelKey);
      return model !== null && typeof model === 'object' ? model : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  };

  function cachedName(model, dbId) {
    const key = `${idOf(model)}:${dbId}`;
    if (lru.has(key)) {
      const hit = lru.get(key);
      lru.delete(key);
      lru.set(key, hit);                 // refresh recency
      return hit;
    }
    const name = readNodeName(model, dbId);
    if (name !== null) {                 // only successes are cached: a tree that becomes ready later is re-read
      lru.set(key, name);
      if (lru.size > LABEL_CACHE_MAX) lru.delete(lru.keys().next().value);
    }
    return name;
  }

  function knownKeys() {
    const keys = new Set();
    try { for (const e of catalog.list() ?? []) if (typeof e?.modelKey === 'string') keys.add(e.modelKey); } catch { /* none */ }
    try { for (const k of knownModelKeys() ?? []) if (typeof k === 'string') keys.add(k); } catch { /* none */ }
    return keys;
  }

  /** Host display name, disambiguated against every other KNOWN model (catalog + displayed run) sharing it. */
  function modelName(modelKey) {
    if (names === null || !names.has(modelKey)) {
      const keys = knownKeys();
      keys.add(modelKey);
      names = disambiguatedNames(catalog, [...keys].sort());
    }
    return names.get(modelKey);
  }

  /** The known-model set or a host name changed (catalog change, new displayed run): recompute names lazily. */
  function invalidateNames() {
    names = null;
  }

  /** Element name when the side's model is live and names it; otherwise `#dbId`. */
  function elementLabel(ref) {
    const model = liveModel(ref.modelKey);
    const name = model === null ? null : cachedName(model, ref.dbId);
    return name ?? `#${ref.dbId}`;
  }

  /** Lowercased searchable text: model name + element name if indexed by warm() + dbId (spec §10.1). */
  function searchText(ref) {
    const name = searchIndex.get(ref.modelKey)?.get(ref.dbId) ?? '';
    return `${modelName(ref.modelKey)} ${name} ${ref.dbId}`.toLowerCase();
  }

  /**
   * Sliced label-index build for the text filter: LIST_CHUNK_SIZE records per slice, scheduler.yield() between
   * slices, isCurrent() checked per slice. Swaps the finished index in atomically; resolves true when it
   * committed, false when superseded (a newer warm() or !isCurrent()).
   */
  async function warm(index, { isCurrent = () => true } = {}) {
    warmSeq += 1;
    const seq = warmSeq;
    const next = new Map();
    const live = new Map();                // one resolveLiveModel per modelKey per pass
    const modelFor = (key) => {
      if (!live.has(key)) live.set(key, liveModel(key));
      return live.get(key);
    };
    const add = (ref) => {
      const model = modelFor(ref.modelKey);
      if (model === null) return;          // unloaded: matching is by model name / dbId only (spec §10.1)
      let perModel = next.get(ref.modelKey);
      if (perModel === undefined) { perModel = new Map(); next.set(ref.modelKey, perModel); }
      if (perModel.has(ref.dbId)) return;
      const name = readNodeName(model, ref.dbId);
      if (name !== null) perModel.set(ref.dbId, name.toLowerCase());
    };
    for (let start = 0; start < index.count; start += LIST_CHUNK_SIZE) {
      if (seq !== warmSeq || !isCurrent()) return false;
      const end = Math.min(index.count, start + LIST_CHUNK_SIZE);
      for (let i = start; i < end; i += 1) {
        const record = index.at(i);
        add(record.pair.first);
        add(record.pair.second);
      }
      await scheduler.yield();
    }
    if (seq !== warmSeq || !isCurrent()) return false;
    searchIndex = next;
    return true;
  }

  /** Drops the search-index names of a model that left the scene (spec §10.1: unloaded ⇒ dbId/model only). */
  function forgetModel(modelKey) {
    searchIndex.delete(modelKey);
  }

  /** Forgets the search index (a new result set is displayed) and cancels an in-flight warm(). */
  function reset() {
    warmSeq += 1;
    searchIndex = new Map();
    names = null;
  }

  return Object.freeze({ modelName, elementLabel, searchText, warm, forgetModel, reset, invalidateNames });
}
```

```js
// clashpanel/core/resolve.js
// Spec §9.1 resolution contract (read-only; no Viewer mutation). A side is `live` iff the registry binding exists
// AND its bindingGeneration and modelVersion equal the sealed run's provenance row AND the bound Model object is
// currently in the scene (catalog.list(), by identity). Everything is recomputed at use time — nothing is cached
// and no Model is kept in Panel state — so an unload/reload shows up the next time a row or action resolves
// (AC-P7/AC-P8). The registry is only READ (bindingFor); the Panel never registers or repairs a binding (AC-P20).
import { modelDisplayName } from './labels.js';

function provenanceRow(provenance, modelKey) {
  const models = Array.isArray(provenance?.models) ? provenance.models : [];
  for (const row of models) if (row && row.modelKey === modelKey) return row;
  return null;
}

function readBinding(engine, modelKey) {
  try {
    const binding = engine.registry.bindingFor(modelKey);
    return binding ?? null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function inScene(catalog, model) {
  let entries;
  try { entries = catalog.list(); } catch { return false; }
  if (!Array.isArray(entries)) return false;
  return entries.some((entry) => entry !== null && typeof entry === 'object' && entry.model === model);
}

const unavailable = (reason, modelKey, dbId) => Object.freeze({ state: 'unavailable', reason, modelKey, dbId });

/**
 * @returns {{state:'live', model, dbId, modelKey} | {state:'unavailable', reason:'not-registered'|'reloaded-since-run'|'version-mismatch'|'not-in-scene', modelKey, dbId}}
 * A missing provenance row (e.g. a planning-failed seal has `provenance.models: []`) is `not-registered`: the run
 * never bound that model, so no binding can be proven to be the one the run used.
 */
export function resolveSide({ ref, provenance, engine, catalog }) {
  const modelKey = ref?.modelKey;
  const dbId = ref?.dbId;
  const row = typeof modelKey === 'string' ? provenanceRow(provenance, modelKey) : null;
  const binding = row === null ? null : readBinding(engine, modelKey);
  if (row === null || binding === null) return unavailable('not-registered', modelKey, dbId);
  if (binding.bindingGeneration !== row.bindingGeneration) return unavailable('reloaded-since-run', modelKey, dbId);
  if (binding.modelVersion !== row.modelVersion) return unavailable('version-mismatch', modelKey, dbId);
  if (!inScene(catalog, binding.model)) return unavailable('not-in-scene', modelKey, dbId);
  return Object.freeze({ state: 'live', model: binding.model, dbId, modelKey });
}

/** Both sides of one result; `notes` carries "<Model name> is not loaded" when exactly one side is live (§9.3). */
export function resolveResult({ record, provenance, engine, catalog }) {
  const first = resolveSide({ ref: record.pair.first, provenance, engine, catalog });
  const second = resolveSide({ ref: record.pair.second, provenance, engine, catalog });
  const anyLive = first.state === 'live' || second.state === 'live';
  const allLive = first.state === 'live' && second.state === 'live';
  const notes = [];
  if (anyLive && !allLive) {
    const down = first.state === 'live' ? second : first;
    notes.push(`${modelDisplayName(catalog, down.modelKey)} is not loaded`);
  }
  return Object.freeze({ sides: Object.freeze([first, second]), anyLive, allLive, notes: Object.freeze(notes) });
}
```

```js
// clashpanel/core/rows.js
// Spec §8.2 row model. Pure: every Viewer-derived string arrives through `labels`, liveness through the resolver.
// formatGap is the SINGLE place the Soft gap is formatted (OD-13 Part 2 changes only GAP_UNIT_LABEL/GAP_DECIMALS).
// Hard (volume-overlap) rows carry no magnitude: `gap` is null (no invented penetration depth).
import { GAP_DECIMALS, GAP_UNIT_LABEL } from './constants.js';

export const LIVENESS_TEXT = Object.freeze({
  'not-registered': 'model not loaded',
  'reloaded-since-run': 'reloaded since run',
  'version-mismatch': 'version mismatch',
  'not-in-scene': 'not in scene',
});

/** Row liveness from a resolveResult() value: 'live' only when BOTH sides are live, else the first side's reason. */
export function livenessOf(resolution) {
  if (resolution.allLive) return 'live';
  const down = resolution.sides.find((side) => side.state !== 'live');
  return LIVENESS_TEXT[down?.reason] ?? 'model not loaded';
}

export function formatGap(distance) {
  if (typeof distance !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(distance)) return '—';
  return `${distance.toFixed(GAP_DECIMALS)} ${GAP_UNIT_LABEL}`;
}

const isPoint = (p) => Array.isArray(p) && p.length === 3 && p.every((v) => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v));

/**
 * Spec §8.2 "Location": Hard = evidence.witness.point; Soft = midpoint of closestPoints. null when the record
 * has no usable location (flags.witnessUnavailable, or the evidence is absent/malformed).
 * @returns {null | {kind:'witness', point:number[]} | {kind:'closest-points', point:number[], closestPoints:{first:number[],second:number[]}}}
 */
export function locationOf(record) {
  if (record?.flags?.witnessUnavailable === true) return null;
  const evidence = record?.evidence ?? {};
  if (record?.mode === 'clearance') {
    const cp = evidence.closestPoints;
    if (!cp || !isPoint(cp.first) || !isPoint(cp.second)) return null;
    const point = [0, 1, 2].map((i) => (cp.first[i] + cp.second[i]) / 2);
    return { kind: 'closest-points', point, closestPoints: { first: cp.first, second: cp.second } };
  }
  const point = evidence.witness?.point;
  return isPoint(point) ? { kind: 'witness', point } : null;
}

/** Badge order is fixed: 'no location','unreachable owner','mixed owner','duplicate-evidence conflict','caveated'. */
export function badgesFor(record, caveatedIds) {
  const flags = record?.flags ?? {};
  const badges = [];
  if (locationOf(record) === null) badges.push('no location');
  if (flags.unreachableOwner === true) badges.push('unreachable owner');
  if (flags.mixedOwnerProvenance === true) badges.push('mixed owner');
  if (flags.duplicateEvidenceConflict === true) badges.push('duplicate-evidence conflict');
  if (caveatedIds instanceof Set && caveatedIds.has(record.resultId)) badges.push('caveated');
  return badges;
}

/** {modelKey, modelName, label, dbId} for one pair side; names are raw strings (UI uses textContent). */
export function sideView(ref, labels) {
  return { modelKey: ref.modelKey, modelName: labels.modelName(ref.modelKey), label: labels.elementLabel(ref), dbId: ref.dbId };
}

/** gap text for a record: Soft only, else null. */
export function gapOf(record) {
  return record?.mode === 'clearance' ? formatGap(record.evidence?.distance) : null;
}

export function buildRow({ record, canonicalIndex, groupId = null, labels, liveness, caveatedIds = null, selected = false }) {
  return {
    kind: 'result',
    key: `${groupId ?? '-'}|${record.resultId}`,
    resultId: record.resultId,
    groupId: groupId ?? null,
    ordinal: canonicalIndex + 1,
    side1: sideView(record.pair.first, labels),
    side2: sideView(record.pair.second, labels),
    gap: gapOf(record),
    badges: badgesFor(record, caveatedIds),
    liveness,
    selected: selected === true,
  };
}

/** group = a filterGroups() entry {groupId, ref, count, filteredCount}. */
export function buildGroupHeaderRow({ group, labels, expanded }) {
  return {
    kind: 'group',
    key: `group:${group.groupId}`,
    groupId: group.groupId,
    label: `${labels.modelName(group.ref.modelKey)} · ${labels.elementLabel(group.ref)}`,
    count: group.count,
    filteredCount: group.filteredCount,
    expanded: expanded === true,
  };
}
```

**Scope note:** `controller.js` is a thin orchestrator: an explicit state object `c`, generation guards, port wiring and a `DISPATCH` table keyed by `INTENT`; all domain logic stays in T4–T15 modules. Unknown intent types throw `TypeError('unknown intent: …')` synchronously; intents whose owning task is later (T17: filters/grouping/sort/page/`PANEL_SHOWN`; T18: navigation/actions/`PANEL_HIDDEN`) are therefore *unknown* until that task adds them (T18 asserts every `INTENT` value is handled). `viewModel.js` is a pure builder over a documented *view input*. **Fields per task:** T16 fills all of `setup` and `run` except `run.counts` (`{total:null, filtered:null}`), `run.badges` (`null`) and the report banners; `filters` is the catalog-shaped default; `results.state` ∈ `before-run|running|error|list` (list with `rows:[]` once a set is displayed); `selected` is `null`. T17 adds `run.counts`, `run.badges`, `bannersFor` banners, all of `filters`, and `results` list/empty/grouping states; T18 adds `results.nav`, `results.hiddenByFiltersNote`, row `selected`, and `selected`; T19 refines `run.statusLive`. Catalog additions implemented here (see Notes): `INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_COLLAPSED`, `Banner.action = {label, intent}`, `run.diagnostics`, and `dispatch(DIAGNOSTICS_COPY)` resolving with the diagnostics string. At admission the controller records the Panel-local `runRecord = {basisVerdict}` (the Soft basis verdict the run was admitted under, §6.2 step 4; consumed by T17/T19 Run details). While a Soft evaluation is pending, `softAvailability.explanation` is `null` and the blocking Soft finding reads `SOFT_CHECKING_TEXT` ('Checking whether Soft is available for these models…'); Run stays disabled (fail closed) — the mapping is done in the VM builder from T5's finding codes (`soft-checking`/`soft-unavailable`), so T5 is untouched. Review-Focus pins implemented here: RF-1 (a same-tick double `RUN_START` admits once — a microtask latch — even when the admission fails), RF-2 (setup checklist/scope use the disambiguated `labels.modelName`; the label resolver learns the displayed run's model keys and names are invalidated on catalog change / new display), RF-4 (edits during a run never touch it; edit-then-revert reruns with the same `definitionKey` and revision; a real change bumps and a later revert never reuses a revision). `controllerHarness.mjs` pins the exact engine-port/bridge doubles the controller tests need (manual RunHandles, residency ledger with Core's lease/acknowledgement rules, controllable reads/derivations with AbortSignal and the 2-in-flight busy rule, forbidden members that record and throw) instead of assuming unspecified details of T3's generic `fakeEngine`; it uses T3's `createFakeScheduler`/`createFakeCatalog` (whose mutators do NOT fire — tests call `catalog.fire()`).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `createDefaultScheduler()` (T2 `core/scheduler.js`); `createGeneration() -> {current, bump, isCurrent}` (T2 `core/generation.js`); `narrowEnginePort(engine)`, `assertCatalogPort(c)`, `assertBridgePort(b)` (T2 `core/ports.js`); `createDraft({testId, testNumber})`, `draftReduce(draft, {type:'name'|'mode'|'clearance'|'selfClash', value} | {type:'toggleModel', side, modelKey} | {type:'setElements', side, elements} | {type:'newTest', testId})`, `prepareRun(draft) -> {draft, definition|null, problems}` (T4 `core/draft.js`); `validateSetup({draft, engine, catalog, softAvailability})`, `participatingModelKeys(draft)` (T5); `evaluateSoftAvailability({participants, catalog, scheduler, timeoutMs})` (T6); `createDerivationQueue({scheduler, generation}) -> {submit, dispose}` (T7); `RUN_PHASE`, `initialRunState()`, `reduceRun(state, {type:'admitted'|'core-event'|'poll'|'stop-requested'|'done'|'admission-failed', …})`, `canRun`, `canStop` (T8); `createResidency({engine}) -> {adopt, onPersisted, current, release, releaseSuperseded, disposeAll}` (T9); `mapAdmissionError(error, {heldRunId}) -> {text, action}`, `runHeadline({status,total,coverage,resultSet})`, `STATEMENTS`, `diagnosticsExport(set)` (T11); `createLabelResolver`, `resolveSide` (T15); Core `RunHandle {runId, getSnapshot, subscribe, cancel, done, persisted}` and `engine.startRun(def)` sync throws (`clashtest/run/Run.js`, `clashtest/engine.js`); error classes from `clashtest/index.js` (tests only).
- Produces: `INTENT` (catalog list + `SETUP_TOGGLE_COLLAPSED`); `createPanelController({engine, catalog, bridge, scheduler = createDefaultScheduler(), mintId}) -> Object.freeze({getViewModel, subscribe(cb) -> unsubscribe, dispatch(intent) -> Promise, dispose() -> Promise<{released:boolean, errors:Error[]}>})` (dispose never rejects; same promise on repeat); `buildViewModel(viewInput) -> ViewModel` (+ exported wording constants). Test support: `makeSet`, `hardResults`, `createScriptedEngine`, `createRecordingBridge`, `makeFakeModel`, `makeHarness`.

**Depends on:** T1–T9, T11, T15.

```js
// test/clashpanel/support/controllerHarness.mjs
// Controller-test doubles owned by Tasks 16–21 (created in Task 16; later tasks only ADD exports). They pin the
// EXACT engine-port behaviour the controller tests need — manual RunHandles, a residency ledger mirroring
// clashtest/results/residency.js (one-shot lease; retain only when `saved`; release refuses while leased and for
// unsaved sets without `acknowledgeUnsaved`), controllable async reads/derivations with AbortSignal support and
// the engine's 2-in-flight DerivationBusyError rule — so the controller tests do not depend on unspecified
// details of Task 3's generic fakeEngine. Real Core error classes come from the public barrel (by name, spec §13
// rule 4). No timers, no wall clock: everything settles through the fake scheduler + setImmediate (settle.mjs).
import {
  UnsavedResultSetError, ResultSetRetainedError, ResultNotResidentError, DerivationBusyError,
  DerivationAbortedError, ReadAbortedError, ResultCapacityError,
} from '../../../clashtest/index.js';
import { createFakeScheduler } from './fakeScheduler.mjs';
import { createFakeCatalog } from './fakeCatalog.mjs';
import { settle } from './settle.mjs';
import { createPanelController } from '../../../clashpanel/core/controller.js';
import { INTENT } from '../../../clashpanel/core/intents.js';

const deepFreeze = (value) => {
  if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Object.isFrozen(value)) {
    Object.freeze(value);
    for (const key of Object.keys(value)) deepFreeze(value[key]);
  }
  return value;
};

// ---- synthetic sealed sets ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

const CAVEATED = new WeakMap();                        // set -> Set<resultId> the double's `caveated` facet answers

/**
 * A hand-built, deep-frozen ResultSet with the real top-level/outcome/provenance/ledger/diagnostics shape
 * (field names copied from a real sealed set). Result specs: `{ a:[modelKey,dbId], b:[modelKey,dbId],
 * point?:[x,y,z]|null, distance?, flags?, caveated? }`. Result ids are `r<i>` unless `id` is given.
 */
export function makeSet({
  runId = 'run-x', results = [], mode = 'volume-overlap', clearance = null, status = 'completed',
  coverage = 'full', integrity = 'clean', freshness = 'current', reasons = [], models,
  ledger = {}, testId = 'T-1', diagnosticsTruncated = false,
} = {}) {
  const provenanceModels = models ?? [
    { modelKey: 'mA', modelVersion: 'v1', bindingGeneration: 1, placementGeneration: 0 },
    { modelKey: 'mB', modelVersion: 'v1', bindingGeneration: 1, placementGeneration: 0 },
  ];
  const caveated = new Set();
  const records = results.map((spec, i) => {
    const resultId = spec.id ?? `r${i}`;
    if (spec.caveated === true) caveated.add(resultId);
    const first = { modelKey: spec.a[0], dbId: spec.a[1] };
    const second = { modelKey: spec.b[0], dbId: spec.b[1] };
    let evidence;
    const flags = { ...(spec.flags ?? {}) };
    if (mode === 'clearance') {
      const d = spec.distance ?? 0.01;
      evidence = { distance: d, clearance, closestPoints: { first: [0, 0, 0], second: [d, 0, 0] } };
    } else {
      const point = spec.point === undefined ? [i, 0, 0] : spec.point;
      evidence = { witness: point === null ? null : { kind: 'surface-crossing', point } };
      if (point === null) flags.witnessUnavailable = true;
    }
    return { resultId, pair: { first, second }, mode, evaluatedAs: { source: first, target: second }, evidence, flags, unitId: '1.0' };
  });
  const set = {
    schemaVersion: 1,
    runId,
    testRef: { testId, revision: 1, semanticDigest: 'sha256:0' },
    definition: {
      schemaVersion: 1, testId, revision: 1, name: 'Clash test 1',
      selectionA: { entries: [{ kind: 'model', modelKey: provenanceModels[0]?.modelKey ?? 'mA' }] },
      selectionB: { entries: [{ kind: 'model', modelKey: provenanceModels[1]?.modelKey ?? provenanceModels[0]?.modelKey ?? 'mB' }] },
      mode, ...(mode === 'clearance' ? { clearance } : {}),
    },
    derivedFromRunId: null,
    outcome: { status, coverage, integrity, freshness, environmentSensitive: false, environmentSensitiveCauses: [], reasons },
    provenance: {
      registrySessionId: 'regsess-test', libraryVersion: null, broadPhase: 'tlas',
      scopeProof: { method: 'bracketed-digest', digestVersion: 1 }, hierarchyInternalAcceptance: null,
      libraryExclusions: [], placementVerified: false, startedAt: '2026-09-26T00:00:00.000Z', finishedAt: '2026-09-26T00:00:01.000Z',
      determinismClass: 'deterministic', runOptions: { maxResultsPerRun: 100000, persist: true },
      models: provenanceModels.map((m) => ({ ...m, scopeKinds: ['model'], elementCount: 999999, scopeDigests: {} })),
      admissionBaseline: [],
    },
    ledger: {
      planExists: true, pairSpaceTotal: Math.max(1, records.length), emptyOperand: false, units: [], rootOwners: [],
      unresolvedSelections: [], unreachablePopulation: [], hierarchyInternal: [], planningGaps: [], exclusions: [],
      warnings: [], budgetExhausted: false, firstRefusalUnitId: null, ...ledger,
    },
    results: records,
    diagnostics: { diagnostics: [], truncated: diagnosticsTruncated, total: 0, completenessAffectingCount: 0, unclassifiedOccurrences: 0, completenessAffectingUpperBound: 0, countsByReason: [], omittedReasonOccurrences: 0, geometryReadinessOccurrences: 0 },
    statistics: { libraryMsTotal: 0, maxUnitMs: 0 },
    digests: { digestVersion: 1, pairSetDigest: 'sha256:0', ledgerDigest: 'sha256:0' },
    sealed: true,
  };
  deepFreeze(set);
  CAVEATED.set(set, caveated);
  return set;
}

/** `n` Hard results mA:(1000+i) ↔ mB:(2000+(i % 97)); every 10th has no witness, every 7th is caveated. */
export function hardResults(n) {
  return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => ({
    a: ['mA', 1000 + i], b: ['mB', 2000 + (i % 97)], point: i % 10 === 9 ? null : [i, 0, 0], caveated: i % 7 === 3,
  }));
}

// ---- engine double ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function controllable(compute, makeAbortError, state) {
  const ctl = { calls: 0, successes: 0, manual: false, pending: [], failNext: [], args: [] };
  const fn = (...args) => {
    ctl.calls += 1;
    ctl.args.push(args);
    const last = args[args.length - 1];
    const signal = last !== null && typeof last === 'object' && !Array.isArray(last) && !('results' in last) ? last.signal : undefined;
    if (state && state.inFlight >= 2) return Promise.reject(new DerivationBusyError({ limit: 2 }));
    if (state) state.inFlight += 1;
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const entry = { args, signal, settled: false };
      const finish = () => { entry.settled = true; if (state) state.inFlight -= 1; };
      entry.resolve = (value) => {
        if (entry.settled) return;
        let v;
        try { v = value === undefined ? compute(...args) : value; } catch (e) { finish(); reject(e); return; }
        finish(); ctl.successes += 1; resolve(v);
      };
      entry.reject = (error) => { if (entry.settled) return; finish(); reject(error); };
      if (signal) {
        if (signal.aborted) { entry.reject(makeAbortError()); return; }
        signal.addEventListener('abort', () => entry.reject(makeAbortError()), { once: true });
      }
      if (ctl.failNext.length > 0) { entry.reject(ctl.failNext.shift()); return; }
      if (ctl.manual) ctl.pending.push(entry);
      else queueMicrotask(() => entry.resolve());
    });
  };
  ctl.resolveNext = (value) => { const e = ctl.pending.shift(); e.resolve(value); };
  ctl.rejectNext = (error) => { const e = ctl.pending.shift(); e.reject(error); };
  ctl.resolveAll = (value) => { while (ctl.pending.length > 0) ctl.resolveNext(value); };
  return { fn, ctl };
}

function elementGroups(set) {
  const groups = new Map();
  const add = (ref, resultId) => {
    const groupId = JSON.stringify(['element', {}, { dbId: ref.dbId, modelKey: ref.modelKey }]);
    let g = groups.get(groupId);
    if (g === undefined) { g = { groupId, path: [groupId], facetId: 'element', params: {}, value: { modelKey: ref.modelKey, dbId: ref.dbId }, count: 0, members: [] }; groups.set(groupId, g); }
    if (g.members[g.members.length - 1] !== resultId) { g.members.push(resultId); g.count += 1; }
  };
  for (const r of set.results) { add(r.pair.first, r.resultId); add(r.pair.second, r.resultId); }
  const list = [...groups.values()].sort((x, y) => (x.value.modelKey < y.value.modelKey ? -1 : x.value.modelKey > y.value.modelKey ? 1 : x.value.dbId - y.value.dbId));
  return { facets: [{ facetId: 'element', params: {}, multiValued: true }], unavailable: [], total: set.results.length, memberships: list.reduce((n, g) => n + g.count, 0), groups: list };
}

class ScriptedHandle {
  constructor(engine, runId) {
    this.engine = engine;
    this.runId = runId;
    this.listeners = new Set();
    this.cancelReasons = [];
    this.snapshot = { runId, status: 'queued', phase: 'queued', seq: 0, unitsTotal: 0, unitsEvaluated: 0, unitsFailedOrSkipped: 0, pairSpaceTotal: 0, pairSpaceEvaluated: 0, pairSpaceProcessed: 0, fractionEvaluated: null, fractionProcessed: null, resultsFound: 0, caveatCount: 0, caveatUnclassified: 0, currentUnitId: null, elapsedMs: 0 };
    this.done = new Promise((resolve) => { this.resolveDone = resolve; });
    this.persisted = new Promise((resolve) => { this.resolvePersistedPromise = resolve; });
    this.terminal = false;
    const self = this;
    // The frozen public face the controller receives (the RunHandle shape of clashtest/run/Run.js).
    this.face = Object.freeze({
      runId,
      getSnapshot: () => ({ ...self.snapshot }),
      subscribe(fn) {
        if (typeof fn !== 'function') throw new TypeError('listener must be a function');
        self.listeners.add(fn);
        return () => { self.listeners.delete(fn); };
      },
      cancel(reason) {
        self.cancelReasons.push(reason);
        if (!self.terminal && self.snapshot.status === 'running') self.emitState({ status: 'cancelling', phase: 'executing' });
        return self.done;
      },
      done: this.done,
      persisted: this.persisted,
    });
  }

  emitState({ status, phase, terminal, persistence }) {
    this.snapshot.seq += 1;
    this.snapshot.status = status;
    this.snapshot.phase = phase;
    const event = { type: 'state', seq: this.snapshot.seq, status, phase, ...(terminal ? { terminal: true, persistence } : {}) };
    for (const fn of [...this.listeners]) { try { fn(event); } catch { /* Core swallows listener errors */ } }
  }

  emitUnit(partial = {}) {
    this.snapshot = { ...this.snapshot, ...partial, status: 'running', phase: 'executing', seq: this.snapshot.seq + 1 };
    const event = { type: 'unit', seq: this.snapshot.seq, status: 'running', phase: 'executing' };
    for (const fn of [...this.listeners]) { try { fn(event); } catch { /* swallowed */ } }
  }

  /** Seals the run: resultSet becomes resident with `persistence.state`, then done resolves. */
  finish({ status = 'completed', resultSet = null, persistence = { state: 'saved', timedOut: false, attempt: 1 } } = {}) {
    this.terminal = true;
    if (resultSet !== null) this.engine.resident.set(this.runId, { set: resultSet, state: persistence.state, leases: 0 });
    this.emitState({ status, phase: 'finalizing' });
    this.emitState({ status, phase: 'terminal', terminal: true, persistence });
    this.resolveDone({ runId: this.runId, status, resultSet, persistence });
    if (persistence.state !== 'pending') this.resolvePersisted(persistence.state === 'failed' ? { state: 'failed', error: new Error('store failed') } : { state: persistence.state, ...(persistence.reason ? { reason: persistence.reason } : {}) });
  }

  /** pending → saved|failed after `done` (persistTimeoutMs elapsed first). */
  resolvePersisted(outcome) {
    const entry = this.engine.resident.get(this.runId);
    if (entry !== undefined) entry.state = outcome.state;
    this.resolvePersistedPromise(outcome);
  }
}

const FORBIDDEN = ['register', 'unregister', 'invalidateModelPlacement', 'dispose', 'getPairStatus', 'getElementStatus', 'wireModelUnload', 'saveTest', 'rerun', 'retryPersist', 'discardRun'];

/**
 * @param {{bindings?: Record<string, object|null>, capacity?: number}} [options] modelKey -> binding
 *   (`{modelKey, model, modelVersion, bindingGeneration}` — `model` must be the SAME object the catalog lists);
 *   `capacity` mirrors Core's `maxResidentResultSets` admission: non-terminal runs + non-evictable resident sets
 *   (leased, or not saved) must leave a slot, else startRun throws ResultCapacityError{cap,active,retained,held};
 *   saved, unleased sets are evicted to make room (as Core does).
 */
export function createScriptedEngine({ bindings = {}, capacity = Infinity } = {}) {
  const forbidden = [];
  const derivationState = { inFlight: 0 };
  const resident = new Map();                 // runId -> {set, state, leases}
  const handles = [];
  const admissionErrors = [];
  const releaseErrors = [];
  const leaseReleaseErrors = [];
  let releaseFailure = null;
  const table = { ...bindings };
  const setOf = (runIdOrSet) => (typeof runIdOrSet === 'string' ? resident.get(runIdOrSet)?.set : runIdOrSet);

  const summarize = controllable((set) => ({
    runId: set.runId, status: set.outcome.status, environmentSensitive: false,
    axes: { coverage: set.outcome.coverage, integrity: set.outcome.integrity, freshness: set.outcome.freshness, freshnessAtSeal: true },
    totalResults: set.results.length, resultsByMode: [], resultsByPairModels: [], resultsByCrossModel: { crossModel: 0, sameModel: 0 },
    resultsCaveated: (CAVEATED.get(set) ?? new Set()).size, unitOutcomes: [], planningGaps: [], gapWeight: 0,
    caveats: { total: 0, completenessAffectingUpperBound: 0, omittedReasonOccurrences: 0, unclassifiedOccurrences: 0, countsByReason: [] },
  }), () => new DerivationAbortedError(), derivationState);
  const filter = controllable((set, clauses) => {
    const c = clauses[0];
    if (!(c && c.facet === 'caveated' && c.op === 'eq' && c.value === true)) throw new Error('scripted engine: only the caveated=true clause is supported');
    const ids = CAVEATED.get(set) ?? new Set();
    const matches = set.results.filter((r) => ids.has(r.resultId)).map((r) => r.resultId);
    return { matches, count: matches.length, total: set.results.length, unavailable: [] };
  }, () => new DerivationAbortedError(), derivationState);
  const groupBy = controllable((set, facets) => {
    if (!(facets.length === 1 && facets[0] === 'element')) throw new Error('scripted engine: only groupBy(["element"]) is supported');
    return elementGroups(set);
  }, () => new DerivationAbortedError(), derivationState);
  const freshness = controllable((runIdOrSet) => {
    const set = setOf(runIdOrSet);
    if (set === undefined) throw new ResultNotResidentError({ runId: runIdOrSet });
    return { state: set.outcome.freshness, reasons: [] };
  }, () => new ReadAbortedError());
  const claim = controllable((runIdOrSet) => {
    const set = setOf(runIdOrSet);
    if (set === undefined) throw new ResultNotResidentError({ runId: runIdOrSet });
    const o = set.outcome;
    const allowed = set.results.length === 0 && o.status === 'completed' && o.coverage === 'full' && o.integrity === 'clean' && o.freshness === 'current';
    return { allowed, unqualified: allowed, qualifiers: [], exclusions: [], proofMethod: 'bracketed-digest' };
  }, () => new ReadAbortedError());

  const engine = {
    forbidden,
    handles,
    resident,
    control: { summarize: summarize.ctl, filter: filter.ctl, groupBy: groupBy.ctl, getFreshness: freshness.ctl, assessNoClashClaim: claim.ctl },
    validation: () => ({ issues: [], issuesTruncated: false }),
    startCalls: [],
    get lastHandle() { return handles[handles.length - 1]; },
    /** The next startRun throws `error` synchronously (admission failure). */
    failNextStart(error) { admissionErrors.push(error); },
    /** The next releaseResultSet (on a resident set) throws `error`; the set stays resident. */
    failNextRelease(error) { releaseErrors.push(error); },
    /** The next lease.release() throws `error`; the lease stays live (so releaseResultSet then refuses). */
    failNextLeaseRelease(error) { leaseReleaseErrors.push(error); },
    /** Every releaseResultSet throws `error` until called with null (a permanent failure). */
    setReleaseFailure(error) { releaseFailure = error; },
    setBinding(modelKey, binding) { table[modelKey] = binding; },
    validateTest(definition) { return engine.validation(definition); },
    startRun(definition, runOptions) {
      engine.startCalls.push({ definition, runOptions });
      if (admissionErrors.length > 0) throw admissionErrors.shift();
      if (capacity !== Infinity) {
        const active = handles.filter((h) => !h.terminal).map((h) => h.runId);
        const pinned = [...resident].filter(([, e]) => e.leases > 0 || e.state !== 'saved');
        if (active.length + pinned.length >= capacity) {
          throw new ResultCapacityError({
            cap: capacity, active,
            retained: pinned.filter(([, e]) => e.leases > 0).map(([id]) => id),
            held: pinned.filter(([, e]) => e.leases === 0).map(([id, e]) => ({ runId: id, persistence: e.state })),
          });
        }
        for (const [id, e] of [...resident]) {
          if (active.length + resident.size < capacity) break;
          if (e.leases === 0 && e.state === 'saved') resident.delete(id);      // evictable
        }
      }
      const handle = new ScriptedHandle(engine, `run-${handles.length + 1}`);
      handles.push(handle);
      return handle.face;
    },
    retainResultSet(runId) {
      const entry = resident.get(runId);
      if (entry === undefined) throw new ResultNotResidentError({ runId });
      if (entry.state !== 'saved') throw new UnsavedResultSetError({ runId });
      entry.leases += 1;
      let released = false;
      return {
        release() {
          if (released) return;
          if (leaseReleaseErrors.length > 0) throw leaseReleaseErrors.shift();   // lease stays live
          released = true;
          entry.leases -= 1;
        },
      };
    },
    releaseResultSet(runId, { acknowledgeUnsaved = false } = {}) {
      const entry = resident.get(runId);
      if (entry === undefined) return;
      if (releaseFailure !== null) throw releaseFailure;              // permanent failure injection
      if (releaseErrors.length > 0) throw releaseErrors.shift();      // one-shot failure injection
      if (entry.leases > 0) throw new ResultSetRetainedError({ runId });
      if (entry.state !== 'saved' && acknowledgeUnsaved !== true) throw new UnsavedResultSetError({ runId });
      resident.delete(runId);
    },
    getPersistenceState(runId) {
      const entry = resident.get(runId);
      return entry === undefined ? null : { state: entry.state, timedOut: false, attempt: 1 };
    },
    getFreshness: freshness.fn,
    assessNoClashClaim: claim.fn,
    derivations: { summarize: summarize.fn, groupBy: groupBy.fn, filter: filter.fn },
    registry: {
      bindingFor(modelKey) { return table[modelKey] ?? null; },
      register() { forbidden.push('registry.register'); throw new Error('forbidden: registry.register'); },
      unregister() { forbidden.push('registry.unregister'); throw new Error('forbidden: registry.unregister'); },
      keyOf() { forbidden.push('registry.keyOf'); throw new Error('forbidden: registry.keyOf'); },
      notifyPlacementChanged() { forbidden.push('registry.notifyPlacementChanged'); throw new Error('forbidden: registry.notifyPlacementChanged'); },
    },
  };
  for (const name of FORBIDDEN) {
    engine[name] = () => { forbidden.push(name); throw new Error(`forbidden: ${name}`); };
  }
  return engine;
}

// ---- bridge double ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function createRecordingBridge() {
  const calls = [];                              // Viewer-MUTATING operations only: present / clear / dispose
  const reads = [];                              // read-only operations (isolation prerequisite, selection)
  const modelLeft = new Set();
  let prerequisite = { available: true, reason: null };
  let selection = [];
  let manual = false;
  let clearOutcome = { isolation: 'none', markersRemoved: 0, notes: [] };
  let clearImpl = null;
  const pending = [];
  const bridge = {
    calls,
    reads,
    get presents() { return calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'present'); },
    setIsolationPrerequisite(value) { prerequisite = value; },
    setSelection(list) { selection = list; },
    /** The ClearOutcome every later clear() resolves with. */
    setClearOutcome(outcome) { clearOutcome = outcome; },
    /** Custom clear() behaviour (a delayed or rejecting promise); null restores the default. */
    setClearImpl(fn) { clearImpl = fn; },
    /** When manual, present() stays pending until resolvePresent(). */
    setManual(value) { manual = value; },
    resolvePresent(outcome) { pending.shift()(outcome); },
    listenerCount: () => modelLeft.size,
    fireModelLeft(event) { for (const cb of [...modelLeft]) cb(event); },
    present(req) {
      calls.push({ op: 'present', req });
      const auto = { superseded: false, fitted: req.options.focus, isolated: req.options.isolate, marked: req.options.marker, notes: [] };
      if (manual) return new Promise((resolve) => pending.push((o) => resolve(o ?? auto)));
      return Promise.resolve(auto);
    },
    clear() { calls.push({ op: 'clear' }); return clearImpl !== null ? clearImpl() : Promise.resolve(clearOutcome); },
    dispose() { calls.push({ op: 'dispose' }); return Promise.resolve(); },
    checkIsolationPrerequisite() { reads.push('checkIsolationPrerequisite'); return prerequisite; },
    readAggregateSelection() { reads.push('readAggregateSelection'); return selection; },
    onModelLeft(cb) { modelLeft.add(cb); return () => { modelLeft.delete(cb); }; },
  };
  return bridge;
}

// ---- models + one-call setup -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** A Viewer-Model-shaped object whose object tree names dbIds from `names` (a map or a function). */
export function makeFakeModel(label, names = {}) {
  const nameOf = typeof names === 'function' ? names : (dbId) => names[dbId];
  return { label, getObjectTree: () => ({ getNodeName: (dbId) => nameOf(dbId) }) };
}

/**
 * A controller over the doubles with two registered, loaded models mA ("Architecture") and mB ("Structure") —
 * names overridable through `displayNames` —
 * bindingGeneration 1 / modelVersion 'v1' (matching makeSet's default provenance).
 */
export function makeHarness({ basis = { state: 'verified', basisKey: 'b1' }, names, displayNames = { mA: 'Architecture', mB: 'Structure' }, capacity = Infinity } = {}) {
  const scheduler = createFakeScheduler();
  const modelA = makeFakeModel('A', names?.mA ?? ((dbId) => `A-${dbId}`));
  const modelB = makeFakeModel('B', names?.mB ?? ((dbId) => `B-${dbId}`));
  const catalog = createFakeCatalog({
    models: [
      { modelKey: 'mA', displayName: displayNames.mA, model: modelA, loaded: true },
      { modelKey: 'mB', displayName: displayNames.mB, model: modelB, loaded: true },
    ],
    basis,
  });
  const engine = createScriptedEngine({
    capacity,
    bindings: {
      mA: { modelKey: 'mA', model: modelA, modelVersion: 'v1', bindingGeneration: 1, placementGeneration: 0 },
      mB: { modelKey: 'mB', model: modelB, modelVersion: 'v1', bindingGeneration: 1, placementGeneration: 0 },
    },
  });
  const bridge = createRecordingBridge();
  let ids = 0;
  const controller = createPanelController({ engine, catalog, bridge, scheduler, mintId: () => { ids += 1; return `test-${ids}`; } });
  const h = {
    scheduler, catalog, engine, bridge, controller, modelA, modelB,
    vm: () => controller.getViewModel(),
    settle: (rounds) => settle(scheduler, rounds),
    async dispatch(intent) { const out = await controller.dispatch(intent); await settle(scheduler); return out; },
    /** Select mA for Set A and mB for Set B (Hard, the default mode) and let validation settle. */
    async readyHard() {
      await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_MODEL, side: 'A', modelKey: 'mA' });
      await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_MODEL, side: 'B', modelKey: 'mB' });
    },
    /** Starts a run (RUN_START) and returns the scripted handle. */
    async start() {
      await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
      return engine.lastHandle;
    },
    /** Starts a run and seals it with `set` (persistence default `saved`). */
    async runToDone(set, { status = set?.outcome?.status ?? 'failed', persistence } = {}) {
      const handle = await h.start();
      handle.emitState({ status: 'planning', phase: 'enumerating' });
      handle.finish({ status, resultSet: set, ...(persistence ? { persistence } : {}) });
      await settle(scheduler);
      return handle;
    },
  };
  return h;
}
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/core/controller.setupRun.test.mjs — Task 16: setup, validation state, run/stop, supersession,
// residency (spec §6, §7, §7.6; AC-P1, AC-P3, AC-P14, AC-P15, AC-P18, AC-P20).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { ResultCapacityError, RunQueueFullError } from '../../../clashtest/index.js';
import { INTENT } from '../../../clashpanel/core/intents.js';
import { SOFT_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT, READINESS_POLL_MS } from '../../../clashpanel/core/constants.js';
import { SOFT_CHECKING_TEXT } from '../../../clashpanel/core/viewModel.js';
import { definitionKey } from '../../../clashpanel/core/draft.js';
import { createPanelController } from '../../../clashpanel/core/controller.js';
import { makeHarness, makeSet, createScriptedEngine, createRecordingBridge } from '../support/controllerHarness.mjs';
import { createFakeCatalog } from '../support/fakeCatalog.mjs';
import { createFakeScheduler } from '../support/fakeScheduler.mjs';

const twoResults = () => makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: [{ a: ['mA', 1], b: ['mB', 10] }, { a: ['mA', 2], b: ['mB', 10] }] });

test('ViewModel is frozen, identical until state changes, and subscribers see every change', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.settle();
  const vm1 = h.vm();
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(vm1) && Object.isFrozen(vm1.setup) && Object.isFrozen(vm1.setup.models));
  assert.equal(h.vm(), vm1);                                             // same object while nothing changed
  const seen = [];
  const off = h.controller.subscribe((vm) => seen.push(vm.version));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_NAME, value: 'Walls vs ducts' });
  const vm2 = h.vm();
  assert.notEqual(vm2, vm1);
  assert.ok(vm2.version > vm1.version);
  assert.equal(vm2.setup.name, 'Walls vs ducts');
  assert.equal(seen.at(-1), vm2.version);
  off();
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_NAME, value: 'again' });
  assert.equal(seen.at(-1), vm2.version);                                 // unsubscribed
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(vm2).sort(), ['filters', 'results', 'run', 'selected', 'setup', 'version']);
  assert.equal(vm2.selected, null);
  assert.equal(vm2.results.state, 'before-run');
});

test('unknown or malformed intents throw TypeError synchronously', () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  assert.throws(() => h.controller.dispatch({ type: 'nope/never' }), { name: 'TypeError', message: /unknown intent/ });
  assert.throws(() => h.controller.dispatch(null), TypeError);
  assert.throws(() => h.controller.dispatch({}), TypeError);
});

test('setup: model checklist, scope text, validation ready ⇒ Run enabled; unregistered / loading models block Run', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.canRun, false);                                  // empty sets
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.validation.state, 'blocked');
  await h.readyHard();
  const vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.setup.validation.state, 'ready');
  assert.equal(vm.run.canRun, true);
  assert.deepEqual(vm.setup.models.map((m) => [m.modelKey, m.inA, m.inB, m.ready, m.registered, m.note]),
    [['mA', true, false, true, true, null], ['mB', false, true, true, true, null]]);
  assert.deepEqual(vm.setup.scope, { A: 'Architecture', B: 'Structure' });
  assert.equal(vm.setup.clearance.visible, false);                        // Hard has no tolerance/clearance control

  h.catalog.setLoaded('mB', false);                                        // readiness change…
  h.catalog.fire();                                                        // …announced through onChange
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.canRun, false);
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.models[1].note, 'Model Structure is still loading');
  h.catalog.setLoaded('mB', true);
  h.engine.setBinding('mB', null);                                         // host unregistered it
  h.catalog.fire();
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.canRun, false);
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.models[1].registered, false);
  assert.equal(h.engine.forbidden.length, 0);                             // never tries to (re-)register (AC-P20)
});

test('AC-P18: Soft availability is async and fail-closed; pending counts as unavailable', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness({ basis: { state: 'unverified', reason: 'units differ' } });
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_MODE, value: 'soft' });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_CLEARANCE, value: '0.05' });
  const vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.setup.softAvailability.available, false);
  assert.equal(vm.setup.softAvailability.pending, false);
  assert.ok(vm.setup.softAvailability.explanation.startsWith(SOFT_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT));
  assert.equal(vm.setup.clearance.visible, false);
  assert.equal(vm.run.canRun, false);                                      // Soft selected + unavailable ⇒ Run disabled
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_MODE, value: 'hard' });
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.canRun, true);                                   // Hard unaffected

  const v = makeHarness({ basis: { state: 'verified', basisKey: 'shared' } });
  await v.readyHard();
  await v.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_MODE, value: 'soft' });
  await v.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_CLEARANCE, value: '0.05' });
  assert.equal(v.vm().setup.softAvailability.available, true);
  assert.equal(v.vm().setup.clearance.visible, true);
  assert.equal(v.vm().run.canRun, true);

  // Pending: a basis verdict that never settles keeps Soft unavailable (and Run disabled) until it does.
  const p = makeHarness({ basis: () => new Promise(() => {}) });
  await p.readyHard();
  await p.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_MODE, value: 'soft' });
  await p.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_CLEARANCE, value: '0.05' });
  assert.equal(p.vm().setup.softAvailability.pending, true);
  assert.equal(p.vm().setup.softAvailability.available, false);
  assert.equal(p.vm().setup.softAvailability.explanation, null);          // never "not a verified basis" while checking
  assert.equal(p.vm().run.canRun, false);
  const texts = p.vm().setup.validation.messages.map((m) => m.text);
  assert.ok(texts.includes(SOFT_CHECKING_TEXT));
  assert.equal(texts.some((t) => t.startsWith(SOFT_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT)), false);
});

test('AC-P3: RUN_START admits one run; during the run there is no list and no ETA, Stop is enabled in every non-terminal state', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  const handle = await h.start();
  assert.equal(h.engine.startCalls.length, 1);
  assert.equal(h.engine.startCalls[0].runOptions, undefined);              // no run option invented (AC-P1)
  const seen = [];
  const check = () => {
    const vm = h.vm();
    seen.push(vm.run.state);
    assert.equal(vm.run.canStop, true);
    assert.equal(vm.run.canRun, false);
    assert.equal(vm.results.state, 'running');
    assert.deepEqual(vm.results.rows, []);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(vm.run.progress).sort(), ['caveatCount', 'elapsedText', 'fraction', 'resultsFound', 'unitsEvaluated', 'unitsTotal']);
  };
  check();                                                                // preparing
  handle.emitState({ status: 'planning', phase: 'enumerating' }); await h.settle(); check();
  handle.emitUnit({ unitsTotal: 4, unitsEvaluated: 1, fractionProcessed: 0.25, resultsFound: 3 }); await h.settle(); check();
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.progress.fraction, 0.25);
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.setup, undefined);
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.collapsed, true);                              // setup collapses when a run starts
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });                            // own run non-terminal ⇒ ignored
  assert.equal(h.engine.startCalls.length, 1);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_STOP });
  check();
  assert.deepEqual(handle.cancelReasons, ['user']);
  handle.emitState({ status: 'cancelled', phase: 'finalizing' }); await h.settle(); check();
  assert.deepEqual(seen, ['preparing', 'planning', 'running', 'stopping', 'finalizing']);
  handle.finish({ status: 'cancelled', resultSet: makeSet({ runId: handle.runId, status: 'cancelled', coverage: 'partial', results: [] }) });
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.state, 'done');
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.doneKind, 'cancelled');
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.canStop, false);
});

test('"Waiting for another run": the preparing poll re-reads the snapshot and stops once the run moves on', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  const handle = await h.start();
  assert.equal(h.scheduler.pendingTimers(), 1);                            // one low-frequency poll while preparing
  await h.scheduler.advance(READINESS_POLL_MS);
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.waitingForOtherRun, true);
  handle.emitState({ status: 'planning', phase: 'enumerating' });
  await h.scheduler.advance(READINESS_POLL_MS);
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.waitingForOtherRun, false);
  assert.equal(h.scheduler.pendingTimers(), 0);
});

test('new run: bridge.clear + release happen ONLY after startRun returns a handle; admission failure preserves everything', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.runToDone(twoResults());
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.doneKind, 'completed');
  const lease = h.engine.resident.get('run-1');
  assert.equal(lease.leases, 1);                                           // saved ⇒ leased
  const clearsBefore = h.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'clear').length;

  h.engine.failNextStart(new RunQueueFullError({ limit: 1, queued: 1 }));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  let vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.run.state, 'done');                                      // previous results still displayed
  assert.equal(vm.run.doneKind, 'completed');
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.get('run-1').leases, 1);                  // nothing released
  assert.equal(h.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'clear').length, clearsBefore);   // Viewer untouched
  const banner = vm.run.banners.find((b) => b.id === 'admission-error');
  assert.equal(banner.kind, 'error');
  assert.equal(banner.action, undefined);

  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });                            // admitted this time
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(h.engine.startCalls.length, 3);
  assert.equal(h.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'clear').length, clearsBefore + 1);
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.has('run-1'), false);                     // previous set released after admission
  assert.equal(vm.run.state, 'preparing');
  assert.equal(vm.run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'admission-error'), false);
});

test('ResultCapacityError caused by the Panel\'s own set offers release-and-retry; RUN_RELEASE_AND_RETRY releases then runs', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.runToDone(twoResults());
  h.engine.failNextStart(new ResultCapacityError({ cap: 1, active: [], retained: ['run-1'], held: [] }));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  const banner = h.vm().run.banners.find((b) => b.id === 'admission-error');
  assert.deepEqual(banner.action, { label: 'Release previous results and retry', intent: { type: INTENT.RUN_RELEASE_AND_RETRY } });
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.has('run-1'), true);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_RELEASE_AND_RETRY });
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.has('run-1'), false);
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.state, 'preparing');
  assert.equal(h.engine.startCalls.length, 3);
});

test('AC-P14: unsaved (skipped) results need an explicit acknowledgement before Clear or a new Run discards them', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.runToDone(twoResults(), { persistence: { state: 'skipped', timedOut: false, attempt: 0, reason: 'no-store' } });
  let vm = h.vm();
  assert.ok(vm.run.banners.some((b) => /held in memory/i.test(b.text)));
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.get('run-1').leases, 0);                  // engine-held, not leased

  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR });
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.run.state, 'done');                                      // not cleared yet
  const confirm = vm.run.banners.find((b) => b.id === 'confirm-discard-unsaved');
  assert.deepEqual(confirm.action.intent, { type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR_CONFIRMED });
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.has('run-1'), true);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR_CONFIRMED });
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.has('run-1'), false);                     // released with acknowledgeUnsaved
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.state, 'idle');
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.state, 'before-run');

  // Run over unsaved results (explicitly confirmed path): confirmation → RELEASE (acknowledged) → admission
  // (startRun). An ordinary, unconfirmed replacement stays admission → release.
  const handle = await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-2', results: [] }), { persistence: { state: 'failed', timedOut: false, attempt: 1 } });
  assert.equal(handle.runId, 'run-2');
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  assert.equal(h.engine.startCalls.length, 2);                             // asked, not started
  assert.ok(h.vm().run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'confirm-discard-unsaved'));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR_CONFIRMED });
  assert.equal(h.engine.startCalls.length, 3);
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.has('run-2'), false);
});

test('single resident slot (Core-exact admission): an ordinary Run over a SAVED set fails admission and keeps it; a CONFIRMED discard of an unsaved set releases it before startRun', async () => {
  const saved = makeHarness({ capacity: 1 });
  await saved.readyHard();
  await saved.runToDone(twoResults());                                     // saved ⇒ leased ⇒ holds the only slot
  const clears = saved.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'clear').length;
  await saved.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  let vm = saved.vm();
  assert.equal(saved.engine.startCalls.length, 2);
  assert.equal(vm.run.doneKind, 'completed');                              // previous results preserved (§7.6)
  assert.equal(saved.engine.resident.get('run-1').leases, 1);
  assert.equal(saved.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'clear').length, clears);
  assert.deepEqual(vm.run.banners.find((b) => b.id === 'admission-error').action.intent, { type: INTENT.RUN_RELEASE_AND_RETRY });

  const unsaved = makeHarness({ capacity: 1 });
  await unsaved.readyHard();
  await unsaved.runToDone(twoResults(), { persistence: { state: 'skipped', timedOut: false, attempt: 0, reason: 'no-store' } });
  await unsaved.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  assert.equal(unsaved.engine.startCalls.length, 1);                      // asked first
  await unsaved.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR_CONFIRMED });
  vm = unsaved.vm();
  assert.equal(unsaved.engine.startCalls.length, 2);
  assert.equal(vm.run.state, 'preparing');                                 // admitted: the slot was freed first
  assert.equal(unsaved.engine.resident.has('run-1'), false);
  assert.equal(vm.run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'admission-error'), false);
});

test('a failed release (stuck lease) shows the release-error banner; the next Clear/Run retries it and recovers', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.runToDone(twoResults());
  h.engine.failNextLeaseRelease(new Error('lease release failed'));        // ⇒ releaseResultSet refuses (lease live)
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR });
  let vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.run.state, 'idle');                                      // the display is cleared regardless
  assert.ok(vm.run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'release-error'));
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.get('run-1').leases, 1);                  // still stuck
  const handle = await h.start();                                           // Run: release() retries the stuck entry
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.has('run-1'), false);
  assert.equal(vm.run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'release-error'), false);
  handle.finish({ status: 'completed', resultSet: makeSet({ runId: handle.runId, results: [] }) });
  await h.settle();
  h.engine.failNextRelease(new Error('store busy'));                        // releaseResultSet itself fails on Run
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  assert.ok(h.vm().run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'release-error'));
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.has(handle.runId), true);
  h.engine.lastHandle.finish({ status: 'completed', resultSet: makeSet({ runId: h.engine.lastHandle.runId, results: [] }) });
  await h.settle();
  await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'x', results: [] }));                 // the next Run's release() retries…
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.has(handle.runId), false);                 // …and recovers
});

test('dispose: a transient late-set release failure is retried before resolving {released:true}; a permanent one resolves {released:false, errors} without rejecting', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  const handle = await h.start();
  handle.emitState({ status: 'planning', phase: 'enumerating' });
  await h.settle();
  const p = h.controller.dispose();
  h.engine.failNextRelease(new Error('transient'));
  handle.finish({ status: 'cancelled', resultSet: makeSet({ runId: handle.runId, status: 'cancelled', coverage: 'partial', results: [] }) });
  const outcome = await p;
  assert.equal(outcome.released, true);
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.size, 0);

  const g = makeHarness();
  await g.readyHard();
  const h2 = await g.start();
  h2.emitState({ status: 'planning', phase: 'enumerating' });
  await g.settle();
  g.engine.setReleaseFailure(new Error('permanent'));
  const q = g.controller.dispose();
  h2.finish({ status: 'cancelled', resultSet: makeSet({ runId: h2.runId, status: 'cancelled', coverage: 'partial', results: [] }) });
  const bad = await q;
  assert.equal(bad.released, false);
  assert.ok(bad.errors.length > 0);
  assert.equal(g.controller.dispose(), q);                                  // same promise on repeat
  assert.equal(g.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'dispose').length, 1); // the bridge is still disposed
});

test('AC-P14: pending → saved upgrades to a lease (Clear then needs no confirmation); pending → failed keeps it unsaved', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  const handle = await h.runToDone(twoResults(), { persistence: { state: 'pending', timedOut: true, attempt: 1 } });
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.get('run-1').leases, 0);
  handle.resolvePersisted({ state: 'saved' });
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.get('run-1').leases, 1);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR });
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.has('run-1'), false);
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'confirm-discard-unsaved'), false);

  const g = makeHarness();
  await g.readyHard();
  const h2 = await g.runToDone(twoResults(), { persistence: { state: 'pending', timedOut: true, attempt: 1 } });
  h2.resolvePersisted({ state: 'failed', error: new Error('disk') });
  await g.settle();
  await g.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR });
  assert.ok(g.vm().run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'confirm-discard-unsaved'));
  assert.equal(g.engine.resident.has('run-1'), true);
});

test('setup collapse: auto on run start, user toggle, auto-expand on admission failure; diagnostics preview + copy', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.collapsed, false);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_COLLAPSED });
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.collapsed, true);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_COLLAPSED });
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.collapsed, false);
  const set = makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', status: 'failed', coverage: 'partial', reasons: ['planning:model-not-bound'], ledger: { planningGaps: [{ phase: 'binding', cause: 'model-not-bound' }] }, diagnosticsTruncated: true });
  await h.runToDone(set);
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.collapsed, false);                            // re-expanded on failure
  const diag = h.vm().run.diagnostics;
  assert.equal(diag.available, true);
  assert.ok(diag.preview.length <= 10);
  assert.ok(diag.preview.some((l) => l.includes('model-not-bound')));
  assert.ok(diag.preview.includes('Diagnostic detail was truncated'));
  const text = await h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.DIAGNOSTICS_COPY });
  assert.equal(typeof text, 'string');
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(text).diagnostics.truncated, true);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_COLLAPSED });               // collapse, then fail an admission
  h.engine.failNextStart(new RunQueueFullError({ limit: 1, queued: 1 }));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.collapsed, false);
  const empty = makeHarness();
  assert.equal(await empty.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.DIAGNOSTICS_COPY }), null);
  assert.equal(empty.vm().run.diagnostics, null);
});

test('a foreign isolation change reported by bridge.clear() becomes an isolation notice; the next clean clear removes it', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.runToDone(twoResults());
  h.bridge.setClearOutcome({ isolation: 'skipped-external', markersRemoved: 0, notes: [] });
  await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-2', results: [] }));             // new run ⇒ clear()
  const notice = h.vm().run.banners.find((b) => b.id === 'isolation-notice');
  assert.deepEqual({ kind: notice.kind, text: notice.text }, { kind: 'info', text: 'Isolation was changed elsewhere, so the Panel left it as is.' });
  h.bridge.setClearOutcome({ isolation: 'failed', markersRemoved: 0, notes: [] });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR });
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.banners.find((b) => b.id === 'isolation-notice').kind, 'warning');
  h.bridge.setClearOutcome({ isolation: 'restored', markersRemoved: 2, notes: [] });
  await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-3', results: [] }));
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'isolation-notice'), false);
});

test('a null resultSet (fallback seal failed) ⇒ failed headline, error results state, setup re-expanded', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.runToDone(null, { status: 'failed', persistence: { state: 'skipped', timedOut: false, attempt: 0, reason: 'seal-failed' } });
  const vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.run.doneKind, 'failed');
  assert.equal(vm.results.state, 'error');
  assert.ok(vm.run.headline.length > 0 && vm.run.headline !== 'No clashes');
  assert.equal(vm.setup.collapsed, false);
});

test('AC-P15 + AC-P14: dispose during an active run cancels it; the late done releases its own set and changes nothing', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  const handle = await h.start();
  handle.emitState({ status: 'planning', phase: 'enumerating' });
  await h.settle();
  const before = h.vm();
  const p1 = h.controller.dispose();
  const p2 = h.controller.dispose();
  assert.equal(p1, p2);                                                    // idempotent
  let resolved = false;
  p1.then(() => { resolved = true; });
  await h.settle();
  assert.deepEqual(handle.cancelReasons, ['panel-disposed']);
  assert.equal(resolved, false);                                           // waits for the cancelled run's done
  handle.finish({ status: 'cancelled', resultSet: makeSet({ runId: handle.runId, status: 'cancelled', coverage: 'partial', results: [{ a: ['mA', 1], b: ['mB', 10] }] }) });
  await p1;
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.size, 0);                                 // released BEFORE dispose resolved
  assert.equal(h.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'dispose').length, 1);
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm(), before);                                            // display unchanged after dispose
  h.catalog.fire();                                                        // listener removed: no throw, no change
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm(), before);
  await h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });                 // no-op after dispose
  assert.equal(h.engine.startCalls.length, 1);
});

test('setupChangedSinceRun: set by an edit after a run, cleared by the next admitted run; New test clears results', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.runToDone(twoResults());
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.setupChangedSinceRun, false);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_NAME, value: 'Renamed' });
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.setupChangedSinceRun, true);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_NEW_TEST });
  const vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.setup.setupChangedSinceRun, false);
  assert.equal(vm.setup.name, 'Clash test 2');
  assert.equal(vm.run.state, 'idle');
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.size, 0);
});

test('AC-P20: the controller works on the narrowed port; forbidden engine members are never reached', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.runToDone(twoResults());
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR });
  await h.controller.dispose();
  assert.deepEqual(h.engine.forbidden, []);
  const scheduler = createFakeScheduler();
  const catalog = createFakeCatalog({ models: [] });
  const noDerivations = { ...createScriptedEngine(), derivations: undefined };
  assert.throws(() => createPanelController({ engine: noDerivations, catalog, bridge: createRecordingBridge(), scheduler, mintId: () => 'x' }), TypeError);
});

test('RF-1: a double Run in one tick admits exactly once — also when that admission fails (one banner)', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  await Promise.all([h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START }), h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START })]);
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.engine.startCalls.length, 1);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });                            // own run non-terminal ⇒ ignored
  assert.equal(h.engine.startCalls.length, 1);

  const g = makeHarness();
  await g.readyHard();
  g.engine.failNextStart(new RunQueueFullError({ limit: 1, queued: 1 }));
  g.engine.failNextStart(new RunQueueFullError({ limit: 1, queued: 1 }));
  await Promise.all([g.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START }), g.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START })]);
  await g.settle();
  assert.equal(g.engine.startCalls.length, 1);
  assert.equal(g.vm().run.banners.filter((b) => b.id === 'admission-error').length, 1);
  await g.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });                            // a later, separate click tries again
  assert.equal(g.engine.startCalls.length, 2);
});

test('RF-2: two catalog models with the same display name are distinguishable in the setup checklist and scope', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness({ displayNames: { mA: 'Model', mB: 'Model' } });
  await h.readyHard();
  const vm = h.vm();
  assert.deepEqual(vm.setup.models.map((m) => m.displayName), ['Model · …mA', 'Model · …mB']);
  assert.deepEqual(vm.setup.scope, { A: 'Model · …mA', B: 'Model · …mB' });
});

test('RF-4: setup edits during a run never touch that run; edit-then-revert reruns with the same definitionKey and revision', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  const handle = await h.start();
  const def1 = h.engine.startCalls[0].definition;
  const frozen = JSON.stringify(def1);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_NAME, value: 'Edited while running' });
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.setupChangedSinceRun, true);
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(def1), frozen);                              // the running run's identity is untouched
  handle.finish({ status: 'completed', resultSet: makeSet({ runId: handle.runId, results: [{ a: ['mA', 1], b: ['mB', 10] }] }) });
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.doneKind, 'completed');                          // its results are displayed as sealed
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.setupChangedSinceRun, true);                   // …and flagged as the previous setup
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_NAME, value: def1.name });         // revert
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  const def2 = h.engine.startCalls[1].definition;
  assert.equal(definitionKey(def2), definitionKey(def1));
  assert.equal(def2.revision, def1.revision);                              // same question ⇒ same revision (stable resultIds)
  h.engine.lastHandle.finish({ status: 'completed', resultSet: makeSet({ runId: 'run-2', results: [] }) });
  await h.settle();
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_NAME, value: 'A different question' });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  const def3 = h.engine.startCalls[2].definition;
  assert.ok(def3.revision > def2.revision);                                // a changed definition bumps
  h.engine.lastHandle.finish({ status: 'completed', resultSet: makeSet({ runId: 'run-3', results: [] }) });
  await h.settle();
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_NAME, value: def1.name });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  const def4 = h.engine.startCalls[3].definition;
  assert.equal(definitionKey(def4), definitionKey(def1));
  assert.ok(def4.revision > def3.revision);                                // monotone: an old revision is never reused
});

test('Use current selection maps Viewer selection to element entries through keyOfModel (unknown models skipped)', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();

  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_USE_SELECTION, side: 'A' });
```
