- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** `clashpanel/core/intents.js`, `clashpanel/core/controller.js`, `clashpanel/core/viewModel.js` (each in full):

```js
// clashpanel/core/intents.js
// The ONLY vocabulary the UI may dispatch to the controller (catalog §4; frozen). Payload fields, all optional
// unless noted — `value` carries a control's new value:
//   SETUP_NAME/SETUP_MODE('hard'|'soft')/SETUP_CLEARANCE(string)/SETUP_SELF_CLASH(boolean): {value}
//   SETUP_TOGGLE_MODEL: {side:'A'|'B', modelKey}      SETUP_USE_SELECTION: {side:'A'|'B'}
//   FILTER_TEXT(string)/FILTER_MAX_GAP(string)/FILTER_UNVERIFIED(boolean)/FILTER_HAS_LOCATION(boolean): {value}
//   FILTER_MODEL: {value: string[]} ([] = all models)  FILTER_ELEMENT: {ref:{modelKey,dbId}|null}
//   GROUP_MODE: {value:'none'|'element'}  GROUP_TOGGLE: {groupId}  SORT_SET: {value:'default'|'gap-asc'|'group-count'|'group-label'}
//   NAV_SELECT: {resultId, groupId:string|null}        NAV_PAGE: {page:number}
//   ACTION_ISOLATE/ACTION_MARKERS/ACTION_FOCUS_ON_SELECT: {value:boolean}
//   Every other intent carries no payload. A ViewModel banner's optional `action: {label, intent}` carries the
//   exact intent its button dispatches (RUN_RELEASE_AND_RETRY / RESULTS_CLEAR / RESULTS_CLEAR_CONFIRMED).
//   SETUP_TOGGLE_COLLAPSED (catalog addition, requested by the UI part) flips `vm.setup.collapsed`.
//   DIAGNOSTICS_COPY is the one intent whose dispatch() RESOLVES WITH A VALUE: the plain-JSON diagnostics string
//   (or null when no result set is displayed); the UI copies it to the clipboard.
export const INTENT = Object.freeze({
  SETUP_NAME: 'setup/name', SETUP_MODE: 'setup/mode', SETUP_CLEARANCE: 'setup/clearance',
  SETUP_TOGGLE_MODEL: 'setup/toggleModel',
  SETUP_USE_SELECTION: 'setup/useSelection',
  SETUP_SELF_CLASH: 'setup/selfClash',
  SETUP_NEW_TEST: 'setup/newTest',
  SETUP_TOGGLE_COLLAPSED: 'setup/toggleCollapsed',
  RUN_START: 'run/start', RUN_STOP: 'run/stop', RESULTS_CLEAR: 'results/clear', RESULTS_CLEAR_CONFIRMED: 'results/clearConfirmed', RUN_RELEASE_AND_RETRY: 'run/releaseAndRetry',
  FILTER_TEXT: 'filter/text', FILTER_MODEL: 'filter/model', FILTER_MAX_GAP: 'filter/maxGap', FILTER_UNVERIFIED: 'filter/unverified', FILTER_HAS_LOCATION: 'filter/hasLocation',
  FILTER_ELEMENT: 'filter/element',
  FILTER_CLEAR: 'filter/clear',
  GROUP_MODE: 'group/mode',
  GROUP_TOGGLE: 'group/toggle',
  SORT_SET: 'sort/set',
  NAV_SELECT: 'nav/select',
  NAV_PREV: 'nav/prev', NAV_NEXT: 'nav/next', NAV_PAGE: 'nav/page',
  ACTION_FOCUS: 'action/focus', ACTION_ISOLATE: 'action/isolate', ACTION_MARKERS: 'action/markers',
  ACTION_FOCUS_ON_SELECT: 'action/focusOnSelect', ACTION_BACK_TO_ALL: 'action/backToAll',
  PANEL_HIDDEN: 'panel/hidden', PANEL_SHOWN: 'panel/shown',
  DIAGNOSTICS_COPY: 'diagnostics/copy',
});
```

```js
// clashpanel/core/controller.js
// The headless Panel controller (spec §5, §6, §7; catalog §4 "Controller behaviors"). A THIN orchestrator: all
// domain logic lives in the sibling modules; this file owns only the state container, generation guards, the
// wiring between ports and modules, and the intent dispatch table. It holds no Viewer/DOM reference (AC-P10).
//
// Invariants kept here:
//  * Run = validate → engine.startRun → ONLY AFTER a handle returns: generation++, bridge.clear(), release of the
//    previous set. An admission failure changes nothing but the error banner (§7.2/§7.6, AC-P14).
//  * Every async completion captures a generation (results) or setup generation (Soft availability) and commits
//    only if it is still current; a superseded run's late `done` releases its own set only (§5.2, AC-P15).
//  * The engine is narrowed to the EnginePort at construction (AC-P20): register/unregister/
//    invalidateModelPlacement/dispose are unreachable from here.
//  * getViewModel() returns the SAME frozen object until the state changes (version counter).
import { INTENT } from './intents.js';
import { createDefaultScheduler } from './scheduler.js';
import { createGeneration } from './generation.js';
import { narrowEnginePort, assertCatalogPort, assertBridgePort } from './ports.js';
import { createDraft, draftReduce, prepareRun } from './draft.js';
import { validateSetup, participatingModelKeys } from './setupValidation.js';
import { evaluateSoftAvailability } from './softAvailability.js';
import { createDerivationQueue } from './derivationQueue.js';
import { RUN_PHASE, initialRunState, reduceRun, canRun, canStop } from './runMachine.js';
import { createResidency } from './residency.js';
import { mapAdmissionError, diagnosticsExport } from './runReport.js';
import { createLabelResolver } from './labels.js';
import { resolveSide } from './resolve.js';
import { buildViewModel } from './viewModel.js';
import { BASIS_VERDICT_TIMEOUT_MS, READINESS_POLL_MS } from './constants.js';

// ── construction ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function createPanelController({ engine, catalog, bridge, scheduler = createDefaultScheduler(), mintId = () => globalThis.crypto.randomUUID() }) {
  const port = narrowEnginePort(engine);
  assertCatalogPort(catalog);
  assertBridgePort(bridge);
  const gen = createGeneration();
  const c = {
    engine: port, catalog, bridge, scheduler, mintId,
    gen,                                   // results generation: Run, Clear results, New test, dispose
    setupGen: createGeneration(),          // Soft-availability evaluations (independent of runs)
    queue: createDerivationQueue({ scheduler, generation: gen }),
    residency: createResidency({ engine: port }),
    labels: null,
    disposed: false, disposing: null, disposers: [], subscribers: new Set(),
    version: 0, vmCache: null,
    draft: createDraft({ testId: mintId(), testNumber: 1 }),
    validation: null,
    soft: { available: false, pending: false, verdict: null, explanation: null }, softKey: null,
    setupChanged: false, hasRun: false, setupCollapsed: false,
    run: initialRunState(), handle: null, handleUnsub: null, snapshot: null, pollTimer: null, startLatch: false,
    admission: null, confirm: null, releaseErrors: [], releaseStuck: false, residencyNotice: null,
    isolationNotice: null, viewerSeq: 0,   // last bridge.clear()/present() outcome worth telling the user about
    displayed: null,                       // {runId, status, resultSet|null, persistence}
    runRecord: null,                       // Panel-local facts captured when the run was ADMITTED (not in the sealed set)
    readAbort: new AbortController(),
  };
  c.labels = createLabelResolver({
    catalog, scheduler,
    resolveLiveModel: (modelKey) => liveModelFor(c, modelKey),
    // Models known only from the displayed run (e.g. unloaded since) still count for name disambiguation (RF-2).
    knownModelKeys: () => (c.displayed?.resultSet?.provenance?.models ?? []).map((m) => m.modelKey),
  });
  revalidate(c);
  c.disposers.push(catalog.onChange(() => onCatalogChange(c)));

  return Object.freeze({
    getViewModel: () => viewModelOf(c),
    subscribe(cb) {
      if (typeof cb !== 'function') throw new TypeError('subscribe: callback must be a function');
      if (c.disposed) return () => {};
      c.subscribers.add(cb);
      return () => { c.subscribers.delete(cb); };
    },
    dispatch: (intent) => dispatch(c, intent),
    /** Resolves {released, errors} after the run drained, sets were released and the bridge disposed (see dispose()). */
    dispose: () => dispose(c),
  });
}

// ── state container ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function viewModelOf(c) {
  if (c.vmCache === null) c.vmCache = buildViewModel(viewInput(c));
  return c.vmCache;
}

/** Every state change ends here: new version, drop the cached ViewModel, notify subscribers (errors swallowed). */
function touch(c) {
  c.version += 1;
  c.vmCache = null;
  if (c.subscribers.size === 0) return;
  const vm = viewModelOf(c);
  for (const cb of [...c.subscribers]) {
    try { cb(vm); } catch { /* a subscriber failure never breaks the controller */ }
  }
}

function bumpGeneration(c) {
  c.gen.bump();
  c.readAbort.abort();
  c.readAbort = new AbortController();
}

/**
 * bridge.clear() for a restore-table trigger. The outcome is surfaced only if no later clear/present superseded
 * it: 'skipped-external' ⇒ info notice (foreign isolation left untouched, §9.4), 'failed' ⇒ warning.
 */
function clearViewer(c) {
  c.viewerSeq += 1;
  const seq = c.viewerSeq;
  let pending;
  try { pending = c.bridge.clear(); } catch (error) { pending = Promise.reject(error); }
  return Promise.resolve(pending).then((outcome) => outcome, () => ({ isolation: 'failed' })).then((outcome) => {
    if (c.disposed || seq !== c.viewerSeq || outcome?.disposed === true) return;
    const next = outcome?.isolation === 'skipped-external' || outcome?.isolation === 'failed' ? outcome.isolation : null;
    if (next !== c.isolationNotice) { c.isolationNotice = next; touch(c); }
  });
}

function readBinding(c, modelKey) {
  try { return c.engine.registry.bindingFor(modelKey) ?? null; } catch { return null; }
}

/** The live Model for `modelKey` under the DISPLAYED run's provenance (spec §9.1), else null. */
function liveModelFor(c, modelKey) {
  const set = c.displayed?.resultSet ?? null;
  if (set === null) return null;
  const side = resolveSide({ ref: { modelKey, dbId: 0 }, provenance: set.provenance, engine: c.engine, catalog: c.catalog });
  return side.state === 'live' ? side.model : null;
}

const isActive = (c) => canStop(c.run);   // every non-terminal Panel state

function canRunNow(c) {
  return !c.disposed && canRun(c.run) && c.validation?.state === 'ready';
}

/**
 * True when the displayed set is engine-held and not (yet) saved: discarding it needs an explicit acknowledgement.
 * An unreadable state counts as unsaved (fail safe: residency.release() would also refuse without the ack).
 */
function heldUnsaved(c) {
  const current = c.residency.current();
  if (current === null || current.kind !== 'held-unsaved') return false;
  let state = null;
  try { state = c.engine.getPersistenceState(current.runId)?.state ?? null; } catch { state = null; }
  return state !== 'saved';
}

// ── setup (spec §6) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function safeValidate(c) {
  try {
    return validateSetup({
      draft: c.draft, engine: c.engine, catalog: c.catalog,
      // A pending Soft evaluation counts as unavailable (fail closed, PD-17).
      softAvailability: { available: c.soft.available === true && c.soft.pending !== true, pending: c.soft.pending === true, verdict: c.soft.verdict, explanation: c.soft.explanation },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return { state: 'blocked', findings: [{ control: 'general', code: 'validation-error', text: `The setup could not be validated: ${String(error?.message ?? error)}` }], issuesTruncated: false, definition: null };
  }
}

function startSoftEvaluation(c, participants, key) {
  const g = c.setupGen.bump();
  c.softKey = key;
  c.soft = { available: false, pending: true, verdict: null, explanation: null };
  let pending;
  try {
    pending = evaluateSoftAvailability({ participants, catalog: c.catalog, scheduler: c.scheduler, timeoutMs: BASIS_VERDICT_TIMEOUT_MS });
  } catch (error) {
    pending = Promise.reject(error);
  }
  Promise.resolve(pending).then((r) => r, () => null).then((r) => {
    if (c.disposed || !c.setupGen.isCurrent(g)) return;          // superseded by a newer participant set
    c.soft = { available: r?.available === true, pending: false, verdict: r?.verdict ?? null, explanation: r?.explanation ?? null };
    c.validation = safeValidate(c);
    touch(c);
  });
}

/** validateSetup re-runs on every setup/catalog change; Soft availability re-evaluates when the participants change. */
function revalidate(c, { reEvaluateSoft = false } = {}) {
  const participants = participatingModelKeys(c.draft);
  const key = participants.join('\u0000');
  if (reEvaluateSoft || key !== c.softKey) startSoftEvaluation(c, participants, key);
  c.validation = safeValidate(c);
}

function applySetup(c, action) {
  c.draft = draftReduce(c.draft, action);
  if (c.hasRun) c.setupChanged = true;                            // spec §6.3
  c.admission = null;
  revalidate(c);
  touch(c);
}

function onSetupName(c, intent) { applySetup(c, { type: 'name', value: String(intent.value ?? '') }); }
function onSetupMode(c, intent) { if (intent.value === 'hard' || intent.value === 'soft') applySetup(c, { type: 'mode', value: intent.value }); }
function onSetupClearance(c, intent) { applySetup(c, { type: 'clearance', value: String(intent.value ?? '') }); }
function onSetupSelfClash(c, intent) { applySetup(c, { type: 'selfClash', value: intent.value === true }); }

function onSetupToggleModel(c, intent) {
  if ((intent.side !== 'A' && intent.side !== 'B') || typeof intent.modelKey !== 'string') return;
  applySetup(c, { type: 'toggleModel', side: intent.side, modelKey: intent.modelKey });
}

/** "Use current selection": read-only Viewer read through the bridge; models the host never identified are skipped. */
function onSetupUseSelection(c, intent) {
  if (intent.side !== 'A' && intent.side !== 'B') return;
  let selection = [];
  try { selection = c.bridge.readAggregateSelection() ?? []; } catch { selection = []; }
  const elements = {};
  for (const entry of Array.isArray(selection) ? selection : []) {
    let key = null;
    try { key = c.catalog.keyOfModel(entry?.model); } catch { key = null; }
    const dbIds = Array.isArray(entry?.dbIds) ? entry.dbIds.filter((d) => Number.isInteger(d) && d >= 0) : [];
    if (typeof key !== 'string' || dbIds.length === 0) continue;
    elements[key] = [...new Set([...(elements[key] ?? []), ...dbIds])].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  }
  applySetup(c, { type: 'setElements', side: intent.side, elements });
}

function onSetupNewTest(c) {
  if (isActive(c)) return;                                        // setup identity never changes under a live run
  if (heldUnsaved(c)) { c.confirm = { for: 'newTest' }; touch(c); return; }
  newTest(c, false);
}

function newTest(c, acknowledgeUnsaved) {
  c.confirm = null;
  retireDisplayed(c, { acknowledgeUnsaved });
  c.draft = draftReduce(c.draft, { type: 'newTest', testId: c.mintId() });
  c.hasRun = false;
  c.setupChanged = false;
  c.setupCollapsed = false;
  c.admission = null;
  revalidate(c);
  touch(c);
}

function onSetupToggleCollapsed(c) {
  c.setupCollapsed = !c.setupCollapsed;
  touch(c);
}

function onCatalogChange(c) {
  if (c.disposed) return;
  c.labels.invalidateNames();                                     // names/known models may have changed (RF-2)
  revalidate(c, { reEvaluateSoft: true });                        // readiness/registration/basis may have changed
  touch(c);
}

// ── run lifecycle (spec §7) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function onRunStart(c) {
  // RF-1: a double-click delivers two RUN_STARTs in one tick; only the first is acted on, even when its admission
  // failed (no second startRun, no second error banner). A non-terminal own run disables Run anyway (canRunNow).
  if (c.startLatch || !canRunNow(c)) return;
  c.startLatch = true;
  queueMicrotask(() => { c.startLatch = false; });
  if (heldUnsaved(c)) { c.confirm = { for: 'run' }; touch(c); return; }   // "discard unsaved results?" (§7.6)
  startRun(c, { acknowledgeUnsaved: false });
}

/**
 * Admission order (§7.2/§7.6): ordinarily the new run is admitted FIRST and only then is the previous set
 * released, so an admission failure preserves the previous results and Viewer state. EXCEPTION — the user has
 * explicitly confirmed discarding the (unsaved) previous set (RESULTS_CLEAR_CONFIRMED for a pending Run, or
 * RUN_RELEASE_AND_RETRY): that consent covers releasing it BEFORE startRun, which Core needs when the unsaved,
 * non-evictable set holds the last resident slot (otherwise startRun throws ResultCapacityError forever).
 */
function startRun(c, { acknowledgeUnsaved }) {
  c.confirm = null;
  const prepared = prepareRun(c.draft);
  if (prepared.definition === null) { c.validation = safeValidate(c); touch(c); return; }
  const confirmedDiscard = acknowledgeUnsaved === true;
  if (confirmedDiscard) retireDisplayed(c, { acknowledgeUnsaved: true });   // consented: free the slot first
  let handle;
  try {
    handle = c.engine.startRun(prepared.definition);
  } catch (error) {
    // Admission failure: previous results, residency and Viewer state stay exactly as they were (AC-P14) —
    // unless the user already confirmed discarding them (then they were released above, by consent).
    c.admission = mapAdmissionError(error, { heldRunId: c.residency.current()?.runId ?? null });
    c.run = reduceRun(c.run, { type: 'admission-failed', error });
    c.setupCollapsed = false;                                     // §14.3: Setup re-expands when a run cannot start
    touch(c);
    return;
  }
  c.draft = prepared.draft;                                       // revision rule applied only for an admitted run
  c.admission = null;
  if (!confirmedDiscard) retireDisplayed(c, { acknowledgeUnsaved: false });   // ONLY now: generation++, bridge.clear(), release
  c.runRecord = { basisVerdict: c.soft.verdict };                 // §6.2 step 4: the basis verdict this run was admitted under
  c.hasRun = true;
  c.setupChanged = false;
  c.setupCollapsed = true;                                        // spec §14.3: collapses when a run starts
  adoptHandle(c, handle);
  touch(c);
}

/** Replace/clear path shared by Run, Clear results and New test (restore-table rows "Start a new run"/"Back to All"). */
function retireDisplayed(c, { acknowledgeUnsaved }) {
  bumpGeneration(c);
  clearPoll(c);
  unsubscribeHandle(c);
  void clearViewer(c);
  const released = c.residency.release({ acknowledgeUnsaved: acknowledgeUnsaved === true });
  c.releaseErrors = Array.isArray(released?.errors) ? released.errors : [];
  // T9 retries 'stuck' entries: `released:false` with stuckCount > 0 is reported like a release error.
  c.releaseStuck = released?.released === false && Number(released?.stuckCount) > 0;
  c.residencyNotice = null;
  c.displayed = null;
  c.labels.invalidateNames();
  c.runRecord = null;
  c.handle = null;
  c.run = initialRunState();
}

function safeSnapshot(handle) {
  try { return handle.getSnapshot(); } catch { return null; }
}

function adoptHandle(c, handle) {
  const g = c.gen.current();
  c.handle = handle;
  c.snapshot = safeSnapshot(handle);
  c.run = reduceRun(initialRunState(), { type: 'admitted', snapshot: c.snapshot, runId: handle.runId, atMs: c.scheduler.now() });
  try {
    c.handleUnsub = handle.subscribe((event) => onCoreEvent(c, g, handle, event));
  } catch {
    c.handleUnsub = null;
  }
  schedulePoll(c, g, handle);
  handle.done
    .then((summary) => onRunDone(c, g, handle, summary))
    .then(() => handle.persisted)
    .then((outcome) => onPersisted(c, g, handle, outcome))
    .catch(() => { /* done/persisted never reject; a throwing module must not surface as unhandled */ });
}

function onCoreEvent(c, g, handle, event) {
  if (c.disposed || !c.gen.isCurrent(g) || c.handle !== handle) return;
  c.snapshot = safeSnapshot(handle);
  c.run = reduceRun(c.run, { type: 'core-event', event, snapshot: c.snapshot });
  touch(c);
}

/** While `preparing`, re-read the snapshot at the Panel's low-frequency poll cadence ("Waiting for another run"). */
function schedulePoll(c, g, handle) {
  clearPoll(c);
  if (c.run.phase !== RUN_PHASE.PREPARING) return;
  c.pollTimer = c.scheduler.setTimeout(() => {
    c.pollTimer = null;
    if (c.disposed || !c.gen.isCurrent(g) || c.handle !== handle || c.run.phase !== RUN_PHASE.PREPARING) return;
    c.snapshot = safeSnapshot(handle);
    c.run = reduceRun(c.run, { type: 'poll', snapshot: c.snapshot });
    touch(c);
    schedulePoll(c, g, handle);
  }, READINESS_POLL_MS);
}

function clearPoll(c) {
  if (c.pollTimer !== null) { c.scheduler.clearTimeout(c.pollTimer); c.pollTimer = null; }
}

function unsubscribeHandle(c) {
  const off = c.handleUnsub;
  c.handleUnsub = null;
  if (typeof off === 'function') { try { off(); } catch { /* ignore */ } }
}

function onRunDone(c, g, handle, summary) {
  if (c.disposed || !c.gen.isCurrent(g) || c.handle !== handle) {
    // Superseded (dispose, New test or Clear during the run): release its own set, never display it (§7.6).
    try { c.residency.releaseSuperseded(summary); } catch { /* reported nowhere: nothing is displayed */ }
    return;
  }
  clearPoll(c);
  unsubscribeHandle(c);
  c.snapshot = safeSnapshot(handle);
  c.run = reduceRun(c.run, { type: 'done', summary });
  let adopted = { notice: null };
  try { adopted = c.residency.adopt(summary) ?? adopted; } catch (error) { c.releaseErrors = [error]; }
  c.residencyNotice = adopted.notice ?? null;
  c.displayed = { runId: summary.runId, status: summary.status, resultSet: summary.resultSet ?? null, persistence: summary.persistence ?? null };
  c.labels.invalidateNames();                                     // the displayed run's models join the known set
  if (summary.status === 'failed' || !summary.resultSet) c.setupCollapsed = false;   // §14.3: re-expands on failure
  touch(c);
}

function onPersisted(c, g, handle, outcome) {
  if (c.disposed || !c.gen.isCurrent(g) || c.handle !== handle || c.displayed === null) return;
  let upgraded = null;
  try { upgraded = c.residency.onPersisted(outcome); } catch { upgraded = null; }
  const state = typeof outcome?.state === 'string' ? outcome.state : c.displayed.persistence?.state;
  c.displayed = { ...c.displayed, persistence: { ...(c.displayed.persistence ?? {}), state, timedOut: false } };
  c.residencyNotice = upgraded?.notice ?? (state === 'saved' ? null : c.residencyNotice);
  touch(c);
}

function onRunStop(c) {
  if (c.handle === null || !canStop(c.run)) return;              // Stop: enabled in every non-terminal state
  c.run = reduceRun(c.run, { type: 'stop-requested' });
  try { void c.handle.cancel('user'); } catch { /* Core absorbs a late cancel */ }
  touch(c);
}

function onResultsClear(c) {
  if (isActive(c) || (c.displayed === null && c.run.phase !== RUN_PHASE.DONE)) return;
  if (heldUnsaved(c)) { c.confirm = { for: 'clear' }; touch(c); return; }
  clearResults(c, false);
}

function clearResults(c, acknowledgeUnsaved) {
  c.confirm = null;
  c.admission = null;
  retireDisplayed(c, { acknowledgeUnsaved });
  touch(c);
}

/** The one-time "discard unsaved results?" confirmation for whichever action asked for it. */
function onResultsClearConfirmed(c) {
  const pending = c.confirm;
  if (pending === null) return;
  c.confirm = null;
  if (pending.for === 'clear') clearResults(c, true);
  else if (pending.for === 'newTest') newTest(c, true);
  else if (pending.for === 'run' && canRunNow(c)) startRun(c, { acknowledgeUnsaved: true });
  else touch(c);
}

/** "Release previous results and retry" after a ResultCapacityError caused by the Panel's own set (§7.6). */
function onReleaseAndRetry(c) {
  if (c.admission?.action !== 'release-and-retry' || isActive(c)) return;
  c.admission = null;
  // The explicit user action is the acknowledgement; startRun releases the previous set BEFORE admission.
  if (canRunNow(c)) { startRun(c, { acknowledgeUnsaved: true }); return; }
  retireDisplayed(c, { acknowledgeUnsaved: true });
  touch(c);
}

/** Resolves with the plain-JSON diagnostics of the displayed set (spec §8.4), or null when none is displayed. */
function onDiagnosticsCopy(c) {
  const set = c.displayed?.resultSet ?? null;
  return set === null ? null : diagnosticsExport(set);
}

// ── dispose (restore-table row "Extension unload / dispose") ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Disposal contract → Promise<{released:boolean, errors:Error[]}> (never rejects; the same promise on repeat).
 * Cancels an active run with 'panel-disposed' and resolves ONLY AFTER (a) that run's `handle.done` has settled,
 * (b) its sealed set was released (releaseSuperseded) and THEN the final `disposeAll()` ran — which also retries
 * any `stuck` release (a transient late-set failure) once — and (c) the bridge is disposed. `released:false` only
 * when a release still fails after that retry (terminal policy: report, never hang). Waiting is bounded by every
 * wait the engine owns; it is unbounded only by a unit executor that never returns (Core open item O9):
 * `engine.dispose()` signals the run and waits for its drain as well, so the Panel has no escape hatch — a host
 * whose executor can hang must accept that or not await panel.dispose().
 */
function dispose(c) {
  if (c.disposing !== null) return c.disposing;
  c.disposed = true;
  const active = c.handle !== null && canStop(c.run) ? c.handle : null;
  const errors = [];
  c.disposing = (async () => {
    const step = (fn) => { try { return fn(); } catch (error) { errors.push(error); return undefined; } };
    step(() => bumpGeneration(c));
    step(() => clearPoll(c));
    if (active !== null) step(() => { void active.cancel('panel-disposed'); });
    step(() => unsubscribeHandle(c));
    step(() => c.queue.dispose());
    for (const off of c.disposers.splice(0)) step(() => off());
    if (active !== null) {
      let summary = null;
      try { summary = await active.done; } catch (error) { errors.push(error); }   // done never rejects; guarded anyway
      // The late-done handler already tried releaseSuperseded; repeating it here makes the release part of THIS
      // promise regardless of callback order (a non-resident set is a no-op; a failure is kept as `stuck`).
      if (summary !== null) {
        const r = step(() => c.residency.releaseSuperseded(summary));
        if (Array.isArray(r?.errors)) errors.push(...r.errors);
      }
    }
    // Final release of the displayed set + one retry of every stuck release, AFTER the late set was handled.
    const report = step(() => c.residency.disposeAll()) ?? { stuckCount: 1, errors: [] };
    c.disposeReport = report;
    if (Array.isArray(report.errors)) errors.push(...report.errors);
    try { await c.bridge.dispose(); } catch (error) { errors.push(error); }
    c.subscribers.clear();
    return { released: (Number(report.stuckCount) || 0) === 0, errors: [...errors] };
  })().then((outcome) => outcome, (error) => ({ released: false, errors: [...errors, error] }));
  return c.disposing;
}

// ── view input (pure data handed to viewModel.js) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function viewInput(c) {
  return {
    version: c.version,
    setup: setupInput(c),
    run: runInput(c),
    displayed: displayedInput(c),
    list: listInput(c),
    selected: selectedInput(c),
  };
}

function setupInput(c) {
  let entries = [];
  try { entries = c.catalog.list() ?? []; } catch { entries = []; }
  const models = (Array.isArray(entries) ? entries : []).map((e) => {
    const modelKey = typeof e?.modelKey === 'string' ? e.modelKey : null;
    // Keyed models show the disambiguated name (RF-2); an unidentified model shows the host's raw name.
    const displayName = modelKey !== null ? c.labels.modelName(modelKey) : String(e?.displayName ?? '');
    return { modelKey, displayName, loaded: e?.loaded === true, registered: modelKey !== null && readBinding(c, modelKey) !== null };
  });
  return {
    draft: c.draft, validation: c.validation, soft: c.soft, models,
    modelName: (modelKey) => c.labels.modelName(modelKey),
    setupChangedSinceRun: c.setupChanged, collapsed: c.setupCollapsed, runActive: isActive(c),
  };
}

function runInput(c) {
  return {
    machine: c.run,
    snapshot: isActive(c) ? c.snapshot : null,
    elapsedMs: c.run.startedAtMs === null || !isActive(c) ? null : Math.max(0, c.scheduler.now() - c.run.startedAtMs),
    canRun: canRunNow(c),
    canStop: !c.disposed && c.handle !== null && canStop(c.run),
    admission: c.admission, confirm: c.confirm, releaseErrors: c.releaseErrors, releaseStuck: c.releaseStuck,
    residencyNotice: c.residencyNotice, setupChanged: c.setupChanged, isolationNotice: c.isolationNotice,
  };
}

function displayedInput(c) {
  if (c.displayed === null) return null;
  return { ...c.displayed, freshness: null, freshnessPending: false, claim: null, claimPending: false };
}

/** Task 16 has no browsable list yet (Task 17 builds the results pipeline). */
function listInput() { return null; }

/** Task 16 has no selection yet (Task 18 adds selection and navigation). */
function selectedInput() { return null; }

// ── dispatch ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const DISPATCH = {
  [INTENT.SETUP_NAME]: onSetupName,
  [INTENT.SETUP_MODE]: onSetupMode,
  [INTENT.SETUP_CLEARANCE]: onSetupClearance,
  [INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_MODEL]: onSetupToggleModel,
  [INTENT.SETUP_USE_SELECTION]: onSetupUseSelection,
  [INTENT.SETUP_SELF_CLASH]: onSetupSelfClash,
  [INTENT.SETUP_NEW_TEST]: onSetupNewTest,
  [INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_COLLAPSED]: onSetupToggleCollapsed,
  [INTENT.RUN_START]: onRunStart,
  [INTENT.RUN_STOP]: onRunStop,
  [INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR]: onResultsClear,
  [INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR_CONFIRMED]: onResultsClearConfirmed,
  [INTENT.RUN_RELEASE_AND_RETRY]: onReleaseAndRetry,
  [INTENT.DIAGNOSTICS_COPY]: onDiagnosticsCopy,
};

/** Unknown intents throw synchronously (a programming error in the UI); known intents resolve after their effect
 *  (with `undefined`, except DIAGNOSTICS_COPY which resolves with the diagnostics string). */
function dispatch(c, intent) {
  if (intent === null || typeof intent !== 'object' || typeof intent.type !== 'string') {
    throw new TypeError('unknown intent: an intent must be an object with a string `type`');
  }
  const handler = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(DISPATCH, intent.type) ? DISPATCH[intent.type] : undefined;
  if (handler === undefined) throw new TypeError(`unknown intent: ${intent.type}`);
  if (c.disposed) return Promise.resolve(undefined);
  try {
    return Promise.resolve(handler(c, intent));
  } catch (error) {
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
}
```

```js
// clashpanel/core/viewModel.js
// PURE builder: (view input assembled by the controller) -> deep-frozen ViewModel of the exact catalog shape.
// The UI renders ONLY this object (AC-P21). No Viewer/DOM access; all Viewer-derived strings arrive in the input
// already resolved (labels, rows) and stay raw text (the UI inserts them with textContent, AC-P13).
// Task 16 fills `setup` and `run`; `filters`/`results`/`selected` are shape-complete defaults that Tasks 17–19
// replace region by region.
import { PAGE_SIZE } from './constants.js';
import { runHeadline, STATEMENTS } from './runReport.js';
import { INTENT } from './intents.js';

// ── shared helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function deepFreeze(value) {
  if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Object.isFrozen(value)) {
    Object.freeze(value);
    for (const key of Object.keys(value)) deepFreeze(value[key]);
  }
  return value;
}

const plural = (n, one, many) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;
const NON_TERMINAL = new Set(['preparing', 'planning', 'running', 'stopping', 'finalizing']);

export const READY_TEXT = 'Ready to run';
export const PHASE_TEXT = Object.freeze({
  preparing: 'Preparing…', planning: 'Planning…', running: 'Running…',
  stopping: 'Stopping… (finishing the current step)', finalizing: 'Finalizing…',
});
export const WAITING_TEXT = 'Waiting for another run…';
export const BEFORE_RUN_TEXT = 'Run a test to see clashes.';
export const RUNNING_RESULTS_TEXT = 'Results appear when the run finishes.';
export const DISCARD_TEXT = Object.freeze({
  run: 'The current results are held in memory only. Running again discards them — discard and run?',
  clear: 'These results are held in memory only. Clearing discards them — discard?',
  newTest: 'The current results are held in memory only. Starting a new test discards them — discard?',
});
export const RELEASE_ERROR_TEXT = 'The previous results could not be released cleanly.';
export const SOFT_CHECKING_TEXT = 'Checking whether Soft is available for these models…';
export const ISOLATION_NOTICE = Object.freeze({
  'skipped-external': { kind: 'info', text: 'Isolation was changed elsewhere, so the Panel left it as is.' },
  failed: { kind: 'warning', text: 'Isolation could not be restored.' },
});
const DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_MAX = 10;   // presentation-only: preview lines shown beside "Copy diagnostics" (not a limit)

/** mapAdmissionError().action → the banner button the UI renders (label + the exact intent it dispatches). */
const ADMISSION_ACTIONS = Object.freeze({
  'release-and-retry': { label: 'Release previous results and retry', intent: { type: INTENT.RUN_RELEASE_AND_RETRY } },
  'clear-results': { label: 'Clear results', intent: { type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR } },
});
const CONFIRM_ACTION = Object.freeze({ label: 'Discard unsaved results', intent: { type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR_CONFIRMED } });

// ── setup region ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function describeScope(side, modelName) {
  const parts = side.modelKeys.map((key) => modelName(key));
  for (const [key, dbIds] of Object.entries(side.elements)) {
    if (side.modelKeys.includes(key)) continue;                   // a model entry wins over elements (§6.1)
    parts.push(`${plural(dbIds.length, 'element', 'elements')} in ${modelName(key)}`);
  }
  return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join('; ') : 'Nothing selected';
}

function modelNote(m) {
  if (m.modelKey === null || !m.registered) return `Model ${m.displayName} is not registered`;
  if (!m.loaded) return `Model ${m.displayName} is still loading`;
  return null;
}

function inSide(side, modelKey) {
  return modelKey !== null && (side.modelKeys.includes(modelKey) || Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(side.elements, modelKey));
}

function buildSetupRegion(input) {
  const s = input.setup;
  const { draft, validation, soft } = s;
  const checking = soft.pending === true;
  // While the basis verdict is pending, Soft stays unavailable (Run disabled, fail closed) but is never described
  // as "not a verified basis": the Soft finding reads as a check in progress and no explanation is shown.
  const messages = (validation?.findings ?? []).map((f) => ({
    control: f.control,
    text: checking && (f.code === 'soft-checking' || f.code === 'soft-unavailable') ? SOFT_CHECKING_TEXT : f.text,
  }));
  const scopeA = describeScope(draft.setA, s.modelName);
  const scopeB = draft.selfClash ? 'Same as Set A' : describeScope(draft.setB, s.modelName);
  const modeText = draft.mode === 'soft' ? `Soft (clearance ${draft.clearance === '' ? 'not set' : draft.clearance})` : 'Hard';
  return {
    collapsed: s.collapsed === true,
    summary: `${draft.name} · ${modeText} · A: ${scopeA} · B: ${scopeB}`,
    name: draft.name,
    mode: draft.mode,
    softAvailability: { available: soft.available === true && !checking, pending: checking, explanation: checking ? null : (soft.explanation ?? null) },
    clearance: {
      value: draft.clearance,
      visible: draft.mode === 'soft' && soft.available === true && !checking,   // §6.1: only while Soft is available
      error: messages.find((m) => m.control === 'clearance')?.text ?? null,
    },
    models: s.models.map((m) => ({
      modelKey: m.modelKey, displayName: m.displayName, ready: m.loaded, registered: m.registered,
      inA: inSide(draft.setA, m.modelKey),
      inB: draft.selfClash ? inSide(draft.setA, m.modelKey) : inSide(draft.setB, m.modelKey),
      note: modelNote(m),
    })),
    selfClash: draft.selfClash,
    useSelectionEnabled: s.runActive !== true,
    scope: { A: scopeA, B: scopeB },
    validation: { state: validation?.state === 'ready' ? 'ready' : 'blocked', messages, issuesTruncated: validation?.issuesTruncated === true },
    setupChangedSinceRun: s.setupChangedSinceRun === true,
  };
}

// ── run region ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function formatElapsed(ms) {
  const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Number.isFinite(ms) ? ms : 0) / 1000));
  return `${Math.floor(total / 60)}:${String(total % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function progressOf(run) {
  const snap = run.snapshot ?? {};
  const num = (v) => (Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0);
  return {
    fraction: Number.isFinite(snap.fractionProcessed) ? snap.fractionProcessed : null,   // null ⇒ indeterminate
    unitsEvaluated: num(snap.unitsEvaluated),
    unitsTotal: num(snap.unitsTotal),
    resultsFound: num(snap.resultsFound),
    caveatCount: num(snap.caveatCount),
    elapsedText: formatElapsed(run.elapsedMs),                                            // the Panel's clock; no ETA
  };
}

function headlineOf(input) {
  const m = input.run.machine;
  if (m.phase === 'idle') return READY_TEXT;
  if (m.phase === 'preparing' && m.waitingForOtherRun === true) return WAITING_TEXT;
  if (PHASE_TEXT[m.phase] !== undefined) return PHASE_TEXT[m.phase];
  const d = input.displayed;
  if (d === null || d.resultSet === null) return STATEMENTS.NO_RESULT_SET;
  const set = d.resultSet;
  return runHeadline({ status: set.outcome.status, total: set.results.length, coverage: set.outcome.coverage, resultSet: set });
}

function countsOf() {
  return { total: null, filtered: null };
}

function badgesOf() {
  return null;
}

/** Controller-owned banners (admission error, discard confirmation, release errors, residency notice). */
function controllerBanners(input) {
  const r = input.run;
  const banners = [];
  if (r.admission) {
    const action = ADMISSION_ACTIONS[r.admission.action];
    banners.push({ id: 'admission-error', kind: 'error', text: r.admission.text, ...(action ? { action: { label: action.label, intent: { ...action.intent } } } : {}) });
  }
  if (r.confirm) {
    banners.push({ id: 'confirm-discard-unsaved', kind: 'warning', text: DISCARD_TEXT[r.confirm.for] ?? DISCARD_TEXT.clear, action: { label: CONFIRM_ACTION.label, intent: { ...CONFIRM_ACTION.intent } } });
  }
  if (r.releaseErrors.length > 0 || r.releaseStuck === true) banners.push({ id: 'release-error', kind: 'warning', text: RELEASE_ERROR_TEXT, details: r.releaseErrors.map((e) => String(e?.name ?? 'Error')) });
  if (r.residencyNotice) banners.push({ id: 'residency-notice', kind: 'info', text: r.residencyNotice });
  const iso = ISOLATION_NOTICE[r.isolationNotice];
  if (iso) banners.push({ id: 'isolation-notice', kind: iso.kind, text: iso.text });
  return banners;
}

function runBanners(input) {
  return controllerBanners(input);
}

/** Short plain-text preview for "Copy diagnostics" (≤ DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_MAX lines); the full JSON comes from
 *  dispatch(DIAGNOSTICS_COPY). Every value is Core data rendered as text (no markup). */
function diagnosticsOf(input) {
  const set = input.displayed?.resultSet ?? null;
  if (set === null) return null;
  const lines = [`Status: ${set.outcome?.status ?? 'unknown'} · coverage ${set.outcome?.coverage ?? '?'} · integrity ${set.outcome?.integrity ?? '?'}`];
  for (const reason of set.outcome?.reasons ?? []) lines.push(`Reason: ${String(reason)}`);
  for (const gap of set.ledger?.planningGaps ?? []) lines.push(`Planning gap: ${String(gap?.phase ?? '?')} — ${String(gap?.cause ?? '?')}`);
  const total = set.diagnostics?.total;
  if (Number.isFinite(total)) lines.push(`Diagnostics: ${total}`);
  if (set.diagnostics?.truncated === true) lines.push(STATEMENTS.DIAGNOSTICS_TRUNCATED);
  return { available: true, preview: lines.slice(0, DIAGNOSTICS_PREVIEW_MAX) };
}

/** aria-live text for the status region. */
function describeStatusLive(run) {
  return run.headline;
}

function buildRunRegion(input) {
  const r = input.run;
  const m = r.machine;
  const state = m.phase;
  const run = {
    state,
    doneKind: state === 'done' ? (m.terminal?.status ?? null) : null,
    canRun: r.canRun === true,
    canStop: r.canStop === true,
    progress: NON_TERMINAL.has(state) ? progressOf(r) : null,
    headline: headlineOf(input),
    counts: countsOf(input),
    badges: badgesOf(input),
    banners: runBanners(input),
    diagnostics: diagnosticsOf(input),
    statusLive: '',
    waitingForOtherRun: m.waitingForOtherRun === true,
  };
  run.statusLive = describeStatusLive(run);
  return run;
}

// ── filters / results / selected regions (Task 16 defaults) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const DEFAULT_SORT_OPTIONS = Object.freeze([{ value: 'default', label: 'Default order' }]);

function defaultFilters() {
  return {
    text: '', models: [], modelOptions: [], maxGap: { visible: false, value: '', max: null, error: null },
    unverified: false, hasLocation: false, elementOnly: null, groupBy: 'none', groupingNote: null,
    sort: 'default', sortOptions: DEFAULT_SORT_OPTIONS.map((o) => ({ ...o })), active: false, busy: false,
  };
}

function buildFiltersRegion() {
  return defaultFilters();
}

export const NO_SELECTION_TEXT = 'No clash selected';

function resultsBase() {
  return {
    state: 'before-run', message: BEFORE_RUN_TEXT, lines: [], view: 'flat',
    page: { index: 0, count: 0, size: PAGE_SIZE }, rows: [], multiValuedNote: null, hiddenByFiltersNote: false,
    nav: { canPrev: false, canNext: false, label: NO_SELECTION_TEXT },
  };
}

function buildResultsRegion(input) {
  const base = resultsBase();
  if (NON_TERMINAL.has(input.run.machine.phase)) return { ...base, state: 'running', message: RUNNING_RESULTS_TEXT };
  const d = input.displayed;
  if (d === null) return base;
  if (d.resultSet === null) return { ...base, state: 'error', message: STATEMENTS.NO_RESULT_SET };
  return { ...base, state: 'list', message: null };                // rows arrive with Task 17's results pipeline
}

function buildSelectedRegion() {
  return null;
}

// ── entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function buildViewModel(input) {
  return deepFreeze({
    version: input.version,
    setup: buildSetupRegion(input),
    run: buildRunRegion(input),
    filters: buildFiltersRegion(input),
    results: buildResultsRegion(input),
    selected: buildSelectedRegion(input),
  });
}
```

### Task 17: Controller II (results pipeline: index, summarize, caveat mask, claim, freshness, filters/grouping/sort/page)

**Tier:** [A] format-agnostic headless

**Files:**
- Modify: `clashpanel/core/controller.js`, `clashpanel/core/viewModel.js`
- Test: `test/clashpanel/core/controller.results.test.mjs`

**Scope note:** After a sealed set the controller builds the ResultIndex once, submits `summarize` (priority 0) then the one `caveated` mask (priority 1) through the single-flight queue (one successful computation per `(generation, key)`, AC-P4), reads freshness (and, for an EMPTY set only, `assessNoClashClaim`) with the generation's AbortSignal, and keeps the list as one sliced Panel-side filter pass (`filterEpoch` inside the generation) + a typed-array ordered index. Group by Element = one `computeElementGroups` per generation, cached in `pipe.groupTable`; failure ⇒ `'Grouping unavailable for a set this large — showing the flat list.'` (T13's `GROUPING_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT`). No `getPairStatus`/`getElementStatus` anywhere. Freshness is re-checked on done, catalog change (model add/remove/readiness) and `PANEL_SHOWN` (model-left in T18); older checks are superseded by a sequence number. **Claim gate (independent Work review H1).** `engine.getFreshness` and `engine.assessNoClashClaim` each recompute live freshness, so their results can disagree (claim allowed at t1, stale at t2). The pair is therefore ONE snapshot: for an EMPTY set the controller commits `pipe.freshness` and `pipe.claim` **together, only when both reads of the same check have completed** (never one half from an earlier check; a superseded/aborted check commits nothing), and `recheckFreshness` withdraws the held claim synchronously (`claim = null`, `claimPending = true`) so an old `allowed` never outlives the event that invalidated it. `buildResultsRegion` in `viewModel.js` is the single owner of the view decision: it hands `emptyStatement` (T11, the pure gate) the pair only when neither half is pending (`claimGateOf`), and `emptyStatement` renders clearance wording only for `claim.allowed === true` ∧ `freshness.state === 'current'`. The Core is unchanged; PR-OQ17 (placement invalidation reaching the Panel) stays a host gate — an invalidation the Panel never hears about is the documented residual, not something the Panel can close. In this task a filter/sort/group change resets to page 0 (T18 makes the page follow the selection).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `buildResultIndex(set) -> {count, at, indexOfResultId, models, isSoft, clearance, …}` (T10); `EMPTY_FILTER_SPEC`, `isFilterActive(spec)`, `parseMaxGap(text, clearance) -> {value, error}`, `runFilterPass({index, spec, caveatedIds, labelText, scheduler, isCurrent}) -> Uint32Array|'superseded'|'mask-missing'`, `FILTER_MASK_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT` (T12); `computeElementGroups({queue, engine, resultSet})`, `filterGroups(table, {matchIds, index})`, `sortGroups(groups, 'core'|'count-desc'|'label', labelOf)`, `matchIdsFrom(matching, index)`, `GROUPING_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT`, `MULTI_VALUED_NOTE` (T13); `buildOrderedIndex({view, matching, index, sortKey, groups, expanded})` (`.view`, `.length`, `entryAt`), `pageSlice`, `clampPage` (T14); `describeAxes(outcome, freshness|null)`, `bannersFor({terminal, resultSet, freshness, setupChanged, persistence})`, `emptyStatement({resultSet, claim|null, freshness|null, modelName}) -> {kind, text, lines}|null` (T11); `resolveResult`, `buildRow`, `buildGroupHeaderRow`, `livenessOf` (T15); `engine.derivations.summarize(set,{signal})`, `engine.derivations.filter(set, [{facet:'caveated',op:'eq',value:true}], {signal}) -> {matches,…}`, `engine.getFreshness(runId,{signal}) -> {state, reasons}`, `engine.assessNoClashClaim(runId,{signal})` (EnginePort, catalog §1).
- Produces: controller handlers for `FILTER_TEXT` (debounced `FILTER_DEBOUNCE_MS`), `FILTER_MODEL {value:string[]}`, `FILTER_MAX_GAP {value:string}`, `FILTER_UNVERIFIED`, `FILTER_HAS_LOCATION`, `FILTER_ELEMENT {ref}`, `FILTER_CLEAR`, `GROUP_MODE`, `GROUP_TOGGLE`, `SORT_SET`, `NAV_PAGE {page}`, `PANEL_SHOWN`; ViewModel `run.counts`, `run.badges`, report banners, `filters.*`, `results.*` (except nav/hidden note); the view input's `displayed.runRecord`. New viewModel exports `SORT_LABELS`, `EMPTY_FILTERED_TEXT`, `INDEX_FAILED_TEXT` and `buildRunDetails({resultSet, runRecord, modelName}) -> [{label:string, value:string}]` (definition name/mode/clearance, startedAt/finishedAt, determinismClass, per-model key/version/bindingGeneration, libraryExclusions, and for Soft the basis verdict captured at run start — never `elementCount`).

**Depends on:** T7, T10–T16.

// AC-P2, AC-P4, AC-P15).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { getEventListeners } from 'node:events';
import { GroupingTooLargeError } from '../../../clashtest/index.js';
import { INTENT } from '../../../clashpanel/core/intents.js';

const allStrings = (value, out = []) => {
  if (typeof value === 'string') out.push(value);
  else if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object') for (const v of Object.values(value)) allStrings(v, out);
  return out;
};

async function doneWith(set, opts) {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.runToDone(set, opts);

}

  assert.deepEqual([vm.run.badges.coverage.value, vm.run.badges.integrity.value, vm.run.badges.freshness.value], ['full', 'clean', 'current']);
  assert.equal(vm.run.badges.freshness.pending, false);
  const row = vm.results.rows[0];
  assert.deepEqual([row.ordinal, row.side1.modelName, row.side1.label, row.side2.modelName, row.gap, row.liveness], [1, 'Architecture', 'A-1000', 'Structure', null, 'live']);
  assert.equal(vm.results.rows[3].badges.includes('caveated'), true);      // hardResults: i % 7 === 3 is caveated
  assert.equal(vm.results.rows[9].badges.includes('no location'), true);
  const firstSummarize = h.engine.control.summarize.args.length;

  assert.equal(h.engine.control.summarize.successes, 1);
  assert.equal(h.engine.control.filter.successes, 1);

});

test('AC-P4: 50 filter/sort/group/page interactions — no startRun, no Viewer call, no per-interaction derivation', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(300) }));
  const bridgeCalls = h.bridge.calls.length;
  const intents = [
    { type: INTENT.FILTER_UNVERIFIED, value: true }, { type: INTENT.FILTER_UNVERIFIED, value: false },
    { type: INTENT.FILTER_HAS_LOCATION, value: true }, { type: INTENT.FILTER_HAS_LOCATION, value: false },
    { type: INTENT.FILTER_MODEL, value: ['mA'] }, { type: INTENT.FILTER_MODEL, value: [] },

  ];
  let n = 0;
  while (n < 50) {

    await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_TEXT, value: `a-10${n % 10}` });

  assert.equal(h.engine.control.summarize.successes, 1);
  assert.equal(h.engine.control.filter.successes, 1);                      // the one cached caveated mask
  assert.equal(h.engine.control.groupBy.successes, 1);                     // one groupBy per (generation, spec)
  assert.deepEqual(h.engine.forbidden, []);                                // no getPairStatus/getElementStatus

  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(100) }));

test('pagination clamps; freshness is async ("checking" while pending) and re-checked on Panel show and catalog change', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();

  assert.equal(vm.run.badges.freshness.pending, false);

  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.engine.control.getFreshness.calls, 3);

});

test('H1 claim gate: an allowed claim is never worded while EITHER read is pending, whichever read lands first', async () => {
  const ALLOWED = { allowed: true, unqualified: true, qualifiers: [], exclusions: [], proofMethod: 'bracketed-digest' };
  const CURRENT = { state: 'current', reasons: [] };
  const held = async () => {
    const h = makeHarness();
    await h.readyHard();
    h.engine.control.getFreshness.manual = true;
    h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.manual = true;
    const seen = [];
    h.controller.subscribe((vm) => seen.push(vm.results.state));
    await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: [] }));
    assert.equal(h.engine.control.getFreshness.pending.length, 1);
    assert.equal(h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.pending.length, 1);
    return { h, seen };
  };
  // (1) claim lands first (freshness still pending): pending wording, badge still "checking", NOT the claim.
  const a = await held();
  a.h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.resolveNext(ALLOWED);
  await a.h.settle();
  assert.equal(a.h.vm().results.state, 'empty-nonclaim');
  assert.equal(a.h.vm().results.message, STATEMENTS.CLAIM_PENDING);
  assert.equal(a.h.vm().run.badges.freshness.pending, true);
  assert.ok(!a.seen.includes('empty-claim'), 'no claim was ever published while freshness was pending');
  a.h.engine.control.getFreshness.resolveNext(CURRENT);
  await a.h.settle();
  assert.equal(a.h.vm().results.state, 'empty-claim');                       // both complete ∧ allowed ∧ current
  assert.equal(a.h.vm().results.message, STATEMENTS.CLAIM);
  assert.equal(a.h.vm().run.badges.freshness.value, 'current');
  // (2) freshness lands first (claim still pending): the badge does not move until the pair lands, and no claim yet.
  const b = await held();
  b.h.engine.control.getFreshness.resolveNext(CURRENT);
  await b.h.settle();
  assert.equal(b.h.vm().results.message, STATEMENTS.CLAIM_PENDING);
  assert.equal(b.h.vm().run.badges.freshness.pending, true);
  assert.ok(!b.seen.includes('empty-claim'));
  b.h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.resolveNext(ALLOWED);
  await b.h.settle();
  assert.equal(b.h.vm().results.state, 'empty-claim');
  // (3) the claim read fails (Core error): fail closed even with a current freshness — never a clearance.
  const c = await held();
  c.h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.rejectNext(new Error('claim read failed'));
  c.h.engine.control.getFreshness.resolveNext(CURRENT);
  await c.h.settle();
  assert.equal(c.h.vm().results.state, 'empty-nonclaim');
  assert.deepEqual(c.h.vm().results.lines, [STATEMENTS.NO_CONFIRMATION]);
  assert.ok(!c.seen.includes('empty-claim'));
});

test('H1 claim gate (adverse ordering): claim allowed at t1 but freshness stale at t2 ⇒ stale wording, in either resolution order, never the claim', async () => {
  const ALLOWED = { allowed: true, unqualified: true, qualifiers: [], exclusions: [], proofMethod: 'bracketed-digest' };
  const STALE = { state: 'stale', reasons: ['scope-drift'] };
  for (const order of ['claim-then-freshness', 'freshness-then-claim']) {
    const h = makeHarness();
    await h.readyHard();
    h.engine.control.getFreshness.manual = true;
    h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.manual = true;
    const seen = [];
    h.controller.subscribe((vm) => seen.push([vm.results.state, vm.results.message]));
    await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: [] }));
    if (order === 'claim-then-freshness') {
      h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.resolveNext(ALLOWED);              // the earlier assessment: allowed
      h.engine.control.getFreshness.resolveNext(STALE);                      // the later read: the model moved in between
    } else {
      h.engine.control.getFreshness.resolveNext(STALE);
      h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.resolveNext(ALLOWED);
    }
    await h.settle();
    const vm = h.vm();
    assert.equal(vm.results.state, 'empty-nonclaim', order);
    assert.equal(vm.results.message, STATEMENTS.NON_CLAIM, order);
    assert.equal(vm.results.lines[0], STATEMENTS.STALE, order);
    assert.equal(vm.run.badges.freshness.value, 'stale', order);
    assert.ok(vm.run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'stale'), order);
    assert.ok(!seen.some(([state, message]) => state === 'empty-claim' || message === STATEMENTS.CLAIM), `${order}: the claim was never published`);
    for (const str of allStrings(vm)) assert.notEqual(str.trim().replace(/[.!]$/, ''), 'No clashes');
  }
});

test('H1 claim gate: a held claim is withdrawn synchronously when a re-check starts, and a superseded pair never commits', async () => {
  const ALLOWED = { allowed: true, unqualified: true, qualifiers: [], exclusions: [], proofMethod: 'bracketed-digest' };
  const STALE = { state: 'stale', reasons: ['scope-drift'] };
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: [] }));       // auto-resolving reads: allowed + current
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.state, 'empty-claim');
  h.engine.control.getFreshness.manual = true;
  h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.manual = true;
  const seen = [];
  h.controller.subscribe((vm) => seen.push(vm.results.state));
  h.catalog.fire();                                                           // a model change ⇒ re-check
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.state, 'empty-nonclaim');                       // BEFORE any read lands: the old claim is gone
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.message, STATEMENTS.CLAIM_PENDING);
  await h.settle();
  h.catalog.fire();                                                           // a second event supersedes the first check
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.engine.control.getFreshness.pending.length, 2);              // (the first, aborted pair stays in the fake's list)
  h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.resolveAll(ALLOWED);                    // the aborted pair's late claim is a no-op
  h.engine.control.getFreshness.resolveAll(STALE);
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.state, 'empty-nonclaim');
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.lines[0], STATEMENTS.STALE);
  assert.ok(!seen.includes('empty-claim'), 'the invalidated claim was never shown again');
});

test('H1 claim gate: a FAILED freshness read is "unverifiable" — never current, never a clearance — even when the claim read says allowed', async () => {
  const ALLOWED = { allowed: true, unqualified: true, qualifiers: [], exclusions: [], proofMethod: 'bracketed-digest' };
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  h.engine.control.getFreshness.manual = true;
  h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.manual = true;
  const seen = [];
  h.controller.subscribe((vm) => seen.push(vm.results.state));
  await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: [] }));
  h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.resolveNext(ALLOWED);
  h.engine.control.getFreshness.rejectNext(new Error('freshness read failed'));
  await h.settle();
  const vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.state, 'empty-nonclaim');
  assert.equal(vm.results.message, STATEMENTS.NON_CLAIM);
  assert.equal(vm.results.lines[0], STATEMENTS.STALE);
  assert.deepEqual([vm.run.badges.freshness.value, vm.run.badges.freshness.pending], ['unverifiable', false]);
  assert.ok(!seen.includes('empty-claim'), 'no clearance was ever published');
  // A non-empty set needs no claim; a failed freshness read still lands as 'unverifiable' (not pending, not 'current').
  const nonEmpty = makeHarness();
  await nonEmpty.readyHard();
  nonEmpty.engine.control.getFreshness.failNext.push(new Error('freshness read failed'));
  await nonEmpty.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(2) }));
  assert.deepEqual([nonEmpty.vm().run.badges.freshness.value, nonEmpty.vm().run.badges.freshness.pending], ['unverifiable', false]);
});

test('freshness re-checks never accumulate abort listeners on the generation signal (completed AND superseded checks)', async () => {
  const created = [];
  const RealAbortController = globalThis.AbortController;
  globalThis.AbortController = class extends RealAbortController { constructor() { super(); created.push(this); } };
  try {
    const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(2) }));
    const before = created.slice();                                          // every controller that exists before the burst
    const count = (ac) => getEventListeners(ac.signal, 'abort').length;
    const base = new Map(before.map((ac) => [ac, count(ac)]));
    // Net listener growth on the pre-burst signals that are still live (the generation signal is one of them; a
    // superseded check's own controller is aborted, so it is not counted).
    const growth = () => before.filter((ac) => !ac.signal.aborted).reduce((n, ac) => n + count(ac) - base.get(ac), 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i += 1) { h.catalog.fire(); await h.settle(); }   // 40 completed re-checks
    assert.equal(growth(), 0, 'completed checks leave no listener behind');
    h.engine.control.getFreshness.manual = true;                              // superseded (never-completing) checks
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i += 1) { h.catalog.fire(); await h.settle(); }
    assert.ok(growth() <= 1, `only the newest pending check may listen (growth ${growth()})`);
    h.engine.control.getFreshness.resolveAll({ state: 'current', reasons: [] });
    await h.settle();
    assert.equal(growth(), 0, 'once the last check settles nothing is left');
  } finally {
    globalThis.AbortController = RealAbortController;
  }
});

test('AC-P15: late summarize / mask / freshness / claim / groupBy from a superseded generation never change the display', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  for (const name of ['summarize', 'filter', 'getFreshness', 'assessNoClashClaim']) h.engine.control[name].manual = true;
  await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: [] }));
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.state, 'empty-nonclaim');                   // claim pending ⇒ never a claim yet
  h.engine.control.summarize.manual = false;
  h.engine.control.filter.manual = false;
  h.engine.control.getFreshness.manual = false;
  h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.manual = false;
  // Supersede: a new run is admitted while run-1's reads/derivations are still pending.
  const handle2 = await h.start();
  handle2.emitState({ status: 'planning', phase: 'enumerating' });
  await h.settle();
  const during = h.vm();
  h.engine.control.getFreshness.resolveAll({ state: 'stale', reasons: ['late'] });
  h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.resolveAll();
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm(), during);                                            // nothing committed from generation 1
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.has('run-1'), false);                     // run-1's set was still released
  handle2.finish({ status: 'completed', resultSet: makeSet({ runId: handle2.runId, results: hardResults(3) }) });
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.badges.freshness.value, 'current');
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.rows.length, 3);
});

test('run details (§8.4): sealed-set facts + the basis verdict captured at run start; never elementCount; raw names', () => {
  const hostile = '<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>';
  const soft = makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', mode: 'clearance', clearance: 0.05, results: [] });
  const lines = buildRunDetails({ resultSet: soft, runRecord: { basisVerdict: { state: 'verified', basisKey: 'shared-m' } }, modelName: (k) => (k === 'mA' ? hostile : 'Structure') });
  assert.deepEqual(lines.map((l) => l.label), ['Test', 'Mode', 'Clearance', 'Started', 'Finished', 'Determinism', `Model ${hostile}`, 'Model Structure', 'Library exclusions', 'Measurement basis (at run start)']);
  assert.deepEqual(lines.slice(0, 3).map((l) => l.value), ['Clash test 1', 'Soft (clearance)', '0.05']);
  assert.equal(lines[6].value, 'key mA · version v1 · binding generation 1');
  assert.equal(lines.at(-1).value, 'verified (shared-m)');
  assert.ok(lines.every((l) => typeof l.label === 'string' && typeof l.value === 'string'));
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(lines).includes('999999'), false);          // makeSet's provenance elementCount (G-EC)
  const hard = buildRunDetails({ resultSet: makeSet({ runId: 'run-2' }) });
  assert.equal(hard.some((l) => l.label === 'Clearance' || l.label.startsWith('Measurement basis')), false);
  assert.equal(buildRunDetails({ resultSet: soft, runRecord: { basisVerdict: null } }).at(-1).value, 'single model (no cross-model comparison)');
  assert.equal(buildRunDetails({ resultSet: soft, runRecord: { basisVerdict: { state: 'unverified', reason: 'units differ' } } }).at(-1).value, 'unverified: units differ');
});

test('unverified filter: a PENDING mask keeps the committed list (busy) until it lands; an UNAVAILABLE mask is an explicit error, never an empty list', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  h.engine.control.filter.manual = true;
  await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(20) }));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_UNVERIFIED, value: true });
  let vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.filters.busy, true);
  assert.equal(vm.run.counts.filtered, 20);                                 // previous list kept while pending
  assert.equal(vm.results.rows.length, 20);
  h.engine.control.filter.resolveNext();
  await h.settle();
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.filters.busy, false);
  assert.equal(vm.run.counts.filtered, 3);                                  // hardResults: i % 7 === 3 ⇒ r3, r10, r17
  assert.ok(vm.results.rows.every((r) => r.badges.includes('caveated')));

  const f = makeHarness();
  await f.readyHard();
  f.engine.control.filter.failNext.push(new Error('derivation failed'));    // the mask derivation rejects (not busy ⇒ no retry)
  await f.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(20) }));
  await f.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_UNVERIFIED, value: true });
  vm = f.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.state, 'error');
  assert.equal(vm.results.message, FILTER_MASK_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT);
  assert.deepEqual(vm.results.rows, []);
  assert.equal(vm.filters.active, true);
  await f.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_CLEAR });                          // Clear filters recovers
  vm = f.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.state, 'list');
  assert.equal(vm.run.counts.filtered, 20);
  await f.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_UNVERIFIED, value: true });
  await f.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_UNVERIFIED, value: false });       // so does turning 'unverified' off
  assert.equal(f.vm().results.state, 'list');
});

test('a filter pass superseded by a newer one never commits', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(50) }));
  const p1 = h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_HAS_LOCATION, value: true });
  const p2 = h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_MODEL, value: ['mZ'] });

});

export function createPanelController({ engine, catalog, bridge, scheduler = createDefaultScheduler(), mintId = () => globalThis.crypto.randomUUID() }) {
  const port = narrowEnginePort(engine);
  assertCatalogPort(catalog);
  assertBridgePort(bridge);

    queue: createDerivationQueue({ scheduler, generation: gen }),

    version: 0, vmCache: null,
    draft: createDraft({ testId: mintId(), testNumber: 1 }),
    validation: null,
    soft: { available: false, pending: false, verdict: null, explanation: null }, softKey: null,
    setupChanged: false, hasRun: false, setupCollapsed: false,
    run: initialRunState(), handle: null, handleUnsub: null, snapshot: null, pollTimer: null, startLatch: false,
    admission: null, confirm: null, releaseErrors: [], releaseStuck: false, residencyNotice: null,
    isolationNotice: null, viewerSeq: 0,   // last bridge.clear()/present() outcome worth telling the user about
    displayed: null,                       // {runId, status, resultSet|null, persistence}
    runRecord: null,                       // Panel-local facts captured when the run was ADMITTED (not in the sealed set)

    knownModelKeys: () => (c.displayed?.resultSet?.provenance?.models ?? []).map((m) => m.modelKey),
  });
  revalidate(c);
  c.disposers.push(catalog.onChange(() => onCatalogChange(c)));

  return Object.freeze({
    getViewModel: () => viewModelOf(c),
    subscribe(cb) {
      if (typeof cb !== 'function') throw new TypeError('subscribe: callback must be a function');
      if (c.disposed) return () => {};
      c.subscribers.add(cb);
      return () => { c.subscribers.delete(cb); };
    },
    dispatch: (intent) => dispatch(c, intent),
    /** Resolves {released, errors} after the run drained, sets were released and the bridge disposed (see dispose()). */
    dispose: () => dispose(c),
  });
}

function bumpGeneration(c) {
  c.gen.bump();
  c.readAbort.abort();
  c.readAbort = new AbortController();
  if (c.filterTimer !== null) { c.scheduler.clearTimeout(c.filterTimer); c.filterTimer = null; }
  c.filterEpoch += 1;
  c.labels.reset();
}

/** Replace/clear path shared by Run, Clear results and New test (restore-table rows "Start a new run"/"Back to All"). */
function retireDisplayed(c, { acknowledgeUnsaved }) {
  bumpGeneration(c);
  clearPoll(c);
  unsubscribeHandle(c);
  void clearViewer(c);
  const released = c.residency.release({ acknowledgeUnsaved: acknowledgeUnsaved === true });
  c.releaseErrors = Array.isArray(released?.errors) ? released.errors : [];
  // T9 retries 'stuck' entries: `released:false` with stuckCount > 0 is reported like a release error.
  c.releaseStuck = released?.released === false && Number(released?.stuckCount) > 0;
  c.residencyNotice = null;
  c.displayed = null;
  c.labels.invalidateNames();
  c.runRecord = null;
  c.handle = null;
  c.run = initialRunState();
  resetResultsView(c);
}

function onRunDone(c, g, handle, summary) {
  if (c.disposed || !c.gen.isCurrent(g) || c.handle !== handle) {
    // Superseded (dispose, New test or Clear during the run): release its own set, never display it (§7.6).
    try { c.residency.releaseSuperseded(summary); } catch { /* reported nowhere: nothing is displayed */ }
    return;
  }
  clearPoll(c);
  unsubscribeHandle(c);
  c.snapshot = safeSnapshot(handle);
  c.run = reduceRun(c.run, { type: 'done', summary });
  let adopted = { notice: null };
  try { adopted = c.residency.adopt(summary) ?? adopted; } catch (error) { c.releaseErrors = [error]; }
  c.residencyNotice = adopted.notice ?? null;
  c.displayed = { runId: summary.runId, status: summary.status, resultSet: summary.resultSet ?? null, persistence: summary.persistence ?? null };
  c.labels.invalidateNames();                                     // the displayed run's models join the known set
  if (summary.status === 'failed' || !summary.resultSet) c.setupCollapsed = false;   // §14.3: re-expands on failure
  if (summary.resultSet) startPipeline(c, g, summary.resultSet);
  touch(c);
}

function onCatalogChange(c) {
  if (c.disposed) return;
  c.labels.invalidateNames();                                     // names/known models may have changed (RF-2)
  revalidate(c, { reEvaluateSoft: true });                        // readiness/registration/basis may have changed
  recheckFreshness(c);                                            // §7.3: re-check on model add/unload
  touch(c);
}
