(d) Insert this new section immediately before the `// ── view input (pure data handed to viewModel.js)` section header:

```js
// ── results pipeline (spec §7.3, §7.5, §8, §10, §12; Task 17) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

const CAVEATED_CLAUSE = Object.freeze({ facet: 'caveated', op: 'eq', value: true });
const SORT_VALUES = new Set(['default', 'gap-asc', 'group-count', 'group-label']);
const GROUP_SORT = Object.freeze({ 'group-count': 'count-desc', 'group-label': 'label' });
const NO_CLAIM = Object.freeze({ allowed: false, unqualified: false, qualifiers: [], exclusions: [] });   // fail closed

function defaultView() {
  return {
    filter: EMPTY_FILTER_SPEC, textDraft: '', maxGapText: '', maxGapError: null,
    groupBy: 'none', sort: 'default', page: 0, expanded: new Set(),
  };
}

function resultsState() {
  return { pipe: null, view: defaultView(), filterTimer: null, filterEpoch: 0, freshAbort: null, freshDetach: null, freshQueued: false };
}

/** New run / Clear / New test: drop the displayed list; Group-by mode is a view preference and survives. */
function resetResultsView(c) {
  c.pipe = null;
  c.view = { ...defaultView(), groupBy: c.view.groupBy };
}

/** A pipeline completion commits only for the displayed generation. */
function current(c, g) {
  return !c.disposed && c.gen.isCurrent(g) && c.pipe !== null && c.pipe.gen === g;
}

function startPipeline(c, g, resultSet) {
  let index = null;
  try { index = buildResultIndex(resultSet); } catch { index = null; }
  c.pipe = {
    gen: g, set: resultSet, index,
    summary: null, caveatedIds: null, maskState: 'pending',   // caveated mask: 'pending' | 'ready' | 'unavailable'
    maskMissing: false,
    freshness: null, freshnessPending: false, claim: null, claimPending: false,
    groupTable: null, groupingState: 'idle', groupingReason: null, groupsById: null,
    matching: null, filterBusy: false, ordered: null, textIndexed: false,
  };
  if (index === null) return;
  const p = c.pipe;
  // One summarize and one caveated mask per (generation, spec), single-flight, summarize first (§5.2, AC-P4).
  c.queue.submit({ key: 'summarize', priority: 0, job: (signal) => c.engine.derivations.summarize(resultSet, { signal }) })
    .then((r) => {
      if (!current(c, g) || r.status !== 'ok') return;
      p.summary = r.value;
      touch(c);
    }, () => {});
  c.queue.submit({ key: 'caveated-mask', priority: 1, job: (signal) => c.engine.derivations.filter(resultSet, [CAVEATED_CLAUSE], { signal }) })
    .then((r) => {
      if (!current(c, g) || r.status === 'superseded') return;
      p.caveatedIds = r.status === 'ok' ? new Set(r.value.matches) : null;
      p.maskState = r.status === 'ok' ? 'ready' : 'unavailable';     // failed after the queue's bounded retries
      if (c.view.filter.unverified) refreshList(c);
      touch(c);
    }, () => {});
  recheckFreshness(c);
  refreshList(c);
  if (c.view.groupBy === 'element') ensureGrouping(c);
}

/**
 * Async freshness (and, for an EMPTY set, the no-clash claim). Re-checked on done, catalog change, model left and
 * Panel show. Triggers in the same tick are coalesced into ONE check; a newer check aborts the previous pair
 * through its own AbortController (also aborted by a generation change); an aborted read is swallowed — never
 * shown as 'unverifiable' — and the generation guard remains the final commit check.
 *
 * CLAIM GATE (review H1). For an EMPTY set the two reads are ONE snapshot: `land()` commits `freshness` and `claim`
 * together, only after BOTH reads of the SAME check completed, so the badge, the claim and the wording can never
 * describe different reads; and a re-check withdraws the held claim immediately (it never outlives the event that
 * invalidated it). Non-empty sets need no claim, so their freshness commits on its own. Each check registers ONE listener
 * on the generation signal and removes it when its reads settle or a newer check supersedes it (no per-recheck growth).
 */
function recheckFreshness(c) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  if (p === null || p.index === null) return;
  p.freshnessPending = true;
  if (p.index.count === 0) { p.claim = null; p.claimPending = true; }   // withdraw the previous claim now (fail closed)
  if (c.freshQueued) return;                                        // coalesce a burst of triggers
  c.freshQueued = true;
  queueMicrotask(() => { c.freshQueued = false; startFreshnessCheck(c); });
}

const UNVERIFIABLE_FRESHNESS = Object.freeze({ state: 'unverifiable', reasons: [] });

function startFreshnessCheck(c) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  if (c.disposed || p === null || p.index === null) return;
  const g = p.gen;
  const runId = p.set.runId;
  if (c.freshAbort !== null) c.freshAbort.abort();                  // the previous freshness/claim pair is obsolete…
  if (c.freshDetach !== null) c.freshDetach();                      // …and stops listening to the generation signal
  const controller = new AbortController();
  c.freshAbort = controller;
  const { signal } = controller;
  const generationSignal = c.readAbort.signal;
  const onGenerationAbort = () => controller.abort();
  generationSignal.addEventListener('abort', onGenerationAbort, { once: true });
  const detach = () => generationSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onGenerationAbort);   // no listener outlives its check
  c.freshDetach = detach;
  const wantsClaim = p.index.count === 0;                           // the claim only words an EMPTY set (§7.5)
  let outstanding = wantsClaim ? 2 : 1;                             // reads of THIS check still to settle
  const release = () => { outstanding -= 1; if (outstanding === 0) detach(); };
  const reads = { freshness: null, claim: null };                   // the reads of THIS check only
  const land = () => {
    if (reads.freshness === null || (wantsClaim && reads.claim === null)) return;   // the pair is incomplete
    p.freshness = reads.freshness;
    p.freshnessPending = false;
    if (wantsClaim) { p.claim = reads.claim; p.claimPending = false; }
  };
  const commit = (apply) => (r) => {
    try {
      if (signal.aborted || r.error?.name === 'ReadAbortedError' || !current(c, g)) return;   // swallowed
      apply(r);
      land();
      touch(c);
    } finally {
      release();
    }
  };
  const settle = (promiseFn) => Promise.resolve().then(promiseFn).then((value) => ({ value }), (error) => ({ error }));
  settle(() => c.engine.getFreshness(runId, { signal })).then(commit((r) => {
    reads.freshness = r.error === undefined && r.value ? r.value : UNVERIFIABLE_FRESHNESS;   // a failed read is never 'current'
  }));
  if (!wantsClaim) return;
  settle(() => c.engine.assessNoClashClaim(runId, { signal })).then(commit((r) => {
    reads.claim = r.error === undefined && r.value ? r.value : NO_CLAIM;    // fail closed
  }));
}

/**
 * One sliced, supersedable Panel-side filter pass (filterEpoch inside the generation, §10.1). The 'unverified'
 * filter needs the caveated mask: while it is pending the previously committed list stays (busy); if it is
 * unavailable the list is an explicit error state — an empty match set is never committed for a missing mask.
 */
function refreshList(c) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  if (p === null || p.index === null) return;
  const g = p.gen;
  c.filterEpoch += 1;
  const epoch = c.filterEpoch;
  p.maskMissing = false;
  if (c.view.filter.unverified) {
    if (p.maskState === 'pending') return;                          // re-run when the mask lands (startPipeline)
    if (p.maskState === 'unavailable') { p.maskMissing = true; p.filterBusy = false; return; }
  }
  const isCurrent = () => current(c, g) && epoch === c.filterEpoch;
  p.filterBusy = true;
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(() => runFilterPass({
      index: p.index, spec: c.view.filter, caveatedIds: p.caveatedIds,
      labelText: (ref) => c.labels.searchText(ref), scheduler: c.scheduler, isCurrent,
    }))
    .then((matching) => {
      if (matching === 'superseded' || !isCurrent()) return;
      if (matching === 'mask-missing') { p.maskMissing = true; p.filterBusy = false; touch(c); return; }
      p.matching = matching;
      p.filterBusy = false;
      rebuildOrdered(c, { follow: true });
      touch(c);
    }, () => {
      if (!isCurrent()) return;
      p.filterBusy = false;
      touch(c);
    });
}

function labelOfRef(c, ref) {
  return `${c.labels.modelName(ref.modelKey)} · ${c.labels.elementLabel(ref)}`;
}

/** Rebuilds the typed-array ordered index from the cached pass + group table (no Core call, AC-P4). */
function rebuildOrdered(c, { follow = false } = {}) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  if (p === null || p.matching === null) return;
  const v = c.view;
  const grouped = v.groupBy === 'element' && p.groupingState === 'ok';
  let groups = [];
  if (grouped) {
    const matchIds = isFilterActive(v.filter) ? matchIdsFrom(p.matching, p.index) : null;
    groups = sortGroups(filterGroups(p.groupTable, { matchIds, index: p.index }), GROUP_SORT[v.sort] ?? 'core', (ref) => labelOfRef(c, ref));
  }
  p.groupsById = grouped ? new Map(groups.map((gr) => [gr.groupId, gr])) : null;
  p.ordered = buildOrderedIndex({
    view: grouped ? 'grouped' : 'flat', matching: p.matching, index: p.index,
    sortKey: v.sort === 'gap-asc' && p.index.isSoft ? 'gap-asc' : 'default', groups, expanded: v.expanded,
  });
  if (follow) v.page = 0;                                           // a new ordering starts at its first page
  v.page = clampPage(v.page, p.ordered.length, PAGE_SIZE);
}

function ensureGrouping(c) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  if (p === null || p.index === null || p.groupingState !== 'idle') return;
  const g = p.gen;
  p.groupingState = 'pending';
  computeElementGroups({ queue: c.queue, engine: c.engine, resultSet: p.set })
    .then((r) => r, () => ({ status: 'unavailable', reason: 'error' }))
    .then((r) => {
      if (!current(c, g) || r.status === 'superseded') return;
      if (r.status === 'ok') { p.groupTable = r.table; p.groupingState = 'ok'; }
      else { p.groupingState = 'unavailable'; p.groupingReason = r.reason; }
      rebuildOrdered(c, { follow: true });
      touch(c);
    });
}

/** Lazily builds the text-filter label index once per displayed set (sliced), then re-filters. */
function ensureLabelIndex(c) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  if (p === null || p.index === null || p.textIndexed || c.view.filter.text.trim() === '') return;
  p.textIndexed = true;
  const g = p.gen;
  c.labels.warm(p.index, { isCurrent: () => current(c, g) })
    .then((committed) => { if (committed && current(c, g) && c.view.filter.text.trim() !== '') refreshList(c); }, () => {});
}

function setFilter(c, patch) {
  c.view.filter = { ...c.view.filter, ...patch };
  refreshList(c);
  touch(c);
}

function onFilterText(c, intent) {
  c.view.textDraft = String(intent.value ?? '');
  if (c.filterTimer !== null) c.scheduler.clearTimeout(c.filterTimer);
  const g = c.gen.current();
  c.filterTimer = c.scheduler.setTimeout(() => {                    // debounced (FILTER_DEBOUNCE_MS)
    c.filterTimer = null;
    if (c.disposed || !c.gen.isCurrent(g)) return;
    setFilter(c, { text: c.view.textDraft });
    ensureLabelIndex(c);
  }, FILTER_DEBOUNCE_MS);
  touch(c);
}

function onFilterModel(c, intent) {
  const raw = Array.isArray(intent.value) ? intent.value : [];
  setFilter(c, { models: [...new Set(raw.filter((k) => typeof k === 'string'))] });
}

function onFilterMaxGap(c, intent) {
  const text = String(intent.value ?? '');
  const parsed = parseMaxGap(text, c.pipe?.index?.clearance ?? null);
  c.view.maxGapText = text;
  c.view.maxGapError = parsed.error;
  if (parsed.error !== null || c.pipe?.index?.isSoft !== true) { touch(c); return; }   // invalid: keep the last good filter
  setFilter(c, { maxGap: parsed.value });
}

function onFilterUnverified(c, intent) { setFilter(c, { unverified: intent.value === true }); }
function onFilterHasLocation(c, intent) { setFilter(c, { hasLocation: intent.value === true }); }

function onFilterElement(c, intent) {
  const ref = intent.ref;
  const valid = ref !== null && typeof ref === 'object' && typeof ref.modelKey === 'string' && Number.isInteger(ref.dbId);
  setFilter(c, { elementOnly: valid ? { modelKey: ref.modelKey, dbId: ref.dbId } : null });
}

function onFilterClear(c) {
  if (c.filterTimer !== null) { c.scheduler.clearTimeout(c.filterTimer); c.filterTimer = null; }
  c.view.textDraft = '';
  c.view.maxGapText = '';
  c.view.maxGapError = null;
  c.view.filter = EMPTY_FILTER_SPEC;
  refreshList(c);
  touch(c);
}

function onGroupMode(c, intent) {
  if (intent.value !== 'none' && intent.value !== 'element') return;
  c.view.groupBy = intent.value;
  if (intent.value === 'element') ensureGrouping(c);
  rebuildOrdered(c, { follow: true });
  touch(c);
}

function onGroupToggle(c, intent) {
  if (typeof intent.groupId !== 'string') return;
  if (c.view.expanded.has(intent.groupId)) c.view.expanded.delete(intent.groupId);
  else c.view.expanded.add(intent.groupId);
  rebuildOrdered(c);                                                // expansion keeps the current page
  touch(c);
}

function onSortSet(c, intent) {
  if (!SORT_VALUES.has(intent.value)) return;
  c.view.sort = intent.value;
  rebuildOrdered(c, { follow: true });
  touch(c);
}

function onNavPage(c, intent) {
  const length = c.pipe?.ordered?.length ?? 0;
  c.view.page = clampPage(Number(intent.page), length, PAGE_SIZE);
  touch(c);
}

function onPanelShown(c) {
  recheckFreshness(c);                                              // §7.3: re-check on Panel show
  touch(c);
}

function resultRow(c, canonicalIndex, groupId) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  const record = p.index.at(canonicalIndex);
  const resolution = resolveResult({ record, provenance: p.set.provenance, engine: c.engine, catalog: c.catalog });   // lazy (§11.2)
  return buildRow({ record, canonicalIndex, groupId, labels: c.labels, liveness: livenessOf(resolution), caveatedIds: p.caveatedIds, selected: false });
}

/** Only the current page is materialized (PAGE_SIZE entries at most, spec §12.1). */
function pageRows(c) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  return pageSlice(p.ordered, c.view.page, PAGE_SIZE).map((entry) => (entry.kind === 'group'
    ? buildGroupHeaderRow({ group: p.groupsById.get(entry.groupId), labels: c.labels, expanded: c.view.expanded.has(entry.groupId) })
    : resultRow(c, entry.canonicalIndex, entry.groupId)));
}
```

```js
function countsOf(input) {
  const l = input.list;
  return { total: l === null ? null : l.total, filtered: l === null ? null : l.filtered };
}

/** Coverage / Integrity / Freshness, always together (§7.3); freshness shows the at-seal value while pending. */
function badgesOf(input) {
  const d = input.displayed;
  if (d === null || d.resultSet === null) return null;
  return describeAxes(d.resultSet.outcome, d.freshnessPending ? null : d.freshness);
}

function runBanners(input) {
  const banners = controllerBanners(input);
  const d = input.displayed;
  if (d === null) return banners;
  const report = bannersFor({
    terminal: input.run.machine.terminal, resultSet: d.resultSet,
    freshness: d.freshnessPending ? null : d.freshness, setupChanged: input.run.setupChanged, persistence: d.persistence,
  });
  const texts = new Set(report.map((b) => b.text));
  // The residency notice and the report's held-in-memory banner say the same thing: keep one.
  return [...report, ...banners.filter((b) => !(b.id === 'residency-notice' && texts.has(b.text)))];
}
```

```js
export const SORT_LABELS = Object.freeze({
  default: 'Default order', 'gap-asc': 'Gap (smallest first)', 'group-count': 'Group size (largest first)', 'group-label': 'Group name',
});

function buildFiltersRegion(input) {
  const l = input.list;
  if (l === null) return defaultFilters();
  const sortValues = ['default', ...(l.isSoft ? ['gap-asc'] : []), ...(l.view === 'grouped' ? ['group-count', 'group-label'] : [])];
  return {
    text: l.textDraft,
    models: [...l.spec.models],
    modelOptions: l.modelOptions,
    maxGap: { visible: l.isSoft === true, value: l.maxGapText, max: l.clearance, error: l.maxGapError },
    unverified: l.spec.unverified === true,
    hasLocation: l.spec.hasLocation === true,
    elementOnly: l.elementOnly,
    groupBy: l.groupBy,
    groupingNote: l.groupBy === 'element' && l.groupingState === 'unavailable'
      ? (GROUPING_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT[l.groupingReason] ?? GROUPING_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT.error) : null,
    sort: l.sort,
    sortOptions: sortValues.map((value) => ({ value, label: SORT_LABELS[value] })),
    active: isFilterActive(l.spec),
    busy: l.busy === true,
  };
}

export const EMPTY_FILTERED_TEXT = 'No clashes match the current filters.';

export const INDEX_FAILED_TEXT = 'The result set could not be read. Details are available to copy.';

/**
 * The ONE (claim, freshness) pair the empty-set wording may use (review H1) — this view-model builder owns the combined
 * decision, `emptyStatement` (T11) is its pure gate. The controller commits both halves together (T17); this function
 * additionally refuses to hand over a half-settled pair: unless BOTH are settled the statement sees `(null, null)`
 * and words "checking…", never a clearance.
 */
function claimGateOf(d) {
  const settled = d.claimPending !== true && d.freshnessPending !== true && d.claim !== null && d.freshness !== null;
  return settled ? { claim: d.claim, freshness: d.freshness } : { claim: null, freshness: null };
}

/** Results-region state machine (§14.4 "State coverage inside the Results region"): never a bare "No clashes". */
function buildResultsRegion(input) {
  const base = resultsBase();
  if (NON_TERMINAL.has(input.run.machine.phase)) return { ...base, state: 'running', message: RUNNING_RESULTS_TEXT };
  const d = input.displayed;
  if (d === null) return base;
  if (d.resultSet === null) return { ...base, state: 'error', message: STATEMENTS.NO_RESULT_SET };
  const l = input.list;
  if (l === null) return { ...base, state: 'error', message: INDEX_FAILED_TEXT };
  const listed = {
    ...base, view: l.view, page: { ...l.page }, rows: l.rows,
    multiValuedNote: l.view === 'grouped' ? MULTI_VALUED_NOTE : null,
    hiddenByFiltersNote: l.hiddenByFilters === true,
    nav: l.nav ? { ...l.nav } : base.nav,
  };
  if (l.total === 0) {
    const statement = emptyStatement({ resultSet: d.resultSet, ...claimGateOf(d), modelName: input.setup.modelName });
    const claimed = statement?.kind === 'claim' || statement?.kind === 'qualified-claim';
    return { ...listed, rows: [], state: claimed ? 'empty-claim' : 'empty-nonclaim', message: statement?.text ?? STATEMENTS.NON_CLAIM, lines: [...(statement?.lines ?? [])] };
  }
  if (l.maskUnavailable === true) return { ...listed, rows: [], state: 'error', message: FILTER_MASK_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT };
  if (l.filtered === 0) return { ...listed, rows: [], state: 'empty-filtered', message: EMPTY_FILTERED_TEXT };
  if (l.groupBy === 'element' && l.groupingState === 'unavailable') {
    return { ...listed, state: 'grouping-unavailable', message: GROUPING_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT[l.groupingReason] ?? GROUPING_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT.error };
  }
  return { ...listed, state: 'list', message: null };
}
```

(j) Insert the Run-details data builder (spec §8.4; exposed as `vm.run.details` in T19) immediately before the `// ── filters / results / selected regions (Task 16 defaults)` section header:

```js
// ── run details (spec §8.4) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const text = (v) => (typeof v === 'string' ? v : v === null || v === undefined ? '—' : typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v));

function basisText(verdict) {
  if (verdict === null || verdict === undefined) return 'single model (no cross-model comparison)';
  if (verdict.state === 'verified') return `verified (${text(verdict.basisKey)})`;
  return `${text(verdict.state)}: ${text(verdict.reason)}`;
}

/**
 * "Run details" lines, built ONLY from the sealed set plus the Panel-local run record (the Soft basis verdict the
 * run was admitted under — not part of the sealed set). All values are plain strings; model names and Core values
 * pass through as raw text (the UI uses textContent). `provenance.models[].elementCount` is never read (G-EC, AC-P12).
 */
export function buildRunDetails({ resultSet, runRecord = null, modelName = (key) => String(key) }) {
  const lines = [];
  const add = (label, value) => lines.push({ label, value: text(value) });
  const definition = resultSet.definition ?? null;
  if (definition === null) add('Definition', 'not recorded (the run ended before its definition was resolved)');
  else {
    add('Test', definition.name);
    add('Mode', definition.mode === 'clearance' ? 'Soft (clearance)' : 'Hard (volume overlap)');
    if (definition.mode === 'clearance') add('Clearance', definition.clearance);
  }
  const provenance = resultSet.provenance ?? {};
  add('Started', provenance.startedAt);
  add('Finished', provenance.finishedAt);
  add('Determinism', provenance.determinismClass);
  for (const m of Array.isArray(provenance.models) ? provenance.models : []) {
    add(`Model ${modelName(m.modelKey)}`, `key ${text(m.modelKey)} · version ${text(m.modelVersion)} · binding generation ${text(m.bindingGeneration)}`);
  }
  const exclusions = Array.isArray(provenance.libraryExclusions) ? provenance.libraryExclusions : [];
  add('Library exclusions', exclusions.length === 0 ? 'none' : exclusions.map(text).join('; '));
  if (definition?.mode === 'clearance') add('Measurement basis (at run start)', basisText(runRecord?.basisVerdict));
  return lines;
}
```

### Task 18: Controller III (selection, navigation, present intents, restore-table triggers, model events, dispose)

**Tier:** [A] format-agnostic headless

**Files:**
- Modify: `clashpanel/core/controller.js`, `clashpanel/core/viewModel.js`
- Test: `test/clashpanel/core/controller.navigation.test.mjs`

**Scope note:** Selection is `{occurrence:{groupId, resultId}, navScope}`; the page follows the selected OCCURRENCE via `positionOf` + `pageOfPosition` (never `indexOf(resultId)`, AC-P17); a selection hidden by filters keeps its detail and `hiddenByFilters`, and the page does not jump. `present` resolves the result lazily; only live sides go to `bridge.present` (Hard ⇒ `point`, Soft ⇒ `closestPoints`); isolate only when `bridge.checkIsolationPrerequisite().available`; fit only when Focus-on-select is on (row/Prev/Next) and always for Focus. No live side ⇒ no Viewer call (and a previous visualization is cleared so a different clash is never left on screen). Restore-table triggers: new run (T16 `retireDisplayed`, now also drops the selection), Back to All (clear + selection + navScope only), `PANEL_HIDDEN` (clear, selection kept), dispose (T16's `dispose`, whose contract this task pins: cancel the active run with `'panel-disposed'` and resolve `{released, errors}` ONLY after that run's `handle.done` settled, its sealed set was released (`releaseSuperseded`), the final `disposeAll()` ran (retrying any stuck release once) and the bridge was disposed; `released:false` only when a release still fails after that retry; never rejects; same promise on repeat. Waiting is bounded by every wait the engine owns and unbounded only by a unit executor that never returns (Core open item O9) — `engine.dispose()` also signals the run and waits for its drain, so there is no escape hatch; a host whose executor can hang must accept that or not await `panel.dispose()`. Dispose now also unsubscribes `bridge.onModelLeft`), and `bridge.onModelLeft` (clear iff the current visualization references that model's key — an unknown key clears conservatively; idempotent for the `unload`+`removed` pair; labels forgotten; freshness re-check; results kept). ClearOutcome `skipped-external`/`failed` surfaces as the T16 `isolation-notice` banner; a successful present clears it. The controller never stores a `Model` beyond one `present` call (`presented` keeps modelKeys only).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `pageOfPosition(position, pageSize) -> number (-1 when absent)`, `ordered.positionOf(occurrence)`, `ordered.navNeighbor(occurrence|null, dir, navScope)` — navScope honored only while that group is expanded (T14); `locationOf(record)`, `sideView(ref, labels)`, `gapOf(record)` (T15); bridge port `present(req) -> Promise<PresentOutcome>`, `clear() -> Promise<ClearOutcome>`, `checkIsolationPrerequisite() -> {available, reason}`, `onModelLeft(cb) -> unsubscribe` (catalog §3; PresentOutcome/ClearOutcome may carry `disposed:true`; `ClearOutcome.isolation` ∈ `restored|skipped-external|none|failed`); `catalog.keyOfModel(model)`.
- Produces: handlers `NAV_SELECT {resultId, groupId}`, `NAV_PREV`, `NAV_NEXT`, `ACTION_FOCUS`, `ACTION_ISOLATE {value}`, `ACTION_MARKERS {value}`, `ACTION_FOCUS_ON_SELECT {value}`, `ACTION_BACK_TO_ALL`, `PANEL_HIDDEN`; ViewModel `results.nav`, `results.hiddenByFiltersNote`, `ResultRow.selected` (every occurrence of the selected resultId), and the `selected` region with action enable/disable reasons.

**Depends on:** T14–T17.

```js
// test/clashpanel/core/controller.navigation.test.mjs — Task 18: selection, navigation, present intents,
// restore-table triggers, model events, dispose (spec §9, §11.2, §12.2; AC-P5, AC-P6 (controller side), AC-P7,
// AC-P14, AC-P15, AC-P17).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { INTENT } from '../../../clashpanel/core/intents.js';
import { PAGE_SIZE } from '../../../clashpanel/core/constants.js';
import { makeHarness, makeSet, hardResults } from '../support/controllerHarness.mjs';

async function doneWith(set, harnessOptions) {
  const h = makeHarness(harnessOptions);
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.runToDone(set);
  return h;
}
const presents = (h) => h.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'present');
const clears = (h) => h.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'clear').length;

test('row select presents the live sides with the Hard witness point and per-toggle options (Focus on select default on)', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(10) }));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r2', groupId: null });
  const [call] = presents(h);
  assert.deepEqual(call.req.sides, [{ model: h.modelA, dbId: 1002 }, { model: h.modelB, dbId: 2002 }]);
  assert.deepEqual(call.req.point, [2, 0, 0]);
  assert.equal(call.req.closestPoints, undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(call.req.options, { focus: true, isolate: false, marker: true });
  const vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.selected.resultId, 'r2');
  assert.equal(vm.selected.ordinal, 3);
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.side1, { modelKey: 'mA', modelName: 'Architecture', label: 'A-1002', dbId: 1002 });
  assert.equal(vm.selected.hasLocation, true);
  assert.equal(vm.selected.liveness, 'live');
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.actions.focus, { enabled: true, reason: null });
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.actions.focusOnSelect, { checked: true });
  assert.deepEqual(vm.results.rows.filter((r) => r.selected).map((r) => r.resultId), ['r2']);
  assert.equal(vm.results.nav.label, 'Clash #3');
  assert.equal(h.engine.control.summarize.successes, 1);                   // selection is not a derivation
});

test('Focus on select off ⇒ select without fit; the Focus button always fits', async () => {

});

test('Isolate is disabled with the bridge\'s reason when the §9.5 prerequisite fails; enabled toggles re-present without fit', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(3) }));
  h.bridge.setIsolationPrerequisite({ available: false, reason: 'Some elements are hidden — show all to enable isolation' });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r0', groupId: null });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.ACTION_ISOLATE, value: true });
  let vm = h.vm();
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.actions.isolate, { enabled: false, checked: false, reason: 'Some elements are hidden — show all to enable isolation' });
  assert.equal(presents(h).at(-1).req.options.isolate, false);
  h.bridge.setIsolationPrerequisite({ available: true, reason: null });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.ACTION_ISOLATE, value: true });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.ACTION_MARKERS, value: false });
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.actions.isolate, { enabled: true, checked: true, reason: null });
  assert.deepEqual(presents(h).at(-1).req.options, { focus: false, isolate: true, marker: false });
});

test('AC-P7: one live side ⇒ that side only + "<model> is not loaded"; no live side ⇒ nothing attempted, actions disabled, still selectable', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(4) }));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r0', groupId: null });
  h.catalog.removeModel('mB');                                             // mB left the scene (hideModel-like)
  await h.settle();
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r1', groupId: null });
  const last = presents(h).at(-1);
  assert.deepEqual(last.req.sides, [{ model: h.modelA, dbId: 1001 }]);
  let vm = h.vm();
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.notes, ['Structure is not loaded']);
  assert.equal(vm.selected.liveness, 'not in scene');
  assert.equal(vm.results.rows[1].liveness, 'not in scene');
  h.engine.setBinding('mA', null);                                         // mA unregistered too
  const before = presents(h).length;
  const clearsBefore = clears(h);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r2', groupId: null });
  assert.equal(presents(h).length, before);                                // no Viewer action for an unresolvable side
  assert.equal(clears(h), clearsBefore + 1);                               // the previous clash is not left on screen
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.selected.resultId, 'r2');
  assert.equal(vm.selected.actions.focus.enabled, false);
  assert.match(vm.selected.actions.focus.reason, /unavailable/);
  assert.equal(vm.selected.actions.markers.enabled, false);
  assert.equal(vm.selected.actions.isolate.enabled, false);
  assert.equal(vm.run.counts.total, 4);                                    // list/counts keep working
});

test('AC-P5: Prev/Next walk the list across pages; the page follows the selection; ends do not wrap', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(PAGE_SIZE + 5) }));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: `r${PAGE_SIZE - 1}`, groupId: null });
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.page.index, 0);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_NEXT });
  assert.equal(h.vm().selected.resultId, `r${PAGE_SIZE}`);
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.page.index, 1);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_PREV });
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.page.index, 0);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: `r${PAGE_SIZE + 4}`, groupId: null });
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.nav.canNext, false);
  const n = presents(h).length;
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_NEXT });
  assert.equal(presents(h).length, n);
  assert.equal(h.vm().selected.resultId, `r${PAGE_SIZE + 4}`);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r0', groupId: null });
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.nav.canPrev, false);
});

test('AC-P17: a grouped occurrence keeps page and navScope across re-sort and filter changes; detail keyed by resultId is unchanged', async () => {
  const results = Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, i) => ({ a: ['mA', 1000 + i], b: ['mB', 10] }));
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results }));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_MODE, value: 'element' });
  const gMB10 = JSON.stringify(['element', {}, { dbId: 10, modelKey: 'mB' }]);
  const gMA1005 = JSON.stringify(['element', {}, { dbId: 1005, modelKey: 'mA' }]);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_TOGGLE, groupId: gMA1005 });       // r5 also rendered on page 0
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r5', groupId: gMB10 });
  let vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.page.index, 1);                                  // mB:10 members start after 60 mA headers
  assert.ok(vm.results.rows.some((r) => r.key === `${gMB10}|r5` && r.selected));
  const presentCount = presents(h).length;
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_HAS_LOCATION, value: true });     // rebuilt ordering: occurrence still on page 1
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.page.index, 1);
  assert.ok(vm.results.rows.some((r) => r.key === `${gMB10}|r5` && r.selected));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SORT_SET, value: 'group-count' });       // mB:10 (60) moves to the top
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.page.index, 0);
  assert.ok(vm.results.rows.some((r) => r.key === `${gMB10}|r5` && r.selected));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SORT_SET, value: 'group-label' });       // "Structure · B-10" sorts after every "Architecture · …"
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.page.index, 1);
  assert.ok(vm.results.rows.some((r) => r.key === `${gMB10}|r5` && r.selected));
  assert.equal(vm.selected.resultId, 'r5');
  assert.equal(presents(h).length, presentCount);                          // sort/filter never re-present
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_NEXT });                             // stays inside the mB:10 group
  assert.equal(h.vm().selected.resultId, 'r6');
  assert.equal(presents(h).at(-1).req.sides.length, 2);
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.nav.label, 'Clash #7 (within its group)');
});

test('collapsing the navScope group ends group-scoped navigation: Next lands on a rendered occurrence and the page follows', async () => {
  const results = Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, i) => ({ a: ['mA', 1000 + i], b: ['mB', 10] }));
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results }));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_MODE, value: 'element' });
  const gMB10 = JSON.stringify(['element', {}, { dbId: 10, modelKey: 'mB' }]);
  const gMA1006 = JSON.stringify(['element', {}, { dbId: 1006, modelKey: 'mA' }]);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_TOGGLE, groupId: gMA1006 });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r5', groupId: gMB10 });
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.page.index, 1);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_TOGGLE, groupId: gMB10 });           // collapse the group being navigated
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.nav.label, 'Clash #6');                        // no longer "(within its group)"
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_NEXT });
  const vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.selected.resultId, 'r6');                                  // the only rendered result occurrence
  assert.equal(vm.results.page.index, 0);                                    // the page followed it
  assert.ok(vm.results.rows.some((r) => r.key === `${gMA1006}|r6` && r.selected));
});

test('AC-P5: a selection hidden by filters keeps its detail and the note; the page does not jump; Next goes to the first', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(120) }));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r9', groupId: null });   // r9 has no witness

  assert.equal(vm.results.hiddenByFiltersNote, true);
  assert.equal(vm.results.page.index, 1);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_NEXT });
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.selected.resultId, 'r0');
  assert.equal(vm.selected.hiddenByFilters, false);
  assert.equal(vm.results.page.index, 0);
});

test('Back to All clears the Viewer and the selection only; Hide Panel clears the Viewer but keeps the selection', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(120) }));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_HAS_LOCATION, value: true });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_PAGE, page: 1 });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r60', groupId: null });
  const c0 = clears(h);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.PANEL_HIDDEN });
  assert.equal(clears(h), c0 + 1);
  assert.equal(h.vm().selected.resultId, 'r60');                           // kept (reapply via Focus)
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.ACTION_FOCUS });
  assert.equal(presents(h).at(-1).req.options.focus, true);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.ACTION_BACK_TO_ALL });
  const vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(clears(h), c0 + 2);
  assert.equal(vm.selected, null);
  assert.equal(vm.filters.hasLocation, true);                              // filters untouched
  assert.equal(vm.results.page.index, 1);                                  // page untouched
  assert.equal(vm.run.counts.total, 120);
});

test('model left: clears only a visualization that references it (idempotent for unload+removed); results, counts and filters keep working', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(20) }));
  const c0 = clears(h);
  h.bridge.fireModelLeft({ model: h.modelB, reason: 'removed' });          // nothing presented yet
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(clears(h), c0);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r3', groupId: null });
  const freshness = h.engine.control.getFreshness.calls;
  h.catalog.removeModel('mB');
  h.bridge.fireModelLeft({ model: h.modelB, reason: 'unload' });
  h.bridge.fireModelLeft({ model: h.modelB, reason: 'removed' });          // the same unload, second event
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(clears(h), c0 + 1);
  assert.ok(h.engine.control.getFreshness.calls > freshness);
  const vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.selected.resultId, 'r3');                                // selection kept
  assert.ok(vm.results.rows.every((r) => r.liveness === 'not in scene'));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_HAS_LOCATION, value: true });
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.counts.filtered, 18);
  const c1 = clears(h);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r4', groupId: null });   // mA still live: one side
  h.bridge.fireModelLeft({ model: { unrelated: true }, reason: 'removed' });      // unknown model ⇒ conservative clear
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(clears(h), c1 + 1);
});

test('RF-3: a model unloads/hides while the run is non-terminal — no Viewer mutation, no throw; after done its rows are unavailable and the list keeps working', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  const handle = await h.start();
  handle.emitState({ status: 'planning', phase: 'enumerating' });
  await h.settle();
  const mutating = h.bridge.calls.length;
  h.engine.setBinding('mB', null);                                         // host unregistered (wireModelUnload)
  h.catalog.removeModel('mB');
  h.bridge.fireModelLeft({ model: h.modelB, reason: 'unload' });
  h.bridge.fireModelLeft({ model: h.modelB, reason: 'removed' });          // the same unload's second event
  h.catalog.fire();
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.bridge.calls.length, mutating);                           // nothing presented ⇒ nothing to clear
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.state, 'planning');                              // the run continues
  const freshness = h.engine.control.getFreshness.calls;
  handle.finish({ status: 'completed', resultSet: makeSet({ runId: handle.runId, results: hardResults(12) }) });
  await h.settle();
  assert.ok(h.engine.control.getFreshness.calls > freshness);              // re-checked for the sealed set
  let vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.run.doneKind, 'completed');
  assert.ok(vm.results.rows.every((r) => r.liveness === 'model not loaded'));
  assert.equal(vm.run.counts.total, 12);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_HAS_LOCATION, value: true });
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.counts.filtered, 11);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_MODE, value: 'element' });
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.view, 'grouped');
  assert.ok(vm.results.rows.length > 0);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r0', groupId: null });
  assert.equal(h.bridge.presents.at(-1).req.sides.length, 1);              // only the live mA side
});

test('a new run drops the selection (restore table) and later outcomes of an old present are ignored', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(5) }));
  h.bridge.setManual(true);
  const pending = h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r1', groupId: null });
  await h.settle();
  await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-2', results: hardResults(2) }));
  h.bridge.resolvePresent({ superseded: false, fitted: true, isolated: false, marked: true, notes: ['late note'] });
  await pending;
  await h.settle();
  const vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.selected, null);
  assert.equal(vm.run.headline.includes('2'), true);
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(vm).includes('late note'), false);
});

test('present outcome notes reach the detail; superseded outcomes do not', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(3) }));
  h.bridge.setManual(true);
  const first = h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r0', groupId: null });
  const second = h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r1', groupId: null });
  h.bridge.resolvePresent({ superseded: false, fitted: true, isolated: false, marked: true, notes: ['stale'] });
  h.bridge.resolvePresent({ superseded: false, fitted: false, isolated: false, marked: true, notes: ['Framed the first live side only'] });
  await Promise.all([first, second]);
  await h.settle();
  assert.deepEqual(h.vm().selected.notes, ['Framed the first live side only']);
});

test('dispose: cancels, releases, disposes the bridge once, removes every listener; later events are inert', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(3) }));
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r0', groupId: null });
  assert.equal(h.bridge.listenerCount(), 1);
  const before = h.vm();
  await Promise.all([h.controller.dispose(), h.controller.dispose()]);
  assert.equal(h.bridge.listenerCount(), 0);
  assert.equal(h.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'dispose').length, 1);
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.size, 0);                                 // leased set released (AC-P14)
  h.catalog.fire();
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm(), before);
  assert.equal(await h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_NEXT }), undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(h.engine.forbidden, []);
});

test('a new selection never carries the previous clash\'s notes (subscriber view); a clear-only outcome still notifies, also when clear is delayed or fails', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(5) }));
  const seen = [];
  h.controller.subscribe((vm) => seen.push(vm));
  h.bridge.setManual(true);
  const p1 = h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r0', groupId: null });
  await h.settle();
  h.bridge.resolvePresent({ superseded: false, fitted: true, isolated: false, marked: true, notes: ['note A'] });
  await p1;
  await h.settle();
  assert.deepEqual(h.vm().selected.notes, ['note A']);
  h.engine.setBinding('mA', null);
  h.engine.setBinding('mB', null);
  let releaseClear;
  h.bridge.setClearImpl(() => new Promise((resolve) => { releaseClear = () => resolve({ isolation: 'none', markersRemoved: 1, notes: [] }); }));
  const mark = seen.length;
  const p2 = h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r2', groupId: null });
  await h.settle();
  for (const vm of seen.slice(mark)) if (vm.selected?.resultId === 'r2') assert.equal(vm.selected.notes.includes('note A'), false);
  const beforeClear = seen.length;
  releaseClear();
  await p2;
  await h.settle();
  assert.ok(seen.length > beforeClear);                                    // the clear-only completion notified
  assert.deepEqual(seen.at(-1).selected.notes, []);

  h.engine.setBinding('mA', { modelKey: 'mA', model: h.modelA, modelVersion: 'v1', bindingGeneration: 1 });
  const p3 = h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r3', groupId: null });
  await h.settle();
  h.bridge.resolvePresent({ superseded: false, fitted: true, isolated: false, marked: true, notes: ['note B'] });
  await p3;
  h.engine.setBinding('mA', null);
  h.bridge.setClearImpl(() => Promise.reject(new Error('clear failed')));
  const before = seen.length;
  await assert.doesNotReject(h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: 'r4', groupId: null }));
  await h.settle();
  assert.ok(seen.length > before);
  assert.deepEqual(seen.at(-1).selected.notes, []);
  assert.equal(seen.at(-1).run.banners.find((b) => b.id === 'isolation-notice').kind, 'warning');   // a failed clear is reported
});

test('freshness bursts (Panel show + catalog change + model left): coalesced per tick, older checks aborted, only the newest commits', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  h.engine.control.getFreshness.manual = true;
  await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(3) }));
  assert.equal(h.engine.control.getFreshness.calls, 1);
  void h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.PANEL_SHOWN });               // three triggers in ONE tick…
  h.catalog.fire();
  h.bridge.fireModelLeft({ model: { unrelated: true }, reason: 'removed' });
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.engine.control.getFreshness.calls, 2);                    // …one new check
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.PANEL_SHOWN });
  h.catalog.fire();
  await h.settle();
  const signals = h.engine.control.getFreshness.args.map((args) => args[1].signal);
  assert.equal(signals.length, 4);
  assert.deepEqual(signals.map((s) => s.aborted), [true, true, true, false]);   // all but the newest aborted
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.badges.freshness.pending, true);                 // aborts are swallowed, not 'unverifiable'
  h.engine.control.getFreshness.resolveAll({ state: 'stale', reasons: ['scope-drift'] });
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.badges.freshness.value, 'stale');
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.badges.freshness.pending, false);
});

test('freshness bursts on an EMPTY set: the whole freshness+claim pair of every older check is aborted; only the newest pair commits', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  h.engine.control.getFreshness.manual = true;
  h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.manual = true;
  await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: [] }));
  void h.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.PANEL_SHOWN });
  h.catalog.fire();
  h.bridge.fireModelLeft({ model: { unrelated: true }, reason: 'removed' });
  await h.settle();
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.PANEL_SHOWN });
  await h.settle();
  const fresh = h.engine.control.getFreshness.args.map((a) => a[1].signal);
  const claim = h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.args.map((a) => a[1].signal);
  assert.equal(fresh.length, 3);
  assert.equal(claim.length, 3);
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) assert.equal(fresh[i], claim[i]);          // one signal per check pair
  assert.deepEqual(claim.map((s) => s.aborted), [true, true, false]);
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.state, 'empty-nonclaim');                    // pending ⇒ never worded as a claim
  h.engine.control.getFreshness.resolveAll();
  h.engine.control.assessNoClashClaim.resolveAll();
  await h.settle();
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.state, 'empty-claim');
  assert.equal(h.vm().run.badges.freshness.pending, false);
});

test('dispose contract: pending until the held run is done AND its set released AND the bridge disposed; same promise; never rejects', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(3) }));
  const handle = await h.start();                                          // run-1 released at admission
  handle.emitState({ status: 'planning', phase: 'enumerating' });
  handle.emitUnit({ unitsTotal: 1 });
  await h.settle();
  let resolved = false;
  const p = h.controller.dispose();
  p.then(() => { resolved = true; });
  assert.equal(h.controller.dispose(), p);
  await h.settle();
  assert.deepEqual(handle.cancelReasons, ['panel-disposed']);
  assert.equal(resolved, false);
  assert.equal(h.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'dispose').length, 0);   // bridge disposed only after release
  handle.finish({ status: 'cancelled', resultSet: makeSet({ runId: handle.runId, status: 'cancelled', coverage: 'partial', results: hardResults(2) }), persistence: { state: 'skipped', timedOut: false, attempt: 0, reason: 'no-store' } });
  assert.deepEqual(await p, { released: true, errors: [] });
  assert.equal(h.engine.resident.size, 0);                                 // unsaved sealed set released (acknowledged)
  assert.equal(h.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'dispose').length, 1);

  const idle = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(1) }));
  assert.equal(idle.engine.resident.get('run-1').leases, 1);
  const q = idle.controller.dispose();
  await q;
  assert.equal(idle.engine.resident.size, 0);                              // no active run: resolves after release

  const failing = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(1) }));
  failing.bridge.dispose = () => Promise.reject(new Error('bridge teardown failed'));
  await assert.doesNotReject(failing.controller.dispose());
});

test('every INTENT value is handled by the dispatch table', async () => {
  const h = await doneWith(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: hardResults(3) }));
  const payload = {
    [INTENT.NAV_SELECT]: { resultId: 'r0', groupId: null }, [INTENT.NAV_PAGE]: { page: 0 },
    [INTENT.FILTER_MODEL]: { value: [] }, [INTENT.FILTER_ELEMENT]: { ref: null }, [INTENT.GROUP_TOGGLE]: { groupId: 'x' },
    [INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_MODEL]: { side: 'A', modelKey: 'mA' }, [INTENT.SETUP_USE_SELECTION]: { side: 'B' },
  };
  for (const type of Object.values(INTENT)) {
    await assert.doesNotReject(async () => { await h.controller.dispatch({ type, value: false, ...(payload[type] ?? {}) }); }, `intent ${type}`);
  }
  await h.settle();
  assert.throws(() => h.controller.dispatch({ type: 'nav/teleport' }), { name: 'TypeError', message: /unknown intent/ });
});
```

```js
export function createPanelController({ engine, catalog, bridge, scheduler = createDefaultScheduler(), mintId = () => globalThis.crypto.randomUUID() }) {
  const port = narrowEnginePort(engine);
  assertCatalogPort(catalog);
  assertBridgePort(bridge);
  const gen = createGeneration();
  const c = {
    engine: port, catalog, bridge, scheduler, mintId,
    gen,                                   // results generation: Run, Clear results, New test, dispose
    setupGen: createGeneration(),          // Soft-availability evaluations (independent of runs)
    queue: createDerivationQueue({ scheduler, generation: gen }),
    residency: createResidency({ engine: port }),
    labels: null,
    disposed: false, disposing: null, disposers: [], subscribers: new Set(),
    version: 0, vmCache: null,
    draft: createDraft({ testId: mintId(), testNumber: 1 }),
    validation: null,
    soft: { available: false, pending: false, verdict: null, explanation: null }, softKey: null,
    setupChanged: false, hasRun: false, setupCollapsed: false,
    run: initialRunState(), handle: null, handleUnsub: null, snapshot: null, pollTimer: null, startLatch: false,
    admission: null, confirm: null, releaseErrors: [], releaseStuck: false, residencyNotice: null,
    isolationNotice: null, viewerSeq: 0,   // last bridge.clear()/present() outcome worth telling the user about
    displayed: null,                       // {runId, status, resultSet|null, persistence}
    runRecord: null,                       // Panel-local facts captured when the run was ADMITTED (not in the sealed set)
    readAbort: new AbortController(),
  };
  Object.assign(c, resultsState(), selectionState());
  c.labels = createLabelResolver({
    catalog, scheduler,
    resolveLiveModel: (modelKey) => liveModelFor(c, modelKey),
    // Models known only from the displayed run (e.g. unloaded since) still count for name disambiguation (RF-2).
    knownModelKeys: () => (c.displayed?.resultSet?.provenance?.models ?? []).map((m) => m.modelKey),
  });
  revalidate(c);
  c.disposers.push(catalog.onChange(() => onCatalogChange(c)));
  c.disposers.push(bridge.onModelLeft((event) => onModelLeft(c, event)));

  return Object.freeze({
    getViewModel: () => viewModelOf(c),
    subscribe(cb) {
      if (typeof cb !== 'function') throw new TypeError('subscribe: callback must be a function');
      if (c.disposed) return () => {};
      c.subscribers.add(cb);
      return () => { c.subscribers.delete(cb); };
    },
    dispatch: (intent) => dispatch(c, intent),
    /** Resolves {released, errors} after the run drained, sets were released and the bridge disposed (see dispose()). */
    dispose: () => dispose(c),
  });
}
```

(c) Replace `resetResultsView`, `rebuildOrdered`, `onGroupToggle` (collapsing the current `navScope` group resets navScope to whole-list navigation) and `resultRow` with:

```js
/** New run / Clear / New test: drop the displayed list; Group-by mode is a view preference and survives. */
function resetResultsView(c) {
  c.pipe = null;
  c.view = { ...defaultView(), groupBy: c.view.groupBy };
  c.selection = null;                                              // restore table: a new run drops the selection
  c.presented = null;
  c.presentNotes = [];
}

/** Rebuilds the typed-array ordered index from the cached pass + group table (no Core call, AC-P4). */
function rebuildOrdered(c, { follow = false } = {}) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  if (p === null || p.matching === null) return;
  const v = c.view;
  const grouped = v.groupBy === 'element' && p.groupingState === 'ok';
  let groups = [];
  if (grouped) {
    const matchIds = isFilterActive(v.filter) ? matchIdsFrom(p.matching, p.index) : null;
    groups = sortGroups(filterGroups(p.groupTable, { matchIds, index: p.index }), GROUP_SORT[v.sort] ?? 'core', (ref) => labelOfRef(c, ref));
  }
  p.groupsById = grouped ? new Map(groups.map((gr) => [gr.groupId, gr])) : null;
  p.ordered = buildOrderedIndex({
    view: grouped ? 'grouped' : 'flat', matching: p.matching, index: p.index,
    sortKey: v.sort === 'gap-asc' && p.index.isSoft ? 'gap-asc' : 'default', groups, expanded: v.expanded,
  });
  if (follow) {
    // AC-P17: the page follows the selected OCCURRENCE; a selection hidden by filters leaves the page where it is;
    // with no selection a new ordering starts at its first page.
    const pos = c.selection === null ? -1 : p.ordered.positionOf(c.selection.occurrence);
    if (pos >= 0) v.page = pageOfPosition(pos, PAGE_SIZE);
    else if (c.selection === null) v.page = 0;
  }
  v.page = clampPage(v.page, p.ordered.length, PAGE_SIZE);
}

function onGroupToggle(c, intent) {
  if (typeof intent.groupId !== 'string') return;
  if (c.view.expanded.has(intent.groupId)) {
    c.view.expanded.delete(intent.groupId);
    // Collapsing the group the user navigates in ends group-scoped navigation (whole-list Prev/Next).
    if (c.selection !== null && c.selection.navScope === intent.groupId) c.selection = { ...c.selection, navScope: null };
  } else c.view.expanded.add(intent.groupId);
  rebuildOrdered(c);                                                // expansion keeps the current page
  touch(c);
}

function resultRow(c, canonicalIndex, groupId) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  const record = p.index.at(canonicalIndex);
  const resolution = resolveResult({ record, provenance: p.set.provenance, engine: c.engine, catalog: c.catalog });   // lazy (§11.2)
  const selected = c.selection !== null && c.selection.occurrence.resultId === record.resultId;   // every occurrence
  return buildRow({ record, canonicalIndex, groupId, labels: c.labels, liveness: livenessOf(resolution), caveatedIds: p.caveatedIds, selected });
}
```

(d) Insert this new section immediately before the `// ── view input (pure data handed to viewModel.js)` section header:

```js
// ── selection, navigation and presentation (spec §9.1–§9.6, §12.2, §12.3; Task 18) ─────────────────────────────

const ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT = 'Isolation is unavailable in the current viewer state.';

function selectionState() {
  return {
    selection: null,                     // {occurrence:{groupId,resultId}, navScope:string|null}
    toggles: { focusOnSelect: true, isolate: false, markers: true },
    presented: null,                     // {modelKeys:string[]} of the current visualization (never a Model object)
    presentNotes: [],
  };
}

/** Sync, read-only (§9.5). Any failure reads as "unavailable" — Isolate is then disabled, never faked. */
function isolationState(c) {
  try {
    const r = c.bridge.checkIsolationPrerequisite();
    if (r?.available === true) return { available: true, reason: null };
    return { available: false, reason: typeof r?.reason === 'string' && r.reason !== '' ? r.reason : ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT };
  } catch {
    return { available: false, reason: ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE_TEXT };
  }
}

function containsSorted(sorted, value) {
  let lo = 0;
  let hi = sorted.length - 1;
  while (lo <= hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi) >>> 1;
    if (sorted[mid] === value) return true;
    if (sorted[mid] < value) lo = mid + 1; else hi = mid - 1;
  }
  return false;
}

function selectedCanonical(c) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  if (c.selection === null || p === null || p.index === null) return -1;
  return p.index.indexOfResultId(c.selection.occurrence.resultId);
}

function selectionHidden(c) {
  const i = selectedCanonical(c);
  return i >= 0 && c.pipe.matching !== null && !containsSorted(c.pipe.matching, i);
}

/** Page follows the selected OCCURRENCE (never indexOf(resultId)); a hidden selection leaves the page alone. */
function pageToSelection(c) {
  const ordered = c.pipe?.ordered ?? null;
  if (ordered === null || c.selection === null) return;
  const pos = ordered.positionOf(c.selection.occurrence);
  if (pos >= 0) c.view.page = pageOfPosition(pos, PAGE_SIZE);
}

/**
 * Presents the selected result through the bridge (the only Viewer mutator). Only live sides are sent; with no
 * live side nothing is attempted (AC-P7). Hard ⇒ `point` (witness), Soft ⇒ `closestPoints`. Isolation is
 * requested only when the §9.5 prerequisite holds. Fit only when `fit` (row/Prev/Next: Focus-on-select; Focus: always).
 */
async function present(c, { fit }) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  const i = selectedCanonical(c);
  if (c.disposed || i < 0) return;
  const record = p.index.at(i);
  const resolution = resolveResult({ record, provenance: p.set.provenance, engine: c.engine, catalog: c.catalog });
  if (!resolution.anyLive) {                                        // no Viewer action for an unresolvable result…
    const shown = c.presented !== null;
    c.presented = null;
    c.presentNotes = [];
    if (shown) await clearViewer(c);                                // …but never leave the previous clash shown
    if (!c.disposed) touch(c);                                      // a clear-only outcome is still a state change
    return;
  }
  const live = resolution.sides.filter((side) => side.state === 'live');
  const location = locationOf(record);
  const request = {
    sides: live.map((side) => ({ model: side.model, dbId: side.dbId })),
    options: { focus: fit === true, isolate: c.toggles.isolate === true && isolationState(c).available, marker: c.toggles.markers === true },
  };
  if (location?.kind === 'witness') request.point = location.point;
  if (location?.kind === 'closest-points') request.closestPoints = location.closestPoints;
  c.presented = { modelKeys: [...new Set(live.map((side) => side.modelKey))] };
  c.viewerSeq += 1;
  const seq = c.viewerSeq;
  const g = c.gen.current();
  let outcome;
  try {
    outcome = await c.bridge.present(request);
  } catch (error) {
    outcome = { superseded: false, fitted: false, isolated: false, marked: false, notes: [`The clash could not be shown in the viewer: ${String(error?.message ?? error)}`] };
  }
  if (c.disposed || !c.gen.isCurrent(g) || seq !== c.viewerSeq || outcome?.superseded === true || outcome?.disposed === true) return;
  c.presentNotes = Array.isArray(outcome?.notes) ? outcome.notes.filter((n) => typeof n === 'string') : [];
  c.isolationNotice = null;                                         // a successful present supersedes old notices
  touch(c);
}

function select(c, occurrence, navScope) {
  c.selection = { occurrence: { groupId: occurrence.groupId ?? null, resultId: occurrence.resultId }, navScope };
  c.presentNotes = [];                                              // never show the previous clash's notes with this one
  pageToSelection(c);
  touch(c);
  return present(c, { fit: c.toggles.focusOnSelect });
}

function onNavSelect(c, intent) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  if (p === null || p.index === null || typeof intent.resultId !== 'string' || p.index.indexOfResultId(intent.resultId) < 0) return undefined;
  const groupId = typeof intent.groupId === 'string' ? intent.groupId : null;
  if (groupId !== null && !c.view.expanded.has(groupId)) {        // §10.2: selecting expands the group it came from
    c.view.expanded.add(groupId);
    rebuildOrdered(c);
  }
  return select(c, { groupId, resultId: intent.resultId }, groupId);   // navScope = the group the user reads
}

function onNavStep(c, dir) {
  const ordered = c.pipe?.ordered ?? null;
  if (ordered === null) return undefined;
  const scope = c.selection?.navScope ?? null;
  const next = ordered.navNeighbor(c.selection?.occurrence ?? null, dir, scope);
  if (next === null) return undefined;                             // ends: no wrap
  return select(c, next, scope);
}

function onNavPrev(c) { return onNavStep(c, -1); }
function onNavNext(c) { return onNavStep(c, 1); }

function onActionFocus(c) { return present(c, { fit: true }); }   // Focus always fits

function onActionIsolate(c, intent) {
  c.toggles = { ...c.toggles, isolate: intent.value === true && isolationState(c).available };
  touch(c);
  return c.selection === null ? undefined : present(c, { fit: false });
}

function onActionMarkers(c, intent) {
  c.toggles = { ...c.toggles, markers: intent.value === true };
  touch(c);
  return c.selection === null ? undefined : present(c, { fit: false });
}

function onActionFocusOnSelect(c, intent) {
  c.toggles = { ...c.toggles, focusOnSelect: intent.value === true };
  touch(c);
}

/** Back to All = bridge.clear() + clear selection + navScope; filters, grouping, page and results untouched. */
function onBackToAll(c) {
  c.selection = null;
  c.presented = null;
  c.presentNotes = [];
  touch(c);
  return clearViewer(c);
}

/** Restore-table "Hide Panel": clear the visualization, KEEP the selection (reapply via Focus). */
function onPanelHidden(c) {
  c.presented = null;
  c.presentNotes = [];
  touch(c);
  return clearViewer(c);
}

/**
 * bridge.onModelLeft ('unload' or 'removed'; a real unload may deliver both for one model — idempotent):
 * clear the visualization iff it references that model (unknown key ⇒ conservatively clear), forget its
 * search labels, re-check freshness; results, counts, filters and grouping stay (rows re-resolve lazily).
 */
function onModelLeft(c, event) {
  if (c.disposed) return;
  let key = null;
  try { key = c.catalog.keyOfModel(event?.model); } catch { key = null; }
  if (typeof key === 'string') c.labels.forgetModel(key);
  const shown = c.presented;
  if (shown !== null && (typeof key !== 'string' || shown.modelKeys.includes(key))) {
    c.presented = null;
    c.presentNotes = [];
    void clearViewer(c);
  }
  recheckFreshness(c);
  touch(c);
}

function navOf(c) {
  const ordered = c.pipe?.ordered ?? null;
  const sel = c.selection;
  const label = sel === null ? 'No clash selected' : `Clash #${selectedCanonical(c) + 1}${sel.navScope !== null ? ' (within its group)' : ''}`;
  if (ordered === null) return { canPrev: false, canNext: false, label };
  const occ = sel?.occurrence ?? null;
  const scope = sel?.navScope ?? null;
  return { canPrev: ordered.navNeighbor(occ, -1, scope) !== null, canNext: ordered.navNeighbor(occ, 1, scope) !== null, label };
}
```

```js
function listInput(c) {
  const p = c.pipe;
  if (p === null || p.index === null) return null;
  const v = c.view;
  const ordered = p.ordered;
  const elementOnly = v.filter.elementOnly;
  return {
    total: p.index.count,
    filtered: p.matching === null ? null : p.matching.length,
    busy: p.filterBusy || p.groupingState === 'pending' || (v.filter.unverified && p.maskState === 'pending'),
    maskUnavailable: v.filter.unverified === true && p.maskMissing === true,
    spec: v.filter, textDraft: v.textDraft, maxGapText: v.maxGapText, maxGapError: v.maxGapError,
    groupBy: v.groupBy, groupingState: p.groupingState, groupingReason: p.groupingReason,
    sort: v.sort, isSoft: p.index.isSoft, clearance: p.index.clearance,
    modelOptions: p.index.models.map((m) => ({ modelKey: m.modelKey, label: c.labels.modelName(m.modelKey) })),
    elementOnly: elementOnly === null ? null : { ...elementOnly, label: labelOfRef(c, elementOnly) },
    view: ordered === null ? 'flat' : ordered.view,
    page: { index: v.page, count: ordered === null ? 0 : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(ordered.length / PAGE_SIZE)), size: PAGE_SIZE },
    rows: ordered === null ? [] : pageRows(c),
    nav: navOf(c),
    hiddenByFilters: selectionHidden(c),
  };
}

function selectedInput(c) {
  const i = selectedCanonical(c);
  if (i < 0) return null;
  const p = c.pipe;
  const record = p.index.at(i);
  const resolution = resolveResult({ record, provenance: p.set.provenance, engine: c.engine, catalog: c.catalog });
  return {
    resultId: record.resultId, ordinal: i + 1,
    side1: sideView(record.pair.first, c.labels), side2: sideView(record.pair.second, c.labels),
    gap: gapOf(record), hasLocation: locationOf(record) !== null, liveness: livenessOf(resolution),
    notes: [...resolution.notes, ...c.presentNotes], hiddenByFilters: selectionHidden(c),
    anyLive: resolution.anyLive, isolation: isolationState(c), toggles: { ...c.toggles },
  };
}
```

```js
/** Selected Clash region (§9.3, §14.4 region 5): detail survives filters/pages; actions carry enable reasons. */
function buildSelectedRegion(input) {
  const s = input.selected;
  if (s === null) return null;
  const blocked = s.anyLive !== true ? `Viewer actions are unavailable: ${s.liveness}.` : null;   // AC-P7
  return {
    resultId: s.resultId, ordinal: s.ordinal, side1: { ...s.side1 }, side2: { ...s.side2 }, gap: s.gap,
    hasLocation: s.hasLocation, liveness: s.liveness, notes: [...s.notes], hiddenByFilters: s.hiddenByFilters === true,
    actions: {
      focus: { enabled: blocked === null, reason: blocked },
      isolate: {
        enabled: blocked === null && s.isolation.available,
        checked: s.toggles.isolate === true && s.isolation.available,
        reason: blocked ?? (s.isolation.available ? null : s.isolation.reason),
      },
      markers: { enabled: blocked === null, checked: s.toggles.markers === true, reason: blocked },
      focusOnSelect: { checked: s.toggles.focusOnSelect === true },
      backToAll: { enabled: true },
    },
  };
}
```
