```js
// test/clashpanel/core/viewModel.test.mjs — Task 19: the pure ViewModel builder (AC-P2, AC-P3, AC-P11, AC-P21 shape).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { buildViewModel, describeStatusLive, EMPTY_FILTERED_TEXT } from '../../../clashpanel/core/viewModel.js';
import { createDraft } from '../../../clashpanel/core/draft.js';
import { initialRunState, reduceRun } from '../../../clashpanel/core/runMachine.js';
import { runHeadline, STATEMENTS } from '../../../clashpanel/core/runReport.js';
import { PAGE_SIZE } from '../../../clashpanel/core/constants.js';
import { INTENT } from '../../../clashpanel/core/intents.js';
import { makeSet, makeHarness } from '../support/controllerHarness.mjs';

// ── input builders (the ViewInput documented at the top of viewModel.js) ──────────────────────────────────────

const snapshot = (over = {}) => ({ runId: 'run-1', status: 'queued', phase: 'queued', seq: 0, unitsTotal: 0, unitsEvaluated: 0, unitsFailedOrSkipped: 0, pairSpaceTotal: 0, pairSpaceEvaluated: 0, pairSpaceProcessed: 0, fractionEvaluated: null, fractionProcessed: null, resultsFound: 0, caveatCount: 0, caveatUnclassified: 0, currentUnitId: null, elapsedMs: 0, ...over });

function machineFor(phase, status) {
  const admitted = reduceRun(initialRunState(), { type: 'admitted', snapshot: snapshot(), atMs: 0 });
  if (phase === 'idle') return initialRunState();
  if (phase === 'preparing') return admitted;
  if (phase === 'running') return reduceRun(admitted, { type: 'core-event', event: { type: 'unit', seq: 1, status: 'running', phase: 'executing' }, snapshot: snapshot({ status: 'running', phase: 'executing', seq: 1 }) });
  return reduceRun(admitted, { type: 'done', summary: { status, resultSet: {}, persistence: { state: 'saved' } } });
}

function input({ phase = 'idle', set = null, list = null, freshness, claim = null, claimPending = false, selected = null, persistence = { state: 'saved', timedOut: false, attempt: 1 }, setupChanged = false } = {}) {
  const status = set?.outcome?.status ?? 'failed';
  return {
    version: 7,
    setup: {
      draft: createDraft({ testId: 't', testNumber: 1 }),
      validation: { state: 'blocked', findings: [{ control: 'setA', code: 'empty', text: 'Set A is empty' }], issuesTruncated: false, definition: null },
      soft: { available: false, pending: false, verdict: null, explanation: null },
      models: [{ modelKey: 'mA', displayName: 'Architecture', loaded: true, registered: true }],
      modelName: (k) => ({ mA: 'Architecture', mB: 'Structure' })[k] ?? `Model ${k}`,
      setupChangedSinceRun: setupChanged, collapsed: false, runActive: phase === 'running' || phase === 'preparing',
    },
    run: {
      machine: machineFor(phase, status), snapshot: phase === 'running' ? snapshot({ status: 'running', unitsTotal: 4, unitsEvaluated: 1, fractionProcessed: 0.25, resultsFound: 2 }) : null,
      elapsedMs: phase === 'running' ? 65000 : null, canRun: phase === 'idle' || phase === 'done', canStop: phase === 'running' || phase === 'preparing',
      admission: null, confirm: null, releaseErrors: [], residencyNotice: null, setupChanged, isolationNotice: null,
    },
    displayed: phase !== 'done' ? null : {
      runId: 'run-1', status, resultSet: set, persistence,
      freshness: freshness === undefined ? { state: set?.outcome?.freshness ?? 'current', reasons: [] } : freshness,
      freshnessPending: freshness === null, claim, claimPending, summary: null,
    },
    list, selected,
  };
}

function listFor(set, over = {}) {
  const n = set.results.length;
  return {
    total: n, filtered: n, busy: false, spec: { text: '', models: [], elementOnly: null, maxGap: null, unverified: false, hasLocation: false },
    textDraft: '', maxGapText: '', maxGapError: null, groupBy: 'none', groupingState: 'idle', groupingReason: null, sort: 'default',
    isSoft: false, clearance: null, modelOptions: [{ modelKey: 'mA', label: 'Architecture' }], elementOnly: null, view: 'flat',
    page: { index: 0, count: n === 0 ? 0 : 1, size: PAGE_SIZE },
    rows: set.results.map((r, i) => ({ kind: 'result', key: `-|${r.resultId}`, resultId: r.resultId, groupId: null, ordinal: i + 1, side1: { modelKey: 'mA', modelName: 'Architecture', label: '#1', dbId: 1 }, side2: { modelKey: 'mB', modelName: 'Structure', label: '#10', dbId: 10 }, gap: null, badges: [], liveness: 'live', selected: false })),
    nav: { canPrev: false, canNext: n > 0, label: 'No clash selected' }, hiddenByFilters: false, ...over,
  };
}

const claimFor = (set) => {
  const o = set.outcome;
  const allowed = set.results.length === 0 && o.status === 'completed' && o.coverage === 'full' && o.integrity === 'clean' && o.freshness === 'current';
  return { allowed, unqualified: allowed, qualifiers: [], exclusions: [], proofMethod: 'bracketed-digest' };
};

const strings = (v, out = []) => {
  if (typeof v === 'string') out.push(v);
  else if (v !== null && typeof v === 'object') for (const x of Object.values(v)) strings(x, out);
  return out;
};
// The two §7.5 claim statements and the §8.3 empty-after-filter line are the only sentences allowed to start so.
const SANCTIONED = new Set([STATEMENTS.CLAIM, STATEMENTS.QUALIFIED_CLAIM, EMPTY_FILTERED_TEXT]);
function assertNoBareNoClashes(vm) {
  for (const s of strings(vm)) {
    assert.notEqual(s.trim().replace(/[.!]$/, ''), 'No clashes', 'bare "No clashes"');
    if (/\bNo clashes\b/.test(s)) assert.ok(SANCTIONED.has(s), `"No clashes" outside the sanctioned sentences: ${s}`);
  }
}

const SHAPE = {
  top: ['filters', 'results', 'run', 'selected', 'setup', 'version'],
  setup: ['clearance', 'collapsed', 'mode', 'models', 'name', 'scope', 'selfClash', 'setupChangedSinceRun', 'softAvailability', 'summary', 'useSelectionEnabled', 'validation'],
  run: ['badges', 'banners', 'canRun', 'canStop', 'counts', 'details', 'diagnostics', 'doneKind', 'headline', 'progress', 'state', 'statusLive', 'waitingForOtherRun'],
  filters: ['active', 'busy', 'elementOnly', 'groupBy', 'groupingNote', 'hasLocation', 'maxGap', 'modelOptions', 'models', 'sort', 'sortOptions', 'text', 'unverified'],
  results: ['hiddenByFiltersNote', 'lines', 'message', 'multiValuedNote', 'nav', 'page', 'rows', 'state', 'view'],
  selected: ['actions', 'gap', 'hasLocation', 'hiddenByFilters', 'liveness', 'notes', 'ordinal', 'resultId', 'side1', 'side2'],
  actions: ['backToAll', 'focus', 'focusOnSelect', 'isolate', 'markers'],
};
const keys = (o) => Object.keys(o).sort();

// ── tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

test('every region has exactly the catalog shape and the whole ViewModel is deep-frozen', () => {
  const set = makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: [{ a: ['mA', 1], b: ['mB', 10] }] });
  const selected = {
    resultId: 'r0', ordinal: 1, side1: { modelKey: 'mA', modelName: 'Architecture', label: '#1', dbId: 1 }, side2: { modelKey: 'mB', modelName: 'Structure', label: '#10', dbId: 10 },
    gap: null, hasLocation: true, liveness: 'live', notes: [], hiddenByFilters: false, anyLive: true,
    isolation: { available: true, reason: null }, toggles: { focusOnSelect: true, isolate: false, markers: true },
  };
  for (const vm of [buildViewModel(input()), buildViewModel(input({ phase: 'running' })), buildViewModel(input({ phase: 'done', set, list: listFor(set), selected }))]) {
    assert.deepEqual(keys(vm), SHAPE.top);
    assert.deepEqual(keys(vm.setup), SHAPE.setup);
    assert.deepEqual(keys(vm.run), SHAPE.run);
    assert.deepEqual(keys(vm.filters), SHAPE.filters);
    assert.deepEqual(keys(vm.results), SHAPE.results);
    assert.deepEqual(keys(vm.results.nav), ['canNext', 'canPrev', 'label']);
    assert.deepEqual(keys(vm.results.page), ['count', 'index', 'size']);
    const walk = (v) => { if (v !== null && typeof v === 'object') { assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(v)); Object.values(v).forEach(walk); } };
    walk(vm);
    assert.equal(vm.version, 7);
  }
  const vm = buildViewModel(input({ phase: 'done', set, list: listFor(set), selected }));
  assert.deepEqual(keys(vm.selected), SHAPE.selected);
  assert.deepEqual(keys(vm.selected.actions), SHAPE.actions);
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(vm).includes('tolerance'), false);            // no Hard tolerance control (AC-P1)
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(vm).includes('elementCount'), false);         // G-EC never displayed (AC-P12)
});

test('AC-P3: a running ViewModel offers progress counters and elapsed time, no list and no ETA-like field', () => {
  const vm = buildViewModel(input({ phase: 'running' }));
  assert.equal(vm.results.state, 'running');
  assert.deepEqual(vm.results.rows, []);
  assert.deepEqual(keys(vm.run.progress), ['caveatCount', 'elapsedText', 'fraction', 'resultsFound', 'unitsEvaluated', 'unitsTotal']);
  assert.equal(vm.run.progress.elapsedText, '1:05');
  assert.equal(vm.run.canStop, true);
  assert.equal(/\b(eta|remaining|throughput)\b/i.test(JSON.stringify(vm.run)), false);
});

test('AC-P2: every terminal status × coverage × integrity × freshness (empty and non-empty) has a matrix headline, never bare "No clashes"', () => {
  let combos = 0;
  for (const status of ['completed', 'cancelled', 'failed', 'invalidated']) {
    for (const coverage of ['full', 'partial']) {
      for (const integrity of ['clean', 'caveated']) {
        for (const freshness of ['current', 'stale', 'unverifiable']) {
          for (const n of [0, 2]) {
            const results = n === 0 ? [] : [{ a: ['mA', 1], b: ['mB', 10] }, { a: ['mA', 2], b: ['mB', 10] }];
            const reasons = status === 'failed' ? ['unit:extraction-limit'] : [];
            const set = makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', status, coverage, integrity, freshness, reasons, results });
            const vm = buildViewModel(input({ phase: 'done', set, list: listFor(set), freshness: { state: freshness, reasons: [] }, claim: claimFor(set) }));
            const expected = runHeadline({ status, total: n, coverage, resultSet: set });
            assert.equal(vm.run.headline, expected, `${status}/${coverage}/${integrity}/${freshness}/${n}`);
            assert.ok(vm.run.headline.length > 0);
            assert.equal(vm.run.doneKind, status);
            assert.deepEqual([vm.run.badges.coverage.value, vm.run.badges.integrity.value, vm.run.badges.freshness.value], [coverage, integrity, freshness]);
            if (n === 0) {
              const claimed = claimFor(set).allowed;
              assert.equal(vm.results.state, claimed ? 'empty-claim' : 'empty-nonclaim');
              if (!claimed) assert.ok(vm.results.lines.length > 0, 'a non-claim names at least one failed conjunct');
            } else {
              assert.equal(vm.results.state, 'list');
            }
            if (freshness !== 'current') assert.ok(vm.run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'stale'));
            assertNoBareNoClashes(vm);
            combos += 1;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  assert.equal(combos, 96);
});

test('results.state covers before-run, running, list, empty-claim, empty-nonclaim, empty-filtered, grouping-unavailable and error', () => {
  const two = makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: [{ a: ['mA', 1], b: ['mB', 10] }, { a: ['mA', 2], b: ['mB', 10] }] });
  const empty = makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: [] });
  const cases = [
    ['before-run', input()],
    ['running', input({ phase: 'running' })],
    ['list', input({ phase: 'done', set: two, list: listFor(two) })],
    ['empty-claim', input({ phase: 'done', set: empty, list: listFor(empty), claim: claimFor(empty) })],
    ['empty-nonclaim', input({ phase: 'done', set: empty, list: listFor(empty), claim: { ...claimFor(empty), allowed: false, unqualified: false } })],
    ['empty-filtered', input({ phase: 'done', set: two, list: listFor(two, { filtered: 0, rows: [] }) })],
    ['grouping-unavailable', input({ phase: 'done', set: two, list: listFor(two, { groupBy: 'element', groupingState: 'unavailable', groupingReason: 'too-large' }) })],
    ['error', input({ phase: 'done', set: null })],
  ];
  for (const [state, vmInput] of cases) {
    const vm = buildViewModel(vmInput);
    assert.equal(vm.results.state, state, state);
    if (state !== 'list') assert.ok(typeof vm.results.message === 'string' && vm.results.message.length > 0, `${state} has a message`);
    assertNoBareNoClashes(vm);
  }
  const pending = buildViewModel(input({ phase: 'done', set: empty, list: listFor(empty), claim: null }));
  assert.equal(pending.results.state, 'empty-nonclaim');                   // a pending claim is never worded as a claim
  const grouping = buildViewModel(cases[6][1]);
  assert.equal(grouping.filters.groupingNote, 'Grouping unavailable for a set this large — showing the flat list.');
  assert.equal(grouping.results.rows.length, 2);                           // the flat list is still shown
});

test('H1 (the view-model owns the claim/freshness pair): an allowed claim renders only from a settled pair whose freshness is current', () => {
  const empty = makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: [] });
  const allowed = claimFor(empty);
  assert.equal(allowed.allowed, true, 'control: Core would allow this claim');
  const vmOf = (over) => buildViewModel(input({ phase: 'done', set: empty, list: listFor(empty), ...over }));
  assert.deepEqual([vmOf({ claim: allowed }).results.state, vmOf({ claim: allowed }).results.message], ['empty-claim', STATEMENTS.CLAIM]);   // allowed + current
  for (const state of ['stale', 'unverifiable']) {                                                       // allowed + not current ⇒ forbidden
    const vm = vmOf({ claim: allowed, freshness: { state, reasons: ['scope-drift'] } });
    assert.deepEqual([vm.results.state, vm.results.message], ['empty-nonclaim', STATEMENTS.NON_CLAIM], state);
    assert.equal(vm.results.lines[0], STATEMENTS.STALE);
    assertNoBareNoClashes(vm);
  }
  const freshnessPending = vmOf({ claim: allowed, freshness: null });                                     // one half pending ⇒ "checking…"
  assert.deepEqual([freshnessPending.results.state, freshnessPending.results.message], ['empty-nonclaim', STATEMENTS.CLAIM_PENDING]);
  const claimPending = vmOf({ claim: allowed, claimPending: true });
  assert.deepEqual([claimPending.results.state, claimPending.results.message], ['empty-nonclaim', STATEMENTS.CLAIM_PENDING]);
  const denied = vmOf({ claim: { ...allowed, allowed: false, unqualified: false } });                     // disallowed + current ⇒ forbidden
  assert.equal(denied.results.state, 'empty-nonclaim');
  for (const vm of [freshnessPending, claimPending, denied]) assertNoBareNoClashes(vm);
});

test('selected actions: enable/disable reasons for no live side, isolation prerequisite and toggles', () => {
  const set = makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', results: [{ a: ['mA', 1], b: ['mB', 10] }] });
  const base = {
    resultId: 'r0', ordinal: 1, side1: { modelKey: 'mA', modelName: 'Architecture', label: '#1', dbId: 1 }, side2: { modelKey: 'mB', modelName: 'Structure', label: '#10', dbId: 10 },
    gap: null, hasLocation: false, liveness: 'model not loaded', notes: [], hiddenByFilters: true, anyLive: false,
    isolation: { available: false, reason: 'Some elements are hidden — show all to enable isolation' }, toggles: { focusOnSelect: false, isolate: true, markers: true },
  };
  let vm = buildViewModel(input({ phase: 'done', set, list: listFor(set), selected: base }));
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.actions.focus, { enabled: false, reason: 'Viewer actions are unavailable: model not loaded.' });
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.actions.isolate, { enabled: false, checked: false, reason: 'Viewer actions are unavailable: model not loaded.' });
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.actions.backToAll, { enabled: true });
  assert.equal(vm.selected.hiddenByFilters, true);
  vm = buildViewModel(input({ phase: 'done', set, list: listFor(set), selected: { ...base, anyLive: true, liveness: 'live' } }));
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.actions.focus, { enabled: true, reason: null });
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.actions.isolate, { enabled: false, checked: false, reason: 'Some elements are hidden — show all to enable isolation' });
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.actions.markers, { enabled: true, checked: true, reason: null });
  assert.deepEqual(vm.selected.actions.focusOnSelect, { checked: false });
});

test('run.details (§8.4): null before a set; plain-string lines from the sealed set; hostile names raw; no elementCount', () => {
  assert.equal(buildViewModel(input()).run.details, null);
  const hostile = '<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>';

  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(vm.run.details).includes('999999'), false);   // provenance.models[].elementCount (G-EC)
  assert.equal(vm.run.details.lines.some((l) => l.label.startsWith('Measurement basis')), false);   // Hard run

test('run.details shows the Soft basis verdict captured when the run was admitted, not the current one', async () => {
  const h = makeHarness({ basis: { state: 'verified', basisKey: 'shared-frame' } });
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_MODE, value: 'soft' });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_CLEARANCE, value: '0.05' });
  await h.runToDone(makeSet({ runId: 'run-1', mode: 'clearance', clearance: 0.05, results: [{ a: ['mA', 1], b: ['mB', 10], distance: 0.01 }] }));
  h.catalog.setBasis({ state: 'incompatible', reason: 'frames differ' });  // the verdict changes after the run
  h.catalog.fire();
  await h.settle();
  const basis = h.vm().run.details.lines.find((l) => l.label === 'Measurement basis (at run start)');
  assert.equal(basis.value, 'verified (shared-frame)');
  assert.equal(h.vm().setup.softAvailability.available, false);           // the live setup verdict did change
});

test('statusLive: headline + filtered count + pending freshness + an extra error; plain text for aria-live', () => {
  const run = {

    banners: [{ id: 'x', kind: 'error', text: 'Something failed.' }, { id: 'y', kind: 'info', text: 'ignored' }],

  const vm = buildViewModel(input({ phase: 'running' }));
  assert.equal(vm.run.statusLive, describeStatusLive(vm.run));
});
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/core/index.test.mjs — Task 19: the core barrel and the AC-P1 control → Core-field mapping.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import * as core from '../../../clashpanel/core/index.js';
import * as constants from '../../../clashpanel/core/constants.js';
import { INTENT } from '../../../clashpanel/core/intents.js';
import { makeHarness } from '../support/controllerHarness.mjs';

test('the barrel exports exactly the core surface and no presentation constant (AC-P11)', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(core).sort(), ['INTENT', 'buildViewModel', 'createDefaultScheduler', 'createPanelController']);
  for (const name of Object.keys(constants)) assert.equal(name in core, false, `${name} must not be re-exported`);
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(core.INTENT));
});

const DEFINITION_KEYS = new Set(['schemaVersion', 'testId', 'revision', 'name', 'description', 'selectionA', 'selectionB', 'mode', 'clearance']);

/** AC-P1 table: each §6.1 control, the intent that sets it, and the Core definition field it must (only) reach. */
const CONTROL_MAP = [
  { control: 'Test name', intents: [{ type: INTENT.SETUP_NAME, value: 'Walls vs beams' }], check: (d) => assert.equal(d.name, 'Walls vs beams') },
  { control: 'Mode Hard (default)', intents: [], check: (d) => { assert.equal(d.mode, 'volume-overlap'); assert.equal('clearance' in d, false); } },
  { control: 'Mode Soft + Clearance', intents: [{ type: INTENT.SETUP_MODE, value: 'soft' }, { type: INTENT.SETUP_CLEARANCE, value: '0.25' }], check: (d) => { assert.equal(d.mode, 'clearance'); assert.equal(d.clearance, 0.25); } },
  { control: 'Set A / Set B models', intents: [], check: (d) => { assert.deepEqual(d.selectionA, { entries: [{ kind: 'model', modelKey: 'mA' }] }); assert.deepEqual(d.selectionB, { entries: [{ kind: 'model', modelKey: 'mB' }] }); } },
  { control: 'Use current selection', intents: [{ type: INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_MODEL, side: 'A', modelKey: 'mA' }, { type: INTENT.SETUP_USE_SELECTION, side: 'A' }], check: (d) => assert.deepEqual(d.selectionA, { entries: [{ kind: 'elements', modelKey: 'mA', dbIds: [4, 7] }] }) },
  { control: 'Self-clash', intents: [{ type: INTENT.SETUP_SELF_CLASH, value: true }], check: (d) => { assert.deepEqual(d.selectionB, d.selectionA); assert.notEqual(d.selectionB, d.selectionA); } },
  { control: 'Test identity', intents: [], check: (d) => { assert.equal(d.schemaVersion, 1); assert.equal(d.testId, 'test-1'); assert.equal(d.revision, 1); } },
  { control: 'Group by / sort / filters (post-run only)', intents: [{ type: INTENT.GROUP_MODE, value: 'element' }, { type: INTENT.SORT_SET, value: 'group-count' }], check: (d) => { assert.equal('groupBy' in d, false); assert.equal('sort' in d, false); } },
];

for (const row of CONTROL_MAP) {
  test(`AC-P1: "${row.control}" maps to a Core definition field only; no definition or run option is invented`, async () => {
    const h = makeHarness();
    h.bridge.setSelection([{ model: h.modelA, dbIds: [7, 4] }]);
    await h.readyHard();                                                     // mA → Set A, mB → Set B
    for (const intent of row.intents) await h.dispatch(intent);
    await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
    assert.equal(h.engine.startCalls.length, 1, 'the run was admitted');
    const { definition, runOptions } = h.engine.startCalls[0];
    assert.equal(runOptions, undefined);                                     // v1 exposes no run options
    for (const key of Object.keys(definition)) assert.ok(DEFINITION_KEYS.has(key), `invented definition key ${key}`);
    row.check(definition);
  });
}
```

```js
//
```

(b) Replace the Task-16 `describeStatusLive` with the following, preceded by the new `detailsOf` (spec §8.4 Run details from T17's `buildRunDetails`):

```js
/** Run details (§8.4) for the displayed sealed set; null before any set is displayed. */
function detailsOf(input) {
  const d = input.displayed;
  if (d === null || d.resultSet === null) return null;
  return { lines: buildRunDetails({ resultSet: d.resultSet, runRecord: d.runRecord ?? null, modelName: input.setup.modelName }) };
}

/**
 * aria-live="polite" text for the status region (§14.5): the headline, the filtered-of-total count when a filter
 * narrows the list, a pending freshness check, and the first error banner that the headline does not already say.
 * Progress counters are deliberately left out (they change per work unit and would flood a screen reader).
 */
export function describeStatusLive(run) {
  const parts = [run.headline];
  const { total, filtered } = run.counts;
  if (total !== null && filtered !== null && filtered !== total) parts.push(`${filtered} of ${total} clashes match the filters`);
  if (run.badges?.freshness?.pending === true) parts.push('Checking freshness');
  const error = run.banners.find((b) => b.kind === 'error' && b.text !== run.headline);
  if (error) parts.push(error.text);
  return `${parts.map((p) => String(p).replace(/[\s.…]+$/u, '')).filter((p) => p !== '').join('. ')}.`;
}
```

(b2) Replace `buildRunRegion` (adds `details`):

```js
function buildRunRegion(input) {
  const r = input.run;
  const m = r.machine;
  const state = m.phase;
  const run = {
    state,
    doneKind: state === 'done' ? (m.terminal?.status ?? null) : null,
    canRun: r.canRun === true,
    canStop: r.canStop === true,
    progress: NON_TERMINAL.has(state) ? progressOf(r) : null,
    headline: headlineOf(input),
    counts: countsOf(input),
    badges: badgesOf(input),
    banners: runBanners(input),
    diagnostics: diagnosticsOf(input),
    details: detailsOf(input),
    statusLive: '',
    waitingForOtherRun: m.waitingForOtherRun === true,
  };
  run.statusLive = describeStatusLive(run);
  return run;
}
```

### Task 20: Contract test against the REAL engine (scripted executor)

**Tier:** [A] format-agnostic headless

**Files:**
- Test: `test/clashpanel/core/realEngineContract.test.mjs`

**Scope note:** The only test of the controller against real Core shapes: `createEngineWorld()` (models `mA` roots 1,2 and `mB` root 10, registered `'v1'`) + `createScriptedExecutor(script, {unscripted:{facts:[], pairs}})` + `createClashTestEngine(w.config({unitExecutor, …}))` from the public barrel, driven only through public engine methods (the port handed to the controller is a counting pass-through of the EnginePort members; `retentionReport`/`getPersistenceState`/`getRun` are read by the test on the raw engine). **Recipe facts verified at plan time by executing it against the repo:** the default `w.config()` works under plain Node — `interUnitYield:'animation-frame'` degrades to a macrotask when `requestAnimationFrame` is absent (`clashtest/util/slicer.js:20-24`), so no `now`/`yieldToScheduler` injection is needed; a scripted witness `kind` must be a real library kind (`'surface-crossing'`) — an unknown kind seals `failed` / `unit:internal-error`; `resultStore: null` ⇒ persistence `skipped` (`no-store`); `limits: {maxResidentResultSets: 1}` + a leased saved set ⇒ the next `startRun` throws `ResultCapacityError{cap:1, retained:[runId]}`; a Stop while unit `'1.0'` is held (`hold:true`) seals `cancelled` with that unit's pairs; unregistering `mB` after validation seals `failed` with `planningGaps:[{phase:'binding', cause:'model-not-bound'}]` and `provenance.models: []`. A self-clash definition must not share one selection object between A and B (Core's structural walk reports `cyclic` at `/selectionB`) — T4's `buildDefinition` already clones; the Soft self-clash scenario would catch a regression.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `createClashTestEngine` (`clashtest/index.js`); `createEngineWorld` (`test/clashtest/support/engineWorld.mjs`); `createScriptedExecutor` (`test/clashtest/support/scriptedExecutor.mjs`: `inFlight(unitId)`, `release(unitId)`); `engine.retentionReport() -> {active, sets:[{runId}], …}`, `engine.getPersistenceState(runId)`; `w.registry.unregister(model)` / `register(key, model, {modelVersion})`; T16 `createRecordingBridge`; T2/T3 `createFakeScheduler`, `createFakeCatalog`; `settle`/`until` (T15).
- Produces: `test/clashpanel/core/realEngineContract.test.mjs` (13 tests, incl. the single-slot unsaved confirmed-discard run, RF-3 — a model unloaded while the real run is in flight — and RF-4 — edit-then-revert reruns give identical real resultIds).

**Depends on:** T15–T19.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the test**

```js
// test/clashpanel/core/realEngineContract.test.mjs — Task 20: the controller against the REAL Core engine
// (createClashTestEngine from the public barrel + the P6 scripted unit executor), to catch drift between the Panel's
// doubles and real Core shapes (AC-P8, AC-P9). Only public engine methods are used. The engine runs on its own
// (macrotask) scheduling — in Node the default `interUnitYield:'animation-frame'` degrades to a macrotask
// (clashtest/util/slicer.js) — while the controller uses the fake scheduler; `until` bounds ROUNDS, not time.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createClashTestEngine } from '../../../clashtest/index.js';
import { createEngineWorld } from '../../clashtest/support/engineWorld.mjs';
import { createScriptedExecutor } from '../../clashtest/support/scriptedExecutor.mjs';
import { createPanelController } from '../../../clashpanel/core/controller.js';
import { INTENT } from '../../../clashpanel/core/intents.js';
import { runHeadline, STATEMENTS } from '../../../clashpanel/core/runReport.js';
import { createFakeCatalog } from '../support/fakeCatalog.mjs';
import { createFakeScheduler } from '../support/fakeScheduler.mjs';
import { createRecordingBridge } from '../support/controllerHarness.mjs';
import { settle, until } from '../support/settle.mjs';

// Witness kinds must be a real library kind: an unknown kind seals `failed: unit:internal-error`.
const HARD_PAIRS = [
  { source: { modelKey: 'mA', dbId: 1 }, target: { modelKey: 'mB', dbId: 10 }, type: 'volume-overlap', witness: { kind: 'surface-crossing', point: [1, 2, 3] } },
  { source: { modelKey: 'mA', dbId: 2 }, target: { modelKey: 'mB', dbId: 10 }, type: 'volume-overlap', witness: null },
];
const SOFT_PAIRS = [
  { source: { modelKey: 'mA', dbId: 1 }, target: { modelKey: 'mA', dbId: 2 }, type: 'clearance', distance: 0.02, clearance: 0.05, witness: { sourcePoint: [0, 0, 0], targetPoint: [0.02, 0, 0] } },
];

/** Counts derivation/read calls while delegating to the real engine (the controller narrows it to the port). */
function spied(engine) {
  const counts = { summarize: 0, groupBy: 0, filter: 0, getFreshness: 0, assessNoClashClaim: 0 };
  const wrap = (owner, name) => (...args) => { counts[name] += 1; return owner[name](...args); };
  return {
    counts,
    port: {
      validateTest: (...a) => engine.validateTest(...a),
      startRun: (...a) => engine.startRun(...a),
      retainResultSet: (...a) => engine.retainResultSet(...a),
      releaseResultSet: (...a) => engine.releaseResultSet(...a),
      getPersistenceState: (...a) => engine.getPersistenceState(...a),
      getFreshness: wrap(engine, 'getFreshness'),
      assessNoClashClaim: wrap(engine, 'assessNoClashClaim'),
      derivations: { summarize: wrap(engine.derivations, 'summarize'), groupBy: wrap(engine.derivations, 'groupBy'), filter: wrap(engine.derivations, 'filter') },
      registry: engine.registry,
    },
  };
}

function setup({ pairs = HARD_PAIRS, script = {}, engineConfig = {} } = {}) {
  const w = createEngineWorld();
  const executor = createScriptedExecutor(script, { unscripted: { facts: [], pairs } });
  const engine = createClashTestEngine(w.config({ unitExecutor: executor, ...engineConfig }));
  const { port, counts } = spied(engine);
  const scheduler = createFakeScheduler();
  const catalog = createFakeCatalog({
    models: [
      { modelKey: 'mA', displayName: 'Architecture', model: w.models.get('mA'), loaded: true },
      { modelKey: 'mB', displayName: 'Structure', model: w.models.get('mB'), loaded: true },
    ],
    basis: { state: 'unverified', reason: 'no shared basis evidence' },
  });
  const bridge = createRecordingBridge();
  let n = 0;
  const controller = createPanelController({ engine: port, catalog, bridge, scheduler, mintId: () => { n += 1; return `real-${n}`; } });
  const t = {
    w, engine, executor, counts, scheduler, catalog, bridge, controller,
    vm: () => controller.getViewModel(),
    async dispatch(intent) { const out = await controller.dispatch(intent); await settle(scheduler); return out; },
    until: (predicate) => until(scheduler, predicate),
    async hardAB() {
      await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_MODEL, side: 'A', modelKey: 'mA' });
      await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_MODEL, side: 'B', modelKey: 'mB' });
    },
    async runAndWait() {
      await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
      await t.until(() => t.vm().run.state === 'done');
      await t.until(() => { const s = t.vm().results.state; return s !== 'running' && !t.vm().filters.busy && t.vm().run.badges?.freshness?.pending !== true; });
    },
  };
  return t;
}

test('Hard, completed with 2 real results: index, summarize, caveated mask, freshness, grouping, filters, select + present', async () => {
  const t = setup();
  await t.hardAB();
  assert.equal(t.vm().run.canRun, true);
  await t.runAndWait();
  let vm = t.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.run.doneKind, 'completed');
  assert.deepEqual(vm.run.counts, { total: 2, filtered: 2 });
  assert.equal(vm.results.state, 'list');
  assert.deepEqual(vm.results.rows.map((r) => [r.side1.modelKey, r.side1.dbId, r.side2.modelKey, r.side2.dbId, r.liveness]), [['mA', 1, 'mB', 10, 'live'], ['mA', 2, 'mB', 10, 'live']]);
  assert.deepEqual(vm.results.rows[1].badges, ['no location']);
  assert.deepEqual([vm.run.badges.coverage.value, vm.run.badges.integrity.value, vm.run.badges.freshness.value], ['full', 'clean', 'current']);
  assert.deepEqual([t.counts.summarize, t.counts.filter, t.counts.getFreshness, t.counts.assessNoClashClaim], [1, 1, 1, 0]);

  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_MODE, value: 'element' });
  await t.until(() => t.vm().results.view === 'grouped');
  vm = t.vm();
  assert.deepEqual(vm.results.rows.map((r) => [r.kind, r.count]), [['group', 1], ['group', 1], ['group', 2]]);
  assert.equal(t.counts.groupBy, 1);
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_MODE, value: 'none' });
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_HAS_LOCATION, value: true });
  await t.until(() => t.vm().run.counts.filtered === 1);

  const first = t.vm().results.rows[0];
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: first.resultId, groupId: null });
  const call = t.bridge.calls.find((c) => c.op === 'present');
  assert.deepEqual(call.req.sides, [{ model: t.w.models.get('mA'), dbId: 1 }, { model: t.w.models.get('mB'), dbId: 10 }]);
  assert.deepEqual(call.req.point, [1, 2, 3]);
  assert.equal(t.vm().selected.resultId, first.resultId);
  assert.deepEqual([t.counts.summarize, t.counts.filter, t.counts.groupBy], [1, 1, 1]);
  await t.controller.dispose();
});

test('Soft (clearance), single participating model self-clash: real distance, gap text, closestPoints presented', async () => {
  const t = setup({ pairs: SOFT_PAIRS });
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_MODEL, side: 'A', modelKey: 'mA' });
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_SELF_CLASH, value: true });
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_MODE, value: 'soft' });
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_CLEARANCE, value: '0.05' });
  assert.equal(t.vm().setup.softAvailability.available, true);              // |P| = 1 ⇒ trivially common basis
  assert.equal(t.vm().run.canRun, true);
  await t.runAndWait();
  const vm = t.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.run.doneKind, 'completed');
  assert.equal(vm.results.rows[0].gap, '0.020 scene units');
  assert.equal(vm.filters.maxGap.visible, true);
  assert.equal(vm.filters.maxGap.max, 0.05);
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: vm.results.rows[0].resultId, groupId: null });
  const call = t.bridge.calls.find((c) => c.op === 'present');
  assert.deepEqual(call.req.closestPoints, { first: [0, 0, 0], second: [0.02, 0, 0] });
  await t.controller.dispose();
});

test('empty completed/full/clean run: the real claim is allowed and worded as the §7.5 claim, never bare "No clashes"', async () => {
  const t = setup({ pairs: [] });
  await t.hardAB();
  await t.runAndWait();
  await t.until(() => t.vm().results.state === 'empty-claim');
  const vm = t.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.message, STATEMENTS.CLAIM);
  assert.equal(t.counts.assessNoClashClaim, 1);
  assert.equal(vm.run.headline, 'Completed — 0 clashes');
  await t.controller.dispose();
});

test('Stop during a held unit: the drained unit\'s results stay browsable after the cancelled seal', async () => {
  const t = setup({ script: { '1.0': [{ facts: [], hold: true, pairs: HARD_PAIRS }] } });
  await t.hardAB();
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  await t.executor.inFlight('1.0');
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_STOP });
  assert.equal(t.vm().run.state, 'stopping');
  assert.equal(t.vm().results.state, 'running');                             // no list during the run (AC-P3)
  t.executor.release('1.0');
  await t.until(() => t.vm().run.state === 'done' && t.vm().run.counts.filtered !== null);
  const vm = t.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.run.doneKind, 'cancelled');
  assert.equal(vm.results.rows.length, 2);
  assert.ok(vm.run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'cancelled'));
  await t.controller.dispose();
});

test('planning failure (model unregistered after validation): sealed failed ⇒ headline by cause, banner, no list, rows would be unavailable', async () => {
  const t = setup();
  await t.hardAB();
  assert.equal(t.vm().run.canRun, true);
  t.w.registry.unregister(t.w.models.get('mB'));                             // host unregistered it; no catalog event
  await t.runAndWait();
  const vm = t.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.run.doneKind, 'failed');
  assert.ok(vm.run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'failed'));
  assert.equal(vm.results.rows.length, 0);
  assert.notEqual(vm.results.state, 'list');
  assert.equal(vm.results.state, 'empty-nonclaim');
  assert.ok(vm.run.diagnostics.preview.some((line) => line.includes('model-not-bound')));
  const json = JSON.parse(await t.controller.dispatch({ type: INTENT.DIAGNOSTICS_COPY }));
  assert.deepEqual(json.planningGaps, [{ phase: 'binding', cause: 'model-not-bound' }]);
  await t.controller.dispose();
});

test('AC-P8: after a real re-registration (new Model object, same key) no row resolves live; list and counts still work', async () => {
  const t = setup();
  await t.hardAB();
  await t.runAndWait();
  const reloaded = { fakeModel: 'mA-reloaded' };
  t.w.registry.unregister(t.w.models.get('mA'));
  t.w.registry.register('mA', reloaded, { modelVersion: 'v1' });
  t.catalog.addModel({ modelKey: 'mA', displayName: 'Architecture', model: reloaded, loaded: true });
  t.bridge.fireModelLeft({ model: t.w.models.get('mA'), reason: 'unload' });
  t.catalog.fire();
  await settle(t.scheduler);
  const vm = t.vm();
  assert.ok(vm.results.rows.every((r) => r.liveness === 'reloaded since run'));
  assert.deepEqual(vm.run.counts, { total: 2, filtered: 2 });
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: vm.results.rows[0].resultId, groupId: null });
  assert.deepEqual(t.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'present').at(-1).req.sides, [{ model: t.w.models.get('mB'), dbId: 10 }]);   // only the live side
  assert.deepEqual(t.vm().selected.notes.slice(0, 1), ['Architecture is not loaded']);
  await t.controller.dispose();
});

test('no result store ⇒ persistence skipped: "held in memory" notice; Clear needs the acknowledgement; the set is then released', async () => {
  const t = setup({ engineConfig: { resultStore: null } });
  await t.hardAB();
  await t.runAndWait();
  const runId = t.engine.retentionReport().sets[0].runId;
  assert.ok(t.vm().run.banners.some((b) => /held in memory/i.test(b.text)));
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR });
  assert.ok(t.vm().run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'confirm-discard-unsaved'));
  assert.notEqual(t.engine.getPersistenceState(runId), null);               // still resident
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR_CONFIRMED });
  assert.equal(t.engine.getPersistenceState(runId), null);                  // released with acknowledgeUnsaved
  assert.equal(t.vm().results.state, 'before-run');
  await t.controller.dispose();
});

test('capacity (maxResidentResultSets: 1): ResultCapacityError keeps the previous results; release-and-retry runs', async () => {
  const t = setup({ engineConfig: { limits: { maxResidentResultSets: 1 } } });
  await t.hardAB();
  await t.runAndWait();
  const clears = t.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'clear').length;
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  let vm = t.vm();
  const banner = vm.run.banners.find((b) => b.id === 'admission-error');
  assert.deepEqual(banner.action.intent, { type: INTENT.RUN_RELEASE_AND_RETRY });
  assert.equal(vm.run.doneKind, 'completed');
  assert.equal(vm.results.rows.length, 2);                                 // previous results preserved
  assert.equal(t.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'clear').length, clears);   // Viewer untouched
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_RELEASE_AND_RETRY });
  await t.until(() => t.vm().run.state === 'done');
  vm = t.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.run.doneKind, 'completed');
  assert.equal(t.engine.retentionReport().sets.length, 1);
  await t.controller.dispose();
});

test('single slot + unsaved (maxResidentResultSets:1, no store): Run → confirm discard → the new run is admitted and completes', async () => {
  const t = setup({ engineConfig: { resultStore: null, limits: { maxResidentResultSets: 1 } } });
  await t.hardAB();
  await t.runAndWait();
  const firstRunId = t.engine.retentionReport().sets[0].runId;
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  assert.ok(t.vm().run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'confirm-discard-unsaved'));
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR_CONFIRMED });
  assert.equal(t.vm().run.banners.some((b) => b.id === 'admission-error'), false);
  await t.until(() => t.vm().run.state === 'done' && t.vm().run.counts.filtered !== null);
  assert.equal(t.vm().run.doneKind, 'completed');
  assert.equal(t.engine.getPersistenceState(firstRunId), null);            // released before the new admission
  assert.equal(t.vm().results.rows.length, 2);
  await t.controller.dispose();
});

test('dispose during an active real run cancels it (panel-disposed) and releases the sealed set', async () => {
  const t = setup({ script: { '1.0': [{ facts: [], hold: true, pairs: HARD_PAIRS }] } });
  await t.hardAB();
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  await t.executor.inFlight('1.0');
  let resolved = false;
  const disposing = t.controller.dispose();
  disposing.then(() => { resolved = true; });
  await settle(t.scheduler);
  assert.equal(resolved, false);                                           // held unit: done has not settled yet
  t.executor.release('1.0');
  await disposing;
  const report = t.engine.retentionReport();                               // checked immediately — no waiting loop
  assert.deepEqual([report.active.length, report.sets.length], [0, 0]);
  assert.equal(t.bridge.calls.filter((c) => c.op === 'dispose').length, 1);
});

test('RF-3: a model unloads while the real run is non-terminal — no Viewer mutation, no throw, a sealed outcome, unavailable rows', async () => {
  const t = setup({ script: { '1.0': [{ facts: [], hold: true, pairs: HARD_PAIRS }] } });
  await t.hardAB();
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START });
  await t.executor.inFlight('1.0');
  const mutating = t.bridge.calls.length;
  const modelB = t.w.models.get('mB');
  t.w.registry.unregister(modelB);                                          // what wireModelUnload does on unload
  t.catalog.removeModel('mB');
  t.bridge.fireModelLeft({ model: modelB, reason: 'unload' });
  t.bridge.fireModelLeft({ model: modelB, reason: 'removed' });
  t.catalog.fire();
  await settle(t.scheduler);
  assert.equal(t.bridge.calls.length, mutating);
  t.executor.release('1.0');
  await t.until(() => t.vm().run.state === 'done' && t.vm().results.state !== 'running' && !t.vm().filters.busy);
  const vm = t.vm();
  assert.ok(['completed', 'cancelled', 'failed', 'invalidated'].includes(vm.run.doneKind));
  assert.ok(vm.run.headline.length > 0);
  assert.ok(vm.results.rows.every((r) => r.liveness !== 'live'));          // every pair touches mB
  assert.equal(vm.run.counts.total, vm.results.rows.length);
  assert.ok(t.counts.getFreshness >= 1);
  await t.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_MODE, value: 'element' });
  await t.until(() => !t.vm().filters.busy);
  assert.equal(t.bridge.calls.length, mutating);
  await t.controller.dispose();
});

test('RF-4: edit-then-revert reruns the same question — same definitionKey/revision, identical resultIds from the real engine', async () => {
  const t = setup();
  await t.hardAB();
  await t.runAndWait();
  const first = t.vm().results.rows.map((r) => r.resultId);
  const name = t.vm().setup.name;
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/core/largeResults.test.mjs — Task 21: bounded behaviour on a 100,000-result set (spec §12;
// AC-P4, AC-P5). Structural bounds only — page row count, slicing (yield counts), one derivation per
// (generation, spec), typed-array ordered storage. NO wall-clock assertion: responsiveness is unmeasured (PG-3).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { INTENT } from '../../../clashpanel/core/intents.js';
import { PAGE_SIZE, LIST_CHUNK_SIZE, FILTER_DEBOUNCE_MS } from '../../../clashpanel/core/constants.js';
import { buildResultIndex } from '../../../clashpanel/core/resultIndex.js';
import { runFilterPass } from '../../../clashpanel/core/filters.js';
import { buildOrderedIndex, pageSlice } from '../../../clashpanel/core/orderedList.js';
import { createFakeScheduler } from '../support/fakeScheduler.mjs';
import { makeHarness, makeSet, hardResults } from '../support/controllerHarness.mjs';
import { drain } from '../support/settle.mjs';

const N = 100000;
const SET = makeSet({ runId: 'run-big', results: hardResults(N) });   // built once; deep-frozen
const slices = (n) => Math.ceil(n / LIST_CHUNK_SIZE);

async function bigHarness() {
  const h = makeHarness();
  await h.readyHard();
  await h.runToDone(SET);
  return h;
}

async function waitFor(h, predicate) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 20000 && !predicate(); i += 1) await h.settle(1);
  assert.ok(predicate(), 'condition not reached within the round bound');
}

test('flat view: a page never exceeds PAGE_SIZE rows; counts and page math cover the whole set; one derivation each', async () => {
  const h = await bigHarness();
  await waitFor(h, () => h.vm().run.counts.filtered === N);
  const vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.rows.length, PAGE_SIZE);
  assert.deepEqual(vm.results.page, { index: 0, count: Math.ceil(N / PAGE_SIZE), size: PAGE_SIZE });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_PAGE, page: Math.ceil(N / PAGE_SIZE) - 1 });
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.rows.length, N % PAGE_SIZE === 0 ? PAGE_SIZE : N % PAGE_SIZE);
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.rows.at(-1).ordinal, N);
  assert.deepEqual([h.engine.control.summarize.successes, h.engine.control.filter.successes], [1, 1]);
});

test('an active filter pass is sliced: yields grow with the set size in LIST_CHUNK_SIZE steps (no single long pass)', async () => {
  const h = await bigHarness();
  await waitFor(h, () => h.vm().run.counts.filtered === N);
  const before = h.scheduler.yieldCount;
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_HAS_LOCATION, value: true });
  await waitFor(h, () => h.vm().run.counts.filtered === N - N / 10);
  assert.ok(h.scheduler.yieldCount - before >= slices(N) - 1, `expected ≥ ${slices(N) - 1} yields, saw ${h.scheduler.yieldCount - before}`);
  assert.equal(h.vm().results.rows.length, PAGE_SIZE);

  // The same pass over a 10x smaller index yields ~10x less: slicing scales with size, not with a fixed count.
  const small = buildResultIndex(makeSet({ runId: 'run-small', results: hardResults(N / 10) }));
  const scheduler = createFakeScheduler();
  const matching = await drain(scheduler, runFilterPass({ index: small, spec: { text: '', models: [], elementOnly: null, maxGap: null, unverified: false, hasLocation: true }, caveatedIds: null, labelText: () => '', scheduler, isCurrent: () => true }));
  assert.equal(matching.length, N / 10 - N / 100);
  assert.equal(scheduler.yieldCount, slices(N / 10) - 1);
});

test('text filter: the label index is built in slices once per set, then the text pass runs sliced too', async () => {
  const h = await bigHarness();
  await waitFor(h, () => h.vm().run.counts.filtered === N);
  const before = h.scheduler.yieldCount;
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_TEXT, value: 'a-1500' });
  await h.scheduler.advance(FILTER_DEBOUNCE_MS);
  await waitFor(h, () => h.vm().run.counts.filtered === 11);             // A-1500 and A-15000 … A-15009
  assert.ok(h.scheduler.yieldCount - before >= 2 * (slices(N) - 1), 'label warm + filter pass both sliced');
  assert.deepEqual(h.vm().results.rows.map((r) => r.side1.label).slice(0, 2), ['A-1500', 'A-15000']);
  const afterFirst = h.scheduler.yieldCount;
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_TEXT, value: 'a-1501' });
  await h.scheduler.advance(FILTER_DEBOUNCE_MS);
  await waitFor(h, () => h.vm().filters.busy === false && h.vm().run.counts.filtered === 11);
  assert.ok(h.scheduler.yieldCount - afterFirst < 2 * (slices(N) - 1), 'the label index is not rebuilt for a second text');
});

test('grouped view: one groupBy; pages stay bounded even with a 1,000+-member group expanded', async () => {
  const h = await bigHarness();
  await waitFor(h, () => h.vm().run.counts.filtered === N);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_MODE, value: 'element' });
  await waitFor(h, () => h.vm().results.view === 'grouped');
  let vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.rows.length, PAGE_SIZE);
  assert.equal(h.engine.control.groupBy.successes, 1);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.SORT_SET, value: 'group-count' });      // the mB groups (~1,031 members) first
  vm = h.vm();
  const big = vm.results.rows[0];
  assert.ok(big.count > 1000);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_TOGGLE, groupId: big.groupId });
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.rows.length, PAGE_SIZE);
  assert.ok(vm.results.page.count > Math.ceil(N / PAGE_SIZE) / 100);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_MODE, value: 'none' });
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_MODE, value: 'element' });
  assert.equal(h.engine.control.groupBy.successes, 1);
});

test('selecting a result far outside the current page moves the page to its occurrence; Prev stays on that page', async () => {
  const h = await bigHarness();
  await waitFor(h, () => h.vm().run.counts.filtered === N);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: `r${N - 1}`, groupId: null });
  let vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.results.page.index, Math.ceil(N / PAGE_SIZE) - 1);
  assert.equal(vm.results.rows.filter((r) => r.selected).length, 1);
  await h.dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_PREV });
  vm = h.vm();
  assert.equal(vm.selected.resultId, `r${N - 2}`);
  assert.equal(vm.results.page.index, Math.ceil(N / PAGE_SIZE) - 1);
});

test('memory shape: the pass result and the ordered index are typed arrays; entries are produced per page only', async () => {
  const index = buildResultIndex(SET);
  const scheduler = createFakeScheduler();
  const spec = { text: '', models: ['mA'], elementOnly: null, maxGap: null, unverified: false, hasLocation: true };
  const matching = await drain(scheduler, runFilterPass({ index, spec, caveatedIds: null, labelText: () => '', scheduler, isCurrent: () => true }));
  assert.ok(matching instanceof Uint32Array);
  const ordered = buildOrderedIndex({ view: 'flat', matching, index, sortKey: 'default' });
  assert.ok(ordered.storage.canonical instanceof Uint32Array);
  assert.equal(ordered.length, matching.length);
  const page = pageSlice(ordered, 3, PAGE_SIZE);
  assert.equal(page.length, PAGE_SIZE);
  assert.equal(page[0].canonicalIndex, matching[3 * PAGE_SIZE]);
});
```

```js
  // ---- Task 22 addition (preserving: no existing behaviour changes) --------------------------------------------
  // Ordered cross-method call log + one-shot re-entrancy hooks. `onCall(method, fn, {nth, phase})` runs `fn(...args)`
  // synchronously INSIDE the nth matching call: phase 'before' = before any state change / injected failure; phase
  // 'after' (default) = after the call's effect, and — when an injected failure throws — after that throw is raised
  // but before it propagates (so an `afterEffect` failure is observed as "state changed, hook ran, caller sees throw").
  // Tests use it to call bridge.clear()/dispose()/present() or change isolation mid-mutation (AC-P16 interleavings).
  // Hooks for the same method+phase form a FIFO queue: at most one fires per call, and each counts its `nth` only
  // once it is at the head of that queue (so two `nth: 1` hooks fire on two consecutive calls).
  const callLog = [];
  const hooks = [];
  const runHooks = (method, args, phase) => {
    const i = hooks.findIndex((h) => h.method === method && h.phase === phase);
    if (i < 0) return;
    hooks[i].nth -= 1;
    if (hooks[i].nth > 0) return;
    const [hook] = hooks.splice(i, 1);
    hook.fn(...args);
  };
  const hookable = (target, method) => {
    const original = target[method];
    target[method] = (...args) => {
      callLog.push({ method, args });
      runHooks(method, args, 'before');
      let result;
      try { result = original.apply(target, args); } catch (error) { runHooks(method, args, 'after'); throw error; }
      runHooks(method, args, 'after');
      return result;
    };
  };
  for (const m of ['getAllModels', 'getAggregateIsolation', 'getAggregateHiddenNodes', 'setAggregateIsolation', 'fitToView', 'getAggregateSelection']) hookable(viewer, m);
  for (const m of ['hasScene', 'addScene', 'addMesh', 'removeMesh', 'removeScene']) hookable(overlays, m);
  viewer.callLog = callLog;
  viewer.onCall = (method, fn, { nth = 1, phase = 'after' } = {}) => { hooks.push({ method, fn, nth, phase }); };
  viewer.hooksRemaining = () => hooks.length;
  viewer.isolationState = () => copyIso(state.isolation);   // raw read for assertions: not logged, not hooked, never fails
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/support/viewerFaults.mjs
// Bridge-specific helpers over the ONE Viewer fake (T3 `fakeViewer.mjs`, plus its T22 `onCall`/`callLog` addition).
// Holds no Viewer state of its own. Provides:
//   * `createBridgeHarness(opts)` -> the T3 viewer + a ViewerApi for the bridge = T3 `createFakeViewerApi(viewer)`
//     plus `eventNames` (T26 contract), wrapped so any member whose name contains "theming" resolves to the T3
//     viewer's recording/throwing theming method (AC-P19: a bridge that calls one is recorded in `themingCalls`);
//   * `failAt(method, mode, nth)`: an injected failure on the nth call — mode 'before' throws WITHOUT a state change,
//     'after' changes state THEN throws (T3 `failNext(..., {afterEffect})`, armed by a 'before' hook on the nth call);
//   * `panelMeshes()` / `foreignMeshes()` over the Panel's two overlay scenes, `isolation()` (raw state),
//     `fitCalls()`, `callsOf(method)`, `pendingFaults()`, `assertNoTheming()`.
// Support module: no test() calls.
import { createFakeViewer, createFakeViewerApi, createFakeModel, FAKE_EVENTS } from './fakeViewer.mjs';

export const NAMES = Object.freeze({ overlayMarkers: 'clash-panel-markers', overlayOutlines: 'clash-panel-outlines' });
export const EVENTS = Object.freeze({ BEFORE_MODEL_UNLOAD: FAKE_EVENTS.BEFORE_MODEL_UNLOAD, MODEL_REMOVED: FAKE_EVENTS.MODEL_REMOVED });
export const FOREIGN_THEMING = Object.freeze([{ dbId: 7, color: 'red' }]);

export function createBridgeHarness({ models, isolation = [], hiddenNodes = [], selection = [] } = {}) {
  const ms = models ?? [createFakeModel({ id: 1 }), createFakeModel({ id: 2 })];
  const viewer = createFakeViewer({ models: ms, isolation, hiddenNodes, selection });
  viewer.seedForeignTheming(FOREIGN_THEMING);
  const foreign = new Set();
  const base = { ...createFakeViewerApi(viewer), eventNames: EVENTS };
  const api = new Proxy(base, {
    get(t, prop, r) {
      if (typeof prop === 'string' && /theming/i.test(prop)) return viewer[prop] ?? (() => { viewer.themingCalls.push({ name: prop, args: [] }); throw new Error('theming forbidden'); });
      return Reflect.get(t, prop, r);
    },
  });
  const inPanelScenes = () => [...viewer.overlayMeshes(NAMES.overlayMarkers), ...viewer.overlayMeshes(NAMES.overlayOutlines)];
  return {
    viewer,
    api,
    models: ms,
    log: viewer.callLog,
    failAt(method, mode = 'before', nth = 1) {
      viewer.onCall(method, () => viewer.failNext(method, { afterEffect: mode === 'after' }), { nth, phase: 'before' });
    },
    callsOf: (method) => viewer.callLog.filter((e) => e.method === method),
    fitCalls: () => viewer.calls.fitToView.map((c) => c.form),
    pendingFaults: () => viewer.injectionsRemaining() + viewer.hooksRemaining(),
    isolation: () => viewer.isolationState(),
    addForeignMesh(scene) {
      if (!viewer.overlayScenes().includes(scene)) viewer.overlays.addScene(scene);
      const mesh = { foreign: true };
      viewer.overlays.addMesh(mesh, scene);
      foreign.add(mesh);
      viewer.callLog.length = 0;
      return mesh;
    },
    panelMeshes: () => inPanelScenes().filter((m) => !foreign.has(m)),
    foreignMeshes: () => inPanelScenes().filter((m) => foreign.has(m)),
    hasScene: (scene) => viewer.overlayScenes().includes(scene),
    assertNoTheming() {
      if (viewer.themingCalls.length > 0) throw new Error(`theming member called: ${viewer.themingCalls.map((c) => c.name).join(', ')}`);
      if (viewer.forbiddenCalls.length > 0) throw new Error(`forbidden viewer call: ${viewer.forbiddenCalls.join(', ')}`);
      if (JSON.stringify(viewer.themingState()) !== JSON.stringify(FOREIGN_THEMING)) throw new Error('foreign theming state changed');
    },
  };
}

// Normalized, order-independent comparison (model identity + sorted, de-duplicated ids).
export function sameIsolation(a, b) {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  const norm = (ids) => [...new Set(ids)].sort((x, y) => x - y);
  return a.every((e) => {
    const o = b.find((x) => x.model === e.model);
    if (!o) return false;
    const ea = norm(e.ids); const eb = norm(o.ids);
    return ea.length === eb.length && ea.every((v, i) => v === eb[i]);
  });
}

export async function flush(n = 10) { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) await Promise.resolve(); }
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/viewer/ViewerBridge.queue.test.mjs — T22: pure sequencing (queue, tokens, dispose).
// Requests use options all false so these tests stay valid once T25 adds Viewer mutation. Mid-flight
// invalidation is driven from INSIDE a Viewer read via the fake's onCall hook (no production seam).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createViewerBridge, createSerialQueue, createListenerRegistry } from '../../../clashpanel/viewer/ViewerBridge.js';
import { createBridgeHarness, NAMES, flush } from '../support/viewerFaults.mjs';
import { createFakeThree } from '../support/fakeThree.mjs';
import { createFakeViewer } from '../support/fakeViewer.mjs';

const MUTATORS = new Set(['addScene', 'addMesh', 'removeMesh', 'removeScene', 'setAggregateIsolation', 'fitToView']);
const OFF = { focus: false, isolate: false, marker: false };

function setup() {
  const h = createBridgeHarness();
  const { THREE } = createFakeThree();
  const bridge = createViewerBridge({ viewerApi: h.api, THREE, names: NAMES });
  const req = { sides: [{ model: h.models[0], dbId: 1 }], options: OFF };
  return { h, bridge, req };
}

test('serial queue runs tasks one at a time, in call order', async () => {
  const q = createSerialQueue();
  const order = [];
  let running = 0; let maxRunning = 0;
  const task = (name) => async () => {
    running += 1; maxRunning = Math.max(maxRunning, running);
    order.push(`start ${name}`); await flush(3); order.push(`end ${name}`);
    running -= 1; return name;
  };
  const results = await Promise.all([q.run(task('a')), q.run(task('b')), q.run(task('c'))]);
  assert.deepEqual(results, ['a', 'b', 'c']);
  assert.equal(maxRunning, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(order, ['start a', 'end a', 'start b', 'end b', 'start c', 'end c']);
});

test('a rejected task is returned to its caller and never wedges the queue', async () => {
  const q = createSerialQueue();
  const failing = q.run(async () => { throw new Error('boom'); });
  const next = q.run(async () => 'still runs');
  await assert.rejects(failing, /boom/);
  assert.equal(await next, 'still runs');
  assert.equal(q.size(), 0);
});

test('a later present invalidates earlier tokens immediately, even before the queue reaches them', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, req } = setup();
  let p2; let p3;
  // Arrives synchronously INSIDE p1's step-1 read, i.e. while p1 is in flight.
  h.viewer.onCall('getAllModels', () => { p2 = bridge.present(req); p3 = bridge.present(req); });
  const o1 = await bridge.present(req);
  const [o2, o3] = await Promise.all([p2, p3]);
  assert.equal(o1.superseded, true, 'in-flight token stopped at its next check');
  assert.equal(o2.superseded, true, 'queued token was already stale when the queue reached it');
  assert.equal(o3.superseded, false);
  assert.equal(h.callsOf('getAllModels').length, 2, 'p2 never started (only p1 and p3 read)');
});

test('clear() invalidates the in-flight present and resolves only after the queue drains (AC-P16 completion point)', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, req } = setup();
  const settled = [];
  let c;
  h.viewer.onCall('getAllModels', () => {
    c = bridge.clear().then((o) => { settled.push('clear'); return o; });
  }, { phase: 'before' });
  const po = await bridge.present(req).then((o) => { settled.push('present'); return o; });
  const co = await c;
  assert.equal(po.superseded, true, 'invalidated mid-flight by the clear');
  assert.deepEqual(settled, ['present', 'clear'], 'clear queued behind the in-flight step');
  assert.deepEqual(co, { isolation: 'none', markersRemoved: 0, notes: [] });
  const later = await bridge.present(req);
  assert.equal(later.superseded, false, 'a present after the clear is live again');
});

test('dispose() is idempotent, awaited, and every later call is a non-mutating disposed no-op', async () => {

  const d1 = bridge.dispose();
  const d2 = bridge.dispose();
  assert.equal(d1, d2, 'same promise');
  assert.equal(await d1, undefined);
  h.log.length = 0;
  const po = await bridge.present(req);
  assert.equal(po.disposed, true);
  assert.equal(po.superseded, true);
  const co = await bridge.clear();
  assert.equal(co.disposed, true);
  assert.equal(co.isolation, 'none');
  assert.equal(await bridge.dispose(), undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(h.log.filter((e) => MUTATORS.has(e.method)), [], 'no Viewer mutation after dispose');
  h.assertNoTheming();
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** the skeleton.

```js
// clashpanel/viewer/ViewerBridge.js
// The ONLY Viewer mutator of the Panel (spec §9.2). Tier B. T22 skeleton: sequencing only — single-flight
// queue, tokens, invalidation, disposed no-ops, symmetric listener bookkeeping. NO Viewer mutation yet
// (markers/isolation/fit arrive in T25/T26).
//
// Invalidation (normative, §9.2): each present gets token ++n; clear(), dispose() and any later present
// invalidate every earlier token AT CALL TIME, before the queue reaches them; a stale token re-checked
// at its next check point returns {superseded:true} and performs no further work. clear()/dispose()
// resolve only after the queue has drained up to them — the completion point for AC-P6/AC-P16.

// Serial single-flight queue: tasks run one at a time in call order; a rejected task never wedges it.
export function createSerialQueue() {
  let tail = Promise.resolve();
  let pending = 0;
  return Object.freeze({
    run(task) {
      pending += 1;
      const result = tail.then(() => task());
      tail = result.then(() => { pending -= 1; }, () => { pending -= 1; });
      return result;
    },
    size: () => pending,
    idle: () => tail,
  });
}

// Symmetric listener bookkeeping: every add is recorded; removeAll() removes exactly those.
export function createListenerRegistry(viewerApi) {
  const added = [];
  return Object.freeze({
    add(name, fn) { viewerApi.addEventListener(name, fn); added.push([name, fn]); },
    removeAll() {
      const errors = [];
      while (added.length > 0) {
        const [name, fn] = added.pop();
        try { viewerApi.removeEventListener(name, fn); } catch (e) { errors.push(e); }
      }
      return errors;
    },
    count: () => added.length,
  });
}

export const BRIDGE_NOTE = Object.freeze({
  FAILED: 'The Viewer rejected the presentation; nothing is shown',
});

const isModel = (v) => v !== null && typeof v === 'object';
const isDbId = (v) => Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0;

function validateRequest(req) {
  if (!req || !Array.isArray(req.sides) || req.sides.length < 1 || req.sides.length > 2) throw new TypeError('present: sides must hold 1–2 entries');
  for (const s of req.sides) if (!isModel(s?.model) || !isDbId(s?.dbId)) throw new TypeError('present: each side needs {model, dbId}');
  const o = req.options;
  if (!o || typeof o.focus !== 'boolean' || typeof o.isolate !== 'boolean' || typeof o.marker !== 'boolean') {
    throw new TypeError('present: options {focus, isolate, marker} must be booleans');
  }
}

const outcome = (fields) => Object.freeze({ superseded: false, fitted: false, isolated: false, marked: false, ...fields, notes: Object.freeze([...(fields.notes ?? [])]) });
const DISPOSED_PRESENT = outcome({ superseded: true, disposed: true });
const DISPOSED_CLEAR = Object.freeze({ isolation: 'none', markersRemoved: 0, notes: Object.freeze([]), disposed: true });

// Overlay scene names are INSTANCE-scoped by default so two Panels/bridges on one Viewer never share (and so
// never clear or remove) each other's scenes. Injectable for tests/hosts.
let bridgeInstances = 0;
function defaultNames() {
  bridgeInstances += 1;
  return Object.freeze({ overlayMarkers: `clash-panel-markers:${bridgeInstances}`, overlayOutlines: `clash-panel-outlines:${bridgeInstances}` });
}

export function createViewerBridge({ viewerApi, THREE, names = defaultNames() } = {}) {
  if (!viewerApi || !viewerApi.overlays) throw new TypeError('createViewerBridge: viewerApi with overlays is required');
  if (!THREE) throw new TypeError('createViewerBridge: THREE is required');
  if (typeof names?.overlayMarkers !== 'string' || typeof names?.overlayOutlines !== 'string') {
    throw new TypeError('createViewerBridge: names {overlayMarkers, overlayOutlines} are required');
  }
  const queue = createSerialQueue();
  const listeners = createListenerRegistry(viewerApi);
  let seq = 0;
  let live = 0;
  let disposed = false;
  let disposePromise = null;

  const isLive = (t) => !disposed && t === live;

  function sceneModels() {
    try { const m = viewerApi.getAllModels(); return Array.isArray(m) ? m : []; } catch { return []; }
  }

  async function runPresent(t, req) {
    if (!isLive(t)) return outcome({ superseded: true });
    // (1) resolve / compute — reads only. T25 adds the mutating steps, each preceded by a token check.
    const inScene = sceneModels();
    const notes = req.sides.every((s) => inScene.includes(s.model)) ? [] : ["An element's model is no longer in the scene"];
    if (!isLive(t)) return outcome({ superseded: true });   // invalidated during the reads
    return outcome({ notes });
  }

  function present(req) {
    if (disposed) return Promise.resolve(DISPOSED_PRESENT);
    try { validateRequest(req); } catch (e) { return Promise.reject(e); }
    const t = ++seq;
    live = t;                                  // invalidates every earlier token immediately
    return queue.run(async () => {
      try {
        return await runPresent(t, req);
      } catch {                                // unexpected failure: never reject
        return outcome({ superseded: !isLive(t), notes: [BRIDGE_NOTE.FAILED] });
      }
    });
  }

  function clear() {
    if (disposed) return Promise.resolve(DISPOSED_CLEAR);
    seq += 1;
    live = 0;
    return queue.run(async () => Object.freeze({ isolation: 'none', markersRemoved: 0, notes: Object.freeze([]) }));
  }

  function dispose() {
    if (disposePromise !== null) return disposePromise;
    disposed = true;
    seq += 1;
    live = 0;
    disposePromise = queue.run(async () => {
      listeners.removeAll();
    }).then(() => undefined, () => undefined);
    return disposePromise;
  }

  return Object.freeze({ present, clear, dispose });
}
```

### Task 23: Panel-owned markers and bounds outlines

**Tier:** [B] fake/injected-port ViewerBridge/UI (pre-SVF2)

**Files:**
- Create: `clashpanel/viewer/markers.js`
- Test: `test/clashpanel/viewer/markers.test.mjs`

**Scope note:** duplicates (does not import) the Clash Finder marker code (`wwwroot/extensions/ClashFinderExtension.js` constants ~41-76, `_ensureMarkerOverlay`/`_computeMarkerRadius`/`_addMarkers`/`_clearMarkers` ~492-576, soft visualization ~585-718), per OD-10. Differences, all deliberate: radius is computed from the flat `[6]` bounds with plain arithmetic (identical to r71 `Box3.getBoundingSphere().radius`, so no `Box3`/`Sphere` dependency); overlay removal is by exact reference and per-object geometry is disposed at removal; hooks let the bridge record intent and re-check its token before each `addScene`/`addMesh`. Proven against the fake THREE + fake overlays only; overlay rendering on SVF2, colour fidelity and whether `getNodeBox` bounds are world-space are live gates (G2 / PG-1 / F7). The radius/colour constants are PRESENTATION constants (§12.4), never limits.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: injected r71 `THREE` (subset above; `.set(x,y,z)` only — no `setScalar`); `overlays = {hasScene(name), addScene(name), addMesh(mesh, sceneName), removeMesh(mesh, sceneName), removeScene(name)}` — mesh FIRST; `names = {overlayMarkers, overlayOutlines}`; T3 `createFakeThree() -> {THREE, stats}` (dispose accounting via `disposeCount` / `stats.overDisposed()`); T22 `createBridgeHarness`.
- Produces: `clashpanel/viewer/markers.js`: constants `MARKER_RADIUS_FRACTION=0.002, MIN_MARKER_RADIUS=0.05, MAX_MARKER_RADIUS=2.0, HARD_MARKER_COLOR=0xff6a00, SOFT_MARKER_COLOR=0x2b8fff, OUTLINE_COLORS=[0xffd400, 0xd400ff]`; `validBox(box)->boolean`; `computeMarkerRadius(boxes)->number`; `createMarkerSet({THREE, overlays, names}) -> { addLocation({point?, closestPoints?, radius}, {beforeAdd?, beforeScene?}?) -> mesh[], addOutlines(sides, boundsFn, hooks?) -> {meshes, omitted}, remove(mesh)->boolean (throws if the overlay call throws), removeAll()->number, disposeShared()->boolean (true when every mesh, shared resource and self-added scene is gone), size()->number, owns(mesh)->boolean }`. Scene creation is write-ahead (recorded before `addScene`, so an after-effect throw leaks nothing); a scene that still holds a Panel mesh whose removal failed is never removed (retried on the next `disposeShared`).

**Depends on:** T22.

```js
  const { h, set } = setup();
  h.failAt('addScene', 'after');
  assert.throws(() => set.addLocation({ point: [0, 0, 0], radius: 1 }), /injected addScene failure/);
  assert.equal(h.hasScene(NAMES.overlayMarkers), true, 'the Viewer did create it');
  assert.equal(set.size(), 0, 'no mesh was created');
  assert.equal(set.disposeShared(), true);
  assert.equal(h.hasScene(NAMES.overlayMarkers), false, 'no leaked scene');
});

test('beforeAdd runs immediately before each addMesh; a throw there aborts that add (mesh stays tracked for cleanup)', () => {
  const { h, set, THREE, stats } = setup();
  const seen = [];
  const meshes = set.addLocation({ closestPoints: { first: [0, 0, 0], second: [1, 0, 0] }, radius: 1 }, {
    beforeAdd: (mesh, scene) => { seen.push([mesh, scene, h.viewer.overlayMeshes(scene).includes(mesh)]); },
  });
  assert.deepEqual(seen.map(([m, s, inScene]) => [m, s, inScene]), meshes.map((m) => [m, NAMES.overlayMarkers, false]));
  let calls = 0;
  assert.throws(() => set.addLocation({ closestPoints: { first: [0, 0, 0], second: [1, 0, 0] }, radius: 1 }, {
    beforeAdd: () => { if (++calls === 3) throw new Error('stale token'); },
  }), /stale token/);
  assert.equal(h.panelMeshes().length, 5, '3 + 2 added; the line was never added');
  assert.equal(set.size(), 6, 'the aborted line is still tracked');
  set.removeAll();
  assert.deepEqual(h.panelMeshes(), []);
  assert.equal(stats.created.geometry.filter((g) => !(g instanceof THREE.SphereGeometry) && g.disposeCount === 1).length, 2, 'both line geometries disposed');
});
```
