```js
// clashpanel/viewer/markers.js
// Panel-owned overlay markers (spec §9.2 "Marker"; PD-16): a location marker (Hard: one sphere at the
// witness point; Soft: two spheres + a line at closestPoints) and per-side bounds outlines (wireframe
// boxes in two distinct colours). Duplicated — not imported — from the Clash Finder extension's marker
// code (OD-10). Tier B: proven against fakes only; overlay rendering, colour fidelity and whether
// element bounds are world-space are live gates (G2 / PG-1 / F7).
//
// THREE is the injected r71 namespace. Strict subset used: Vector3 (constructor only — r71 has no
// setScalar), Mesh, SphereGeometry, MeshBasicMaterial, LineBasicMaterial, BufferGeometry#setFromPoints,
// Line. Overlay calls are ALWAYS mesh first, scene name second.

// PRESENTATION constants (spec §12.4) — visual tuning only, never limits; duplicated values.
export const MARKER_RADIUS_FRACTION = 0.002;
export const MIN_MARKER_RADIUS = 0.05;
export const MAX_MARKER_RADIUS = 2.0;
export const HARD_MARKER_COLOR = 0xff6a00;
export const SOFT_MARKER_COLOR = 0x2b8fff;
export const OUTLINE_COLORS = Object.freeze([0xffd400, 0xd400ff]);   // side 1, side 2
const OPACITY = 0.65;

const isPoint = (p) => Array.isArray(p) && p.length === 3 && p.every(Number.isFinite);

// A usable bounds box: 6 finite numbers, min <= max on every axis. Anything else is "unavailable".
export function validBox(box) {
  if (box === null || box === undefined || typeof box.length !== 'number' || box.length !== 6) return false;
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) if (!Number.isFinite(box[i])) return false;
  return box[0] <= box[3] && box[1] <= box[4] && box[2] <= box[5];
}

// Like the Clash Finder radius: bounding-sphere radius of the union box × fraction, clamped. Invalid
// boxes are skipped; no valid box (or a non-finite result) ⇒ the minimum radius.
export function computeMarkerRadius(boxes) {
  const min = [Infinity, Infinity, Infinity];
  const max = [-Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];
  let any = false;
  for (const b of boxes) {
    if (!validBox(b)) continue;
    any = true;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { min[i] = Math.min(min[i], b[i]); max[i] = Math.max(max[i], b[i + 3]); }
  }
  if (!any) return MIN_MARKER_RADIUS;
  const radius = 0.5 * Math.hypot(max[0] - min[0], max[1] - min[1], max[2] - min[2]);
  if (!Number.isFinite(radius)) return MIN_MARKER_RADIUS;
  return Math.min(Math.max(radius * MARKER_RADIUS_FRACTION, MIN_MARKER_RADIUS), MAX_MARKER_RADIUS);
}

// Continuous polyline over all 12 box edges (edges retraced where needed): usable with plain Line.
function boxEdgePath(b) {
  const [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1] = b;
  return [
    [x0, y0, z0], [x1, y0, z0], [x1, y1, z0], [x0, y1, z0], [x0, y0, z0],
    [x0, y0, z1], [x1, y0, z1], [x1, y1, z1], [x0, y1, z1], [x0, y0, z1],
    [x0, y1, z1], [x0, y1, z0], [x1, y1, z0], [x1, y1, z1], [x1, y0, z1], [x1, y0, z0],
  ];
}

export function createMarkerSet({ THREE, overlays, names }) {
  if (!THREE || !overlays || typeof names?.overlayMarkers !== 'string' || typeof names?.overlayOutlines !== 'string') {
    throw new TypeError('createMarkerSet: THREE, overlays and names {overlayMarkers, overlayOutlines} are required');
  }
  const created = new Map();       // mesh -> scene name (every object this set created, by reference)
  const perObject = new Set();     // per-object geometries (lines, outline boxes): disposed at removal
  const scenesAdded = new Set();
  let shared = null;

  function ensureShared() {
    if (shared === null) {
      const basic = (color) => new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity: OPACITY, depthTest: false, depthWrite: false });
      const line = (color) => new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity: OPACITY, depthTest: false });
      shared = {
        sphere: new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 12, 8),   // unit sphere, scaled per instance
        hard: basic(HARD_MARKER_COLOR),
        soft: basic(SOFT_MARKER_COLOR),
        softLine: line(SOFT_MARKER_COLOR),
        outline: OUTLINE_COLORS.map(line),
      };
    }
    return shared;
  }

  function ensureScene(name, beforeScene) {
    if (!overlays.hasScene(name)) {
      if (beforeScene) beforeScene(name);
      scenesAdded.add(name);          // write-ahead: an addScene that throws AFTER creating the scene is still ours
      overlays.addScene(name);
    }
  }

  // Hooks: beforeAdd(mesh, sceneName) runs immediately before each overlays.addMesh (the bridge records
  // the write-ahead intent and re-checks its token there); beforeScene(sceneName) immediately before an
  // overlays.addScene. A throw from either aborts before that mutation.
  function add(mesh, name, beforeAdd) {
    created.set(mesh, name);
    if (beforeAdd) beforeAdd(mesh, name);
    overlays.addMesh(mesh, name);
    return mesh;
  }

  function sphere(material, p, radius) {
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(ensureShared().sphere, material);
    mesh.scale.set(radius, radius, radius);
    mesh.position.set(p[0], p[1], p[2]);
    if (typeof mesh.updateMatrixWorld === 'function') mesh.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    return mesh;
  }

  function lineThrough(points, material) {
    const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points.map((p) => new THREE.Vector3(p[0], p[1], p[2])));
    perObject.add(geometry);
    return new THREE.Line(geometry, material);
  }

  // req: {point?, closestPoints?:{first,second}, radius}. Returns the meshes added (possibly none).
  function addLocation(req, { beforeAdd, beforeScene } = {}) {
    const radius = Number.isFinite(req?.radius) && req.radius > 0 ? req.radius : MIN_MARKER_RADIUS;
    const cp = req?.closestPoints;
    const name = names.overlayMarkers;
    const out = [];
    if (cp && isPoint(cp.first) && isPoint(cp.second)) {
      const s = ensureShared();
      ensureScene(name, beforeScene);
      out.push(add(sphere(s.soft, cp.first, radius), name, beforeAdd));
      out.push(add(sphere(s.soft, cp.second, radius), name, beforeAdd));
      out.push(add(lineThrough([cp.first, cp.second], s.softLine), name, beforeAdd));
    } else if (isPoint(req?.point)) {
      const s = ensureShared();
      ensureScene(name, beforeScene);
      out.push(add(sphere(s.hard, req.point, radius), name, beforeAdd));
    }
    return out;
  }

  // Evidence-gated outlines: boundsFn(model, dbId) -> number[6] | null; null/throw/invalid ⇒ omitted.
  function addOutlines(sides, boundsFn, { beforeAdd, beforeScene } = {}) {
    const name = names.overlayOutlines;
    const meshes = [];
    let omitted = 0;
    sides.forEach((side, i) => {
      let box = null;
      try { box = boundsFn(side.model, side.dbId); } catch { box = null; }
      if (!validBox(box)) { omitted += 1; return; }
      const s = ensureShared();
      ensureScene(name, beforeScene);
      meshes.push(add(lineThrough(boxEdgePath(box), s.outline[i % s.outline.length]), name, beforeAdd));
    });
    return { meshes, omitted };
  }

  // Remove ONE mesh this set created, by exact reference; per-object geometry disposed after removal.
  // Returns false for a mesh this set never created (foreign meshes are never touched). Throws if the
  // overlay call throws (the caller decides on retry); the mesh then stays tracked.
  function remove(mesh) {
    const name = created.get(mesh);
    if (name === undefined) return false;
    overlays.removeMesh(mesh, name);
    created.delete(mesh);
    if (mesh.geometry && perObject.has(mesh.geometry)) { perObject.delete(mesh.geometry); mesh.geometry.dispose(); }
    return true;
  }

  function removeAll() {
    let removed = 0;
    for (const mesh of [...created.keys()]) {
      try { if (remove(mesh)) removed += 1; } catch { /* stays tracked; reported by count */ }
    }
    return removed;
  }

  // After every mesh is gone: dispose shared geometry/materials and remove the scenes this set added.
  // A scene that still holds a Panel-created mesh whose removal failed is KEPT (never removeScene under a
  // tracked mesh), and so are the shared resources (never dispose what is still drawn); both are retried on
  // the next call. Returns true when everything this set owns is gone.
  function disposeShared() {
    try {
      if (shared !== null && created.size === 0) {
        shared.sphere.dispose();
        shared.hard.dispose();
        shared.soft.dispose();
        shared.softLine.dispose();
        for (const m of shared.outline) m.dispose();
        shared = null;
      }
    } finally {
      const occupied = new Set(created.values());
      for (const name of [...scenesAdded]) {
        if (occupied.has(name)) continue;
        try {
          if (overlays.hasScene(name)) overlays.removeScene(name);
          scenesAdded.delete(name);
        } catch { /* kept: retried on the next call */ }
      }
    }
    return shared === null && created.size === 0 && scenesAdded.size === 0;
  }

  return Object.freeze({ addLocation, addOutlines, remove, removeAll, disposeShared, size: () => created.size, owns: (m) => created.has(m) });
}
```

### Task 24: Isolation model (normalization, prerequisite, ownership-guarded restore)

**Tier:** [B] fake/injected-port ViewerBridge/UI (pre-SVF2)

**Files:**
- Create: `clashpanel/viewer/isolation.js`
- Test: `test/clashpanel/viewer/isolation.test.mjs`

**Scope note:** implements §9.4/§9.5 against the injected ViewerApi. The session is the isolation half of the bridge's write-ahead ledger (T25): its `record` `{preImage, target, prevTarget, confirmed}` is written BEFORE `setAggregateIsolation` and confirmed after. `preImage` (the session "prior") is a FINAL `readIsolation()` taken after the §9.5 prerequisite reads and immediately before the write-ahead record (unreadable ⇒ fail closed, no mutation) — so a foreign change earlier in the same present, even one made from inside the `getAggregateHiddenNodes()` read, is the pre-image and never clobbered. `restore()` KEEPS the record (pre-image + ownership) when the state is unreadable or the restore still fails after its one retry, and drops it only on a confirmed outcome (restored / pre-image already in place / confirmed foreign), so a later clear or dispose retries. `prevTarget` names the Panel's own previously displayed target while a replacement is in flight (so a replacement that throws before changing state is still recognised as Panel-owned and restored). There is NO clear-all fallback anywhere: unreadable/unnormalizable/hidden-state ⇒ `applied:false` with a reason and no isolation call. Live `setAggregateIsolation`/`getAggregateIsolation`/`getAggregateHiddenNodes` semantics are source-observed only (gate G2).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: ViewerApi members `getAllModels()`, `getAggregateIsolation() -> [{model, ids}]`, `getAggregateHiddenNodes() -> [{model, ids}]` (shape assumed; anything else fails closed), `setAggregateIsolation(list)`; T3 `createFakeModel`; T22 `createBridgeHarness` (`failAt`, `viewer.onCall`).
- Produces: `clashpanel/viewer/isolation.js`: `ISOLATION_REASON {UNREADABLE, HIDDEN:'Some elements are hidden — show all to enable isolation', HIDDEN_UNREADABLE, NOT_IN_SCENE}`; `normalizeIsolation(list) -> frozen [{model, ids}] | null`; `isolationEquals(a, b) -> boolean`; `targetFor(sides) -> normalized` (throws `TypeError` on malformed sides); `readIsolation(viewerApi) -> normalized | null` (never throws); `ISOLATION_NOTE {UNREADABLE_AT_RESTORE, RESTORE_FAILED}`; `isolationPrerequisite(viewerApi) -> {available, reason}` (read-only); `createIsolationSession(viewerApi) -> { apply(sides, {beforeMutation?}?) -> {applied, reason} (throws if the Viewer call or beforeMutation throws; the record stays), restore({beforeMutation?}?) -> {isolation:'restored'|'skipped-external'|'none'|'failed', notes}, owns() -> boolean, record() -> frozen record | null }`.

**Depends on:** T22.

```js
// test/clashpanel/viewer/isolation.test.mjs — T24 (Tier B; fakes only — live isolation semantics are gate G2).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {
  normalizeIsolation, isolationEquals, targetFor, isolationPrerequisite, createIsolationSession, ISOLATION_REASON, ISOLATION_NOTE,
} from '../../../clashpanel/viewer/isolation.js';
import { createBridgeHarness } from '../support/viewerFaults.mjs';
import { createFakeModel } from '../support/fakeViewer.mjs';

const sets = (h) => h.callsOf('setAggregateIsolation').map((e) => e.args[0]);

test('normalizeIsolation: identity keys, sorted de-duplicated ids, empty ids ≠ absence, order irrelevant', () => {
  const a = createFakeModel({ id: 'a' }); const b = createFakeModel({ id: 'b' });
  const n = normalizeIsolation([{ model: b, ids: [3, 1, 3] }, { model: a, ids: [] }]);
  assert.deepEqual(n, [{ model: b, ids: [1, 3] }, { model: a, ids: [] }]);
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(n) && Object.isFrozen(n[0].ids));
  assert.ok(isolationEquals(n, normalizeIsolation([{ model: a, ids: [] }, { model: b, ids: [1, 3] }])), 'order irrelevant');
  assert.equal(isolationEquals(n, normalizeIsolation([{ model: b, ids: [1, 3] }])), false, 'show-all entry ≠ absent entry');
  assert.equal(isolationEquals(normalizeIsolation([{ model: a, ids: [1] }]), normalizeIsolation([{ model: createFakeModel({ id: 'a' }), ids: [1] }])), false, 'identity, not label');
  assert.deepEqual(normalizeIsolation([]), []);
});

test('normalizeIsolation: anything not of the documented shape is NOT normalizable (null)', () => {
  const a = createFakeModel({ id: 'a' });
  for (const bad of [undefined, null, {}, 'x', [null], [{ ids: [1] }], [{ model: a }], [{ model: a, ids: [-1] }],
    [{ model: a, ids: [1.5] }], [{ model: a, ids: ['1'] }], [{ model: a, ids: [1] }, { model: a, ids: [2] }], [{ model: 7, ids: [1] }]]) {
    assert.equal(normalizeIsolation(bad), null, JSON.stringify(bad));
  }
  assert.equal(isolationEquals(null, []), false);
});

test('targetFor: one reconcile entry per model, never {model, ids: []}; malformed sides throw', () => {
  const a = createFakeModel({ id: 'a' }); const b = createFakeModel({ id: 'b' });
  assert.deepEqual(targetFor([{ model: a, dbId: 5 }, { model: a, dbId: 2 }]), [{ model: a, ids: [2, 5] }]);
  assert.deepEqual(targetFor([{ model: a, dbId: 5 }, { model: b, dbId: 5 }]), [{ model: a, ids: [5] }, { model: b, ids: [5] }]);
  assert.throws(() => targetFor([]), TypeError);
  assert.throws(() => targetFor([{ model: a, dbId: -1 }]), TypeError);
  assert.throws(() => targetFor([{ model: null, dbId: 1 }]), TypeError);
});

test('isolationPrerequisite (§9.5): readable + normalizable AND no hidden nodes on any scene model; read-only', () => {
  const h = createBridgeHarness();
  const [m1] = h.models;
  assert.deepEqual(isolationPrerequisite(h.api), { available: true, reason: null });
  h.viewer.setHiddenNodes([{ model: createFakeModel({ id: 'not-in-scene' }), ids: [4] }, { model: m1, ids: [] }]);
  assert.equal(isolationPrerequisite(h.api).available, true, 'hidden nodes of a model outside the scene are ignored');
  h.viewer.setHiddenNodes([{ model: m1, ids: [4] }]);
  assert.deepEqual(isolationPrerequisite(h.api), { available: false, reason: ISOLATION_REASON.HIDDEN });
  assert.equal(ISOLATION_REASON.HIDDEN, 'Some elements are hidden — show all to enable isolation');
  h.viewer.setHiddenNodes('garbage');

test('session: prior captured at the first apply; restore restores a non-empty prior (ownership passes)', () => {
  const [m1, m2, m3] = [createFakeModel({ id: 'm1' }), createFakeModel({ id: 'm2' }), createFakeModel({ id: 'm3' })];

});

  assert.deepEqual(sets(h), [[]]);
});

test('session: a second owned apply keeps the ORIGINAL prior; after a foreign change a new session captures it', () => {
  const [m1, m2, m3] = [createFakeModel({ id: 'm1' }), createFakeModel({ id: 'm2' }), createFakeModel({ id: 'm3' })];

test('session: a restore that throws is retried once; still failing ⇒ "failed" + note AND the record is KEPT for a later retry', () => {
  const [m1, m3] = [createFakeModel({ id: 1 }), createFakeModel({ id: 3 })];
  const prior = [{ model: m3, ids: [4] }];
  const h = createBridgeHarness({ models: [m1, m3], isolation: prior });
  const s = createIsolationSession(h.api);
  s.apply([{ model: m1, dbId: 1 }]);
  h.failAt('setAggregateIsolation', 'before');
  assert.equal(s.restore().isolation, 'restored', 'one retry suffices');
  assert.deepEqual(h.isolation(), prior);

  s.apply([{ model: m1, dbId: 1 }]);
  h.failAt('setAggregateIsolation', 'before');
  h.failAt('setAggregateIsolation', 'before');             // queued: fails the retry
  h.log.length = 0;
  assert.deepEqual(s.restore(), { isolation: 'failed', notes: [ISOLATION_NOTE.RESTORE_FAILED] });
  assert.equal(h.callsOf('setAggregateIsolation').length, 2, 'exactly one retry');
  assert.equal(s.owns(), true, 'pre-image + ownership kept');
  assert.deepEqual(s.record().preImage, prior);
  assert.deepEqual(s.restore(), { isolation: 'restored', notes: [] }, 'a later restore succeeds');
  assert.deepEqual(h.isolation(), prior);
  assert.equal(s.owns(), false, 'dropped only after the confirmed restore');
});

test('session: unreadable state at restore / after a throw ⇒ "failed", record kept; a confirmed foreign state drops it', () => {
  const [m1, m2] = [createFakeModel({ id: 1 }), createFakeModel({ id: 2 })];
  const h = createBridgeHarness({ models: [m1, m2] });
  const s = createIsolationSession(h.api);

  assert.equal(s.owns(), true);
  h.failAt('setAggregateIsolation', 'before');
  h.failAt('getAggregateIsolation', 'before', 2);
  assert.deepEqual(s.restore(), { isolation: 'failed', notes: [ISOLATION_NOTE.RESTORE_FAILED] }, 'unreadable after the throw');
  assert.equal(s.owns(), true);
  h.failAt('setAggregateIsolation', 'before');
  h.viewer.onCall('setAggregateIsolation', () => h.viewer.setIsolationState([{ model: m2, ids: [8] }]));   // during the failing call
  assert.deepEqual(s.restore(), { isolation: 'skipped-external', notes: [] }, 'a foreign change during the failed restore is left alone');
  assert.deepEqual(h.isolation(), [{ model: m2, ids: [8] }]);
  assert.equal(s.owns(), false, 'confirmed foreign ⇒ dropped');
});

test('session: the pre-image is a FINAL read after the prerequisite — a foreign change during getAggregateHiddenNodes is never clobbered', () => {
  const [m1, m2] = [createFakeModel({ id: 1 }), createFakeModel({ id: 2 })];

  const s2 = createIsolationSession(h.api);
  h.viewer.setIsolationState([]);
  h.failAt('getAggregateIsolation', 'before', 3);          // current, prerequisite, FINAL read → the final one fails
  h.log.length = 0;
  assert.deepEqual(s2.apply([{ model: m1, dbId: 1 }]), { applied: false, reason: ISOLATION_REASON.UNREADABLE });
  assert.deepEqual(h.callsOf('setAggregateIsolation'), [], 'fail closed: no mutation');
```

```js
// clashpanel/viewer/isolation.js
// Isolation model of spec §9.4/§9.5 (Tier B; proven against fakes only — live isolation semantics are
// gated G2/PG-1). Pure helpers + one small stateful session. Receives the ViewerApi facade by
// injection; names no Viewer global.
//
// Canonical normalization (§9.5): entries keyed by model OBJECT identity (never modelId), ids sorted and
// de-duplicated, an entry with empty ids ("show all of that model") is a state distinct from absence,
// entry order irrelevant. Anything that does not have that shape is NOT normalizable (null) — and an
// unnormalizable read disables isolation; it is never compensated with a clear-all.

export const ISOLATION_REASON = Object.freeze({
  UNREADABLE: 'Isolation is unavailable: the current isolation state could not be read',
  HIDDEN: 'Some elements are hidden — show all to enable isolation',
  HIDDEN_UNREADABLE: 'Isolation is unavailable: the hidden-element state could not be read',
  NOT_IN_SCENE: "Isolation skipped: an element's model is no longer in the scene",
});

// Notes attached to ClearOutcome.isolation === 'failed'.
export const ISOLATION_NOTE = Object.freeze({
  UNREADABLE_AT_RESTORE: 'Isolation could not be read; left unchanged.',
  RESTORE_FAILED: 'Isolation could not be restored (the Viewer reported an error).',
});

const isDbId = (v) => Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0;
const isModel = (v) => v !== null && typeof v === 'object';

export function normalizeIsolation(list) {
  if (!Array.isArray(list)) return null;
  const seen = new Set();
  const out = [];
  for (const entry of list) {
    if (entry === null || typeof entry !== 'object' || !isModel(entry.model) || !Array.isArray(entry.ids)) return null;
    if (seen.has(entry.model)) return null;           // two entries for one model: ambiguous → not normalizable
    if (!entry.ids.every(isDbId)) return null;
    seen.add(entry.model);
    out.push(Object.freeze({ model: entry.model, ids: Object.freeze([...new Set(entry.ids)].sort((a, b) => a - b)) }));
  }
  return Object.freeze(out);
}

export function isolationEquals(a, b) {
  if (!Array.isArray(a) || !Array.isArray(b) || a.length !== b.length) return false;
  const byModel = new Map(b.map((e) => [e.model, e.ids]));
  return a.every((e) => {
    const other = byModel.get(e.model);
    return other !== undefined && other.length === e.ids.length && other.every((id, i) => id === e.ids[i]);
  });
}

// One reconcile entry per model; never {model, ids:[]} (that would SHOW the whole model).
export function targetFor(sides) {
  if (!Array.isArray(sides) || sides.length === 0) throw new TypeError('targetFor: sides must be a non-empty array');
  const byModel = new Map();
  for (const side of sides) {
    if (!isModel(side?.model) || !isDbId(side?.dbId)) throw new TypeError('targetFor: each side needs {model, dbId}');
    if (!byModel.has(side.model)) byModel.set(side.model, []);
    byModel.get(side.model).push(side.dbId);
  }
  return normalizeIsolation([...byModel].map(([model, ids]) => ({ model, ids })));
}

export function readIsolation(viewerApi) {
  try {
    if (typeof viewerApi.getAggregateIsolation !== 'function') return null;
    return normalizeIsolation(viewerApi.getAggregateIsolation());
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// §9.5 prerequisite: (a) isolation readable + normalizable; (b) no hidden nodes on any model in the scene.
export function isolationPrerequisite(viewerApi) {
  if (readIsolation(viewerApi) === null) return Object.freeze({ available: false, reason: ISOLATION_REASON.UNREADABLE });
  let hidden;
  let inScene;
  try {
    if (typeof viewerApi.getAggregateHiddenNodes !== 'function') throw new TypeError('no hidden-node reader');
    hidden = viewerApi.getAggregateHiddenNodes();
    inScene = viewerApi.getAllModels();
  } catch {
    return Object.freeze({ available: false, reason: ISOLATION_REASON.HIDDEN_UNREADABLE });
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(hidden) || !Array.isArray(inScene)) return Object.freeze({ available: false, reason: ISOLATION_REASON.HIDDEN_UNREADABLE });
  for (const entry of hidden) {
    if (entry === null || typeof entry !== 'object' || !Array.isArray(entry.ids)) {
      return Object.freeze({ available: false, reason: ISOLATION_REASON.HIDDEN_UNREADABLE });
    }
    if (inScene.includes(entry.model) && entry.ids.length > 0) return Object.freeze({ available: false, reason: ISOLATION_REASON.HIDDEN });
  }
  return Object.freeze({ available: true, reason: null });
}

const toViewerList = (normalized) => normalized.map((e) => ({ model: e.model, ids: [...e.ids] }));

// Session = the isolation half of the bridge's resource ledger. `record` is the WRITE-AHEAD entry:
// {preImage, target, prevTarget, confirmed}; restore() is the ownership-guarded undo. preImage is the state before the Panel's ownership began
// (captured, via a fresh read, immediately before the first isolating mutation of a session);
// prevTarget is the Panel's own previously displayed target while a replacement is in flight.
export function createIsolationSession(viewerApi) {
  let record = null;
  const ours = (cur, r) => isolationEquals(cur, r.target) || (r.prevTarget !== null && isolationEquals(cur, r.prevTarget));

  function apply(sides, { beforeMutation } = {}) {
    const target = targetFor(sides);
    let inScene;
    try { inScene = viewerApi.getAllModels(); } catch { inScene = null; }
    if (!Array.isArray(inScene) || !target.every((e) => inScene.includes(e.model))) {
      return { applied: false, reason: ISOLATION_REASON.NOT_IN_SCENE };
    }
    const cur = readIsolation(viewerApi);
    if (cur === null) return { applied: false, reason: ISOLATION_REASON.UNREADABLE };
    let preImage;
    let prevTarget = null;
    if (record !== null && ours(cur, record)) {
      preImage = record.preImage;                     // ownership continues: prior kept (§9.6 row 1)
      prevTarget = cur;
    } else {
      record = null;                                  // no ownership, or lost to a foreign change: new session
      const pre = isolationPrerequisite(viewerApi);
      if (!pre.available) return { applied: false, reason: pre.reason };
      // FINAL read immediately before the write-ahead record: a change made during the prerequisite reads
      // (e.g. by a listener) is the pre-image, never clobbered. Unreadable now ⇒ fail closed, no mutation.
      const fresh = readIsolation(viewerApi);
      if (fresh === null) return { applied: false, reason: ISOLATION_REASON.UNREADABLE };
      preImage = fresh;
    }
    record = { preImage, target, prevTarget, confirmed: false };   // write-ahead: intent + pre-image
    if (beforeMutation) beforeMutation();
    viewerApi.setAggregateIsolation(toViewerList(target));
    record.confirmed = true;
    record.prevTarget = null;
    return { applied: true, reason: null };
  }

  // One call + at most one retry, each followed by read-and-compare. 'failed' = the Viewer kept throwing
  // or became unreadable (the caller KEEPS the record so a later clear/dispose retries); 'skipped-external'
  // only when the state is now genuinely someone else's.
  function restoreTo(preImage, r) {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
      try {
        viewerApi.setAggregateIsolation(toViewerList(preImage));
        return { isolation: 'restored', notes: [] };
      } catch {
        const cur = readIsolation(viewerApi);
        if (cur === null) break;                                     // unreadable: never retry blind
        if (isolationEquals(cur, preImage)) return { isolation: 'restored', notes: [] };
        if (!ours(cur, r)) return { isolation: 'skipped-external', notes: [] };   // foreign now: leave it
      }
    }
    return { isolation: 'failed', notes: [ISOLATION_NOTE.RESTORE_FAILED] };
  }

  // Ownership-guarded release (§9.4): restore preImage ONLY if the current isolation is still the
  // Panel's own; otherwise leave it (foreign). Covers confirmed and pending (ambiguous) records. The record
  // (pre-image + ownership) is dropped ONLY on a confirmed outcome — restored, pre-image already in place, or
  // confirmed foreign state; an unreadable state or a failed restore KEEPS it for the next clear/dispose.
  function restore({ beforeMutation } = {}) {
    if (record === null) return { isolation: 'none', notes: [] };
    const r = record;
    const cur = readIsolation(viewerApi);
    if (cur === null) return { isolation: 'failed', notes: [ISOLATION_NOTE.UNREADABLE_AT_RESTORE] };
    if (!ours(cur, r)) {
      record = null;
      return { isolation: !r.confirmed && isolationEquals(cur, r.preImage) ? 'none' : 'skipped-external', notes: [] };
    }
    if (beforeMutation) beforeMutation();             // may throw: the record stays for the next cleanup
    const result = restoreTo(r.preImage, r);
    if (result.isolation !== 'failed' && record === r) record = null;
    return result;
  }

  return Object.freeze({
    apply,
    restore,
    owns: () => record !== null,
    record: () => (record === null ? null : Object.freeze({ ...record })),
  });
}
```

### Task 25: Presentation transaction (write-ahead ledger, rollback, failure-injection/interleaving matrix, no-theming negative controls)

**Tier:** [B] fake/injected-port ViewerBridge/UI (pre-SVF2)

**Files:**
- Modify (replace wholesale): `clashpanel/viewer/ViewerBridge.js`
- Test: `test/clashpanel/viewer/ViewerBridge.transaction.test.mjs`, `test/clashpanel/viewer/presentationMatrix.test.mjs`, `test/clashpanel/viewer/noTheming.test.mjs`

**Scope note:** the normative §9.2 transaction. Design: every Panel-owned Viewer resource hangs off exactly ONE ledger (`held`). A present first ADOPTS the previous ledger (no mutation), releases the previous markers by exact reference (token-checked before each removal), releases the previous isolation only if it will not isolate itself (otherwise the one reconcile replaces it, prior kept), then adds its markers (write-ahead record → token check → `addMesh`), then isolates (write-ahead record → token check → `setAggregateIsolation` → confirm), then fits (outside the guarantee; T26 swaps in `fit.js`). Any throw from a Viewer call, or an invalidation seen at any check, rolls back everything the held ledger records (markers: exact-mesh removal with one retry; isolation: read-and-compare against target/prevTarget ⇒ restore preImage, pre-image ⇒ nothing, else foreign ⇒ leave). Because the queue is serial and tokens are invalidated at call time, a stale present can only run before the newer one and cleans only what it holds — it can never touch a newer token's resources. AC-P16 is proven by a generated matrix: 4 steps (first marker add, last marker add, isolation, fit) × 2 failure modes (throw before / after the state change) × 8 interleavings (present/present, present-then-present, present/clear, present/dispose, clear during present, dispose during present, newer present during present, foreign isolation change mid-flight) × 2 priors (empty / non-empty) = 128 cases, plus 8 prerequisite-unmet cases; for every clear/dispose/newer-present-DURING-fit case it also asserts the invalidated present reports `superseded:true`, `fitted:false` and made no further (fallback) camera call. Recovery state is never dropped on a failed cleanup: a mesh whose exact removal failed stays in the held ledger (`held` stays non-null until every resource is gone) and is retried by the next clear, replacement present or dispose; the isolation record is kept likewise (T24). The token is re-checked before EVERY camera call and invalidation during fit yields `superseded:true` (no camera rollback; the held resources stay for the invalidator). AC-P19 by the T3 fake's recording `theming forbidden` methods (reached through the harness's ViewerApi) plus `forbiddenCalls` and the seeded foreign theming, and two negative controls that load a mutated COPY of the bridge (written to the OS temp dir, never the repo). All against fakes; the Viewer's real throw/atomicity behaviour and event re-entrancy are gate G2 (PG-1).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: T23 `createMarkerSet`, `computeMarkerRadius`, `MIN_MARKER_RADIUS`; T24 `createIsolationSession`, `targetFor`, `isolationPrerequisite`, `ISOLATION_REASON`; ViewerApi `getAllModels`, `getElementWorldBounds(model, dbId)`, `fitToView(ids, model)`, `overlays.*`; T3 `createFakeModel`, `createFakeThree`; T22 `createBridgeHarness`.
- Produces: `createViewerBridge(...)` now mutating: `present` implements the transaction; `clear()` → `{isolation:'restored'|'skipped-external'|'none'|'failed', markersRemoved, notes}` resolved after the queue drains up to it (`'failed'` = isolation unreadable at clear, or the restore still throwing after its one retry — always with a note; `'skipped-external'` only when the current state is genuinely foreign); `dispose()` = release held ledger → remove leftovers → dispose shared THREE resources + scenes the bridge added → remove listeners (nested `try/finally`); new diagnostic `inspectLedger() -> null | {token, markerMeshes, isolation}` (tests only); `BRIDGE_NOTE {NO_LOCATION:'no location', NO_BOUNDS, NOT_IN_SCENE, FAILED, REMOVE_FAILED}`. No await points and no test seam: the whole present runs synchronously once the queue reaches it.

**Depends on:** T22, T23, T24.

```js
// test/clashpanel/viewer/ViewerBridge.transaction.test.mjs — T25 targeted transaction tests
// (Tier B; fakes only — live Viewer behaviour is gate G2 / PG-1).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createViewerBridge, BRIDGE_NOTE } from '../../../clashpanel/viewer/ViewerBridge.js';
import { targetFor, ISOLATION_REASON, ISOLATION_NOTE } from '../../../clashpanel/viewer/isolation.js';
import { createBridgeHarness, NAMES, sameIsolation } from '../support/viewerFaults.mjs';
import { createFakeModel } from '../support/fakeViewer.mjs';
import { createFakeThree } from '../support/fakeThree.mjs';

const ON = { focus: true, isolate: true, marker: true };
const MUTATORS = new Set(['addScene', 'addMesh', 'removeMesh', 'removeScene', 'setAggregateIsolation', 'fitToView']);

function setup({ prior = [], bounds = true } = {}) {
  const m1 = createFakeModel({ id: 1, boxes: bounds ? { 1: [0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1], 3: [5, 0, 0, 6, 1, 1] } : {} });
  const m2 = createFakeModel({ id: 2, boxes: bounds ? { 2: [2, 0, 0, 3, 1, 1], 4: [7, 0, 0, 8, 1, 1] } : {} });
  const m3 = createFakeModel({ id: 3 });
  const h = createBridgeHarness({ models: [m1, m2, m3], isolation: typeof prior === 'function' ? prior(m3) : prior });
  const { THREE, stats } = createFakeThree();
  const bridge = createViewerBridge({ viewerApi: h.api, THREE, names: NAMES });
  const A = { sides: [{ model: m1, dbId: 1 }, { model: m2, dbId: 2 }], point: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5], options: ON };
  const B = { sides: [{ model: m1, dbId: 3 }, { model: m2, dbId: 4 }], point: [5.5, 0.5, 0.5], options: ON };
  return { h, stats, bridge, A, B, m1, m2, m3 };
}

test('happy path: markers, one isolation reconcile, aggregate fit; ledger holds exactly this token\'s resources', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, A } = setup();
  const o = await bridge.present(A);
  assert.deepEqual({ superseded: o.superseded, fitted: o.fitted, isolated: o.isolated, marked: o.marked }, { superseded: false, fitted: true, isolated: true, marked: true });
  assert.equal(o.notes.includes(BRIDGE_NOTE.FAILED), false);
  assert.equal(h.panelMeshes().length, 3);
  assert.ok(sameIsolation(h.isolation(), targetFor(A.sides)));
  const ledger = bridge.inspectLedger();
  assert.equal(ledger.markerMeshes.length, 3);
  assert.deepEqual(new Set(ledger.markerMeshes), new Set(h.panelMeshes()));
  assert.equal(ledger.isolation.confirmed, true);
  assert.equal(h.callsOf('setAggregateIsolation').length, 1);
  h.assertNoTheming();
});

test('mutation order: reads → markers → isolation → fit last', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, A, m1, m2 } = setup();
  let boundsReadAtFirstMutation = -1;
  h.viewer.onCall('addScene', () => { boundsReadAtFirstMutation = m1.boundsCalls.length + m2.boundsCalls.length; }, { phase: 'before' });
  await bridge.present(A);
  const order = h.log.map((e) => e.method).filter((m) => MUTATORS.has(m));
  assert.equal(order[0], 'addScene', 'the first mutation is the marker scene');
  assert.equal(boundsReadAtFirstMutation, 2, 'both element bounds were read before any mutation');
  assert.ok(order.lastIndexOf('addMesh') < order.indexOf('setAggregateIsolation'));
  const firstFit = order.indexOf('fitToView');
  assert.ok(order.indexOf('setAggregateIsolation') < firstFit);
  assert.ok(order.slice(firstFit).every((m) => m === 'fitToView'), 'fit is the last step');
});

test('write-ahead: the intent is in the ledger BEFORE each Viewer mutation', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, A } = setup();
  const seen = [];
  h.viewer.onCall('addMesh', (mesh) => {
    seen.push(['mesh recorded', bridge.inspectLedger().markerMeshes.includes(mesh) && !h.panelMeshes().includes(mesh)]);
  }, { phase: 'before' });
  h.viewer.onCall('setAggregateIsolation', () => {
    const rec = bridge.inspectLedger().isolation;
    seen.push(['isolation pending', rec !== null && rec.confirmed === false && sameIsolation(rec.target, targetFor(A.sides))]);
  });
  await bridge.present(A);
  assert.deepEqual(seen, [['mesh recorded', true], ['isolation pending', true]]);
});

test('the token is re-checked before EVERY mutation: invalidated mid-step ⇒ no further add/isolate/fit', async () => {
  // addMesh #1: invalidated between the Soft spheres; addMesh #3 (the line): right before the outline
  // scene would be created; getAggregateHiddenNodes: a read inside the isolation step, right before
  // setAggregateIsolation would run.
  for (const [during, nth] of [['addMesh', 1], ['addMesh', 3], ['getAggregateHiddenNodes', 1]]) {
    const { h, bridge, A } = setup();
    const req = { ...A, point: undefined, closestPoints: { first: [0, 0, 0], second: [1, 0, 0] } };
    let cleared;
    let at = -1;
    h.viewer.onCall(during, () => { cleared = bridge.clear(); at = h.log.length; }, { nth });
    const o = await bridge.present(req);
    await cleared;
    assert.equal(o.superseded, true, during);
    const after = h.log.slice(at).map((e) => e.method).filter((m) => MUTATORS.has(m));
    assert.ok(after.every((m) => m === 'removeMesh'), `${during}: only cleanup after invalidation, got ${after}`);
    assert.deepEqual(h.panelMeshes(), []);
    assert.deepEqual(h.isolation(), []);
  }
});

test('a newer successful present releases the previous ledger first; isolation is replaced with prior kept', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, A, B, m3 } = setup({ prior: (m) => [{ model: m, ids: [9] }] });
  await bridge.present(A);
  const oldMeshes = h.panelMeshes();
  h.log.length = 0;
  await bridge.present(B);
  const order = h.log.map((e) => e.method).filter((m) => MUTATORS.has(m));
  assert.deepEqual(order.slice(0, 3), ['removeMesh', 'removeMesh', 'removeMesh'], 'old meshes removed before any new add');
  assert.ok(h.callsOf('removeMesh').every((e) => oldMeshes.includes(e.args[0])));
  assert.equal(h.callsOf('setAggregateIsolation').length, 1, 'one reconcile, no intermediate restore');
  assert.ok(h.panelMeshes().every((m) => !oldMeshes.includes(m)), 'only B\'s meshes remain');
  assert.deepEqual((await bridge.clear()).isolation, 'restored');
  assert.deepEqual(h.isolation(), [{ model: m3, ids: [9] }], 'the ORIGINAL prior, not A\'s target');
});

test('a present without Isolate after an isolated one restores the prior (guarded) before drawing', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, A, B } = setup();
  await bridge.present(A);
  const o = await bridge.present({ ...B, options: { focus: false, isolate: false, marker: true } });
  assert.equal(o.isolated, false);
  assert.deepEqual(h.isolation(), []);
  assert.equal(bridge.inspectLedger().isolation, null);
  assert.equal((await bridge.clear()).isolation, 'none');
});

test('a stale completion never clears a newer token\'s resources', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, A, B } = setup();
  let pb;
  let drawnByA = [];
  // B arrives while A is inside its isolation step (reading the pre-image), after A drew its markers.
  h.viewer.onCall('getAggregateIsolation', () => { drawnByA = h.panelMeshes(); pb = bridge.present(B); }, { phase: 'before' });
  const oa = await bridge.present(A);
  const ob = await pb;
  assert.equal(drawnByA.length, 3, 'A had drawn its markers when it was superseded');
  assert.equal(oa.superseded, true);
  assert.equal(ob.superseded, false);
  assert.equal(h.panelMeshes().length, 3);
  assert.ok(h.panelMeshes().every((m) => !drawnByA.includes(m)), 'only B\'s meshes remain');
  assert.ok(sameIsolation(h.isolation(), targetFor(B.sides)));
});

test('removeMesh failures during cleanup are retried; a double failure is noted and dispose removes it later', async () => {
  for (const mode of ['before', 'after']) {
    const { h, bridge, A } = setup();
    await bridge.present(A);
    h.failAt('removeMesh', mode);
    const c = await bridge.clear();
    assert.equal(c.markersRemoved, 3);
    assert.deepEqual(h.panelMeshes(), [], `retry after a throw ${mode}`);
  }
  const { h, bridge, A } = setup();
  await bridge.present(A);
  h.failAt('removeMesh', 'before');
  h.failAt('removeMesh', 'before');
  const c = await bridge.clear();
  assert.equal(c.markersRemoved, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(c.notes, [BRIDGE_NOTE.REMOVE_FAILED]);
  assert.equal(h.panelMeshes().length, 1);
  await bridge.dispose();
  assert.deepEqual(h.panelMeshes(), []);
});

test('clear reports isolation "failed" (with a note) when the restore keeps throwing or the state is unreadable', async () => {

  assert.deepEqual(s1.h.panelMeshes(), [], 'markers are still removed');

test('no location ⇒ note "no location"; outlines still mark; no bounds and no point ⇒ marked:false, fit and isolate still apply', async () => {
  const s1 = setup();

  assert.deepEqual(o2.notes.slice(0, 2), [BRIDGE_NOTE.NO_LOCATION, BRIDGE_NOTE.NO_BOUNDS]);
  assert.deepEqual(s2.h.panelMeshes(), []);
});

test('a side whose model left the scene is skipped (note); isolation only reconciles live models', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, A, m1, m2 } = setup();

  assert.ok(o.notes.includes(BRIDGE_NOTE.NOT_IN_SCENE));
  assert.deepEqual(h.callsOf('setAggregateIsolation').map((e) => e.args[0]), [[{ model: m1, ids: [1] }]]);
  assert.ok(h.callsOf('fitToView').every((e) => e.args[1] !== m2));

test('unreadable isolation at present ⇒ Isolate reported unavailable, no setAggregateIsolation, markers kept', async () => {

test('AC-P6: after every awaited restore-table trigger no Panel mesh remains and isolation is restored or skipped', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, A, B, m1, m3 } = setup({ prior: (m) => [{ model: m, ids: [9] }] });
  const prior = [{ model: m3, ids: [9] }];
  await bridge.present(A);
  await bridge.present(B);                                  // change selected clash
  assert.equal(h.panelMeshes().length, 3);
  assert.equal((await bridge.clear()).isolation, 'restored'); // Back to All / new run / hide panel
  assert.deepEqual(h.panelMeshes(), []); assert.deepEqual(h.isolation(), prior);
  await bridge.present(A);
  h.viewer.dispatch(h.api.eventNames.BEFORE_MODEL_UNLOAD, { model: m1 });   // controller reacts with clear()
  await bridge.clear();
  assert.deepEqual(h.panelMeshes(), []); assert.deepEqual(h.isolation(), prior);
  await bridge.present(A);
  h.viewer.setIsolationState([{ model: m3, ids: [1] }]);
  assert.equal((await bridge.clear()).isolation, 'skipped-external');
  assert.deepEqual(h.isolation(), [{ model: m3, ids: [1] }]);
  await bridge.present(B);
  await bridge.dispose();                                    // extension unload / dispose
  assert.deepEqual(h.panelMeshes(), []);
  assert.deepEqual(h.isolation(), [{ model: m3, ids: [1] }]);
  assert.equal(h.hasScene(NAMES.overlayMarkers), false);
  h.assertNoTheming();
});

test('F2: a failed isolation restore KEEPS the pre-image — a later clear() (or dispose()) restores the user\'s isolation', async () => {
  for (const finish of ['clear', 'dispose']) {
    const { h, bridge, A, m3 } = setup({ prior: (m) => [{ model: m, ids: [9] }] });
    await bridge.present(A);
    h.failAt('setAggregateIsolation', 'before');
    h.failAt('setAggregateIsolation', 'before');
    const first = await bridge.clear();
    assert.equal(first.isolation, 'failed');
    assert.deepEqual(h.panelMeshes(), [], 'markers are still removed');
    if (finish === 'clear') assert.equal((await bridge.clear()).isolation, 'restored');
    else await bridge.dispose();
    assert.deepEqual(h.isolation(), [{ model: m3, ids: [9] }], `${finish} restored the original isolation`);
  }
});

test('F3: a mesh whose exact removal failed twice stays in the ledger and is retried by the next present and clear', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, A, B } = setup();
  await bridge.present(A);
  h.failAt('removeMesh', 'before');
  h.failAt('removeMesh', 'before');                                   // both attempts on the SAME mesh
  const c1 = await bridge.clear();
  assert.deepEqual(c1.notes, [BRIDGE_NOTE.REMOVE_FAILED]);
  const [orphan] = h.panelMeshes();
  assert.equal(h.panelMeshes().length, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(bridge.inspectLedger().markerMeshes, [orphan], 'held stays non-null until every resource is gone');
  h.log.length = 0;
  await bridge.present(B);
  assert.equal(h.callsOf('removeMesh')[0].args[0], orphan, 'the replacement present retries the orphan first');
  assert.equal(h.panelMeshes().length, 3);
  assert.equal(h.panelMeshes().includes(orphan), false);
  await bridge.clear();
  assert.deepEqual(h.panelMeshes(), []);
  assert.equal(bridge.inspectLedger(), null);
});

test('F5: default overlay scene names are instance-scoped — two bridges on ONE viewer never touch each other', async () => {
  const h = createBridgeHarness();
  const [m1, m2] = h.models;
  const b1 = createViewerBridge({ viewerApi: h.api, THREE: createFakeThree().THREE });
  const b2 = createViewerBridge({ viewerApi: h.api, THREE: createFakeThree().THREE });
  const opts = { focus: false, isolate: false, marker: true };
  await b1.present({ sides: [{ model: m1, dbId: 1 }], point: [0, 0, 0], options: opts });
  await b2.present({ sides: [{ model: m2, dbId: 2 }], point: [1, 1, 1], options: opts });
  const scenes = h.viewer.overlayScenes();
  assert.equal(scenes.length, 2, 'one marker scene per bridge');
  assert.notEqual(scenes[0], scenes[1]);
  const b2Mesh = h.viewer.overlayMeshes(scenes[1]);
  await b1.clear();
  assert.deepEqual(h.viewer.overlayMeshes(scenes[0]), []);
  assert.deepEqual(h.viewer.overlayMeshes(scenes[1]), b2Mesh, 'the other bridge\'s marker survives clear()');
  await b1.dispose();
  assert.deepEqual(h.viewer.overlayScenes(), [scenes[1]], 'only the disposed bridge\'s scene is removed');
  assert.deepEqual(h.viewer.overlayMeshes(scenes[1]), b2Mesh);
  await b2.dispose();
  assert.deepEqual(h.viewer.overlayScenes(), []);
});

test('F6: an addScene that throws after creating the scene leaks nothing; a mesh that cannot be removed keeps its scene', async () => {
  const s1 = setup();
  s1.h.failAt('addScene', 'after');
  const o = await s1.bridge.present(s1.A);
  assert.ok(o.notes.includes(BRIDGE_NOTE.FAILED));
  await s1.bridge.dispose();
  assert.equal(s1.h.hasScene(NAMES.overlayMarkers), false, 'write-ahead scene record ⇒ removed at dispose');
  const s2 = setup();
  await s2.bridge.present({ ...s2.A, point: undefined, options: { focus: false, isolate: false, marker: true } });
  const [kept] = s2.h.viewer.overlayMeshes(NAMES.overlayOutlines);
  // removeMesh calls: #1,#2 = clear on outline 1 (+ retry) fail; #3 = outline 2 succeeds; #4,#5 = dispose's
  // ledger retry of outline 1 (+ retry) fail; #6 = dispose's leftover sweep fails. (FIFO hooks: the nth:2 one
  // becomes head after #2, counts #3 and fires on #4.)
  s2.h.failAt('removeMesh', 'before');
  s2.h.failAt('removeMesh', 'before');
  s2.h.failAt('removeMesh', 'before', 2);
  s2.h.failAt('removeMesh', 'before');
  s2.h.failAt('removeMesh', 'before');
  assert.deepEqual((await s2.bridge.clear()).notes, [BRIDGE_NOTE.REMOVE_FAILED]);
  await s2.bridge.dispose();
  assert.equal(s2.h.pendingFaults(), 0);
  assert.equal(s2.h.hasScene(NAMES.overlayOutlines), true, 'never removeScene under an unremoved Panel mesh');
  assert.deepEqual(s2.h.viewer.overlayMeshes(NAMES.overlayOutlines), [kept]);
});

test('F4: a foreign isolation change made inside the getAggregateHiddenNodes() read becomes the pre-image and is never clobbered', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, A, m3 } = setup();
  const F = [{ model: m3, ids: [5] }];
  h.viewer.onCall('getAggregateHiddenNodes', () => h.viewer.setIsolationState(F));
  const o = await bridge.present(A);
  assert.equal(o.isolated, true);
  assert.deepEqual(bridge.inspectLedger().isolation.preImage, F);
  assert.equal((await bridge.clear()).isolation, 'restored');
  assert.deepEqual(h.isolation(), F, 'the foreign state is what the Panel restores to');
});
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/viewer/presentationMatrix.test.mjs — AC-P16 failure-injection × interleaving matrix
// (Tier B: against the T3 fake Viewer + its T22 onCall hook only; live behaviour is gate G2).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createViewerBridge } from '../../../clashpanel/viewer/ViewerBridge.js';
import { targetFor, isolationPrerequisite } from '../../../clashpanel/viewer/isolation.js';
import { createBridgeHarness, NAMES, sameIsolation } from '../support/viewerFaults.mjs';
import { createFakeModel } from '../support/fakeViewer.mjs';
import { createFakeThree } from '../support/fakeThree.mjs';

const BOX = (x) => [x, 0, 0, x + 1, 1, 1];
const OPTS = { focus: true, isolate: true, marker: true };
const MESHES_PER_PRESENT = 3;                       // hard sphere + two outlines

function world({ priorNonEmpty, hidden = [] }) {
  const m1 = createFakeModel({ id: 1, boxes: { 1: BOX(0), 3: BOX(5) } });
  const m2 = createFakeModel({ id: 2, boxes: { 2: BOX(2), 4: BOX(7) } });
  const m3 = createFakeModel({ id: 3 });
  const prior = priorNonEmpty ? [{ model: m3, ids: [42] }] : [];
  const h = createBridgeHarness({ models: [m1, m2, m3], isolation: prior, hiddenNodes: hidden });
  const { THREE } = createFakeThree();
  const bridge = createViewerBridge({ viewerApi: h.api, THREE, names: NAMES });
  const foreignMesh = h.addForeignMesh(NAMES.overlayMarkers);
  const A = { sides: [{ model: m1, dbId: 1 }, { model: m2, dbId: 2 }], point: [0.5, 0.5, 0.5], options: OPTS };
  const B = { sides: [{ model: m1, dbId: 3 }, { model: m2, dbId: 4 }], point: [5.5, 0.5, 0.5], options: OPTS };
  const F = [{ model: m1, ids: [99] }];
  return { h, bridge, prior, A, B, F, foreignMesh, aMeshes: [] };
}

const STEPS = {
  'marker-first': ['addMesh', 1],
  'marker-last': ['addMesh', MESHES_PER_PRESENT],
  isolation: ['setAggregateIsolation', 1],
  fit: ['fitToView', 1],                           // first fit call (aggregate form for two models)
};
const MODES = ['before', 'after'];

// Each interleaving drives the bridge and returns the expected final state:
//   meshes: 'B' (exactly B's markers) | 'none';  isolation: 'B' | 'prior' | 'foreign'.
const INTERLEAVINGS = {
  async 'present/present'({ h, bridge, A, B }, [method, nth], mode, step) {
    h.failAt(method, mode, nth);
    const [oa, ob] = await Promise.all([bridge.present(A), bridge.present(B)]);
    assert.equal(oa.superseded, true);
    const ok = step === 'fit';
    return { meshes: ok ? 'B' : 'none', isolation: ok ? 'B' : 'prior', outcome: ob };
  },
  async 'present-then-present'(w, [method, nth], mode, step) {
    const { h, bridge, A, B } = w;
    const oa = await bridge.present(A);
    assert.equal(oa.marked, true);
    w.aMeshes = h.panelMeshes();
    h.failAt(method, mode, nth);
    const ob = await bridge.present(B);
    const ok = step === 'fit';
    return { meshes: ok ? 'B' : 'none', isolation: ok ? 'B' : 'prior', outcome: ob };
  },
  async 'present/clear'({ h, bridge, A }, [method, nth], mode) {
    h.failAt(method, mode, nth);
    await bridge.present(A);
    await bridge.clear();
    return { meshes: 'none', isolation: 'prior' };
  },
  async 'present/dispose'({ h, bridge, A }, [method, nth], mode) {
    h.failAt(method, mode, nth);
    await bridge.present(A);
    await bridge.dispose();
    return { meshes: 'none', isolation: 'prior', disposed: true };
  },
  async 'clear during present'({ h, bridge, A }, [method, nth], mode) {
    let cleared;
    h.failAt(method, mode, nth);
    h.viewer.onCall(method, () => { cleared = bridge.clear(); }, { nth });
    const aOutcome = await bridge.present(A);
    await cleared;
    return { meshes: 'none', isolation: 'prior', aOutcome, fitCallCount: 1 };
  },
  async 'dispose during present'({ h, bridge, A }, [method, nth], mode) {
    let disposing;
    h.failAt(method, mode, nth);
    h.viewer.onCall(method, () => { disposing = bridge.dispose(); }, { nth });
    const aOutcome = await bridge.present(A);
    await disposing;
    return { meshes: 'none', isolation: 'prior', disposed: true, aOutcome, fitCallCount: 1 };
  },
  async 'newer present during present'({ h, bridge, A, B }, [method, nth], mode) {
    let pb;
    h.failAt(method, mode, nth);
    h.viewer.onCall(method, () => { pb = bridge.present(B); }, { nth });
    const aOutcome = await bridge.present(A);
    const ob = await pb;
    assert.equal(ob.superseded, false);
    // A's fault was consumed by A; B then applies cleanly (after releasing whatever A still held).
    return { meshes: 'B', isolation: 'B', aOutcome, fitCallCount: 2 };   // A's invalidated call + B's own
  },
  async 'foreign isolation change mid-flight'({ h, bridge, A, F }, [method, nth], mode) {
    h.failAt(method, mode, nth);
    h.viewer.onCall(method, () => h.viewer.setIsolationState(F), { nth });
    await bridge.present(A);
    const c = await bridge.clear();
    assert.ok(['none', 'skipped-external'].includes(c.isolation), `foreign state is never restored over (got ${c.isolation})`);
    return { meshes: 'none', isolation: 'foreign' };
  },
};

const cases = [];
for (const priorNonEmpty of [false, true]) {
  for (const [step, spec] of Object.entries(STEPS)) {
    for (const mode of MODES) {
      for (const name of Object.keys(INTERLEAVINGS)) cases.push({ priorNonEmpty, step, spec, mode, name });
    }
  }
}

test(`matrix has ${cases.length} generated cases (4 steps × 2 failure modes × 8 interleavings × 2 priors)`, () => {
  assert.equal(cases.length, 4 * 2 * 8 * 2);
});

for (const c of cases) {
  test(`AC-P16 ${c.name} · ${c.step} throws ${c.mode} state change · prior ${c.priorNonEmpty ? 'non-empty' : 'empty'}`, async () => {
    const w = world({ priorNonEmpty: c.priorNonEmpty });
    const { h, bridge, prior, B, F, foreignMesh } = w;
    const expected = await INTERLEAVINGS[c.name](w, c.spec, c.mode, c.step);
    if (c.step === 'fit' && expected.aOutcome) {
      // F1: invalidated inside a (throwing) aggregate fit ⇒ A is superseded and NO fallback camera call happens.
      assert.equal(expected.aOutcome.superseded, true, 'invalidated during fit ⇒ superseded');
      assert.equal(expected.aOutcome.fitted, false);
      assert.equal(h.fitCalls().length, expected.fitCallCount, 'no further (fallback) camera call for a stale token');
    }
    const panel = h.panelMeshes();
    if (expected.meshes === 'B') {
      assert.equal(panel.length, MESHES_PER_PRESENT);
      assert.ok(panel.every((m) => !w.aMeshes.includes(m)), 'only the newest token\'s meshes remain');
    } else {
      assert.deepEqual(panel, [], 'no Panel-owned mesh remains');
    }
    const want = expected.isolation === 'B' ? targetFor(B.sides) : expected.isolation === 'foreign' ? F : prior;
    assert.ok(sameIsolation(h.isolation(), want), `isolation expected ${expected.isolation}`);
    assert.deepEqual(h.foreignMeshes(), [foreignMesh], 'foreign mesh untouched');
    if (c.priorNonEmpty) {
      assert.ok(h.callsOf('setAggregateIsolation').every((e) => e.args[0].length > 0), 'no clear-all when prior is non-empty');
    }
    h.assertNoTheming();
    // The queue is not wedged: a final clear resolves and leaves nothing Panel-owned.
    const final = await bridge.clear();
    if (expected.disposed) assert.equal(final.disposed, true);
    assert.deepEqual(h.panelMeshes(), []);
    const settled = expected.isolation === 'foreign' ? F : prior;
    assert.ok(sameIsolation(h.isolation(), settled), 'after the final clear: prior (or the foreign state) only');
    assert.equal(h.pendingFaults(), 0, 'the injected fault was exercised');
    h.assertNoTheming();
  });
}

for (const name of Object.keys(INTERLEAVINGS)) {
  test(`AC-P16 prerequisite unmet (hidden nodes) · ${name}: no setAggregateIsolation of any kind, Isolate unavailable`, async () => {
    const w = world({ priorNonEmpty: false, hidden: [] });
    w.h.viewer.setHiddenNodes([{ model: w.h.models[0], ids: [5] }]);
    assert.deepEqual(isolationPrerequisite(w.h.api), { available: false, reason: 'Some elements are hidden — show all to enable isolation' });
    await INTERLEAVINGS[name](w, STEPS.fit, 'before', 'fit');
    await w.bridge.clear();
    assert.deepEqual(w.h.callsOf('setAggregateIsolation'), []);
    assert.deepEqual(w.h.panelMeshes(), []);
    w.h.assertNoTheming();
  });
}
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/viewer/noTheming.test.mjs — AC-P19 runtime negative controls (Tier B; the static ban is T1).
// The fake ViewerApi records AND throws on any member whose name contains "theming"; foreign theming
// state seeded in the fake must be unchanged after every present/clear/dispose path.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFile, writeFile, mkdtemp, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { createViewerBridge } from '../../../clashpanel/viewer/ViewerBridge.js';
import { createBridgeHarness, NAMES } from '../support/viewerFaults.mjs';
import { createFakeThree } from '../support/fakeThree.mjs';

const ON = { focus: true, isolate: true, marker: true };
const VIEWER_DIR = new URL('../../../clashpanel/viewer/', import.meta.url);

function setup(factory = createViewerBridge) {
  const h = createBridgeHarness();
  const [m1, m2] = h.models;
  const bridge = factory({ viewerApi: h.api, THREE: createFakeThree().THREE, names: NAMES });
  const req = (dbId) => ({ sides: [{ model: m1, dbId }, { model: m2, dbId: dbId + 1 }], point: [0, 0, 0], options: ON });
  return { h, bridge, req, m1 };
}

// Loads a COPY of ViewerBridge.js with one extra line injected after `anchor` (imports re-pointed at
// the real sibling modules); the copy lives in the OS temp dir, never in the repo.
async function mutantBridge(anchor, injected) {
  const src = await readFile(new URL('ViewerBridge.js', VIEWER_DIR), 'utf8');
  assert.ok(src.includes(anchor), `anchor present: ${anchor}`);
  const rewritten = src
    .replace(/from '\.\/([A-Za-z]+\.js)'/g, (_m, f) => `from '${new URL(f, VIEWER_DIR).href}'`)
    .replace(anchor, `${anchor}\n${injected}`);
  const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'clashpanel-mutant-'));
  const file = join(dir, 'ViewerBridge.mutant.mjs');
  await writeFile(file, rewritten);
  const mod = await import(pathToFileURL(file).href);
  return { mod, cleanup: () => rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }) };
}

test('no theming member is touched on any present/clear/dispose path or interleaving; foreign theming unchanged', async () => {
  const { h, bridge, req, m1 } = setup();
  await bridge.present(req(1));                          h.assertNoTheming();
  await bridge.present(req(3));                          h.assertNoTheming();   // change selection
  await bridge.clear();                                  h.assertNoTheming();   // back to all / new run / hide
  const racing = [bridge.present(req(1)), bridge.present(req(3)), bridge.clear(), bridge.present(req(5))];
  await Promise.all(racing);                             h.assertNoTheming();
  h.failAt('setAggregateIsolation', 'after');
  await bridge.present(req(7));                          h.assertNoTheming();   // ambiguous rollback
  h.viewer.dispatch(h.api.eventNames.MODEL_REMOVED, { model: m1 });
  await bridge.clear();                                  h.assertNoTheming();   // model left
  await bridge.present(req(9));
  await bridge.dispose();                                h.assertNoTheming();   // dispose
  await bridge.present(req(1));                          h.assertNoTheming();   // after dispose
  assert.deepEqual(h.viewer.themingCalls, []);
  assert.deepEqual(h.viewer.forbiddenCalls, [], 'no selection / visibility / impl call either');
});

test('negative control: a bridge that calls setThemingColor in present IS caught by the harness', async () => {
  const { mod, cleanup } = await mutantBridge('async function runPresent(t, req) {', '    viewerApi.setThemingColor(req.sides[0].dbId, null, req.sides[0].model);');
  try {
    const { h, bridge, req } = setup(mod.createViewerBridge);
    const o = await bridge.present(req(1));
    assert.equal(o.marked, false, 'the forbidden call aborted the presentation');

    assert.throws(() => h.assertNoTheming(), /theming member called: setThemingColor/);
  } finally {
    await cleanup();
  }
});

test('negative control: a bridge that calls clearThemingColors in clear IS caught by the harness', async () => {
  const { mod, cleanup } = await mutantBridge('  function releaseHeld() {', '    try { viewerApi.clearThemingColors(); } catch { /* swallowed on purpose: the record must still catch it */ }');
  try {

    assert.throws(() => h.assertNoTheming(), /clearThemingColors/);
  } finally {
    await cleanup();
  }
});

test('the harness routes every theming member of the ViewerApi to the T3 recording throw (incl. unknown *Theming* names)', () => {

  assert.throws(() => h.assertNoTheming(), /theming member called/);
});
```

```js
// clashpanel/viewer/ViewerBridge.js
// The ONLY Viewer mutator of the Panel (spec §9.2). Tier B: sequencing, ledger and rollback are proven
// against injected fakes only; live Viewer behaviour is gated (G2 / PG-1 / F7 / F8).
//
// Presentation transaction (normative, §9.2): present/clear/dispose share one single-flight queue;
// each present gets token ++n; clear/dispose/a later present invalidate every earlier token AT CALL
// TIME (before the queue reaches them); the token is re-checked immediately before every Viewer
// mutation. All Panel-owned Viewer resources hang off exactly ONE write-ahead ledger (`held`):
// {token, markerMeshes[], isolation: session record}. An in-flight present adopts the previous ledger
// (releasing it first), so a failure or supersession cleans everything recorded — the newest surviving
// token's resources or none. Mutation order: compute → release previous → markers → isolation → fit.
// Fit is outside the guarantee (best-effort, never rolled back). The bridge never calls any theming
// member and never touches selection or camera restore.
import { createMarkerSet, computeMarkerRadius, MIN_MARKER_RADIUS } from './markers.js';
import { createIsolationSession } from './isolation.js';

// Minimal best-effort fit for the transaction (T26 replaces it with fit.js#fitSides): frame the first live
// side with the public per-model form. Never throws; a failure only adds a note.
function fitSides(viewerApi, sides, isCurrent) {
  if (!isCurrent()) return { fitted: false, notes: [], superseded: true };   // never move the camera for a stale token
  try {
    viewerApi.fitToView([sides[0].dbId], sides[0].model);
    return { fitted: true, notes: sides.some((s) => s.model !== sides[0].model) ? ['Framing first element only'] : [] };
  } catch {
    return { fitted: false, notes: ['Could not frame the clash'] };
  }
}

export const BRIDGE_NOTE = Object.freeze({
  NO_LOCATION: 'no location',
  NO_BOUNDS: 'Element bounds unavailable; outline omitted',
  NOT_IN_SCENE: "An element's model is no longer in the scene",
  FAILED: 'The Viewer rejected the presentation; nothing is shown',
  REMOVE_FAILED: 'A marker could not be removed',
});

// Serial single-flight queue: tasks run one at a time in call order; a rejected task never wedges it.
export function createSerialQueue() {
  let tail = Promise.resolve();
  let pending = 0;
  return Object.freeze({
    run(task) {
      pending += 1;
      const result = tail.then(() => task());
      tail = result.then(() => { pending -= 1; }, () => { pending -= 1; });
      return result;
    },
    size: () => pending,
    idle: () => tail,
  });
}

// Symmetric listener bookkeeping: every add is recorded; removeAll() removes exactly those.
export function createListenerRegistry(viewerApi) {
  const added = [];
  return Object.freeze({
    add(name, fn) { viewerApi.addEventListener(name, fn); added.push([name, fn]); },
    removeAll() {
      const errors = [];
      while (added.length > 0) {
        const [name, fn] = added.pop();
        try { viewerApi.removeEventListener(name, fn); } catch (e) { errors.push(e); }
      }
      return errors;
    },
    count: () => added.length,
  });
}

class Superseded extends Error {}

const isModel = (v) => v !== null && typeof v === 'object';
const isDbId = (v) => Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0;

function validateRequest(req) {
  if (!req || !Array.isArray(req.sides) || req.sides.length < 1 || req.sides.length > 2) throw new TypeError('present: sides must hold 1–2 entries');
  for (const s of req.sides) if (!isModel(s?.model) || !isDbId(s?.dbId)) throw new TypeError('present: each side needs {model, dbId}');
  const o = req.options;
  if (!o || typeof o.focus !== 'boolean' || typeof o.isolate !== 'boolean' || typeof o.marker !== 'boolean') {
    throw new TypeError('present: options {focus, isolate, marker} must be booleans');
  }
}

const outcome = (fields) => Object.freeze({ superseded: false, fitted: false, isolated: false, marked: false, ...fields, notes: Object.freeze([...(fields.notes ?? [])]) });
const DISPOSED_PRESENT = outcome({ superseded: true, disposed: true });
const DISPOSED_CLEAR = Object.freeze({ isolation: 'none', markersRemoved: 0, notes: Object.freeze([]), disposed: true });

// Overlay scene names are INSTANCE-scoped by default so two Panels/bridges on one Viewer never share (and so
// never clear or remove) each other's scenes. Injectable for tests/hosts.
let bridgeInstances = 0;
function defaultNames() {
  bridgeInstances += 1;
  return Object.freeze({ overlayMarkers: `clash-panel-markers:${bridgeInstances}`, overlayOutlines: `clash-panel-outlines:${bridgeInstances}` });
}

export function createViewerBridge({ viewerApi, THREE, names = defaultNames() } = {}) {
  if (!viewerApi || !viewerApi.overlays) throw new TypeError('createViewerBridge: viewerApi with overlays is required');
  if (!THREE) throw new TypeError('createViewerBridge: THREE is required');
  const queue = createSerialQueue();
  const listeners = createListenerRegistry(viewerApi);
  const markers = createMarkerSet({ THREE, overlays: viewerApi.overlays, names });
  const isolation = createIsolationSession(viewerApi);
  let seq = 0;
  let live = 0;
  let disposed = false;
  let disposePromise = null;
  let held = null;                          // the single ledger holding every Panel-owned resource

  const isLive = (t) => !disposed && t === live;
  const guard = (t) => { if (!isLive(t)) throw new Superseded(); };

  function removeExact(mesh, notes) {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
      try { markers.remove(mesh); return true; } catch { /* retry once: removal of an absent mesh is a no-op */ }
    }
    notes.push(BRIDGE_NOTE.REMOVE_FAILED);
    return false;
  }

  // Cleanup of EVERYTHING the held ledger records (confirmed or not). Never token-gated. A mesh whose exact
  // removal failed stays in the ledger and an isolation restore that failed keeps its session record, so the
  // next clear/present/dispose retries them.
  function releaseHeld() {
    const notes = [];
    let markersRemoved = 0;
    const L = held;
    let iso = { isolation: 'none', notes: [] };
    try {
      if (L !== null) {
        const remaining = L.markerMeshes.filter((mesh) => { const ok = removeExact(mesh, notes); if (ok) markersRemoved += 1; return !ok; });
        L.markerMeshes.length = 0;
        L.markerMeshes.push(...remaining);
        held = remaining.length > 0 ? L : null;   // keep the ledger until every mesh is gone: later clear/present/dispose retry
      }
    } finally {
      iso = isolation.restore();
    }
    return { isolation: iso.isolation, markersRemoved, notes: [...notes, ...iso.notes] };
  }

  function sceneModels() {
    try { const m = viewerApi.getAllModels(); return Array.isArray(m) ? m : []; } catch { return []; }
  }

  function readBounds(side) {
    try { return viewerApi.getElementWorldBounds(side.model, side.dbId); } catch { return null; }
  }

  async function runPresent(t, req) {
    if (!isLive(t)) return outcome({ superseded: true });
    const notes = [];
    const { focus, isolate, marker } = req.options;

    // (1) resolve / compute — reads only, no mutation.
    const inScene = sceneModels();
    const liveSides = req.sides.filter((s) => inScene.includes(s.model));
    if (liveSides.length < req.sides.length) notes.push(BRIDGE_NOTE.NOT_IN_SCENE);
    const boxes = marker ? liveSides.map(readBounds) : [];
    const radius = marker ? computeMarkerRadius(boxes) : MIN_MARKER_RADIUS;

    // Adopt the previous ledger: from here on this token's ledger holds every Panel resource.
    const L = { token: t, markerMeshes: held === null ? [] : held.markerMeshes, get isolation() { return isolation.record(); } };
    held = L;
    const hooks = {
      beforeAdd: (mesh) => { L.markerMeshes.push(mesh); guard(t); },   // write-ahead, then token check
      beforeScene: () => guard(t),
    };
    let marked = false;
    let isolated = false;
    try {
      // Release the previous presentation first (exact meshes; isolation only if this one won't isolate).
      for (const mesh of [...L.markerMeshes]) {
        guard(t);
        if (removeExact(mesh, notes)) L.markerMeshes.splice(L.markerMeshes.indexOf(mesh), 1);
      }
      if (!(isolate && liveSides.length > 0) && isolation.owns()) {
        isolation.restore({ beforeMutation: () => guard(t) });
      }
      guard(t);

      // (2) markers
      if (marker) {
        const loc = markers.addLocation({ point: req.point, closestPoints: req.closestPoints, radius }, hooks);
        if (loc.length === 0) notes.push(BRIDGE_NOTE.NO_LOCATION);
        const boundsOf = (model, dbId) => boxes[liveSides.findIndex((s) => s.model === model && s.dbId === dbId)] ?? null;
        const outl = markers.addOutlines(liveSides, boundsOf, hooks);   // bounds already read in step 1
        if (outl.omitted > 0) notes.push(BRIDGE_NOTE.NO_BOUNDS);
        marked = loc.length + outl.meshes.length > 0;
      }
      guard(t);

      // (3) isolation — only if requested and the §9.5 prerequisite holds (checked inside apply).
      if (isolate && liveSides.length > 0) {
        const r = isolation.apply(liveSides, { beforeMutation: () => guard(t) });
        isolated = r.applied;
        if (!r.applied) notes.push(r.reason);
      }
      guard(t);
    } catch (error) {
      const cleanup = releaseHeld();
      if (error instanceof Superseded) return outcome({ superseded: true });
      return outcome({ notes: [...notes, BRIDGE_NOTE.FAILED, ...cleanup.notes] });
    }

    // (4) fit — best-effort, last, outside the transaction guarantee.
    let fitted = false;
    if (focus && liveSides.length > 0) {
      const f = fitSides(viewerApi, liveSides, () => isLive(t));   // token re-checked before every camera call
      fitted = f.fitted;
      notes.push(...f.notes);
    }
    // Invalidated during fit: this presentation is stale. No camera rollback (OD-6); its markers/isolation stay
    // in the held ledger for the invalidator (clear/dispose/newer present) to release.
    if (!isLive(t)) return outcome({ superseded: true });
    return outcome({ fitted, isolated, marked, notes });
  }

  function present(req) {
    if (disposed) return Promise.resolve(DISPOSED_PRESENT);
    try { validateRequest(req); } catch (e) { return Promise.reject(e); }
    const t = ++seq;
    live = t;                                  // invalidates every earlier token immediately
    return queue.run(async () => {
      try {
        return await runPresent(t, req);
      } catch {                                // unexpected (non-Viewer) failure: clean, never reject
        const cleanup = releaseHeld();
        return outcome({ superseded: !isLive(t), notes: [BRIDGE_NOTE.FAILED, ...cleanup.notes] });
      }
    });
  }

  function clear() {
    if (disposed) return Promise.resolve(DISPOSED_CLEAR);
    seq += 1;
    live = 0;
    return queue.run(async () => Object.freeze(releaseHeld()));
  }

  function dispose() {
    if (disposePromise !== null) return disposePromise;
    disposed = true;
    seq += 1;
    live = 0;
    disposePromise = queue.run(async () => {
      try {
        try {
          releaseHeld();
        } finally {
          markers.removeAll();                 // anything a failed removal left behind
        }
      } finally {
        try { markers.disposeShared(); } finally { listeners.removeAll(); }
      }
    }).then(() => undefined, () => undefined);
    return disposePromise;
  }

  // Diagnostic read of the write-ahead ledger (tests; never used by the controller).
  function inspectLedger() {
    if (held === null) return null;
    return Object.freeze({ token: held.token, markerMeshes: Object.freeze([...held.markerMeshes]), isolation: isolation.record() });
  }

  return Object.freeze({ present, clear, dispose, inspectLedger });
}
```

```js
  h.viewer.failNext('fitToView', { afterEffect: true });
  assert.deepEqual(fitSides(h.api, [{ model: m1, dbId: 1 }]), { fitted: false, notes: [FIT_NOTE.FAILED] });

test('isCurrent is re-checked immediately before EVERY camera call: stale ⇒ no call (not even the fallback), superseded', () => {

  h.viewer.onCall('fitToView', () => { live = false; });            // … after the token was invalidated inside it
  assert.deepEqual(fitSides(h.api, [{ model: m1, dbId: 1 }, { model: m2, dbId: 2 }], () => live),
    { fitted: false, notes: [FIT_NOTE.FIRST_ONLY], superseded: true });
  assert.deepEqual(fits(h).map((c) => c[0]), ['aggregate'], 'zero fallback camera calls');
  assert.deepEqual(fitSides(h.api, [{ model: m1, dbId: 1 }], () => false), { fitted: false, notes: [], superseded: true });
  assert.deepEqual(fitSides(h.api, [{ model: m1, dbId: 1 }, { model: m2, dbId: 2 }], () => false), { fitted: false, notes: [], superseded: true });
  assert.equal(fits(h).length, 1, 'a stale token never moves the camera');
});
```
