```js
// clashpanel/viewer/fit.js
// Focus/fit (spec §9.2 "Focus / fit", §16 Framing). Best-effort, last, never rolled back: a failure
// only adds a note. Tier B: proven against fakes only; whether the aggregate (cross-model) form frames
// the true world-space union is a live gate (G2 / PG-1).
//   one model  -> public per-model fitToView(ids, model)
//   two models -> aggregate fit [{model, selection:[dbId]}, …] (unpublished; key MUST be `selection`)
//                 behind hasAggregateFit() + try/catch; fallback: fit the first side + note.

export const FIT_NOTE = Object.freeze({
  FIRST_ONLY: 'Framing first element only',
  FAILED: 'Could not frame the clash',
});

// isCurrent() is re-checked IMMEDIATELY before every camera call (aggregate, per-model and fallback): a
// stale presentation never moves the camera. Not current ⇒ no call, {fitted:false, superseded:true}; a camera
// move that already happened is never rolled back (OD-6).
export function fitSides(viewerApi, sides, isCurrent = () => true) {
  const notes = [];
  if (!Array.isArray(sides) || sides.length === 0) return { fitted: false, notes };
  const byModel = new Map();
  for (const s of sides) {
    if (!byModel.has(s.model)) byModel.set(s.model, new Set());
    byModel.get(s.model).add(s.dbId);
  }
  const perModel = [...byModel].map(([model, ids]) => ({ model, ids: [...ids].sort((a, b) => a - b) }));
  const stale = () => ({ fitted: false, notes, superseded: true });
  const fitOne = (entry) => {
    if (!isCurrent()) return stale();
    try { viewerApi.fitToView([...entry.ids], entry.model); return { fitted: true, notes }; } catch { notes.push(FIT_NOTE.FAILED); return { fitted: false, notes }; }
  };

  if (perModel.length === 1) return fitOne(perModel[0]);
  let aggregate = false;
  try { aggregate = viewerApi.hasAggregateFit() === true; } catch { aggregate = false; }
  if (aggregate) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return stale();
    try {
      viewerApi.fitToViewAggregate(perModel.map((e) => ({ model: e.model, selection: [...e.ids] })));
      return { fitted: true, notes };
    } catch { /* fall through to the per-model fallback (guarded again) */ }
  }
  notes.push(FIT_NOTE.FIRST_ONLY);
  return fitOne({ model: sides[0].model, ids: [sides[0].dbId] });
}
```

```js
// clashpanel/viewer/viewerApi.js
// The ONLY module under clashpanel/ that names Viewer3D methods: a narrow facade over a Viewer3D-shaped
// object (injected by the host). Tier B: every mapping below is source-observed against the pinned
// 7.124.2 bundle only (evidence doc 2026-09-26-viewer-clash-panel-viewer-api-evidence.md) and proven
// here against a shape-mimicking fake — NOTHING is SVF2- or runtime-verified (gates G1/G2, PG-1).
// No theming member is ever read or called (PD-16).

const isFn = (v) => typeof v === 'function';

export function createViewerApi(viewer, { events } = {}) {
  if (!viewer || !viewer.overlays) throw new TypeError('createViewerApi: a Viewer3D-shaped object with overlays is required');
  if (typeof events?.BEFORE_MODEL_UNLOAD !== 'string' || typeof events?.MODEL_REMOVED !== 'string') {
    throw new TypeError('createViewerApi: events {BEFORE_MODEL_UNLOAD, MODEL_REMOVED} names are required');
  }
  const overlays = viewer.overlays;

  return Object.freeze({
    eventNames: Object.freeze({ BEFORE_MODEL_UNLOAD: events.BEFORE_MODEL_UNLOAD, MODEL_REMOVED: events.MODEL_REMOVED }),

    getAllModels: () => viewer.getAllModels(),
    getAggregateIsolation: () => viewer.getAggregateIsolation(),
    getAggregateHiddenNodes: () => viewer.getAggregateHiddenNodes(),
    setAggregateIsolation: (list) => { viewer.setAggregateIsolation(list); },

    // Public per-model form: fitToView(ids, model, immediate).
    fitToView: (ids, model, immediate) => { viewer.fitToView(ids, model, immediate); },
    // Unpublished aggregate form, source-observed: fitToView([{model, selection}], model, immediate) is
    // treated as an aggregate selection when the first entry has a `model`; the key MUST be `selection`
    // (an `ids` key throws). The second argument is the model slot, so it is passed as undefined.
    // Whether it frames the true world-space union is UNVERIFIED (G2 / PG-1).
    hasAggregateFit: () => isFn(viewer.fitToView) && isFn(viewer.getAggregateSelection),
    fitToViewAggregate: (list, immediate) => {
      viewer.fitToView(list.map((e) => ({ model: e.model, selection: [...e.selection] })), undefined, immediate);
    },

    // Bundle and typings return {model, selection}; the reference pages name the key `selectionSet`.
    // Both are accepted and normalised to `selection`; malformed entries are dropped.
    getAggregateSelection: () => {
      const raw = viewer.getAggregateSelection();
      if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
      const out = [];
      for (const e of raw) {
        const ids = Array.isArray(e?.selection) ? e.selection : Array.isArray(e?.selectionSet) ? e.selectionSet : null;
        if (e && e.model && ids) out.push({ model: e.model, selection: [...ids] });
      }
      return out;
    },

    overlays: Object.freeze({
      hasScene: (name) => overlays.hasScene(name),
      addScene: (name) => overlays.addScene(name),
      addMesh: (mesh, name) => overlays.addMesh(mesh, name),          // mesh FIRST, scene name second
      removeMesh: (mesh, name) => overlays.removeMesh(mesh, name),
      removeScene: (name) => overlays.removeScene(name),
    }),

    // Element bounds for the outline overlay. getNodeBox fills a FLAT Float32Array(6)
    // [minx,miny,minz,maxx,maxy,maxz]. WORLD-SPACE CORRECTNESS IS UNVERIFIED (PG-1 / F7, gate G2): the
    // outline is evidence-gated and silently omitted whenever this returns null. The buffer is pre-filled
    // with NaN so an unknown dbId (left unfilled) reads as "unavailable", never as a zero box at the origin.
    getElementWorldBounds: (model, dbId) => {
      try {
        let tree = isFn(model?.getObjectTree) ? model.getObjectTree() : null;
        if (!tree || !isFn(tree.getNodeBox)) tree = isFn(model?.getInstanceTree) ? model.getInstanceTree() : null;
        if (!tree || !isFn(tree.getNodeBox)) return null;
        const box = new Float32Array(6).fill(Number.NaN);
        tree.getNodeBox(dbId, box);
        const out = Array.from(box);
        if (!out.every(Number.isFinite) || out[0] > out[3] || out[1] > out[4] || out[2] > out[5]) return null;
        return out;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    },

    addEventListener: (name, fn) => { viewer.addEventListener(name, fn); },
    removeEventListener: (name, fn) => { viewer.removeEventListener(name, fn); },
  });
}
```

  function checkIsolationPrerequisite() {
    if (disposed) return Object.freeze({ available: false, reason: 'The panel is closed' });
    const record = isolation.record();
    if (record !== null && record.confirmed) {
      const cur = readIsolation(viewerApi);
      if (cur !== null && isolationEquals(cur, record.target)) return Object.freeze({ available: true, reason: null });
    }
    return isolationPrerequisite(viewerApi);
  }

  function readAggregateSelection() {
    let raw;
    try { raw = viewerApi.getAggregateSelection(); } catch { return []; }
    if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
    const inScene = sceneModels();
    const out = [];
    for (const e of raw) {
      if (!isModel(e?.model) || !inScene.includes(e.model) || !Array.isArray(e.selection)) continue;
      const dbIds = [...new Set(e.selection.filter(isDbId))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      if (dbIds.length > 0) out.push(Object.freeze({ model: e.model, dbIds: Object.freeze(dbIds) }));
    }
    return Object.freeze(out);
  }

  let subscribed = false;
  function subscribeOnce() {
    if (subscribed) return;
    subscribed = true;
    const eventNames = viewerApi.eventNames ?? {};
    const relay = (reason) => (event) => {
      const model = event?.model;
      if (!isModel(model)) return;                 // payload guard: {model} required
      for (const cb of [...leftCallbacks]) { try { cb({ model, reason }); } catch { /* never throw into dispatch */ } }
    };
    if (typeof eventNames.BEFORE_MODEL_UNLOAD === 'string') listeners.add(eventNames.BEFORE_MODEL_UNLOAD, relay('unload'));
    if (typeof eventNames.MODEL_REMOVED === 'string') listeners.add(eventNames.MODEL_REMOVED, relay('removed'));
  }

  function onModelLeft(cb) {
    if (typeof cb !== 'function') throw new TypeError('onModelLeft: callback must be a function');
    if (disposed) return () => {};
    subscribeOnce();
    leftCallbacks.add(cb);
    return () => { leftCallbacks.delete(cb); };
  }

The wiring lands in THIS task because it is the first one with a DOM suite and a runner; from here every checkpoint is `npm test`. **The README updates land in the same commit** (the default prerequisite changes here, so the repository's test instructions change here, not later); they are documentation only and describe the aggregate gate, the Chromium prerequisite, and the split between the fake-based Panel DOM suite (in `npm test`) and the live acceptance scripts (never in `npm test`; live Viewer/SVF2 acceptance is never part of the default gate). Until T27 there is nothing to aggregate. The `DockingPanel` stub replicates the source-observed semantics of catalog §1 only; it proves nothing about the live Viewer 7.124.2 panel lifecycle (PG-1 / gate G3). No TCP server: `page.route('**/*')` answers `https://panel.test/**` from repo files and 404s everything else (no network). Served roots are exactly `clashpanel/` and `test/clashpanel/dom/support/` (`.js`/`.mjs` only): production `clashpanel/` imports nothing outside itself. The origin is **https** — a secure context, so `crypto.randomUUID` (the controller's default `mintId`) exists; it does not on `http://panel.test` (verified; see Notes). // test/clashpanel/domIsolation.test.mjs — DOM-suite isolation + default-gate wiring (Task 27; review H2).
// Runs INSIDE the offline suite: proves (1) the offline runner never collects a `*.dom.mjs` and no `*.test.mjs`
// imports the browser-automation package (the offline suite stays Chromium-free), and (2) the ONE default gate
// `npm test` runs BOTH suites through their own scripts, with no script recursion and no runner that re-enters npm.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', '..');
const SKIP = new Set(['node_modules', '.git']);
const PKG = ['play', 'wright'].join(''); // split so this file never matches its own scan

function walk(dir, predicate, out = []) {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (entry.isDirectory()) { if (!SKIP.has(entry.name)) walk(path.join(dir, entry.name), predicate, out); }
    else if (entry.isFile() && predicate(entry.name)) out.push(path.join(dir, entry.name));
  }
  return out;
}

test('scripts/run-tests.mjs collects ONLY *.test.mjs (its single file predicate)', () => {
  const src = readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'scripts', 'run-tests.mjs'), 'utf8');
  const predicates = src.match(/entry\.name\.endsWith\([^)]*\)/g) ?? [];
  assert.deepEqual(predicates, ["entry.name.endsWith('.test.mjs')"]);
});

test('every DOM test is *.dom.mjs, lives under test/clashpanel/dom/, and is not a *.test.mjs', () => {
  const domFiles = walk(path.join(ROOT, 'test', 'clashpanel', 'dom'), (n) => n.endsWith('.mjs'));
  assert.ok(domFiles.some((f) => f.endsWith('.dom.mjs')), 'at least the harness smoke test exists');
  for (const f of domFiles) assert.ok(!f.endsWith('.test.mjs'), `${path.relative(ROOT, f)} would be collected by the offline suite`);
  const strays = walk(ROOT, (n) => n.endsWith('.dom.mjs')).filter((f) => !f.startsWith(path.join(ROOT, 'test', 'clashpanel', 'dom') + path.sep));
  assert.deepEqual(strays, []);
});

test(`no *.test.mjs imports the ${PKG} package (Chromium is never part of the OFFLINE suite)`, () => {
  const pattern = new RegExp(`(from\\s*['"]${PKG}['"])|(import\\(\\s*['"]${PKG}['"]\\s*\\))|(require\\(\\s*['"]${PKG}['"]\\s*\\))`);
  const offenders = walk(ROOT, (n) => n.endsWith('.test.mjs'))
    .filter((f) => pattern.test(readFileSync(f, 'utf8')))
    .map((f) => path.relative(ROOT, f));
  assert.deepEqual(offenders, []);
});

const pkg = () => JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'package.json'), 'utf8'));

const flatDoc = (...parts) => readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, ...parts), 'utf8').replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

  // Negative guards: nothing may describe a live script as part of / included in the default gate.

// Script names a shell command line invokes through npm (`npm test`, `npm run x`); operators split the line.
function invoked(command) {
  const names = [];
  for (const part of String(command).split(/&&|\|\||;|\|/)) {
    const m = /^\s*npm\s+(?:run(?:-script)?\s+)?([^\s]+)/.exec(part);
    if (m) names.push(m[1] === 't' || m[1] === 'tst' ? 'test' : m[1]);
  }
  return names;
}

test('H2: no script recursion — the graph from `test` is acyclic, reaches both suites, and both runners spawn node (never npm)', () => {
  const { scripts } = pkg();
  const reached = new Set();
  const visit = (name, stack) => {
    assert.ok(!stack.includes(name), `script cycle: ${[...stack, name].join(' -> ')}`);
    assert.ok(Object.hasOwn(scripts, name), `npm script "${name}" is invoked but not defined`);
    reached.add(name);
    for (const next of invoked(scripts[name])) visit(next, [...stack, name]);
  };
  visit('test', []);
  assert.ok(reached.has('test:offline') && reached.has('test:clashpanel:dom'), `default gate reaches ${[...reached]}`);
  for (const runner of ['run-tests.mjs', 'run-dom-tests.mjs']) {
    const src = readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, 'scripts', runner), 'utf8');
    const spawned = [...src.matchAll(/\bspawn(?:Sync)?\(\s*([^,\s)]+)/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
    assert.deepEqual([...new Set(spawned)], ['process.execPath'], `${runner} may spawn only process.execPath (node --test)`);
    assert.ok(!/\bexec(?:Sync|File|FileSync)?\(/.test(src), `${runner} must not use exec*`);
  }
});

```js
// scripts/run-dom-tests.mjs
//
// Runner for the Viewer Clash Panel real-browser DOM tests (`npm run test:clashpanel:dom`, which the default gate
// `npm test` runs after the offline suite). Mirrors
// scripts/run-tests.mjs: its own recursive walk (no shell/Node glob), an explicit file list for `node --test`,
// fail-closed on zero files and on a signal-killed child. These files are named `*.dom.mjs` precisely so that
// the OFFLINE suite (`test:offline`, which collects only `*.test.mjs`) never launches Chromium.
//
// A missing Playwright package or Chromium binary is a FAILURE with an actionable message — never a silent skip.
import { readdirSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, relative } from 'node:path';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import process from 'node:process';

const ROOT = process.cwd();
const DOM_DIR = join(ROOT, 'test', 'clashpanel', 'dom');

function findDomTests(dir, out = []) {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (entry.isDirectory()) findDomTests(join(dir, entry.name), out);
    else if (entry.isFile() && entry.name.endsWith('.dom.mjs')) out.push(join(dir, entry.name));
  }
  return out;
}

if (!existsSync(DOM_DIR)) {
  console.error(`run-dom-tests.mjs: ${relative(ROOT, DOM_DIR)} does not exist (run from the repository root)`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const files = findDomTests(DOM_DIR).map((f) => relative(ROOT, f)).sort();
if (files.length === 0) {
  console.error('run-dom-tests.mjs: no *.dom.mjs files found under', relative(ROOT, DOM_DIR));
  process.exit(1);
}

let chromium;
try {
  ({ chromium } = await import('playwright'));
} catch (error) {
  console.error('run-dom-tests.mjs: the `playwright` devDependency is not installed (run `npm install`).', error?.message ?? '');
  process.exit(1);
}
// Probe with the harness's own launch args: a missing/incompatible browser build fails HERE with one clear message.
try {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--single-process', '--no-zygote'] });
  await browser.close();
} catch (error) {
  console.error(
    'run-dom-tests.mjs: Playwright could not launch Chromium, so the DOM suite cannot run (this is a FAILURE, not a skip).\n' +
    'Install the browser with `npx playwright install chromium` (see test/acceptance/README.md, "First-time setup").\n' +
    `Launch error: ${String(error?.message ?? error).split('\n')[0]}`,
  );
  process.exit(1);
}

// One browser at a time: each file launches its own single-process Chromium (see harness.mjs).
const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', '--test-concurrency=1', ...files], { stdio: 'inherit' });
process.exit(result.status === null ? 1 : result.status);
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/dom/support/harness.mjs
//
// Real-browser harness for the Viewer Clash Panel DOM tests (*.dom.mjs, run ONLY by `npm run test:clashpanel:dom`
// — which the default gate `npm test` includes — and never collected by the offline suite). One Chromium per withPage() call, closed in `finally`. No TCP server: every request to
// https://panel.test/ is answered by page.route from this repository's files, PATH-CONFINED to SERVED_ROOTS
// (anything else, including any `..` escape, is a 404). https (not http) so the page is a secure context
// (crypto.randomUUID exists, as it does for the real host on https/localhost).
//
// Launch args: see test/acceptance/README.md "Chromium launch args" (--single-process --no-zygote are needed in
// this repo's dev sandbox; harmless elsewhere).
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { installAutodeskStub } from './stubAutodesk.mjs';

export const REPO_ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', '..', '..', '..');
export const ORIGIN = 'https://panel.test';
export const LAUNCH_ARGS = Object.freeze(['--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--single-process', '--no-zygote']);

// Production clashpanel/ imports nothing outside clashpanel/ (only Node tests import clashtest/), so the page is
// confined to the package itself plus the browser-side test support. Nothing else is reachable.
export const SERVED_ROOTS = Object.freeze(['clashpanel/', 'test/clashpanel/dom/support/']);
const CONTENT_TYPES = Object.freeze({ '.js': 'text/javascript', '.mjs': 'text/javascript' });
const BLANK_PAGE = '<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>clash panel dom test</title></head><body></body></html>';

/** Maps a request pathname to an absolute repo file, or null when it is not servable (fail closed). */
export function resolveServedPath(pathname) {
  let decoded;
  try { decoded = decodeURIComponent(pathname); } catch { return null; }
  if (decoded.includes('\0') || decoded.includes('\\')) return null;
  const rel = decoded.replace(/^\/+/, '');
  if (rel.split('/').some((seg) => seg === '..' || seg === '.')) return null;
  if (!SERVED_ROOTS.some((root) => rel.startsWith(root))) return null;
  if (!Object.hasOwn(CONTENT_TYPES, path.extname(rel))) return null;
  const abs = path.resolve(REPO_ROOT, rel);
  const within = SERVED_ROOTS.some((root) => abs.startsWith(path.resolve(REPO_ROOT, root) + path.sep));
  return within ? abs : null;
}

async function serve(route) {
  const url = new URL(route.request().url());
  if (url.origin !== ORIGIN) return route.fulfill({ status: 404, contentType: 'text/plain', body: 'not served' });
  if (url.pathname === '/') return route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/html', body: BLANK_PAGE });
  const abs = resolveServedPath(url.pathname);
  if (abs === null) return route.fulfill({ status: 404, contentType: 'text/plain', body: 'not served' });
  try {
    const body = await readFile(abs, 'utf8');
    return route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: CONTENT_TYPES[path.extname(abs)], body });
  } catch {
    return route.fulfill({ status: 404, contentType: 'text/plain', body: 'not found' });
  }
}

/**
 * withPage(fn, { allowConsoleErrors = false }) — fn receives { page, consoleErrors, pageErrors }.
 * After fn resolves, console errors and page errors must be empty (unless allowConsoleErrors) — a test that
 * expects some (the confinement negative control) inspects and empties `consoleErrors` itself.
 */
export async function withPage(fn, { allowConsoleErrors = false } = {}) {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: [...LAUNCH_ARGS] });
  try {
    const page = await browser.newPage();
    const consoleErrors = [];
    const pageErrors = [];
    page.on('console', (msg) => { if (msg.type() === 'error') consoleErrors.push(msg.text()); });
    page.on('pageerror', (err) => { pageErrors.push(String(err?.message ?? err)); });
    await page.route('**/*', serve);
    await page.addInitScript(installAutodeskStub);
    await page.goto(`${ORIGIN}/`);
    const value = await fn({ page, consoleErrors, pageErrors });
    if (pageErrors.length > 0) throw new Error(`page errors: ${JSON.stringify(pageErrors)}`);
    if (!allowConsoleErrors && consoleErrors.length > 0) throw new Error(`console errors: ${JSON.stringify(consoleErrors)}`);
    return value;
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
}

/** Mounts one renderer (module path + export name) with a recording dispatch; see mount.mjs. */
export async function mountRenderer(page, modulePath, exportName, vmPart) {
  await page.evaluate(async ([m, e, vm]) => {
    const { mount } = await import('/test/clashpanel/dom/support/mount.mjs');
    await mount(m, e, vm);
  }, [modulePath, exportName, vmPart]);
}

/** Re-renders the mounted renderer with a new view-model part (same root, same dispatch). */
export async function rerender(page, vmPart) {
  await page.evaluate((vm) => window.__clash.render(vm), vmPart);
}

/** The intents dispatched so far (JSON copies), in order. */
export async function intents(page) {
  return page.evaluate(() => window.__clash.intents.slice());
}

/** Structured DOM snapshot of the mounted root (tag, key, text, value, checked, disabled, aria-*). */
export async function snapshot(page, selector = '#clash-root') {
  return page.evaluate(async (sel) => {
    const { snapshotDom } = await import('/test/clashpanel/dom/support/mount.mjs');
    return snapshotDom(document.querySelector(sel));
  }, selector);
}
```

// test/clashpanel/dom/support/stubAutodesk.mjs
//
// A browser-side stand-in for the parts of `Autodesk.Viewing.UI.DockingPanel` the Panel shell uses, replicating
// the source-observed Viewer 7.124.2 semantics recorded in the plan catalog §1 (undocumented members; the live
// lifecycle is gate G3/PG-1, NOT proven by this stub):
//   * constructor(parentContainer, id, title, options): creates + appends `container`, calls the overridable
//     `initialize()` (a subclass's own fields are NOT yet assigned at that point), then calls `setVisible(false)`;
//   * setVisible(show) toggles container.style.display and calls every visibility callback with the boolean;
//     after uninitialize() the container is null, so setVisible throws exactly like the real one would;
//   * addVisibilityListener(cb) is append-only — there is NO remove-listener;
//   * the default close button calls setVisible(false);
//   * uninitialize() removes the container from its parent and nulls it.
// `installAutodeskStub` is self-contained (it is serialized by page.addInitScript) and records every call in
// `window.Autodesk.__stubCalls` (instances in `__stubInstances`).
export function installAutodeskStub() {
  const calls = [];
  const instances = [];
  class DockingPanel {
    constructor(parentContainer, id, title, options = {}) {
      calls.push({ op: 'construct', id, title });
      instances.push(this);
      this.visibilityCallbacks = [];
      this.titleLabel = title;
      this.options = options;
      this.parentContainer = parentContainer;
      this.container = document.createElement('div');
      this.container.id = id;
      this.container.className = 'docking-panel';
      parentContainer.appendChild(this.container);
      this.initialize();
      this.setVisible(false);
    }
    initialize() {
      calls.push({ op: 'initialize:base' });
      this.title = this.createTitleBar(this.titleLabel || this.container.id);
      this.container.appendChild(this.title);
      this.closer = this.createCloseButton();
      this.container.appendChild(this.closer);
    }
    createTitleBar(text) {
      calls.push({ op: 'createTitleBar' });
      const bar = document.createElement('div');
      bar.className = 'docking-panel-title';
      bar.textContent = text;
      return bar;
    }
    createCloseButton() {
      calls.push({ op: 'createCloseButton' });
      const closer = document.createElement('div');
      closer.className = 'docking-panel-close';
      closer.addEventListener('click', () => this.setVisible(false));
      return closer;
    }
    initializeMoveHandlers() { calls.push({ op: 'initializeMoveHandlers' }); }
    setVisible(show) {
      calls.push({ op: 'setVisible', show: Boolean(show), afterUninitialize: this.container === null });
      this.container.style.display = show ? 'block' : 'none'; // throws TypeError after uninitialize (real behavior)
      for (const cb of this.visibilityCallbacks) cb(Boolean(show));
    }
    isVisible() { return this.container !== null && this.container.style.display === 'block'; }
    addVisibilityListener(cb) {
      calls.push({ op: 'addVisibilityListener' });
      this.visibilityCallbacks.push(cb);
    }
    uninitialize() {
      calls.push({ op: 'uninitialize' });
      if (this.container && this.container.parentNode) this.container.parentNode.removeChild(this.container);
      this.container = null;
      this.title = null;
      this.closer = null;
      this.parentContainer = null;
    }
  }
  window.Autodesk = {
    __stubCalls: calls,
    __stubInstances: instances,
    Viewing: {
      UI: { DockingPanel },
      BEFORE_MODEL_UNLOAD_EVENT: 'beforeModelUnload',
      MODEL_REMOVED_EVENT: 'modelRemoved',
    },
  };
}
```

```js
// test/clashpanel/dom/support/mount.mjs
//
// BROWSER-SIDE helper (imported in-page from https://panel.test/test/clashpanel/dom/support/mount.mjs). Mounts one
// renderer into <div id="clash-root"> with a dispatch that records JSON copies of every intent in
// window.__clash.intents. No Node imports.
export async function mount(modulePath, exportName, vmPart) {
  const mod = await import(modulePath);
  const render = mod[exportName];
  if (typeof render !== 'function') throw new TypeError(`${modulePath} has no export ${exportName}`);
  document.getElementById('clash-root')?.remove();
  const root = document.createElement('div');
  root.id = 'clash-root';
  document.body.appendChild(root);
  const intents = [];
  // dispatch resolves undefined, or window.__clash.reply(intent) when a test installs one (DIAGNOSTICS_COPY
  // resolves the diagnostics string in the real controller).
  const dispatch = (intent) => {
    intents.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(intent)));
    const reply = window.__clash.reply;
    return Promise.resolve(typeof reply === 'function' ? reply(intent) : undefined);
  };
  window.__clash = { root, intents, dispatch, reply: null, render: (vm) => render(root, vm, dispatch, document) };
  window.__clash.render(vmPart);
}

/** Order-preserving structural snapshot: enough to compare two renders of the same view-model. */
export function snapshotDom(root) {
  const out = [];
  const walk = (node, depth) => {
    for (const child of node.children) {
      const aria = {};
      for (const attr of child.attributes) {
        if (attr.name.startsWith('aria-') || attr.name === 'role' || attr.name === 'data-key' || attr.name === 'title' || attr.name === 'tabindex') aria[attr.name] = attr.value;
      }
      out.push({
        depth,
        tag: child.tagName.toLowerCase(),
        cls: child.className,
        own: [...child.childNodes].filter((n) => n.nodeType === 3).map((n) => n.data).join(''),
        value: 'value' in child && child.tagName !== 'LI' && child.tagName !== 'BUTTON' ? String(child.value) : null,
        checked: 'checked' in child ? child.checked : null,
        disabled: 'disabled' in child ? child.disabled : null,
        hidden: child.hidden,
        attrs: aria,
      });
      walk(child, depth + 1);
    }
  };
  if (root) walk(root, 0);
  return out;
}

### Task 28: Renderers: Test Setup + Run/Status

**Tier:** **[B] fake/injected-port ViewerBridge/UI (pre-SVF2)**

**Files:**
- Create: `clashpanel/ui/dom.js`, `clashpanel/ui/render/setup.js`, `clashpanel/ui/render/run.js`, `test/clashpanel/dom/support/vmFixtures.mjs`
- Modify: `test/clashpanel/scaffold.test.mjs` — append `'ui/dom.js'`, `'ui/render/setup.js'`, `'ui/render/run.js'` to `EXPECTED_MODULES` (T1 convention)
- Test: `test/clashpanel/dom/dom.dom.mjs`, `test/clashpanel/dom/setup.dom.mjs`, `test/clashpanel/dom/run.dom.mjs`

**Scope note:** renderers are pure functions of their ViewModel part: each call rebuilds its root (idempotent) and restores focus + caret of the active `data-key` element (`rebuild`). All text goes through `textContent`; attribute values through `setAttribute`; `el()` refuses `on*` attributes (belt-and-braces beside T1's static ban). Radio `name`s are namespaced per mounted panel (`instanceNs(root)`: the nearest ancestor's `data-clash-ns`, else a fresh module-counter value stamped on the root; `renderPanel` stamps its root once), so two panels in one document never share a radio group. Region 1 renders a `setup-toggle-collapsed` button (`aria-expanded`) in both states → `INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_COLLAPSED`. Region 2: a banner's `action: {label, intent}` renders one button (text `label`) dispatching a copy of `intent` (malformed actions render nothing); `run.diagnostics: {available:true, preview:string[]}` renders the preview lines and a "Copy diagnostics" button whose `await dispatch({type: DIAGNOSTICS_COPY})` RESOLVES the full string, written with `doc.defaultView.navigator.clipboard.writeText` when present (absent clipboard / non-string reply ⇒ nothing copied, nothing thrown); `run.details: {lines:[{label,value}]}` renders a native `<details>` "Run details" with `<dt>/<dd>` rows, whose presentational `open` state is carried across re-renders; "Clear results" (`RESULTS_CLEAR`) renders whenever `run.state === 'done'`. `vmFixtures.mjs` is created complete here (all five parts) — plain JSON in the catalog §4 shape; later tasks only import it. Region 2 keeps one persistent `role=status aria-live=polite` node and only rewrites its text (a re-created live region is not reliably announced). No ETA/throughput/telemetry text (PD-13).

**Intent payloads:** exactly as documented in the header of Part 3's `clashpanel/core/intents.js` (e.g. `FILTER_MODEL {value: string[]}`, `[]` = all; `NAV_PAGE {page}` 0-based like `vm.results.page.index`; `SETUP_CLEARANCE`/`FILTER_MAX_GAP` raw strings). `dispatch()` resolves `undefined` for every intent except `DIAGNOSTICS_COPY`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `INTENT` from `clashpanel/core/intents.js` (Part 3 T16: catalog names + `SETUP_TOGGLE_COLLAPSED: 'setup/toggleCollapsed'`); `vm.setup` / `vm.run` shapes (catalog §4 `ViewModel` + Part 3 additions `Banner.action = {label, intent}`, `run.diagnostics: null|{available:true, preview:string[]}`, `run.details: null|{lines:[{label,value}]}` — rendered only when present); harness exports of T27.
- Produces: `dom.js`: `el(doc, tag, { class?, attrs?, props?, text?, on? }, children?) -> Element`, `setText(node, str)`, `clear(node)`, `findByKey(root, key) -> Element|null`, `rebuild(root, doc, build)`, `instanceNs(root) -> string`, `NS_ATTR = 'data-clash-ns'`; `render/setup.js`: `renderSetup(root, setup, dispatch, doc)`; `render/run.js`: `renderRun(root, run, dispatch, doc)`, `stateLabel(run) -> string`; `vmFixtures.mjs`: `HOSTILE`, `HOSTILE2`, `setupVm`, `runVm`, `filtersVm`, `side`, `resultRow`, `groupRow`, `resultsVm`, `selectedVm`, `panelVm` (each `(over = {})` shallow-merged).
- **Depends on:** T27; T16 (`clashpanel/core/intents.js`, imported by path — T1's ui allow-list permits `clashpanel/core/{constants,intents}.js`, resolved).

// test/clashpanel/dom/support/vmFixtures.mjs
//
// Plain-JSON ViewModel parts (shape frozen in plan catalog §4, core/viewModel.js) for the DOM renderer tests.
// Renderers are pure functions of the ViewModel, so these literals are sufficient; no controller is involved.
// Each builder takes a shallow `over` object merged at the top level of that part. No imports; no Node APIs.
export const HOSTILE = '<img src=x onerror=window.__pwned=1>';
export const HOSTILE2 = '"><script>window.__pwned=2</script>';

export function setupVm(over = {}) {
  return {
    collapsed: false,
    summary: 'Clash test 1 · Hard · A: Architecture · B: Structure',
    name: 'Clash test 1',
    mode: 'hard',
    softAvailability: { available: true, pending: false, explanation: null },
    clearance: { value: '', visible: false, error: null },
    models: [
      { modelKey: 'mA', displayName: 'Architecture', ready: true, registered: true, inA: true, inB: false, note: null },
      { modelKey: 'mB', displayName: 'Structure', ready: true, registered: true, inA: false, inB: true, note: null },
      { modelKey: 'mC', displayName: 'Mechanical', ready: false, registered: true, inA: false, inB: false, note: 'Model Mechanical is still loading' },
    ],
    selfClash: false,
    useSelectionEnabled: true,
    scope: { A: '1 model', B: '1 model' },
    validation: { state: 'ready', messages: [], issuesTruncated: false },
    setupChangedSinceRun: false,
    ...over,
  };
}

export function runVm(over = {}) {
  return {
    state: 'idle', doneKind: null, canRun: true, canStop: false,
    progress: null, headline: 'Ready to run',
    counts: { total: null, filtered: null },
    badges: null, banners: [], diagnostics: null, details: null, statusLive: 'Ready to run', waitingForOtherRun: false,
    ...over,
  };
}

export function filtersVm(over = {}) {
  return {
    text: '', models: [],
    modelOptions: [{ modelKey: 'mA', label: 'Architecture' }, { modelKey: 'mB', label: 'Structure' }],
    maxGap: { visible: false, value: '', max: null, error: null },
    unverified: false, hasLocation: false, elementOnly: null,
    groupBy: 'none', groupingNote: null,
    sort: 'default',
    sortOptions: [{ value: 'default', label: 'Default' }, { value: 'gap-asc', label: 'Gap (smallest first)' }],
    active: false, busy: false,
    ...over,
  };
}

export function side(modelKey, modelName, label, dbId) {
  return { modelKey, modelName, label, dbId };
}

export function resultRow(i, over = {}) {
  const resultId = `r${i}`;
  return {
    kind: 'result', key: `-|${resultId}`, resultId, groupId: null, ordinal: i + 1,
    side1: side('mA', 'Architecture', `Wall-${i}`, 100 + i),
    side2: side('mB', 'Structure', `Beam-${i}`, 200 + i),
    gap: null, badges: [], liveness: 'live', selected: false,
    ...over,
  };
}

export function groupRow(groupId, over = {}) {
  return { kind: 'group', key: `g|${groupId}`, groupId, label: `Group ${groupId}`, count: 3, filteredCount: 3, expanded: false, ...over };
}

export function resultsVm(over = {}) {
  return {
    state: 'list', message: null, lines: [], view: 'flat',
    page: { index: 0, count: 1, size: 50 },
    rows: [resultRow(0), resultRow(1), resultRow(2)],
    multiValuedNote: null, hiddenByFiltersNote: false,
    nav: { canPrev: false, canNext: true, label: 'No clash selected' },
    ...over,
  };
}

export function selectedVm(over = {}) {
  return {
    resultId: 'r1', ordinal: 2,
    side1: side('mA', 'Architecture', 'Wall-1', 101),
    side2: side('mB', 'Structure', 'Beam-1', 201),
    gap: null, hasLocation: true, liveness: 'live', notes: [], hiddenByFilters: false,
    actions: {
      focus: { enabled: true, reason: null },
      isolate: { enabled: true, checked: false, reason: null },
      markers: { enabled: true, checked: true, reason: null },
      focusOnSelect: { checked: true },
      backToAll: { enabled: true },
    },
    ...over,
  };
}

export function panelVm(over = {}) {
  return {
    version: 1,
    setup: setupVm(), run: runVm(), filters: filtersVm(), results: resultsVm(), selected: selectedVm(),
    ...over,
  };
}

// test/clashpanel/dom/dom.dom.mjs — the ui/dom.js helpers (Task 28).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { withPage } from './support/harness.mjs';

test('el(): text goes through textContent, attribute values are inert, on* attributes are refused', () => withPage(async ({ page }) => {
  const r = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const { el } = await import('/clashpanel/ui/dom.js');
    const hostile = '<img src=x onerror=window.__pwned=1>';
    const node = el(document, 'p', { class: 'c', attrs: { title: hostile, 'data-x': '"><b>' }, text: hostile }, [el(document, 'span', { text: 'kid' }), null, false]);
    document.body.appendChild(node);
    let refused = null;
    try { el(document, 'div', { attrs: { onclick: 'alert(1)' } }); } catch (e) { refused = e.name; }
    let refusedUpper = null;
    try { el(document, 'div', { attrs: { OnMouseOver: 'x' } }); } catch (e) { refusedUpper = e.name; }
    return {
      text: node.firstChild.data, title: node.getAttribute('title'), kids: node.children.length,
      imgs: document.querySelectorAll('img').length, bolds: document.querySelectorAll('b').length, refused, refusedUpper,
    };
  });
  assert.deepEqual(r, { text: '<img src=x onerror=window.__pwned=1>', title: '<img src=x onerror=window.__pwned=1>', kids: 1, imgs: 0, bolds: 0, refused: 'TypeError', refusedUpper: 'TypeError' });
}));

test('el(): false/null attributes are omitted, true becomes a boolean attribute; props are assigned', () => withPage(async ({ page }) => {
  const r = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const { el } = await import('/clashpanel/ui/dom.js');
    const input = el(document, 'input', { attrs: { disabled: false, hidden: null, required: true, type: 'checkbox' }, props: { checked: true } });
    return { disabled: input.hasAttribute('disabled'), hidden: input.hasAttribute('hidden'), required: input.getAttribute('required'), checked: input.checked };
  });
  assert.deepEqual(r, { disabled: false, hidden: false, required: '', checked: true });
}));

test('findByKey(): matches data-key literally (no selector parsing of untrusted keys)', () => withPage(async ({ page }) => {
  const r = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const { el, findByKey } = await import('/clashpanel/ui/dom.js');
    const weird = 'g|"]*,<x>';
    const root = el(document, 'div', {}, [el(document, 'button', { attrs: { 'data-key': 'a' } }), el(document, 'button', { attrs: { 'data-key': weird }, text: 'w' })]);
    return { hit: findByKey(root, weird)?.textContent ?? null, miss: findByKey(root, 'nope') };
  });
  assert.deepEqual(r, { hit: 'w', miss: null });
}));

test('rebuild(): replaces children, restores focus + caret by data-key, leaves focus alone when outside root', () => withPage(async ({ page }) => {
  const r = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const { el, rebuild } = await import('/clashpanel/ui/dom.js');
    const root = el(document, 'div');
    const outside = el(document, 'input', { attrs: { 'data-key': 'outside' } });
    document.body.append(root, outside);
    const build = (v) => () => root.appendChild(el(document, 'input', { attrs: { 'data-key': 'k' }, props: { value: v } }));
    rebuild(root, document, build('hello'));
    const first = root.firstChild;
    first.focus();
    first.setSelectionRange(2, 4);
    rebuild(root, document, build('hello world'));
    const a = { replaced: root.firstChild !== first, count: root.children.length, key: document.activeElement.getAttribute('data-key'), s: document.activeElement.selectionStart, e: document.activeElement.selectionEnd };
    outside.focus();
    rebuild(root, document, build('x'));
    return { ...a, stillOutside: document.activeElement === outside };
  });
  assert.deepEqual(r, { replaced: true, count: 1, key: 'k', s: 2, e: 4, stillOutside: true });
}));

test('clear() and setText() are total (null/undefined become empty text)', () => withPage(async ({ page }) => {
  const r = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const { el, clear, setText } = await import('/clashpanel/ui/dom.js');
    const n = el(document, 'div', {}, [el(document, 'span'), el(document, 'span')]);
    clear(n);
    const kids = n.childNodes.length;
    setText(n, null);
    const a = n.textContent;
    setText(n, 42);
    return { kids, a, b: n.textContent };
  });
  assert.deepEqual(r, { kids: 0, a: '', b: '42' });
}));

```js
// clashpanel/ui/dom.js
//
// The ONLY DOM construction helpers of the Panel view. Spec §8.2 / AC-P13: every model name, element label,
// error message and diagnostic text is untrusted external text, so text reaches the DOM ONLY through
// `textContent` (and attribute VALUES through setAttribute, which never parses markup). This module — and all of
// clashpanel/ui — never parses HTML (static ban in the layering guard, Task 1).

/** Creates an element. opts: { class, attrs: {name: value}, text, on: {event: handler}, props: {name: value} } */
export function el(doc, tag, opts = {}, children = []) {
  const node = doc.createElement(tag);
  if (opts.class) node.className = opts.class;
  if (opts.attrs) {
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(opts.attrs)) {
      if (value === null || value === undefined || value === false) continue;
      if (/^on/i.test(name)) throw new TypeError(`el(): event-handler attribute "${name}" is not allowed; use opts.on`);
      node.setAttribute(name, value === true ? '' : String(value));
    }
  }
  if (opts.props) {
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(opts.props)) node[name] = value;
  }
  if (opts.text !== undefined && opts.text !== null) node.textContent = String(opts.text);
  if (opts.on) {
    for (const [event, handler] of Object.entries(opts.on)) node.addEventListener(event, handler);
  }
  for (const child of children) {
    if (child !== null && child !== undefined && child !== false) node.appendChild(child);
  }
  return node;
}

export function setText(node, str) {
  node.textContent = str === null || str === undefined ? '' : String(str);
}

export function clear(node) {
  while (node.firstChild) node.removeChild(node.firstChild);
}

/** Returns the descendant of `root` whose data-key equals `key` (no selector parsing of untrusted keys). */
export function findByKey(root, key) {
  for (const node of root.querySelectorAll('[data-key]')) {
    if (node.getAttribute('data-key') === key) return node;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Rebuilds `root` with `build()` while preserving focus and caret of the active element when that element
 * lives inside `root` and carries a data-key (spec §14.4: re-render must not steal the user's input).
 */
export function rebuild(root, doc, build) {
  const active = doc.activeElement;
  let saved = null;
  if (active && active !== doc.body && root.contains(active) && active.hasAttribute('data-key')) {
    saved = { key: active.getAttribute('data-key'), start: null, end: null };
    try {
      saved.start = active.selectionStart;
      saved.end = active.selectionEnd;
    } catch { /* inputs without a text selection (checkbox, radio) */ }
  }
  const scrollTop = root.scrollTop;
  clear(root);
  build();
  root.scrollTop = scrollTop;
  if (saved) {
    const next = findByKey(root, saved.key);
    if (next && typeof next.focus === 'function') {
      next.focus();
      if (saved.start !== null && typeof next.setSelectionRange === 'function') {
        try { next.setSelectionRange(saved.start, saved.end); } catch { /* not a text control */ }
      }
    }
  }
}

// Per-mounted-panel namespace for document-global names (radio groups): two panels in one document must never
// share a radio group. renderPanel() stamps its root; a region rendered on its own gets its own namespace.
let nsCounter = 0;
export const NS_ATTR = 'data-clash-ns';
export function instanceNs(root) {
  const owner = root.closest(`[${NS_ATTR}]`);
  if (owner) return owner.getAttribute(NS_ATTR);
  nsCounter += 1;
  const ns = `clash-${nsCounter}`;
  root.setAttribute(NS_ATTR, ns);
  return ns;
}

```js
// clashpanel/ui/render/setup.js — Region 1 TEST SETUP (spec §6.1, §6.2, §14.3, §14.4).
// Pure function of vm.setup: renders it and translates DOM events into INTENT values. Holds no state.
import { el, rebuild, instanceNs } from '../dom.js';
import { INTENT } from '../../core/intents.js';

const SIDES = Object.freeze(['A', 'B']);

function modelChecklist(doc, setup, side, dispatch) {
  const items = setup.models.map((m, i) => {
    const key = m.modelKey === null ? `setup-${side}-#${i}` : `setup-${side}-${m.modelKey}`;
    const checked = side === 'A' ? m.inA : m.inB;
    const box = el(doc, 'input', {
      attrs: { type: 'checkbox', 'data-key': key, disabled: m.modelKey === null },
      props: { checked: Boolean(checked) },
      on: { change: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_MODEL, side, modelKey: m.modelKey }) },
    });
    const state = [];
    if (!m.registered) state.push('not registered');
    else if (!m.ready) state.push('loading');
    return el(doc, 'li', { class: 'clash-model' }, [
      el(doc, 'label', {}, [box, el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-model-name', text: m.displayName })]),
      state.length > 0 ? el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-model-state', text: ` (${state.join(', ')})` }) : null,
      m.note ? el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-model-note', text: ` ${m.note}` }) : null,
    ]);
  });
  return el(doc, 'fieldset', { class: `clash-set clash-set-${side}`, attrs: { 'data-side': side } }, [
    el(doc, 'legend', { text: `Set ${side}` }),
    el(doc, 'ul', { class: 'clash-model-list' }, items),
    el(doc, 'button', {
      attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': `setup-use-selection-${side}`, disabled: !setup.useSelectionEnabled },
      text: 'Use selection',
      on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_USE_SELECTION, side }) },
    }),
    el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-set-scope', text: setup.scope[side] }),
  ]);
}

function modeSelector(doc, setup, dispatch, ns) {
  const soft = setup.softAvailability;
  const radio = (value, label, disabled) => el(doc, 'label', { class: `clash-mode-${value}` }, [
    el(doc, 'input', {
      attrs: { type: 'radio', name: `${ns}-setup-mode`, value, 'data-key': `setup-mode-${value}`, disabled },
      props: { checked: setup.mode === value },
      on: { change: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_MODE, value }) },
    }),
    el(doc, 'span', { text: label }),
  ]);
  return el(doc, 'fieldset', { class: 'clash-mode', attrs: { role: 'radiogroup' } }, [
    el(doc, 'legend', { text: 'Mode' }),
    radio('hard', 'Hard', false),
    radio('soft', 'Soft', !soft.available),
    soft.pending ? el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-soft-pending', text: 'Checking whether Soft is available…' }) : null,
    soft.explanation ? el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-soft-explanation', attrs: { role: 'note' }, text: soft.explanation }) : null,
  ]);
}

function clearanceField(doc, setup, dispatch) {
  const c = setup.clearance;
  if (!c.visible) return null;
  return el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-clearance' }, [
    el(doc, 'label', {}, [
      el(doc, 'span', { text: 'Clearance ' }),
      el(doc, 'input', {
        attrs: { type: 'text', inputmode: 'decimal', 'data-key': 'setup-clearance', 'aria-invalid': c.error ? 'true' : null },
        props: { value: c.value },
        on: { input: (e) => dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_CLEARANCE, value: e.target.value }) },
      }),
    ]),
    c.error ? el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-field-error', text: c.error }) : null,
  ]);
}

function validationBlock(doc, v) {
  const ready = v.state === 'ready';
  return el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-validation', attrs: { 'data-state': v.state } }, [
    el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-validation-head', text: ready ? '✔ Ready' : '✖ Not ready' }),
    v.messages.length > 0
      ? el(doc, 'ul', { class: 'clash-validation-list' }, v.messages.map((m) => el(doc, 'li', { attrs: { 'data-control': m.control }, text: m.text })))
      : null,
    v.issuesTruncated ? el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-validation-truncated', text: 'More issues were found than are listed here.' }) : null,
  ]);
}

export function renderSetup(root, setup, dispatch, doc) {
  const ns = instanceNs(root);
  rebuild(root, doc, () => {
    const newTest = el(doc, 'button', {
      attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'setup-new-test' },
      text: 'New test',
      on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_NEW_TEST }) },
    });
    const toggle = el(doc, 'button', {
      class: 'clash-setup-toggle',
      attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'setup-toggle-collapsed', 'aria-expanded': setup.collapsed ? 'false' : 'true' },
      text: setup.collapsed ? '▸ Show setup' : '▾ Hide setup',
      on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_TOGGLE_COLLAPSED }) },
    });
    if (setup.collapsed) {
      root.appendChild(el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-setup clash-setup-collapsed', attrs: { 'data-state': 'collapsed' } }, [
        toggle,
        el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-setup-summary', text: setup.summary }),
        newTest,
      ]));
      return;
    }
    root.appendChild(el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-setup', attrs: { 'data-state': 'expanded' } }, [
      toggle,
      el(doc, 'label', { class: 'clash-name' }, [
        el(doc, 'span', { text: 'Test name ' }),
        el(doc, 'input', {
          attrs: { type: 'text', 'data-key': 'setup-name' },
          props: { value: setup.name },
          on: { input: (e) => dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_NAME, value: e.target.value }) },
        }),
      ]),
      modeSelector(doc, setup, dispatch, ns),
      clearanceField(doc, setup, dispatch),
      modelChecklist(doc, setup, SIDES[0], dispatch),
      setup.selfClash ? null : modelChecklist(doc, setup, SIDES[1], dispatch),
      el(doc, 'label', { class: 'clash-self-clash' }, [
        el(doc, 'input', {
          attrs: { type: 'checkbox', 'data-key': 'setup-self-clash' },
          props: { checked: setup.selfClash },
          on: { change: (e) => dispatch({ type: INTENT.SETUP_SELF_CLASH, value: e.target.checked }) },
        }),
        el(doc, 'span', { text: 'Self-clash (Set A against itself)' }),
      ]),
      validationBlock(doc, setup.validation),
      setup.setupChangedSinceRun ? el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-setup-changed', text: 'The setup has changed since the last run.' }) : null,
      newTest,
    ]));
  });
}

```js
// clashpanel/ui/render/run.js — Region 2 RUN / STATUS (spec §7.1–§7.3, §13, §14.4).
// Progress only from vm.run.progress (RunProgress fractions/counts + the Panel's own elapsed text): no ETA,
// no throughput, no telemetry (PD-13). The aria-live status node is created once and only its text changes, so
// assistive technology announces updates instead of seeing a new live region on every render.
import { el, rebuild, setText } from '../dom.js';
import { INTENT } from '../../core/intents.js';

const STATE_LABEL = Object.freeze({
  idle: 'Idle', preparing: 'Preparing', planning: 'Planning', running: 'Running',
  stopping: 'Stopping', finalizing: 'Finalizing',
});
const DONE_LABEL = Object.freeze({ completed: 'Completed', cancelled: 'Cancelled', failed: 'Failed', invalidated: 'Invalidated' });

export function stateLabel(run) {
  if (run.state === 'done') return DONE_LABEL[run.doneKind] ?? 'Done';
  return STATE_LABEL[run.state] ?? run.state;
}

function progressBlock(doc, p) {
  if (!p) return null;
  const determinate = typeof p.fraction === 'number' && Number.isFinite(p.fraction);
  const pct = determinate ? Math.round(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, p.fraction)) * 100) : null;
  const bar = el(doc, 'progress', {
    attrs: {
      max: '1', 'aria-label': 'Run progress',
      'aria-valuemin': determinate ? '0' : null, 'aria-valuemax': determinate ? '100' : null,
      'aria-valuenow': determinate ? String(pct) : null,
      'aria-valuetext': determinate ? `${pct}%` : 'progress not yet known',
    },
  });
  if (determinate) bar.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, p.fraction));
  return el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-progress' }, [
    bar,
    el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-progress-pct', text: determinate ? ` ${pct}%` : '' }),
    el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-progress-units', text: ` units ${p.unitsEvaluated}/${p.unitsTotal}` }),
    el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-progress-found', text: ` found ${p.resultsFound}` }),
    el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-progress-caveats', text: ` caveats ${p.caveatCount}` }),
    el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-progress-elapsed', text: ` ${p.elapsedText}` }),
  ]);
}

function countsLine(doc, counts) {
  if (!counts || counts.total === null) return null;
  const parts = [`${counts.total} ${counts.total === 1 ? 'clash' : 'clashes'}`];
  if (counts.filtered !== null && counts.filtered !== undefined) parts.push(`${counts.filtered} match filters`);
  return el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-counts', text: parts.join(' · ') });
}

function badgesBlock(doc, badges) {
  if (!badges) return null;
  const fresh = badges.freshness;
  return el(doc, 'ul', { class: 'clash-badges' }, [
    el(doc, 'li', { class: 'clash-badge-coverage', attrs: { 'data-value': badges.coverage.value }, text: `Coverage: ${badges.coverage.label}` }),
    el(doc, 'li', { class: 'clash-badge-integrity', attrs: { 'data-value': badges.integrity.value }, text: `Integrity: ${badges.integrity.label}` }),
    el(doc, 'li', {
      class: 'clash-badge-freshness',
      attrs: { 'data-value': fresh.value, 'aria-busy': fresh.pending ? 'true' : null },
      text: fresh.pending ? 'Freshness: checking…' : `Freshness: ${fresh.label}`,
    }),
  ]);
}

// Banner.action = {label, intent}: the controller names the exact intent its button dispatches (catalog §4 as
// amended by Part 3). The label is untrusted-safe plain text; the intent is dispatched as a copy.
function bannerBlock(doc, banner, dispatch) {
  const action = banner.action && typeof banner.action.label === 'string' && typeof banner.action.intent?.type === 'string'
    ? banner.action : null;
  return el(doc, 'div', {
    class: `clash-banner clash-banner-${banner.kind}`,
    attrs: { 'data-banner-id': banner.id, role: banner.kind === 'error' ? 'alert' : null },
  }, [
    el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-banner-text', text: banner.text }),
    Array.isArray(banner.details) && banner.details.length > 0
      ? el(doc, 'ul', { class: 'clash-banner-details' }, banner.details.map((d) => el(doc, 'li', { text: d })))
      : null,
    action
      ? el(doc, 'button', {
        attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': `banner-${banner.id}-action` },
        text: action.label,
        on: { click: () => dispatch({ ...action.intent }) },
      })
      : null,
  ]);
}

// "Copy diagnostics": dispatch(DIAGNOSTICS_COPY) RESOLVES with the full plain-JSON string (or null); the view
// copies it with the Clipboard API when the page offers one. No clipboard ⇒ nothing is copied, nothing throws.
async function copyDiagnostics(doc, dispatch) {
  const text = await dispatch({ type: INTENT.DIAGNOSTICS_COPY });
  const clipboard = doc.defaultView?.navigator?.clipboard;
  if (typeof text !== 'string' || typeof clipboard?.writeText !== 'function') return false;
  try {
    await clipboard.writeText(text);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function diagnosticsBlock(doc, diagnostics, dispatch) {
  if (!diagnostics || diagnostics.available !== true) return null;
  return el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-diagnostics' }, [
    el(doc, 'ul', { class: 'clash-diagnostics-preview' }, (diagnostics.preview ?? []).map((line) => el(doc, 'li', { text: line }))),
    el(doc, 'button', {
      attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'diagnostics-copy' },
      text: 'Copy diagnostics',
      on: { click: () => { void copyDiagnostics(doc, dispatch); } },
    }),
  ]);
}

// Spec §8.4 Run details: a native <details> disclosure of label/value rows (plain text).
function detailsBlock(doc, details, wasOpen) {
  if (!details || !Array.isArray(details.lines) || details.lines.length === 0) return null;
  return el(doc, 'details', { class: 'clash-run-details', props: { open: wasOpen } }, [
    el(doc, 'summary', { attrs: { 'data-key': 'run-details' }, text: 'Run details' }),
    el(doc, 'dl', {}, details.lines.flatMap((line) => [
      el(doc, 'dt', { text: line.label }),
      el(doc, 'dd', { text: line.value }),
    ])),
  ]);
}

export function renderRun(root, run, dispatch, doc) {
  let body = null;
  let status = null;
  for (const child of root.children) {
    if (child.classList.contains('clash-run-body')) body = child;
    else if (child.classList.contains('clash-status')) status = child;
  }
  if (!body) {
    body = el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-run-body' });
    root.insertBefore(body, root.firstChild);
  }
  if (!status) {
    status = el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-status', attrs: { role: 'status', 'aria-live': 'polite' } });
    root.appendChild(status);
  }
  // The disclosure's open state is presentational DOM state: carried over a re-render, never sent anywhere.
  const detailsWasOpen = body.querySelector('.clash-run-details')?.open === true;
  rebuild(body, doc, () => {
    const done = run.state === 'done';
    body.appendChild(el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-run-actions' }, [
      el(doc, 'button', {
        attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'run-start', disabled: !run.canRun },
        text: 'Run clash test',
        on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_START }) },
      }),
      el(doc, 'button', {
        attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'run-stop', disabled: !run.canStop },
        text: 'Stop',
        on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.RUN_STOP }) },
      }),
      done ? el(doc, 'button', {
        attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'results-clear' },
        text: 'Clear results',
        on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.RESULTS_CLEAR }) },
      }) : null,
    ]));
    body.appendChild(el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-run-state', attrs: { 'data-state': run.state } }, [
      el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-run-state-label', text: stateLabel(run) }),
      run.headline ? el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-run-headline', text: ` · ${run.headline}` }) : null,
    ]));
    if (run.waitingForOtherRun) body.appendChild(el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-run-waiting', text: 'Waiting for another run to finish…' }));
    const progress = progressBlock(doc, run.progress);
    if (progress) body.appendChild(progress);
    const counts = countsLine(doc, run.counts);
    if (counts) body.appendChild(counts);
    const badges = badgesBlock(doc, run.badges);
    if (badges) body.appendChild(badges);
    if (run.banners.length > 0) {
      body.appendChild(el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-banners' }, run.banners.map((b) => bannerBlock(doc, b, dispatch))));
    }
    const diagnostics = diagnosticsBlock(doc, run.diagnostics, dispatch);
    if (diagnostics) body.appendChild(diagnostics);
    const details = detailsBlock(doc, run.details, detailsWasOpen);
    if (details) body.appendChild(details);
  });
  if (status.textContent !== (run.statusLive ?? '')) setText(status, run.statusLive);
}
```

### Task 29: Renderers: Filters/Grouping + Results list/pagination

**Tier:** **[B] fake/injected-port ViewerBridge/UI (pre-SVF2)**

**Files:**
- Create: `clashpanel/ui/render/filters.js`, `clashpanel/ui/render/results.js`
- Modify: `test/clashpanel/scaffold.test.mjs` — append `'ui/render/filters.js'`, `'ui/render/results.js'` to `EXPECTED_MODULES`
- Test: `test/clashpanel/dom/filters.dom.mjs`, `test/clashpanel/dom/results.dom.mjs`

**Scope note:** the UI dispatches every filter change immediately (the controller debounces, AC-P4). Model filter: `filters.models` is list-valued (the controller accepts `FILTER_MODEL {value:[a,b]}`) but the UI is single-select — with ≥2 models it shows an honest, disabled, selected `Multiple models (n)` option; picking a model dispatches `[key]`, picking "All models" dispatches `[]`. Region 4 renders exactly `vm.results.rows` — the controller has already sliced one page (`PAGE_SIZE`, T14/T17); the renderer never slices, virtualizes, or renders more. Rows: `<li role=option tabindex=0 aria-selected>` inside `role=listbox`; click / Enter / Space → `NAV_SELECT`. Group headers are native `<button aria-expanded>`. Row text: `#ordinal model · label · #dbId ↔ …` (the `#dbId` suffix is omitted when the label already is the `#dbId` fallback, spec §8.2), gap only when non-null (Soft), badges, liveness when not `live`. Non-list states (`before-run`, `running`, `empty-claim`, `empty-nonclaim`, `empty-filtered`, `error`) render `message` + `lines` and no rows/nav; `grouping-unavailable` renders its message AND the flat rows.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `el`, `rebuild` (`clashpanel/ui/dom.js`, T28); `INTENT`; `vm.filters`, `vm.results` (catalog §4); `ResultRow`/`GroupHeaderRow` (catalog §4 `core/rows.js`); `PAGE_SIZE` (`clashpanel/core/constants.js`, read only by the test).
- Produces: `renderFilters(root, filters, dispatch, doc)`, `renderResults(root, results, dispatch, doc)`.
- **Depends on:** T28.

// test/clashpanel/dom/results.dom.mjs — Region 4 RESULTS: rows, groups, selection, Prev/Next, pagination, states (Task 29).
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { withPage, mountRenderer, rerender, intents } from './support/harness.mjs';

const RESULTS = ['/clashpanel/ui/render/results.js', 'renderResults'];
const PAGE_SIZE = 50; // mirrors clashpanel/core/constants.js PAGE_SIZE (asserted equal below)

test('results: a row shows #ordinal, Element 1 ↔ Element 2 with model chips, gap, badges and liveness', () => withPage(async ({ page }) => {

    resultRow(11, { gap: '0.031 scene units', badges: ['caveated', 'no location'], liveness: 'model not loaded' }),

  ] }));

    text: li.textContent,
    chips: [...li.querySelectorAll('.clash-chip')].map((c) => c.textContent),
  })));

    { text: '#12 Architecture · Wall-11 · #111 ↔ Structure · Beam-11 · #211 0.031 scene units caveated no location (model not loaded)', chips: ['Architecture', 'Structure'] },
    { text: '#13 Architecture · Wall-12 · #112 ↔ Structure · #212', chips: ['Architecture', 'Structure'] },
  ]);
}));

test('results: Prev/Next disabled per vm.nav; pagination ‹ n / N › dispatches nav/page and disables at the ends', () => withPage(async ({ page }) => {
  await mountRenderer(page, ...RESULTS, resultsVm({ page: { index: 1, count: 3, size: PAGE_SIZE }, nav: { canPrev: true, canNext: false, label: '12 of 812' } }));
  const r = await page.evaluate(() => ({

```js
// clashpanel/ui/render/filters.js — Region 3 FILTERS / GROUPING (spec §10, §14.4).
// Every change is dispatched IMMEDIATELY; debouncing (FILTER_DEBOUNCE_MS) and all filter/group/sort
// computation are the controller's job (AC-P4). Max gap is shown only when vm.filters.maxGap.visible (Soft).
import { el, rebuild, instanceNs } from '../dom.js';
import { INTENT } from '../../core/intents.js';

function checkbox(doc, key, label, checked, onChange) {
  return el(doc, 'label', { class: `clash-${key}` }, [
    el(doc, 'input', {
      attrs: { type: 'checkbox', 'data-key': key },
      props: { checked: Boolean(checked) },
      on: { change: (e) => onChange(e.target.checked) },
    }),
    el(doc, 'span', { text: label }),
  ]);
}

export function renderFilters(root, filters, dispatch, doc) {
  const ns = instanceNs(root);
  rebuild(root, doc, () => {
    // Single-select UI over a list-valued filter: several selected models (possible through the controller) are
    // shown honestly as one disabled, selected "Multiple models (n)" option; picking any real option replaces them.
    const multiple = filters.models.length > 1;
    const multipleOption = multiple
      ? el(doc, 'option', { attrs: { disabled: true, 'data-multiple': 'true' }, text: `Multiple models (${filters.models.length})` })
      : null;
    const modelSelect = el(doc, 'select', {
      attrs: { 'data-key': 'filter-model', 'aria-label': 'Model filter' },
      on: {
        change: (e) => {
          const option = e.target.selectedOptions[0];
          if (!option || option.hasAttribute('data-multiple')) return;
          dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_MODEL, value: option.value === '' ? [] : [option.value] });
        },
      },
    }, [
      multipleOption,
      el(doc, 'option', { attrs: { value: '' }, text: 'All models' }),
      ...filters.modelOptions.map((o) => el(doc, 'option', { attrs: { value: o.modelKey }, text: o.label })),
    ]);
    if (multiple) modelSelect.selectedIndex = 0;
    else modelSelect.value = filters.models.length === 1 ? filters.models[0] : '';

    const sortSelect = el(doc, 'select', {
      attrs: { 'data-key': 'sort', 'aria-label': 'Sort' },
      on: { change: (e) => dispatch({ type: INTENT.SORT_SET, value: e.target.value }) },
    }, filters.sortOptions.map((o) => el(doc, 'option', { attrs: { value: o.value }, text: o.label })));
    sortSelect.value = filters.sort;

    const groupRadio = (value, label) => el(doc, 'label', { class: `clash-group-${value}` }, [
      el(doc, 'input', {
        attrs: { type: 'radio', name: `${ns}-group-mode`, value, 'data-key': `group-${value}` },
        props: { checked: filters.groupBy === value },
        on: { change: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_MODE, value }) },
      }),
      el(doc, 'span', { text: label }),
    ]);

    const g = filters.maxGap;
    root.appendChild(el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-filters', attrs: { 'aria-busy': filters.busy ? 'true' : null } }, [
      el(doc, 'label', { class: 'clash-filter-text' }, [
        el(doc, 'span', { text: 'Filter ' }),
        el(doc, 'input', {
          attrs: { type: 'search', 'data-key': 'filter-text' },
          props: { value: filters.text },
          on: { input: (e) => dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_TEXT, value: e.target.value }) },
        }),
      ]),
      el(doc, 'label', { class: 'clash-filter-model' }, [el(doc, 'span', { text: 'Model ' }), modelSelect]),
      g.visible ? el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-filter-max-gap' }, [
        el(doc, 'label', {}, [
          el(doc, 'span', { text: g.max === null ? 'Max gap ' : `Max gap (≤ ${g.max}) ` }),
          el(doc, 'input', {
            attrs: { type: 'text', inputmode: 'decimal', 'data-key': 'filter-max-gap', 'aria-invalid': g.error ? 'true' : null },
            props: { value: g.value },
            on: { input: (e) => dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_MAX_GAP, value: e.target.value }) },
          }),
        ]),
        g.error ? el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-field-error', text: g.error }) : null,
      ]) : null,
      checkbox(doc, 'filter-unverified', 'Unverified only', filters.unverified,
        (value) => dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_UNVERIFIED, value })),
      checkbox(doc, 'filter-has-location', 'Has location', filters.hasLocation,
        (value) => dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_HAS_LOCATION, value })),
      filters.elementOnly ? el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-filter-element' }, [
        el(doc, 'span', { text: `Only clashes involving ${filters.elementOnly.label} ` }),
        el(doc, 'button', {
          attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'filter-element-clear' },
          text: 'Show all elements',
          on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_ELEMENT, ref: null }) },
        }),
      ]) : null,
      el(doc, 'fieldset', { class: 'clash-group', attrs: { role: 'radiogroup' } }, [
        el(doc, 'legend', { text: 'Group' }),
        groupRadio('none', 'None'),
        groupRadio('element', 'Element'),
      ]),
      filters.groupingNote ? el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-grouping-note', text: filters.groupingNote }) : null,
      el(doc, 'label', { class: 'clash-sort' }, [el(doc, 'span', { text: 'Sort ' }), sortSelect]),
      el(doc, 'button', {
        attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'filter-clear', disabled: !filters.active },
        text: 'Clear filters',
        on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_CLEAR }) },
      }),
      filters.busy ? el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-filters-busy', text: 'Updating results…' }) : null,
    ]));
  });
}
```

```js
// clashpanel/ui/render/results.js — Region 4 RESULTS (spec §8, §9.3, §12, §14.4 state coverage).
// Renders EXACTLY vm.results.rows (the controller already sliced one page, PAGE_SIZE); never more. Rows are
// focusable (tabindex 0) and Enter/Space select; the selected occurrence carries aria-selected="true".
import { el, rebuild } from '../dom.js';
import { INTENT } from '../../core/intents.js';

const LIST_STATES = new Set(['list', 'grouping-unavailable']);

function sideNodes(doc, side, cls) {
  const plainId = `#${side.dbId}`;
  return el(doc, 'span', { class: `clash-side ${cls}` }, [
    el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-chip', text: side.modelName }),
    el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-sep', text: ' · ' }),
    el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-label', text: side.label }),
    side.label === plainId ? null : el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-dbid', text: ` · ${plainId}` }),
  ]);
}

function resultRow(doc, row, dispatch) {
  const select = () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_SELECT, resultId: row.resultId, groupId: row.groupId ?? null });
  return el(doc, 'li', {
    class: row.selected ? 'clash-row clash-row-selected' : 'clash-row',
    attrs: { role: 'option', tabindex: '0', 'data-key': row.key, 'aria-selected': row.selected ? 'true' : 'false' },
    on: {
      click: select,
      keydown: (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); select(); }
      },
    },
  }, [
    el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-ordinal', text: `#${row.ordinal} ` }),
    sideNodes(doc, row.side1, 'clash-side-1'),
    el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-arrow', attrs: { 'aria-label': 'clashes with' }, text: ' ↔ ' }),
    sideNodes(doc, row.side2, 'clash-side-2'),
    row.gap !== null && row.gap !== undefined ? el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-gap', text: ` ${row.gap}` }) : null,
    ...row.badges.map((b) => el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-badge', text: ` ${b}` })),
    row.liveness !== 'live' ? el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-liveness', text: ` (${row.liveness})` }) : null,
  ]);
}

function groupRow(doc, row, dispatch) {
  const countText = row.filteredCount !== row.count ? `${row.filteredCount} of ${row.count}` : `${row.count}`;
  return el(doc, 'li', { class: 'clash-group-row', attrs: { role: 'presentation' } }, [
    el(doc, 'button', {
      attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': row.key, 'aria-expanded': row.expanded ? 'true' : 'false' },
      on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.GROUP_TOGGLE, groupId: row.groupId }) },
    }, [
      el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-group-twisty', text: row.expanded ? '▾ ' : '▸ ' }),
      el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-group-label', text: row.label }),
      el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-group-count', text: ` (${countText})` }),
    ]),
  ]);
}

function navBlock(doc, results, dispatch) {
  const { nav, page } = results;
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, page.count);
  return el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-nav' }, [
    el(doc, 'button', {
      attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'nav-prev', disabled: !nav.canPrev },
      text: '◀ Prev',
      on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_PREV }) },
    }),
    el(doc, 'button', {
      attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'nav-next', disabled: !nav.canNext },
      text: 'Next ▶',
      on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_NEXT }) },
    }),
    nav.label ? el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-nav-label', text: ` ${nav.label} ` }) : null,
    el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-page' }, [
      el(doc, 'button', {
        attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'page-prev', 'aria-label': 'Previous page', disabled: page.index <= 0 },
        text: '‹',
        on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_PAGE, page: page.index - 1 }) },
      }),
      el(doc, 'span', { class: 'clash-page-label', text: ` ${page.index + 1} / ${pageCount} ` }),
      el(doc, 'button', {
        attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'page-next', 'aria-label': 'Next page', disabled: page.index >= pageCount - 1 },
        text: '›',
        on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.NAV_PAGE, page: page.index + 1 }) },
      }),
    ]),
  ]);
}

export function renderResults(root, results, dispatch, doc) {
  rebuild(root, doc, () => {
    const box = el(doc, 'div', { class: 'clash-results', attrs: { 'data-state': results.state, 'data-view': results.view } });
    root.appendChild(box);
    if (results.message) box.appendChild(el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-results-message', text: results.message }));
    if (results.lines.length > 0) {
      box.appendChild(el(doc, 'ul', { class: 'clash-results-lines' }, results.lines.map((l) => el(doc, 'li', { text: l }))));
    }
    if (results.state === 'empty-filtered') {
      box.appendChild(el(doc, 'button', {
        attrs: { type: 'button', 'data-key': 'results-clear-filters' },
        text: 'Clear filters',
        on: { click: () => dispatch({ type: INTENT.FILTER_CLEAR }) },
      }));
    }
    if (results.multiValuedNote) box.appendChild(el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-multivalued-note', text: results.multiValuedNote }));
    if (results.hiddenByFiltersNote) {
      box.appendChild(el(doc, 'p', { class: 'clash-hidden-note', text: 'The selected clash is hidden by the current filters.' }));
    }
    if (!LIST_STATES.has(results.state)) return;
    box.appendChild(el(doc, 'ul', {
      class: 'clash-rows',
      attrs: { role: 'listbox', 'aria-label': 'Clash results' },
    }, results.rows.map((row) => (row.kind === 'group' ? groupRow(doc, row, dispatch) : resultRow(doc, row, dispatch)))));
    box.appendChild(navBlock(doc, results, dispatch));
  });
}
```

### Task 30: Renderer: Selected Clash actions + banners + hostile-text + a11y

**Tier:** **[B] fake/injected-port ViewerBridge/UI (pre-SVF2)**

**Files:**
- Create: `clashpanel/ui/render/selected.js`, `clashpanel/ui/render/panel.js`
- Modify: `test/clashpanel/scaffold.test.mjs` — append `'ui/render/selected.js'`, `'ui/render/panel.js'` to `EXPECTED_MODULES`
- Test: `test/clashpanel/dom/selected.dom.mjs`, `test/clashpanel/dom/panel.dom.mjs`

**Scope note:** `renderPanel` creates the five `<section data-region aria-label>` elements once (fixed order, headings `1 TEST SETUP` … `5 SELECTED CLASH`) and reuses them, so Region 2's single `aria-live="polite"` node survives. Keyboard: no positive `tabindex`; tab order = DOM order; every action is a native `<button type=button>`/`<input>`/`<select>`; rows are `tabindex=0` options. A disabled action shows its reason as `title` AND visible text (Isolate is disabled with a reason when the §9.5 prerequisite fails — the renderer only mirrors `vm.selected.actions`). Banners are rendered by T28's `renderRun` (kind class, `role=alert` for errors, details list); this task adds their AC-P13 coverage. AC-P13 hostile test: model names (setup list, filter options, row chips, detail), element labels (rows, detail, element-only chip), group labels, banner text + details + action labels, the diagnostics preview, Run-details rows, validation messages, results error lines, headline/status, input values — with a negative control proving the probe detects markup parsing. **Review Focus pin RF-5 (real browser):** 10,000-character names WITHOUT spaces (model name, element label, group label, banner text, validation message, Run-details value) render as inert text of full length, the 420px panel root and every section/row/banner/select keep `scrollWidth <= clientWidth`, and the element count equals the short-name render (no per-character nodes). This needs layout CSS as part of the ui implementation: `renderPanel` inserts ONE `<style id="clash-panel-style">` per document, built with `el()` and `textContent` (no markup parsing; no separate stylesheet file, so the host loads nothing extra), and tags its root `clash-panel-root` (`overflow-wrap:anywhere`, `min-width:0`, `max-width:100%`, fieldset `min-inline-size:0`). Plan-time negative control: emptying that style makes RF-5 fail.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `el`, `rebuild` (T28); `renderSetup`, `renderRun` (T28); `renderFilters`, `renderResults` (T29); `INTENT`; `vm.selected` (catalog §4; `side1/side2` assumed `{modelKey, modelName, label, dbId}` like `ResultRow.side1`).
- Produces: `renderSelected(root, selected, dispatch, doc)`; `renderPanel(root, vm, dispatch, doc)` (also ensures the `clash-panel-style` element once per document); `REGIONS` (frozen `[{id, heading, part, render}]`); `PANEL_STYLE_ID`, `PANEL_CSS` (presentation CSS text, not options).
- **Depends on:** T28, T29.

    filters: filtersVm({ active: true, maxGap: { visible: true, value: '', max: 1, error: null }, elementOnly: { modelKey: 'mA', dbId: 1, label: 'W' } }),
    results: resultsVm({ view: 'grouped', rows: [groupRow('g'), resultRow(0, { groupId: 'g', key: 'g|r0' })], page: { index: 1, count: 3, size: 50 }, nav: { canPrev: true, canNext: true, label: '' } }),

  await mountRenderer(page, ...PANEL, vm);
  const r = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const { INTENT } = await import('/clashpanel/core/intents.js');
    // <summary> only opens its native disclosure (presentational); every other keyed control dispatches.
    const controls = [...document.querySelectorAll('#clash-root [data-key]')].filter((n) => !n.disabled && n.tagName !== 'SUMMARY');
    const checkedRadios = controls.filter((n) => n.type === 'radio' && n.checked).length; // clicking these fires no change
    for (const n of controls) {
      if (n.tagName === 'SELECT') { n.value = n.options[n.options.length - 1].value; n.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); }
      else if (n.tagName === 'INPUT' && (n.type === 'text' || n.type === 'search')) { n.value = `${n.value}1`; n.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); }

    const types = window.__clash.intents.map((i) => i.type);
